tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos le
༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos le

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ dharma shwa ra mo ha badz+ra ā tsar+ya bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka saṅgu ru shrī kā la tsakra ya na ma/ bod skad du/ chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon chen po rje btsun bla ma dam pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med bla ma'i mchog gyur bla ma dang / /dus gsum dus med gzigs pa'i dus 'khor lo/ /dbyer med dbye ba'i tshul ston dbye ba'i gzhi/ /'dren mdzad 'dren pa'i gtsug rgyan 'dren mchog rgyal/ /bstan pa'i snying po dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam/ /lam mchog rgya bod ljongs 'dir gsal mdzad gang / /gang zhig rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ /'dud do bdag kyang khyed 'drar 'gyur bar shog /dus 'khor rgyud dang man ngag 'chad pa dang / /nyams su len la nyer mkho'i bstan bcos mchog /sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun legs bshad pa'i/ /dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de'i zab mo'i rgyud la gzhan gyi log rtog gi cha bsal ba/ dri ma med pa'i bka' srol gyi rgyud dang man ngag 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ sham bha la'i yul du ji ltar byon tshul/ de nas 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar byon tshul/ de nas bod yul du ji ltar byon tshul lo/

/dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i lo gnyis pa la rgyal po zla ba bzang pos rtsa rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad nas/ sham bha la la sogs pa'i yul gyi mi rnams la bstan cing / ma la ya'i tshal gyi dbus su dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rgyu rin po che sna lnga las bzhengs te rdzu 'phrul bstan nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po dang / gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan rnams kyis lo brgya brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan no/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs grags pas kyang lo brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan nas/ de'i rjes su nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa drang srong rnams kyis gsol ba btab nas bsdus pa'i rgyud phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad stong sum cu pa 'di rtsa ba'i rgyud las phyung ste bsdu ba mdzad do/ /de la ye le'i tshigs bcad nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa man chad bcu dang nang le'i tshigs bcad bsham ma ste/ bcu gcig po de grags pa dang / nyi ma'i shing rta'i gsung yin gyi/ rtsa rgyud las bsdus pa ma yin yang / lhag ma stong sum bcu'o/ /zhes kha cig bzhed kyang / shong 'gyur la ye shes le'ur khyim bcu gnyis khams drug dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad gcig chad kyang / gyi co dang rma'i 'gyur la ma chad par yod pas ye le'i tshigs bcad bsham ma bcu dang 'jig rten khams le'i tshigs bcad brgya zhe dgu pa dang / nang le'i tshigs bcad bsham ma ste bcu gnyis po de/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang nyi ma'i shing rta'i gsung yin gyi/ rtsa rgyud las bsdus pa ma yin pas de dag gi lhag ma tshigs bcad stong dang sum cu yin par gsal lo/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs grags pas spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sras pad+ma dkar po la bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di ston cing rgyas 'grel rtsom par bskos te mya ngan las 'das so/

/de nas pad+ma dkar pos rgyas 'grel stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mdzad cing chos bstan to/ /de nas bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / gshin rje bzang po dang / rin chen phyag dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags dang / shin tu bzang po ste brgyad pos lo brgya brgyar chos bstan cing / de nas rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / rgyal dka' gnyis kyis lo bzhi brgya dang gsum gyi bar du chos bstan to/ de nas nyi ma dang sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang / dpal skyong dang / seng ge dang / rnam rnon dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gag pa dang / mi'i seṅge dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / 'khor lo can rigs ldan drag po ste bcu gnyis pos kyang lo brgya brgyar chos bstan cing / drag pos kla klo 'joms par mdzad do/ /'di la kha cig mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gnyis su bgrangs nas/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug yin no/ /zhes 'chad kyang / gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes drag po rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nang du 'dus par gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /bla ma bi bhū ta tsaṇ+ḍa ni/ seng ge rnam gnon gcig mtha' yas rnam rgyal gcig tu byas nas/ mjug gi grags pa dang drag po tha dad du byas te rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngar bzhed ces kyang gsung ngo // ༈ //'di skabs kyi chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi grangs la/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang / stag tshang lo tsā ba/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po/ mkhas pa ran+da ma ti sogs kyi bzhed srol mi mthun pa du ma snang yang / 'dir bkod pa ni jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i lugs dang dper mthun par spyi lam pa'i bshad tshul tsam bstan pa yin la/

rang lugs ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bzhed pa bzhin/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dus 'khor gtan tshigs su gsungs pa ltar/ kho bos byas pa'i dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo'i gtan tshigs kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin 'thad ldan du bzung bar bya zhing / gzhan yang rigs ldan gyi sprul gzhi dang / chos ston pa'i lo grangs kyi bshad tshul mi mthun pa sogs kyi mtha' gcod kyi yi ge rgyas pa zhig logs su 'chad par bdag spro'o/ /gnyis pa de nas 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar byon tshul la/ 'bro ba'i bzhed pa'i lugs dang / ra pa'i bzhed pa'i lugs gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rigs ldan dpal skyong chos ston pa'i dus su/ rgya gar du gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yab yum gnyis kyis/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud nas 'byung pa bzhin du rigs kyi sras skrun pa'i cho ga byas pas khye'u gnyis 'khrungs te cher skyes pa dang / byang phyogs na byang chub sems dpa' dngos su chos ston pa yod par grags pas nyan du byon pa la khye'u'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang chos la 'dun pa dang sham+bha lar 'ongs na tshe'i bar chad du 'gro bar mkhyen nas dpal skyong byon te/ der khyod kyis 'gro bar mi nus chu med pa'i mya ngan gyi thang la zla ba bzhi 'gro dgos pas srog gi bar chad du 'gro/ nga yis 'ongs la bshad gsungs nas zla ba bzhi gsungs/ dang po gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen nang byang chub sems dpa'i skor gsum la sogs pa rgyud sde mang po thugs la bzung nas byon pas 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin par grags shing / de'i mtshan yang dus 'khor zhabs zhes zer ro/ /de ltar sngon gyi lo rgyus la dus 'khor zhabs chen po'i dus na rigs ldan dpal skyong chos ston par grags kyang khungs dang rgyu mtshan ci yang mi snang zhing / rigs ldan rnams kyi chos bstan pa'i tshad dang kla klo'i gnas tshad dang ma kha'i yul du kla klo zhugs nas lo ji snyed 'das pa dang /

byed rtsis kyi lo dag logs par brtsis pa rnams dang mi 'grig cing nang 'gal 'byung bas ma dag par shes par bya'o/ /des na rigs ldan rgyal dka' 'das nas nyi ma chos ston pa'i mgo 'dzugs pa'i dus byed rtsis kyi rab byung la sogs 'das lo bsre ba'i mgo 'dzugs pa tsam gyi dus su dus 'khor zhabs chen po byon par gsal te bla ma brgyud pa phyi ma phyi mas snga ma snga ma'i zhabs la zin pa tsam gyi lo grangs kyi tshe tshad dang yang 'grigs par snang ngo / /de ltar dus 'khor zhabs chen po byon pa'i dus su rgya gar na dge slong blo shin tu rtul ba gcig gis lhas bstan pa'i rmi lam la brten nas/ byi ru la lha mo ku ru kul+le'i sku byas te bud med kyi ro'i khar bcug nas rgyab tu skyil krung bcas te zhag bdun bsgrubs pas kha gyen du bltas te ci 'dod zer ba la/ mthong tshad zin par 'dod byas kyang 'ong ba yin pa la blo rtul bas zhum pas dris zin tshad zin par 'dod byas pas de ltar byung pas paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa zhes bya ba khar+sa pa ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du byung / des slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs la rgyud sde du shes dris/ slob dpon gyis lan gsungs pas rgyud kyi ming tsam yang 'dzin par ma nus skad/ de la slob ma mang po byung pa las phal cher rnal 'byor par gyur nas bshad pa'i srol 'dzin pa/ sras na len+d+ra pa dus 'khor zhabs chung bar grags pa snga ma lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin skad/ lo rgyus kha cig tu dus 'khor zhabs chung pa dang / sras na len+d+ra pa yab sras yin par yang 'chad do/ /de'i dus kha cher bram ze zhig gi bu zla mgon zhes bya ba blo shin tu rno ba zhig byung pas yab mu stegs pa la dad pas mu stegs kyi chos rnams lo bcu gnyis la shes/ yum sangs rgyas pa yin pas nga yi chos slob dgos zer nas/ kha che bram ze zhabs zhes bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta la nyan du bcug pas/

zla mgon de gzugs mdzes par yod pas paṇ+ḍi ta'i sras mo na re/ nga dang lhan gcig 'grogs na chos shod zer/ de ltar khas blangs nas nang pa'i chos mang po gsan/ de nas dbang mdor bstan gyi dpe gzigs pas shin tu mos te ma ga dhar byon pa dang / dus 'khor zhabs yab sras dang mjal/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum rnams zhus so/ /mkhas pa kha che rin chen rdo rje dang rtsod pa byas pas zla mgon ma thub/ rin chen rdo rje na re/ nga la slob ma mi dad par 'ong gzhan du byon gsungs/ de nas chos 'di bod du spel dgongs nas bod du byon no/ /de dag ni 'bro ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ gnyis pa rwa pa'i lugs kyi dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i skor du grags pa 'di rnams rgya gar du rgyal po gsum gyi ring la byung ste/ de yang rdo rje gdan na dbus su bzhag pa'i shar phyogs na/ ga dza pa ti glang po che skyong pa'i rgyal po de ha pa la dang / lho phyogs na na ra pa ti mi skyong pa'i rgyal po dza'u gaṅgā pa/ nub phyogs na a shwa ba dhi rta skyong ba'i rgyal po ka nu du dza zhes pa yod pa'i tshe byung ngo / /de la rgya gar shar phyogs na yul sde lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ or bi'i sar sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po sde snod thams cad la thugs sbyangs pa'i tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas rat+na gi ri bi ha ra dang / bi kra ma shi la dang / na len+d+ra rnams su sde snod kyi po ti thams cad gzigs shing khyad par du/ du ru ka'i gnod pa med pa rin chen ri bor gzigs pas/ spyir sangs rgyas tshe gcig gis 'grub pa la sngags kyi theg pa dgos shing / khyad par byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa gsal bar byas pa dgos la/ de sham+bha la na yod par mkhyen nas yi dam gyi lhas lung bstan pa la brten nas/ rgya mtshor nor bu len pa'i tshong pa dang 'grogs te/ rgya mtsho la brgal ba dang tshong pa rnams dang zla ba drug gi 'dzom dus byas te lam so sor zhugs so/

/de nas slob dpon gyis rim gyis byon nas ri gcig gi steng du 'dzegs pa dang mi zhig dang phrad pas de na re/ khyod gar 'gro zer ba la sham+bha lar byang chub sems dpa'i chos skor 'tshol du 'gro byas pas/ de ni shin tu bgrod dka' ste shes pa byung na 'dir yang mnyan pas chog mod gsungs pa dang / 'jam dpal gyi sprul par shes te phyag byas maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba btab pas/ dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag mtha' dag gnang zhing rjes su bzung nas me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i skor ma lus pa khong du chud par gyur cig ces byin gyis brlabs pas chu snod gcig tu byo ba ltar byang chub sems dpa'i skor ma lus pa khong du chud par gyur to/ /tshur byon pa dang tshong pa rnams dang 'dzom ste slar rgya gar shar phyogs su byon no/ /yang lugs gcig la tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta de rnal 'byor pa gcig gi bu yin pas pha yis sham+bha lar khrid nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dge slong shin tu gzugs bzang ba gcig dang mjal te/ des byin gyis brlabs pas zhag re la sh+lau ka stong stong zin par gyur te/ rgyud 'grel thams cad thugs la bzung nas rgya gar du byon te/ rab tu byung pa'i mtshan tsi lu pa zhes grags so/ /de nas slob dpon des ka ta ka'i rgyal po'i sar bzhugs pas/ slob ma gsum byung ste/ de rnams kyis rgyud 'grel rnams glegs bam la 'bri bar zhus nas bris so/ /slob ma gcig tha mal pa gcig byung / gcig rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes pa grub pa brnyes pa gcig byung / gcig shar phyogs bhang gar sku 'khrungs pa'i bi to ar+ya 'am/ paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya zhes pa mkhas pa zhig byung ste/ des byang chub sems dpa'i skor ma lus pa thugs su chud cing thugs nyams su bzhes so/ /de nas yul der rgyal po gzhan gyi dmag byung ste/ rgyud 'grel gyi dpe thams cad dong du sbas te bros so/

/dmag gyes nas bltas pas bde dgyes gnyis kyi smad mi 'dug nas 'bri bar zhus nas/ mkha' 'gro mas sbas par 'brir mi rung gsungs nas ma gnang / tsi lu pa ba slar rgya gar shar phyogs su gshegs so/ /de nas paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya des/ ba ren trar sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon dus zhabs pa chen po la gsungs shing / des kyang sngar bzhin du mkhyen cing thugs nyams su bzhes so/ /kha cig na re/ dus zhabs pa de sgrol ma'i zhal mthong nas ci 'dod pa zhu ru yod pas sgrol mas lung bstan/ sham+bha lar byon te spyan ras gzigs kyis lam nas bsus nas ma la ya'i tshal gyi khang par khrid de/ dbang bskur rgyud 'grel rnams bshad nas dpe thams cad kyang gnang ste byon no/ /de nas rgya gar shar phyogs me tog khyim zhes bya bar bzhugs pas slob ma'i mchog bzhi byung ste/ dus zhabs pa chung ngu dang gdul ba 'byung gnas blo gros dang / seng ge rgyal mtshan dang mtha' yas rnams so/ /de la dus zhabs pa chung ba ni/ mañdzu ha ste de shar phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ mtshan bo dhi pa zhes kyang zer/ na len+d+ra pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /dus zhabs pa snga ma lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa des rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa ma ga dhar dar na thams cad du dar bar 'gyur snyam du dgongs nas/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po shing stan can gyis byed cing / sen dha pas o d+yan+ta bu ri'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang du rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi sngags bris/ de'i 'og tu gang gis mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa des mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes so/ /zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam dang bral ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar bris pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam bzhugs pa rnams ma rangs par brtsad pas chos kyi rang bzhin zab cing rgya che bas thams cad btul nas/ slob par gyur te/ khyad par du/ mañdzu kirti dang / a bhi mug ta dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ri bo pa dang /

dā byang chub sems dpa' dang / a bha ya dang / pūṇ+ya chen po dang / kha che gam+bhi ra dang / shan+ta gup+ta dang / gu na rak+ṣa ta dang / zla mgon dang / tsa mi la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang du byung zhing rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ tshong pa la sogs pa rnams kyang dad nas dpe 'bri zhing bag chags 'jog pa mang du byung ste/ shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /de nas bal po ye rang du sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta bha dras mkhas pa lnga la gsan cing / khyad par mañdzu kirti rjes su 'brang ngo / /gsum pa de nas bod yul du ji ltar byon pa'i tshul la yang / 'bro pa'i bla ma rnams dang / ra pa'i bla ma dag gi bzhed lugs gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ de nas kha che zla mgon bod du byon zhing kha rag nyos la babs/ 'grel ba dri ma med pa'i 'od bsgyur/ gser srang brgya rdzong bar chad/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma mgu bar 'grel pa phyed las ma bsgyur/ 'gyur byed 'phro bsnams nas 'phan yul brab tu byon/ zhag pho chung bas bla mar bzung / 'bros lo tsā ba byas nas yongs su rdzogs pa bsgyur/ gnyos kyis zhang ston la khyod kyis nga'i bla ma phrogs pa yin pas sba ba'i gseb tu nyung kar rtseng ba gcig bya yi zer ba la/ khro bo brgya yis bsdigs kyang mi 'jigs/ lha mo brgya yis 'dzum bstan kyang mi chags pa yin zer nas zhabs tog mdzad/ gnyos ston ye shes mchog gis gser srang bco brgyad phul/ gra pa mngon shes kyis lo gsum chos ston drangs/ nam mjal dus phyag rten ma chad par byas/ rje btsun tshul khrims rin chen gyis gser srang drug phul/ g.yo ru pa 'gar ston/ mang yul ston ma sri thar smon gro'i 'jam sgom la sogs pas zhabs tog che bar byas kyang / so sor cung zad tsam ma gtogs pa gzhan ma gnang / 'phan yul brab tu sku 'khrungs pa'i bsgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs zhes pa mngon pa dang / sa sde dang / sman dpyad kyi gtsug lag la shin tu mkhas shing yon tan che bar grags pa de nyid kyis 'byor pa thams cad bsdus pas gser srang drug byung pa dang bdag nyid kyi ske la dar yug gcig btags te lus phul nas zhabs tog yun ring du mdzad cing /

ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bsgrubs pas gzhung gdam ngag dang bcas pa rnams ma lus par gnang ngo / /bla ma 'di nyid kyi phyi rten ring bsrel mang po 'byung ba zhig 'phan yul rag ma'i nang na dus ding sang yang 'dug par grags so/ /bla ma sgro ston gnam la rtsegs ni 'phan yul sgro rigs su sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la dbus sde'i dge bshes lo ro pa'i drung du g.yu che chung 'dres pa phul/ gang brgyags su bsnams nas byon te/ lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyis bar du slob gnyer rgya cher mdzad do/ /lo ro ba'i zhal nas mchims sngags pa chen po gcig yod pa la 'di rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ nga kun 'di la ltos na ba lang dang 'dra bar 'dug /'on kyang nga yis kyang lā+o tsa ba chen po leng shākya brtson 'grus/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mgos khug pa lhas btsas gsum la thug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar song ste dus 'khor shes pa gcig ma byung na da dung ba glang dang mtshungs par 'dug gsungs nas bla ma gnam la rtsegs dus 'khor la shin tu dad de/ dus 'khor su yis shes dris pas paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā thas mkhyen zer nas de ma thag der byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta la gser srang bcu gnyis dang rta nag gcig phul nas zhabs tog yun ring du byas kyang so sor spong tsam las ma gnang / bla ma dkon mchog bsrung la'ang gser nyung ngu phul nas zhus kyang paṇ+ḍi ta'i rgya yod gsungs nas ma gnang ngo / /de nas paṇ+ḍi ta rgya gar la gshegs pa'i shul du snor bzangs su lo gsum dang / yer par lo gsum bla ma lha rje go bteg mdzad de zhus pas gdam ngag kun rdzogs par gnang ngo / /phyis paṇ+ḍi ta bod du byon pa'i dus su lha rje bsgom pas sgro ston la gzhung gdam ngag ma lus pa byin 'dug ces pa gsan/ sgro ston dang mjal ma thag chos gang 'dod pa sbyin no gsungs pa la/ gzhon pa'i dus su ni rdzogs par gnang du ma 'dod/

da rgas pas mi zhu lags byas pas/ khyod dkon mchog bsrungs kyi chos kyis ngoms 'dug ste/ de nga las ma byung na su las byung gsungs nas phyag phab bo/ /sgro ston gyis de shin tu mad lags/ bla ma chen po'i bka' drin lags zhes zhus pas/ chos gang gang byin zhes gsungs la/ 'di dang 'di rnams gnang lags zhes zhus pas/ de rnams las lhag pa nga la'ang med/ thams cad tshang 'dug pas su la'ang ma ster/ gzhan la ster ri mna' skyol gsungs nas/ mgul pa la phreng pa bcug pa dang / bla mas ni rdzogs par ma gnang / bla ma dkon mchog bsrungs la zhus pa lags mod ces zhus pas/ phreng ba phud de/ ngan pa 'di gsungs nas dbu la bye ma spar gang brgyab ste da chud ma gson gsungs pa la/ de skad gsung mi 'tshal/ chud ci la gson/ zhes zhus te bkur bsti du ma mdzad de paṇ+ḍi ta mnyes par mdzad do/ /de ltar paṇ+ḍi ta dang bla ma dkon mchog bsrung la byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum gzhung gdam ngag cha lag dang bcas pa ma lus par gsan no/ /de nyid kyi phyi rten mchod rten zhig 'phan yul gyi sgro ris gnas sgang zhes bya ba na bzhugs pa/ zhig pa'i sa 'bur tsam 'dug pa la ding sang yang ring bsrel du ma rnyed cing 'dug ces thos so/ /bla ma yu mo ni gdung rus rngam zhes pa yin zhing / yab rngam khro bo zhes pa yin la/ gangs te se'i rtsar sku 'khrungs shing sku mched bzhi yod pa'i chung pa yin no/ /rim gyis la stod lhor byon nas dgung lo bcu pa la lho mcher gnas su mkhan po stag rol gzhon byang bzhugs pa la/ rab tu byung te mtshan 'dogs pa'i dus na/ khyed kyi gdung rus rngam du 'dug dad pa shin tu che ba gcig 'dug pas/ rngam btsun dad pa rgyal po zhes bya bar 'dogs so/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de ltar mtshan btags mkhan po la chos gsan cing lo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas don mo rir byon te/ se ston sgra gcan 'dzin dang / dge gnas su bar ston thos pa dga'i drung du mngon pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i skor mang du gsan/

khong rang nyid kyis yu mo zhes mtshan bla dwags su btags so/ /de nas dpa' dge mthong dang / snyegs la dbu ma dang tshad ma gsan/ de nas 'dul pa gsan par dgongs pa la/ de dus sogs 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhas par grags pas/ de'i drung du byon te 'dul ba'i skor rnams gsan cing mdo rtsa rdzogs par thugs la gsungs/ spyod phyogs rnams kyang gsan/ kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i sngags kyi skor yang gsan cing bzhugs so/ /grogs gcig gis dgun ci byed ces 'dri ba la/ mtshams byas nas sngags kyi dpe 'dra 'bri gsungs pas/ 'o na kho na re byan lag tshang na rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa'i dpe 'dug zer bas de 'bri 'am zhes zer ba thos pas sngon gyi bag chags sad de dad pas spu zing gyur to/ /dpe g.yar du khugs sam zhes dris pas/ khugs so zhes zer nas g.yar te 'bri zhing gzigs pas shin tu dad de 'di 'chad pa yod dam zhes dris pas/ so ma nā tha zhes bya bas 'chad ces grag go /zhes zer nas/ sngon gyi mi gcig rang yin nam snyam nas rtsad legs par ma gcad gsungs/ de nas khams pa lte'u ba la spyod phyogs gsan pa la dbus su byon nas chos gsan cing bzhugs pa'i dus na paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po skar chung na bzhugs zer ba gsan/ der sngar gyi gtam dran te/ des rdor snying 'grel pa mkhyen nam zhes dris pas/ der ma zad kyi spyir gsang sngags tsam la mkhas/ khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa chen pos thog drangs pa 'grel pa skor gsum la mkhas par grags so/ /zhes gsungs/ zhus na gnang ngam zhes dris pas/ spyir bka' dog ste/ da lta bal yul du gshegs par chas pa la zhabs tog pa ma rnyed 'dug zer bas zhabs tog la 'gro nus na gnang 'ong gsungs/ der dges bzhin du mjal du byon nas/ sum pa rdo rje gzhon nu la mjal ba dang chos zhu ba'i sna bo bcol te phyin pa na paṇ+ḍi ta dang bla ma gnam la rtsegs kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags dang yi ge brgya ba la zhus dag mdzad cing 'dug pa'i tshe mjal zhing chos 'brel zhus pas sngags gnyis po la bshad pa mdzad de gsungs/

chang dkar yol gang yang gnang bas ma 'thungs pa la bla mas gnang ba mi 'thung ba khyod gtangs zhan che zhes gzhan gyis 'phya ba byung zhes 'ga' zhig zer ro/ /paṇ+ḍi tas gser thig po dang gla rtsi'i rkyal pa mang po bstan nas 'di rnams khyed kyis bal yul du 'khur nus shing mgo thon na/ de nas bod du slar 'ongs la chos gang dgos sbyin no gsungs/ de bzhin du bya'o snyam nas bsgom pa tshul grags la dpe cha rnams bcol ba len du byon pas khyod gar 'gro zer ba la lo rgyus rnams bsnyad pas paṇ+ḍi ta la chos mi khugs/ sngar yang mang pos ma khugs pa yin/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos rnams cis kyang don du gnyer na nged kyi bla ma snor bzang pas rdzogs par mkhyen pas der zhus pas mi 'thad dam zhes zer bas blo 'gyur te/ ston pa rgyal 'od/ sgom pa dbang bsod/ sgom pa tshul grags gsum la zhu sna bcol/ gser zho 'ga' zhig dang / dung chos legs pa gcig ka pā la gcig rnams phul bas mnyes te/ khyod kyi 'bul pa 'di rnams kyang la nye bzang sog 'dul ba 'dzin pa de dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan gcig yod pa 'dug ste de'ang thugs zin pa yin zer bas khyed la yon tan ci yod pa yin te 'ong gsungs nas chos gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ bla ma dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang mjal te lo bzhi'i bar bar ma chad du bsten nas 'grel pa skor gsum gyi gzhung man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa dang / mtshan brjod man ngag gi bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus sgron gsal la sogs pa gsan pa'i dus su bla ma bag tsam bsnyung pa na gtsang stod 'di la chos ma phogs kyi bar du nga ma gsod ces mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba btab nas gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par gnang ngo / /de nas 'u yug tu dgung lo lnga bcu pa la byon nas nub ma'i mda' rgyas khab ces par gzhi phab ste/ phu ru dben gnas kyang mdzad cing dgag tshang gyi phu'i brag phug tu'ang thugs dam yun ring du mdzad nas grub pa thob ste/

dbang dang zab lam gyi khrid dang 'grel ba skor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa'i gzhung bshad mang du gsungs/ gdam pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du bzhugs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa yin no/ /bla ma de nyid kyis dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga par rigs kyi sras bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pa las sras dharma shwa ra 'khrungs te/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis klog yig gzhon nu la mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la dbang mdor bstan gsungs/ bcu drug pa nas 'grel chen gyis thog drangs pa'i sems 'grel skor gsum gsungs la/ gzhan yang spyod phyogs kyi dbu tshad dang / lam rim dang sngags kyi rgyud sde dang sgrub thabs mang po rnams dgung lo sum cu'i bar du slob gnyer mdzad cing mkhas par sbyangs nas gzhan phan rgya chen po yang mdzad do/ /bla ma de nyid kyi sras grub thob nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes pa gtsang gi 'o lung gi se mo che'i dgon par bzhugs pa la/ grub thob se mo che zhes grags pa de nyid kyis yab la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sems 'grel skor gsum gdam ngag dang bcas pa rnams thob cing / 'grel chung pad+ma can dang sgrub thabs man ngag phran tshegs 'ga' zung yab kyi sprul sku jo 'bum las kyang thob la/ rje btsun yu mos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig dang / yab kyis mdzad pa'i ro bcud stong thun la sogs pa dang / 'bro pa'i bla ma gong ma'i gsungs bgros bsgrigs pa 'od zer 'phreng ba dang / rje btsun khyung gis mdzad pa'i dri med rgyan rnams ni/ 'gos dbang btsan las rigs tshogs la sogs pa gsan cing / yab kyi bu chen khang gsar pa mkhas par grags pa nam mkha' 'od las yab chos mang du gsan/ bla ma 'di pa ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor pas mngon shes chags thogs med pa brnyes la lung bstan pa rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du byung zhing sku tshe mang po dran la rdzu 'phrul du ma'ang ston par mdzad ces thos so/

/bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar gyi yi ge yang yod cing / skye ba 'di dang 'dir 'khrungs pa'i ri mo ras bris su bris pa da lta yang 'dug ces thos la/ grub thob chen por rtsod med du grags so/ /bla ma de nyid phar tshad mngon gsum la sogs pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i chos rje mngon gra pa rin chen rtse mo zhes grags pa bo dong er bzhugs pa de nyid dang / sde snod dang rgyud sde du ma la dbang 'byor pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma shes rab 'od zer zhes grags pa 'dol chung dang / rkyang 'dur du bzhugs pa des g.yas ru smon mkhar gyi grong chung dgon par gdan drangs nas dbang dang gdam ngag ma lus par zhus/ sems 'grel skor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas dbang dang gzhung bshad gdam ngag mang du spel zhing 'gro ba'i don rgya chen mdzad do/ /'di nyid la ma ngag dge sdings dang rgya ro gser sdings su bzhugs pa'i sngags mtshan nyid du ma la mnga' brnyes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po chos kyi 'od zer zhes thog mar grags shing 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas chos sku 'od zer zhes btags pas/ phyis de ltar grags pa de nyid kyis/ sems 'grel skor gsum gyi dbang gi dam tshig gzhung bshad bcas par rdzogs par gsan pa bla ma de nyid la/ ngas phyar spang sgang du sku 'khrungs pa'i chos rje kun spangs chen po zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus zhes grags la/ jo nang pa chen po zhes kyang grags pa mtshan nyid theg pa dang rgyud sde du ma la mkhas par sbyangs shing / gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gter mdzod du gyur pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor zhing mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba chos rje 'jam dbyangs chen po bzhi thog pa dang / mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams seng ge la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyes mchog du ma smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa de nyid kyis bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob pa yin no/

/de nyid la chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba skor gsum gyi gzhung gdam ngag dang bcas pas thog drangs pa zab cing rgya che ba'i chos dpag tu med pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob par mdzad pa yin te/ chos rje 'di'i 'khrungs yul ni mdog stod kyi men pa yin zhing gzhon nu la rab tu byung nas thugs rje rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan du btags la/ mdar du mdar byang skyabs dang slob dpon spyang ston gyi drung du bsnyen nas dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa dang tshad ma rnam par nges pa/ rigs gter rnams mkhas par mdzad nas bshad pa dang / grwa skor yang mdzad nas/ gdan sa chen po dpal sa skyar byon nas/ bla ma chen po dus 'khor ba ye shes kyi drung du/ dus 'khor dang kyai rdo rje'i rgyud dang / mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs pa gsan cing / bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa chen po la kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gdam ngag dang bcas pa dang / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ spyod 'jug la sogs pa mang du gsan/ bu ston kun bzang dpal la mngon rtogs rgyan/ tshad ma rnam nges/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa la sogs pa mang du gsan cing / mkhyen par mdzad nas/ rje dus 'khor ba'i phyag phyir la gong du byon cing / bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas thugs dam la gzhol bar dgongs te/ bod yul du gshegs par nan gyis zhus nas gdan sar byon cing / de ma khad jo mo nang du byon nas/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang / de'i thugs kyi sras kyi thu bor gyur pa chos rje byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes zhes yongs su grags pa las/ sems 'grel skor gsum la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba'i gzhung dang gdam ngag du ma'i bang mdzod du gyur cing mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can la mnga' brnyes pa la brten te/ ri khrod chen po de nyid las gang du yang ma g.yos par chos rje yab sras kyi yon tan rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thos par mdzad nas lo sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du thugs dam zab lam gyi ting nge 'dzin la g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i ngang nas gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/

/gnyis pa ra pa'i bla ma rim par brgyud pa'i tshul ni/ snyan nam snang yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i ra lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi dbon po ra chos rab kyis ra pa lugs kyi nag 'jigs skor gsungs/ mngon 'byung rnam gsum/ a bhi dha na dang saṃ bhu ṭi la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / chos 'byung drug pa la sogs pa ra pa'i chos skor ma lus pa rnams thugs su chud nas dus kyi 'khor lo don du gnyer bar gyur te bal po'i mthil du byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī la lo lnga zla ba bcu zhag lngar bar ma chad par brten nas bshad bka' dbang bka' man ngag gi bka' dang bcas pa zhus pas legs par gnang ste paṇ+ḍi ta bod du spyan drangs nas rgyud 'grel yan lag dang bcas pa bshad bsgyur gtan la phab/ dngos po thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur cher byas te nyi ma gcig la gser srang sum brgya phul/ gshegs skyel yang skyid rong gi bar du mdzad pas bla ma yang shin tu mnyes te paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i prog zhu chags lham rdo rje dril bu dus 'khor lugs kyi phyag tshad ma gnang ngo / /de la nyid kyi sras bla ma ye shes seng ges gsan cing des kyang bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs la mkhyen cing thugs nyams su bzhes so/ /de la nyid kyi sras ra 'bum seng ges yongs su rdzogs par gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes so/ /de la bla ma rga los zhus so/ /bla ma rga lo ni/ bod kyi rgyal po'i dus su mi nyag ha shang zhes bya ba mchod gnas su spyan drangs sngags 'chang sha stag tu gyur pa'i rgyud las byung pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs shing / yab kyis grub thob dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gdan sa rong gi dben dmar bzung ngo / /yab kyi mtshan ltas la brten nas sngon gyi khams pa rga lo tsā ba'i skye bar dgongs nas mtshan du'ang de nyid btags/ lo gsum tsam bzhes pa na/

kha che paṇa chen ngur smig tu byon pa'i tshe/ ma gcig jo sras ma skyid mos bsnams nas chos dang byin rlabs zhu ru byon pa la gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par saṃ skri ti'i skad kyis lung bstan/ phyag gis zhams/ dbugs phyung bas skye bo 'dus pa phal cher gyis skyes bu dam par rtogs shing / rje btsun rang gi gsung gis kyang / byis pa'i dus na kha che ba'i/ /bla ma paṇa chen nyid dang mjal/ /legs sbyar skad kyis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /ces so/ /gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe yab kyi drung du 'bri klog dang yab kyis mkhyen pa'i chos rnams la sbyangs pa mdzad nas/ lo tsā ba dpyal chos kyi bzang po'i drung du rgya yig dang rgya klog dang saṃ skri ta'i skad ci rigs pa dang rgyud sde dang gdam ngag mang du gsan cing dbang zhus pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas ngo mtshar ba'i sgra thos shing bdud kyi bar chad las thar ba'i lo rgyus zhib par 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i drung du mjal nas shin tu mkhas par mdzad cing bla ma bi bhu dhi tsaṇ+ḍa dang / khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa dang / dpyal a mo gha la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos du ma thos par mdzad nas mkhas pa'i mchog dang rgyud sde'i bang mdzod chen por gyur cing / grub pa'i rtags mang po yang bstan par grags so/ /khyad par du chos rje 'jam gsar bsten nas dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi dbang dang bshad pa dang man ngag gi bka' rnams legs par mnos shing / bla ma ra 'bum seng yun ring du bsten nas dus 'khor gyis gtso byas pa'i ra lugs kyi dbang dang man ngag bshad bka' dang byin rlabs thams cad zhus shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa mdzad pas slob ma mkhas pa rang gi sras rgya gar grags sogs dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug man lung gu ru dang / lho pa grub seng dang /

thang stong lo tsā ba la sogs pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang po byon/ gzhan yang 'gro mgon chos rgyal dang mkhan rin po che khro phu ba la sogs pa yang slob mar gyur cing gzhan gyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de la sras bzhi byung pa la gcig slob dpon rnal 'byor gyis yul 'khor bskyangs shing / slob dpon nam mkha' dpal dang / bla ma a ka ra sid+dhi gnyis kyis dus 'khor la sogs pa yab kyi yon tan rnams phal cher thugs su chud nas gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad do/ /sras gcig bla ma shes rab seng ge yin la/ bla ma de nyid kyis gzhon nu'i dus su 'bri klog la sogs 'byongs nas dus 'khor la slob gnyer mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la gsungs so/ /de nas thar par byon nas dpyal ba'i chos rnams zhus shing / stag sde pa seng ge rgyal gyi drung du phar tshad la mkhas par sbyangs shing grwa skor yang mdzad do/ /dgung lo sum cu pa la 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po dang / mkhan po 'chims chen po'i drung du rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs nas chos mang du zhus/ lo tsā ba chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gdan drangs nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang dang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rgyud dang / sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa la sogs pa gsan/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung nas dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad/ gzhan yang thar pa dang / khro phu la sogs pa dgon pa sna tshogs su chos mang po gsungs nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad cing / bla ma ti shrī kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan bzang pos dbu mdzad/ sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud mang po dang / gzhan yang mi che ba'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / lo tsā ba yar thar dbang gsum gyis dbu mdzad mkhas pa dang bzang ba dang btsun pa'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / khyad par du dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang po byung ngo /

/bla ma de nyid la phar tshad mngon gsum la sogs pa mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la shin tu mkhas par grags shing gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rgya cher mkhyen pa skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po gsan cing mkhas par mdzad pa yin no/ /yang bla ma a ka ra sidhi'i sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan chu mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rgya bod kyi yig klog du ma mkhyen/ dus 'khor la sbyangs nas dgung lo bcu drug la rgyud 'grel gsungs/ sa skya'i shar pa'i 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal dang / slob dpon shes rgyal la mkhan slob zhus/ dge tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug nas/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung ste/ dus 'khor gyi bshad grwa bskyangs/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu dang / zhal mnga' mkhan po las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ thar lo la sgra dang mngon pa gsang sngags mang du gsan/ khyad par bla ma sher seng la dus 'khor gyis gtso byas dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byo gsan/ dus 'khor la mi bde ba gang byung zhu yig tu bskur ba dang / dris lan gyi sgo nas kyang dus phyis kyi bar du gtan la phab nas shin tu mkhas par gyur to/ /gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten/ mdo sngags du ma la mkhas/ bla ma sher seng gshegs nas sham 'bar dang gnyis ka bzung / dus 'khor gyi bshad nyan yun ring du mdzad/ de nas hor rgyal pos gdan drangs te rgya yul du byon/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad glang lo la rgya yul du sku gshegs/ de la bu ston chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ 'di ni yab brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa gdung rabs bcu bdun du sngags rnying ma'i grub thob zam ma chad pa'i mkhas grub cig dang / yum slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum zhes pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos la mnga' brnyes pa zhig gi sras su lcags pho stag la shab smad sgom gnas su sku bltams/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'i sku skyer grags/

'jam dpal bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ dus phyis kyang gzigs rtog ma grub par chos gsung ba'i tshe/ yon tan ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub re sngon du btang na tshig don thams cad gsal lam me thugs la 'char/ dgung lo lnga drug nas yum gyis klog slob par brtsams pa na 'da' ka ye shes dang sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las sbyar klog mdzad pas klog mkhyen pa dang thugs la zin pa mnyam du byung / mes bla chen tshul khrims dpal bzang po'i phyag dpe gzigs pas 'di bstan bcos rnam dag go /'di ni min no zhes so sor phye bas mes po'ang shin tu dges/ yig rtsis bslabs pas slob dpon las mkhas par gyur/ bdun pa la khro phu rin po che'i drung du sems bskyed zhus pas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi thugs bcos min du 'khrungs/ brgyad pa la khro phur rje'i drung du bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhus dus 'di'i dbu la phyag bzhag nas 'o 'di la nga'i ngal sos byed pa lags so gsungs/ khro phu ba'i zab chos rnams kyang gnang / mes po'i drung du gsang sngags rnying ma mang du gsan/ bzo sman mkhyud dpyad mkhas par mkhyen/ bco brgyad pa la lo tsho'i mkhan rgyud mkhan po rin chen seng ge dang / slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon las rab tu byung ste mtshan rin chen grub tu btags/ slob dpon de'i drung du phar phyin gyi slob gnyer la bzhugs te 'di'i phyogs su shi na'ang shi snyam du dgongs te/ nyin mtshan du gsol dang mnal gyi long med par gsan sbyangs la 'bad pas sku seng seng par song ste kun gyis snying rje'i gnas su byed/ gzhung ṭīka nag 'byam thugs su chub cing / nyi snang / brgyad stong 'grel chen/ byams pa dang 'grel pa'i chos sde nyi shu la mkhas par gyur nas khro phur bshad gsar mdzad/ sde snod 'dzin pa rnams rigs pas zil gyis mnan/ bod na ka ba li 'grims pa gcig la shes rab che bar grags/

de nas mdo rtsa dang me tog phreng rgyud gsan cing gtso bor rnam nges la sbyangs pas sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa tshegs med du mkhyen/ de nas mngon pa kun las btus la sbyangs te/ snga dro gzhung mda' tshad shog bu bdun dang ṭīk+ka shog bu lnga thugs su 'dzin pa dang / phyi dro bshad pa rtsal ba bshad du gsan pas zla ba gcig la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ spyod 'jug dang rigs tshogs dbu ma'i skor rnams kyang gsan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seṅge la bde mchog sogs sngags chos mang po gsan/ nyer gcig pa la yab dang lhan cig dbus gtsang gi chos sde phal che bar grwa skor la byon/ dbus nas shākya gzhon/ btsan dgon pa ba/ kha rag byang gzhon/ gtsang nas dpal ldan seng ge 'jam skya sogs lung rigs kyis btul bas pha ston bu ston du grags shing khyad par rje 'di grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas mkhas pa'i grags pas sa thams cad du khyab/ de nas rnam snang ba yon tan rgya mtsho la spyod yul/ don grub dpal ba la brtag gnyis/ yab la phyag rdor/ grang po lung pa la don zhags/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal la rnam 'grel gsan/ de nas khro phur 'chad nyan mdzad de phar tshad mngon gsum la bshad pa'i rkang btsugs/ nyer gsum pa la tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i bla brang du/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags/ bsod nams bzang po ste/ chos lung mkhan po gsum gyis mkhan slob mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun nyer gnyis kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob la mdo rtsa/ sor thar gyi mdo/ karma sha tam/ blo sbyong rnams gsan/ de nas thar pa gling du thar lo'i drung du zla ba bcu bar ma chad dang / lar lo bzhi bzhugs nas/ ka tsan gyi mdo byings nye bsgyur u ṇa dang / a ma ra ko ṣa rnams saṃ skri ta'i skad du thugs 'dzin mdzad nas/ de rnams 'grel pa dang bcas pa legs par sbyangs/ rgya gar shar nub/ kha che saṅgha la/ sin+dhu rgya mtsho mtha' la sogs pa'i yi ge rigs mang po mkhyen/

lo tsā byang bar gyur/ de nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas zab lam gyi khrid zhus pas/ chos 'di'i bdag po khyed rang yin pas bgyi'o gsungs nas/ dpe med mtsho dang sha wa ra'i gdam ngag gnang ste/ 'dag sbyar bug sgo can du bzhugs pa na/ rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul mngon sum du gzigs/ gzung 'dzin dbyings su dag nas ye shes chen po'i rtsal rdzogs/ rin chen snang ba dang rin chen sgron ma sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du gyur te/ nyams rtogs mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa 'khrungs/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes las tha mal du nam yang ma mthong gsungs/ dbang mdor bstan/ rgyud phyi ma/ sems 'grel gnyis/ don dam bsnyen pa/ na ro pa/ a bha ya/ brtson 'grus dpal gyi sbyor drug dbang rab 'byed kyi 'grel ba/ snying po rgyan/ sā dhū pu tra'i bsgrub dkyil/ nyi zla bsgrub pa/ ye shes spyan sgrub/ sbas pa mig 'byed/ thar lo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi skor sogs mang du gsan/ de nas dpal ldan seng ge'i drung du/ ra 'bro'i dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba las khyad par phyag len ra lugs gtso bor ston pa'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ bla ma rdo rje shugs dngos su gzigs/ gzhan yang bde dgyes sgyu thod rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs gsan/ de nas rong dben dmar du bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du byon/ zla ba dgu bar ma chad par bsten nas/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel ra 'bro'i bzhed tshul so sor phye ba'i rgyud bshad mdzub khrid tshar gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ de tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas par gyur/ bla mas kyang 'o chos bdag po la 'phrod da blo bde'o gsungs/ dus phyis kyang dus 'khor kho nar thugs rtsis che zhing / gsungs pa'i dus na'ang 'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bya ba gzhan gyi rgyud 'grel bas 'di'i dkyil chog kyang dga'/ rgyud gzhan gyi dkyil chog pas 'di'i srung 'khor yang tshan che/

'di 'dra ba'i chos slob pa la 'o yang zhor sham la shes pa mi mchi/ 'dir byon cig gsungs nas sa rigs pa la sogs pa rnams dpon slob chos khri'i kha ru bsgrigs nas mdzad/ brjed tho'i dpe chung dang 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la sogs pa rnams rgyud 'grel dang bstun gyin phyag len mdzad/ 'o skol sngags pa kun la phra mo'i lag len tshun chad la dri gtug byed pa gcig rang ma byung na/ o sob sob re'i dge bshes la gsha' ma mi mchi/ des na 'di lta bu'i rgyud la slob gnyer byed na/ khol po thon du dka'/ dka' la nan tan chen po 'tshal/ ma bde ba byung na dris shig chos zab pa rgya che ba sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ bsdu byed rnams kyis bsdus/ paṇa grub rnams kyis bsgyur/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab/ bshad pa'i srol ma chag dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ lhad ma zhugs/ 'dres ma khyer/ dam ma nyams/ bka' brgyud grub thob kyi zam ma chad/ byin rlabs kyi na bun ma yal/ mdo rgyud 'grel pa zab mo rnams kyi lde mig sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad kyi spyi lam 'di lta bu'i chos bshad nyan byar yod pa tshogs bsags pa yin pas da chud ma gsan/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces nan tan chen po'i sgo nas gsung zhing / dka' ba'i gnas rnams la dri ba zhus pa la shin tu dgyes/ dza lan+dha ri pa'i dngos slob bi bhu ti dā ma la gtum mo dang gegs sel dang / bar phug rong pa gzhon nu grub pa la bka' gdams pa'i lugs mang po gsan/ so gcig pa la sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs/ zha lu gser khang gi gtsug lag khang du phyag phebs nas bka' chen bzhi la bshad pa'i rkang mdzad nas bshad nyan gyi grwa btsugs pa na/ grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis chags sdang gi rnam 'gyur mi zad pa bstan pa zhi ba'i ched du dbu mdzad bkra shis bzang po la phar phyin gsan/ 'on kyang da dung ma zlog par spyan la rde'u 'phen pa sogs byas pas/

rang la mi phan gzhan la gnod pa yin/ /bdag gis 'chad nyan 'di 'dras ci bgyis lags/ /za 'dug 'gro 'chags la sogs ci byas kyang / /gzhan gyi khong khro'i rgyu ru 'gyur la skyo/ /da ni tshe yang ring du mi gnas shing / /nang gi dbang po yongs su mi gsal la/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka'/ /cung zad shes pa nyams len dus la bab/ /gsungs nas re zhig thugs las chung ngu la gzhol ba na/ sku zhang chen po stab stab por gyur nas ma rungs pa rnams srog gi chad pa la gtugs pa na/ de rnams kyang 'gyod pas nongs pa 'chags shing rje 'di kho na skyabs su brten te mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'jigs skyob dang bstan pa la dgongs nas slar yang chos kyi 'khor lo zla med pa bskor/ de dus grub thob ze dmar ba la bde mchog gsan/ de nas sngon jo bo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bsti gnas/ de'i mchod rten yang bzhugs pa'i zhwa lu'i ri phug tu gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa bzhengs/ sngar rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor gsan pa'i dus su gsang 'dus shes pa gcig byung na slob zhus pas/ nged kyi mched grogs slob dpon 'phags pa bya ba 'phags yo ga dus gsum la mkhas pa zhig ma dag phyogs na yod gsungs te rtsad bcad pas/ phyis skyi mkhar na bzhugs pa gsan nas gdan 'dren pa btang pas/ mnal lam du bud med gcig gis bum pa chus cung ma gang ba gcig dang / rnal 'byor gcig gis rdo rje dril bu khyer byung nas/ 'di pa sngar rang gi yin pa na ning nas brag ram na yar la phyin da khyed rang la gtod pa yin zer nas gtod du byung pa rmis/ thugs dges tshor dang bcas pas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od zhwa lu ri phug tu gdan drangs pas/ khyed la rgya pa'i rgya lugs dang / gar pa'i gar lugs sogs pa de ma yin/ 'gag 'dra bshad/ gzhan shar rtse bklags nas thob che ba gcig bgyi gsungs/

bshad pa rdo rus thug pa gcig zhu zhus pas/ a pa snying nas rang slob na/ sngon la rim lnga'i dmar khrid bgyi gsungs nas dbang dang khrid gnang / de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems mang po ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsed mo sna tshogs mdzad pa dang / bskyed rim gyi dus su lha so gnyis kyi zhal gzigs/ rdor bzlas kyi dus su rtags lnga dang rlung lnga so sor gsal bar gzigs/ sku lus 'ja' 'od du gyur pa la lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du gzigs/ mnal 'od gsal du zin/ u rgyan du byon nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang mjal/ mngon dgar byon nas rin po che'i gzhal med khang na sangs rgyas stong gral bsgrigs su bzhugs pa gzigs/ zhing khams dag pa lta na nyi zla la zhon pa'am/ 'od zer la 'jug pa'am/ mkha' ldings la sogs byas nas gang 'gro 'dod pa'i yul du sleb pa snyam byas na mthong gin 'dug gsungs/ mtshan mo mnal lam du gsung rab gang bzhed la gzigs rtog mdzad nas sang de tshogs su gsungs/ de nas gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ ye shes zhabs lugs/ dus 'khor rwa 'bro'i dbang rgyud bshad lung man ngag gi bka'/ nā ro pa/ jo bo rje/ shākya shrī/ sha ba ri/ dpyal a mo gha/ gyi jo/ rtsa mi/ rga lo/ zhang tshal pa/ srog pa lung pa/ yar pa bya zer rnams kyi sbyor drug o rgyan bsnyen bsgrub sogs sbyor drug rigs mi 'dra ba mang po/ bde dges/ gshin rje gshed/ sgyu dra/ gdan bzhi/ mā yā/ grub rnying / yo ga bya spyod phal mo che'i dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' thams cad nod/ bla ma 'di la rdo rje 'chang gi 'du shes las skad cig yang mi g.yel/ bla mas kyang chos re re gsungs pa'i gsham du chos bdag po la 'phrod do gsungs/ spyir bla ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad mnga'/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ dbyar dgun gyi dus chos la/ bka' chen bzhi/ spyod 'jug 'phags yog dus gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas/ ston dpyid dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel/

rdo rje 'byung ba/ sum+pu tri rnams rgyun du gtso bor gsungs/ gzhan mdo rgyud kyi bshad lung man ngag thug pa med par zhar chos su gsungs/ bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa las dus 'khor gyi skor la/ rgyud 'grel gyi mchan sa bcad/ chos 'byung / mkhas pa dga' byed/ lag len gyi rtsis myur rtsis kyi lhan thabs/ sgra rig mkhas rgyan/ mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭīk+ka/ nges don snye ma/ lhan skyes dang / thugs dkyil dang / yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ bstod pa/ dkyil chog de'i lhan thabs/ mchod gar/ sngags gar/ stangs stabs bdun pa/ rgyud mchod/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rab gnas/ dus tha ma'i cho ga mchod 'phreng / go la'i rnam gzhag zhi ba dang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg thig rtsa/ khor yug gi lha 'god tshul/ dbang mdor bstan gyi ṭīk+ka/ khrid yig ngo sprod/ 'gal spongs rnams mdzad/ sa skya pa don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis brtag gnyis la ṭīk+ka mdzad par bskul ba na/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang lan gnyis mjal/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas 'di'i 'grel pa byed pa de legs/ spyir bka' bstan bcos rnams dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos la zhu dag dang / yang dgos su nga'i bstan bcos la nga rang gis zhu dag gcig bya snyam na'ang ma grub/ da nyid kyis zhu dag gyis shig ces lung bstan pa/ ga re bla ma rje btsun chen po dang mjal/ sa skya pa'i chos rnams dang khyad par brtag gnyis la nga bas rgyud thag nye ba ding sang med snyam du dgongs/ 'grel pa bya bar lung bstan/ gong ma'i yig cha rnams la dgag sgrub bya bar bkas gnang yang btang snyoms su bzhag nas lung 'grel mdzad/ sku zhang chen po'i rjes su sras kun dga' don grub kyis sbyin bdag byas nas/ zhwa lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gzhal yas khang du lha 'bum mdzad de dkyil 'khor lnga brgya lhag logs bris su bris/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs te dkar chag mdzad/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos shangs su gdan drangs te/

mchod rten dang lugs ma'i rten mang po zhal brkos/ spyod rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu lhag bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor sum cu lhag gi lha 'bum mdzad nas ri mor bris/ ri phug tu dus 'khor gyi sku rin po che las grub pa sogs sku mang po dang bka' 'gyur dang / bod kyi bstan bcos kyang phal mo che bzhengs/ rgya gar/ rgya nag bal po/ hor/ yu gur/ sog po/ 'ga'/ dbus gtsang / mnga' ris/ khams kyi slob ma grangs med pa smin grol du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched/ bsod nams blo gros sku mched/ chos lung mkhan chen bsod nams grags/ gu shrī chos grags dpal bzang po/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal sogs mkhas btsun gyi slob ma mang du 'dus/ bka' chen bzhi/ dbu spyod rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa'i ston pa dang / 'phags yog dus gsum/ gur brtag saṃ gsum/ lu nag dril gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs la mkhas pa'i phyi nang gi rdo rje slob dpon pher pa dang / bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor dang / ku sa li la sogs pa'i slob ma bgrang gis mi langs pa thon/ zhwa lur tshogs pa sum stong brgyad brgya/ ri phug tu sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag dang / 'dag sbyar bug sgo can la bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag re 'dus/ stag tshal/ 'or mo/ tsha mig bre/ 'bras yul/ shangs/ dben dmar la sogs par skye bo khri phrag mang po la sems bskyed gnang / rgya gar gyi rgyal po puṇ+ya mal gyis 'phrin yig skyes dang bcas pa na phul/ chos zab mo'i skyes lan gnang bas gus par 'dzin/ rgya nag nas rgyal po tho gan gyis gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa btang pa dben par bzhugs pa'i thugs kyis bzlogs/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud sogs gsung rab mang por zhu chen mdzad de gzhi nas bsgyur/ 'gyur bcos dang hor khong bsab pa mang pos bstan pa'i srog shing mdzad/

re gnyis pa la g.ya' phag gnyis kyi 'khrug sdums la dbus su byon pa'i lam du myang stod chu mig ra lung sogs su chos mang du gsungs/ rtsis kyi mkhan po nam mkha' rin chen sogs dge slong dge tshul mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad/ ra sog lha btsun gyi bu'i lkugs phye/ kha re dang / yar 'brog sna dkar rtse la sogs par so thar dang sems bskyed mang du gnang / yar 'brog mtsho mo che la byon dus gru nang du 'dul ba'i dus go mdzad/ srin po ri/ gra thang / yar klungs rnam rgyal/ sde sding / do sngon/ khra 'brug su gu do/ 'ol kha tsha thang rnams su sngags mtshan nyid theg pa che chung gi chos mang du gsungs/ de nas dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dwags po nas gdan 'dren pa'i ched du stong ste lung pa las yul ma la brgyud de tswa de yul du byon par brtsams pa na/ yul de'i khrom chen po tshogs pa'i nang du gtsang mo gzugs mi tshad las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba/ gos ne tsho gyon pa rgyan gyis mdzes pa gsum byung nas/ kye grong mi rnams nangs par yul rong la skyes bu dam pa khyad par can 'byon gyi khyed rnams kyis zam pa 'dzugs pa dang bsu skyel byas na bsod nams chen po thob pa zer nas mi snang bar gyur pas/ kun ngo mtshar te thang shing gi zam pa 'dzugs pa dang lam 'phrang bcos tshar ba na/ rje nyid phebs te de rnams kyis zam pa la gdan drangs byin rlabs zhus/ de ni sgrol mas chu'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa yin gsungs/ de nas dwags po mkhar lung bzung du phebs/ dpal ldan bla ma gdan 'dren par brtsams pa na/ rong mi kun gyis dmag gis bkag pas dpung gi khrod du thog babs te star ka'i sdong po phye mar brlags pas sa skya pa'i 'dre byung zer nas skrag ste slar dad par gyur/ sgrum pa dang / sgom tshigs sogs skye bo mang po la sems bskyed gnang / sgam po rin po che sogs dam pa mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad/

de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gdan drangs nas yar byon/ gdan sa thil dang / bsam yas sogs su lha btsun bsod nams 'od zer sogs dge bshes skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag mang po la chos gsungs/ yer ba/ gung thang / 'phrul snang / ra mo che/ mtshur phu/ dbu ri/ gzhu kun ra/ snye mo/ tsha mig brgya ba mdo phug la sogs pa gnas bshad grwa sgom grwa che chung rnams su sngags mtshan nyid kyi bshad srol sngar med pa rnams srol gtod/ yod pa rnams dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ skye dgu'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang po theg pa chen po'i lam la bkod de/ slar ri phug tu phebs te sngar bzhin dus chos rnams dang / sbyor drug rim lnga/ spros med/ chos drug ngal bso/ zhi byed sogs kyi khrid bka' dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bshad byin rlabs kyi bka' bar ma chad du gnang / re gsum par dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chag tshad bsgyur/ ri phug tu byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ dpon chen dbang brtson sogs skye bo mang po byang chub la bkod/ hor rgyal bu pradz+nyā cing ze'u tsing dbang 'khor hor brgya phrag dang bcas pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang / zab chos la sbyar/ chos yon du btson pa gsod nges stong phrag mang po'i srog bskyabs/ khro phur khro mo'i gdan sa mdzad de bshad grwa dang sgom grwa bskyangs/ sa skyar byon nas gdung brgyud pa dang sde snod 'dzin pa gnam kyi skar ma tsam chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ khru so drug pa'i dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa la dbang bskur/ lha khang chen mor rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs rgyu rin po che las grub pa rtsa thig khru bcu gnyis pa'i bkod pa mdzad de bzhengs/ re bdun pa la zhwa lu'i gdan sar thugs sras lo tsā ba bskos nas ri phug nyid du bzhugs te/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta su ma na shrī byon pa la spyan ras gzigs pad+ma'i dra ba gsan/

chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa/ gu shrī kun dga' rin chen/ ta'i si tu/ 'jam dbyangs gu shrī rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang / ti shrī bsod blo ba la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang / dus 'khor sogs phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i lo dus kyi sgrub mchod chen mo'i srol btsugs/ bo dong er thugs sras lo tsā ba dang / chos kyi dpal ba dang / tshe 'jam sogs sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la rdo rje phreng ba sogs chos rje nyid la bzhugs pa'i dbang phal mo che gnang / e'i gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad/ chu mig stag tshal rdzing kha/ rin spungs/ myang stod lcang ra/ stang tshang rdzong kha/ zhu 'brog nas/ shangs mthong smon sogs su gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ gdan sa ri phug tu gtsang phyogs kyi dge 'dun mtha' dag bsags nas/ nga dga' ldan du 'gro ba'i phyi phyag yin gsungs nas spong thag mdzad/ skabs shig tu mdang gsum rmi lam shin tu bzang / dga' ldan nas skas ring gsum byung ba'i dbus ma la byams pa byon/ gcig la ngas 'dzegs/ gcig la sus phyin nam gsungs/ don bzhi pa la/ grwa pa klog pa ba rnams zhwa lur brdzangs/ spong ba pa rnams nang mtshams bsdams/ chos rje nyid kyang mun khang bsrubs nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ 'brug lo'i dpyid sku khams mnyel ba na/ rgyal sras thogs med pa sogs dge 'dun mang pos gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ mdang gsum nga'i rmi lam na rnam thos kyi bus nad tsho 'gos pa yin zer nas lus la bse khrab lta bu mang po bkog nas skyur gtong gyin gda' gsungs nas sku khams dwangs te gtang rag gi gtor ma mdzad do/ /slar hor zla lnga pa'i gzhug nas cung zad mnyel te don lnga pa shing pho 'brug gi zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu rtsa gcig gi tho rangs me tog gi char dang bcas te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ nyi shu bdun la gdung sbyangs pas ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu'i phung por gyur pas rgya gar/

rgya nag bal bod kyi phyogs thams cad du khyab par byas/ zhwa lur nang rten jo bo'i sku tshad ma/ phyi rten gser 'bum/ dbyen zlums pa'i mchod rten/ gdan sa ri phug tu sku 'dra rin po che rnams bzhengs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di la bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mchog tu gyur pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa ni/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta su ma na shrī/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ chos kyi dpal ba gnyis/ lo chen byang rtse/ rgyal thang pa/ skyabs mchog pa/ khyung po lhas pa/ chos grags dpal ba/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ dbang rnon pa/ 'jam dkar ba/ dus 'khor ba shākya dpal/ tshe 'jam pa/ 'jam rin pa/ grub pa dpal/ gzhon nu grub mgon dpal ba/ dbang grags pa/ dpal chen pa sogs byung la/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos gsan/ de la sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer gyis gsan/ de la stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis gsan no/ /yang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la/ nyang ston pa bla ma chos dpal bas gsan/ de la lo bcu gsum du dus 'khor la gril nas sbyangs pa bla ma rin chen bsod nams 'phel gyis gsan/ de la stag tshang lo tsā bas gsan pa sogs bu ston rin po che slob brgyud dang bcas pas kyang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir shin tu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /yang chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma'i mchog tu gyur pa ni kun mkhyen dol bu ba nyid yin te/ dol po ban tshang du yab nam ston ye shes dbang phyug yum jo lcam tshul khrims rgyan gyi sras su chu pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ gdung rus nam/ bla ma skyi steng pa la 'jam dpal dbang mo che zhus/ mtshan shes mgon du btags/ bcu pa la mkhan chen byang chub seng ge la yang dag sogs rnying ma'i skor gsan/

bcu gsum pa la skyi stengs su mkhan po tshul khrims snying po dang / slob dpon ze phug pa las rab tu byung / mtshan shes rab rgyal mtshan bzang por btags/ de dus skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis skyi stengs su byon pa la/ rdo rje phreng ba'i gar thig bslabs pa tshegs med par mkhyen pas mkhas pa chen po gcig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas shin tu dgyes/ skyi ston pa ya tshe rgyal po bla ma la byon nas slar glo bor phebs pa gsan pas/ bco brgyad pa la rang gcig pur dar yug 'ga' zhig dang zangs chen gcig bsnams nas glo bor byon/ skyi ston pa la tshad ma bsdus pa gsan/ skyi ston pa sa skyar thegs rjes sher bzangs pa dang gzhon bzang pa bsten nas lo gnyis su rnam nges sbyangs/ de nas sa skyar byon te skyi ston pa'i drung du phar tshad mngon gsum spyod 'jug rdo rje phreng ba rnams kyi slob gnyer dus gcig la mdzad/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ bdag nyid bzang po dpal/ ti shrī kun blo/ nam legs pa/ shar pa seng ge dpal rnams la phar tshad mngon gsum rnam 'grel rigs gter brtag gnyis rnams gsan/ khyad par du kun spangs grags rgyal ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang sgrub skor gsan/ nyer gsum pa la sa skyar phar tshad mngon gsum gyi bshad ston mdzad/ dpyid chos zla ba gnyis la tshogs chen mo'i shar sgo'i steng nas/ snga dro phar mngon gnyis/ phyi dro rnam nges bsdus pa gnyis gsungs/ gtsang gi chos grwa phal mo cher grwa skor yang mdzad/ nyer bzhi pa la tshong 'dus mgur mor chos lung mkhan chen bsod grags pas mkhan po/ mchog sbyin dpal gyis las slob/ mkhan chen bsod bzang pas gsang ston mdzad nas jo gdan tshogs pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po la mdo rtsa dang / las slob la so thar gsan/ bsad sha mi gsol ba'i g.yar dam mdzad/ slar yang sa skyar skyi ston pa'i drung du mngon pa mdzod la sbyangs shing /

phreng ba zhe gnyis ma dang zhe brgyad mang dus 'khor/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ dpal rtse dbyings gsum la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang nyis brgya bcu bzhi rnams dkyus thog gcig la gsan/ dus 'khor rwa lugs sogs rgyud sde mang po'i bshad pa/ tshad ma sde bdun/ byams pa'i chos lnga/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad sogs gzhung lugs mang po/ lung sde bzhi/ sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ mdo mangs/ phal dkon/ rgyud 'bum sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas lha sar jo shāka rnam gnyis mjal/ khyad par spyan ras gzigs kyi drung du/ sems 'grel skor bcu cha lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud nas gzhan la ston nus pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ bsam yas kyang mjal zhing skyi phan gyi grwas phal mo cher grwa skor la byon/ 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon/ btsan dgon pa ba/ dben dge ba sogs mkhas par grags pa rnams rigs pas btul/ mkhan chen bsod grags pa la blo sbyong zhus pas byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs/ 'khrungs yul du byon nas yab dang mjal/ la stod mnga' ris kyi dge bshes rnams rigs pas btul bas mnga' ris dbus gtsang thams cad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ khab gung thang du shar pa kun bsod pa la bde mchog gsan/ de nas sa skyar phebs te dus chos su bka' chen bzhi sogs po ti lnga drug re bsgril nas gsungs/ dung lung dga' ldan du kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod mdzad pas bum chu khol/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ jo mo nang du gu shrī rin seng ba'i dar 'gyed skyel du byon pas/ sgrub pa ba rnams kyi sgrub tshugs la dad pa skyes te/ da bzod 'dir 'ongs nas sgom chig sgril gcig bya dgos dgongs pa byung / bla ma seng ge dpal bas bskul bas rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka mdzad/ seng ge dpal ba dbus phyogs su chos grwa thams cad du 'byon pa'i phyag phyir byon/

mtshur phur karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i drung du rang stong gi lta ba bzung nas 'bel gtam mdzad pas/ ma 'ongs pa na gzhan stong du 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ seng dpal ba gong du bzhugs pa'i phyag phyir 'byon dgos gsungs pa la zhu ba nan gyis phul nas/ so gcig pa la jo mo nang du mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs te dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang khrid gsan nas nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs kyi klong brdol/ rgyud bshad sogs chos skor ma lus pa gsan/ de nas gsang thabs su kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang phyag len/ byams pa'i chos lnga sogs gsungs/ de nas kun spangs pas zhu ba po mdzad nas/ mkhas btsun pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan dus/ thig 'debs pa la kun spangs pa cher mkhas par byung pas mkhas btsun pa shin tu dges te/ rje 'di la khyed kyis dad 'dun can rnams la rgyud 'grel tshar gcig gsung bar zhu gsungs pas/ bde ba can gyi bla g.yer dbus su dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / phyogs mtshams su thab thig rnams btab/ 'jim pas dkyil 'khor dang thab bslangs phyi 'jig rten dang nang rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi bkod pa rnams bzos/ slob ma nyis brgya tsam la rgyas par gsungs pas/ mkhas btsun pas ber thul sogs gnang sbyin chen po mdzad nas tshogs chos kyang gnang bar zhu gsungs pas/ bka' bzhin skyes rabs spyod 'jug bslab btus rnams gsungs/ de nas mkhas btsun pas bde dges gsang 'dus sogs kyi dbang rgyud man ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du rdzogs par gnang / de nas mkha' spyod bde ldan du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas/ mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba dang srog thur 'dren pa'i bde nyams 'ur langs pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brnyes/ so lnga pa la bla ma'i bkas jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po zhes mtshan don dang mthun par kun gyis gsol/

so dgu pa la bzang ldan 'og mar mchod rten gyi sa chog mdzad pas sa g.yos shing me tog gi char babs/ de nas sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan mthong grol chen mo dpal yon can lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya dpangs mnyam par khru nyis brgya bco lnga pa/ rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ gdugs kyi lha khang na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs bzhugs pa lo phyed dang bzhi la grub ste/ rab gnas mdzad dus 'dab ma yu ba dang bcas pa'i me tog gi char kha ba bab pa tsam babs/ lhun po bzhengs pas rgya mtsho brdol ba snyam/ zhes gsungs te chos kyi gsang mdzod brdol/ rnam gnyis 'gyur la zhus chen dang mchan bu mdzad/ mkhan chen bsod grags pas gtso mdzad jo gdan tshogs pa la gzhal yas khang du dus 'khor gyi dbang mo che mdzad/ de ltar lo bcu gsum gyi bar du jo mo nang nyid du/ lo re bzhin mkhas pa mang po la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dang / byams chos rnams dus chos su gsungs shing ston dpyid sbyor drug gi dus khrid tshogs chos/ dbyar dgun sku mtshams dam po rnams dus las ma g.yos par chag med du mdzad nas/ stag lo la lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gdan sar bskos/ gzims khang bde ba can du bzhugs nas ri chos nges don rgya mtsho/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla'i ṭīk+ka sogs mdzad/ gong ma tho gan thi mur gyis gdan 'dren du mngags pa'i gser yig pa byung dus/ gsang dam pos na thung du lo gnyis sngags pa'i cha lugs mdzad nas rta mgrin gyi thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas gser yig pa bzlogs/ sa skya/ ngam ring / bzang ldan/ chu bzang rnams su snga phyir dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po la dus 'khor la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zla med par bskor/ dga' ldan lha khang du dbu ma stod tshogs gsung dus me tog gi char chen po babs/ rin chen sdings dang lhag rtser sku mtshams dam po mdzad/

jo nang du dus 'khor gyi dar dkyil chen mo 'khrul sangs grub/ rta lo la lo tsā ba sku gshegs rjes chos rje phyogs rgyal ba gdan sar bskos/ gtsang tsho gsum sor lo gsum du cha ga bas lo tog bcom pa la bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis gnod pa zhi/ snar thang du dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po dang rgyud 'grel dang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs chos mang du gsungs/ bdun bcu pa la nub chos lung du phebs te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ bka' bsdu bzhi pa rtsa 'grel gnang / dpal ldan bla mar jo mo nang du gdan sa gcig bsko bar zhus pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa bskos/ rwa lo'i dbon po kun dga' 'phel sogs la dbang khrid gnang / du dben shrī dharma kirtis gong ma'i lung dang gnang sbyin bzang po phul/ de nas khu lung mda'i gnas bde gnas/ dur mig bye ma/ rtsa dbye/ tsha mig dge 'dun sgang / gzhu kun ra/ gnam khra tshang / dbu ri/ gnam rtse ldang / stod klung rnam rgyal/ dkyil 'khor sdings/ dben tsha stag rnams las rim gyis brgyud de lha sar phebs/ gnas so sor bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur mthon po mdzad pa la/ dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag mang po sems bskyed sogs theg pa chen po'i chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ lha sar zla ba bdun gyi bar du bzhugs te jo bo'i drung du mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod nas bstan pa dang sems can kho na'i ched du smon lam 'debs shing dbus phyogs kyi mkhas pa phal mo che 'dus pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag nges don gyi mdo bstan bcos mang po gnang / skor lam rnams kyang khrid pa'i nyams 'ur gyis bkangs/ tshal dang gung thang rnams su yang phebs/ tshal pa khri dbon dang / gzhon rgyal du dben shwa sogs dpon skya mang po yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/

skye bo'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang pos sems bskyed de byang chub tu smin par mdzad/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung / chos lung nas brtsams te 'di yan la/ sor sam gyi khrid thob pas nyams rtogs bzang po dang ldan pa sha stag stong nyis brgya byung / de nas gtsang nas gdan 'dren dang / rgyal mkhar rtse nas dpon 'phags pa dpon g.yog dang / yar 'brog khri dpon rdor rgyal gdan 'dren la phebs pas byi ba lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la/ phyogs rigs kyi mjal mi mang po rnams/ ra mo che nas nyang bran brag gdong gi bar phreng ma chad par bsgrigs pa la/ 'do li'i stengs nas byin rlabs tshim par gnang / de nas rgyal sde dkar chu/ gsang mda'/ snye thang / rnam rgyal sgang / 'u shang ro/ gye re/ chu shul gnas/ rab btsun/ gan pa gnas sar/ gra ma lung / dpal sde/ yar srib/ nyan po/ sna kar rtse/ kha bo gang bzang gi mgul/ ra lung / nying ro'i sman chu kha/ gnas snying / lcang ra/ gnas dkar po/ gser sdings/ zhwa lu mgur mo/ rnam thang / khro phu/ bo dong e la sogs pa rnams su/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / mi chen po rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang khrid gnang / skye bo stong phrag mang po theg pa chen po la bkod nas jo mo nang du phebs/ sku 'bum chen mo'i bzo gnas phra mo rnams legs par grub ste/ mthong grol gyi sku 'bum chen mo la/ nyi gdan gyi steng nas skor ba byed/ zla gdan gyi steng nas me tog 'bul/ khyams khra'i nang du gsung rab blta/ so so'i sgo nang nas phyag mchod byed/ e ma skal ldan kun dga' bar byos/ zhes gsungs shing thugs spro bas skor ba mang du mdzad/ phyogs rigs kun nas 'dus pa'i bu slob mang po la rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsungs/ slob ma'i thu bo rnams la yang chos kyi lhag ma ma lus par stsal/ lo mtshams pa rnams la bug sgo so sor yud kyis phebs nas/

gegs sel dang gdams pa gnang ste bden pa mthong bar mdzad/ phal che bas ni 'phral du grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pas chos rje yang mnyes/ bdun cu pa lcags mo glang gi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin khrid gsal bar rnams la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa gcig gnang nas 'di la rten 'brel thams cad bsgrig dgos/ gal po che yin pas sgoms shig de nas gdan sa bas gnang ngo gsungs/ tshogs pa la nges don rgya mtsho'i chos 'phro de nyid ches thugs gsal zhing / gzi mdangs che ba'i rnam pas lhag par gsung che bar gsungs te/ 'u cag gi chos bshad mtshams de kha la byed pa yin no gsungs nas chos 'phror bzhag tshes drug gi nam langs ma thag 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag nas dgong mo mya ngan las 'das te/ mkha' khyab nam mkha'i rdo rje can yin mod na'ang / sprul pa'i sku ni zhing bde ba can du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /zhag bdun gyi bar du gzi mdangs je ser song zhing zhal 'dzum ston/ gsang ba sbubs su nub/ dbu'i gtsug tor 'phags pa la zla ba bdud rtsi lud/ phyi nang rten 'brel gnad gcig pas gtsang po gyen la log ste gram pa'i mthil gyi rdo mthong ba byung / gdung zhugs la zhen pas ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu'i phung por gyur cing / spyan ras gzigs byon/ bde ba can du tshe dpag med jo bo'i sku tshad ma dang / sku 'bum chen mor sku 'dra mthong ba don ldan bzhengs pa'i nang du ring bsrel phal che ba bzhugs so/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku 'di'i slob ma'i thu bo ni/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos dpal mgon po/ chos rje rin chen tshul ba/ zhang ston rgya po bsod nams grags pa/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ la dong sman chu kha pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang rtse/ se sding pa blo gros dpal/

bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chos grags gsar ma/ nya dbon kun dga'/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ thang chen pa kun dga' 'bum/ sa skya mkhan po nam ye ba/ shangs pa rdo rje/ gnas drug pa blo gros mtshungs med/ 'jam sngon/ 'jam sgeg mkhas pa rin chen mchog mkhas pa ngag dbang / snar thang pa mchims blo bzang grags pa/ chog lung mkhan po bsod nams bzang po dang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i blo gros/ ri don blo chen 'od/ mkhan chen don grub dpal dang yon tan rgyal mtshan/ chos lung mkhan chen grags tshul ba dang grags pa dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub 'od zer/ nub gnas sar ba seng ge dpal/ lo pa gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ snye thang pa bkras seng / gra dgon pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor gling pa byams pa ba/ bde ba can pa 'jam rin/ tsha mig pa yon tan seng ge gsang phu ba blo gros seṅge/ tshal pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khro phu ba nam mkha' bzang po/ e pa nam mkha' grags/ myang stod sge mo ba sangs rgyas dpal/ ngam rings brtsen rgyal/ spangs 'dab rin che/ ri khrod pa dbang rin/ mdzod ma ba ston rin/ dus 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal/ bla ma rtse mo ba/ ba de lung pa/ mkhan po lha btsun/ slob dpon dar dbang / gsang phu ba grags bzang / slob dpon bsod nams dpal/ se stod ba rdor rgyal/ rta nag pa nyi rgyal/ bla ma rgyal 'byung / snye thang pa ror rgyal/ shes rdor ba/ mkhan chen bkras tshul ba/ brag ram pa bsod nams seng ge nags phug pa/ dpal rgyal/ bcom ldan rdo rje snying po sogs dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas shing yongs su grags pa'i slob ma mang du byung la/ tri shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bzhi thog pa la sogs pa sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams dang / rtogs ldan dar rgyal ba/ grub thob dbus pa/ bla ma mkha' spyod pa/ sgom khang pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du byon te de dag gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa mchog tu dar bar mdzad pa yin no/

/gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'i lugs srol mi 'dra ba byung ba'i tshul ni/ dus 'khor zhabs pa'i slob ma shrī bha dra bo dhis gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer la gnang zhing de nyid kyis bzhi 'gyur yang mdzad nas/ lo chung rnams kyis thog drangs pa la bshad pa yang yun ring du mdzad cing / lo chung rnams kyis kyang dgos nas 'gyur mangs su yang bsgyur mod kyi bshad bka' zin pa ma byung gsung ngo / /dā na shrī'i slob ma rma dge ba'i blo gros gyis kyang / gyi jo'i 'gyur gyi steng nas 'gyur bcos mdzad cing / mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang / blo gros snying po dang / bsod nams ye shes dang / 'a zha rgya gar rtsegs rnams kyis kyang bsgyur cing bshad kyang bshad bka' zin pa ma byung gsung / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa ni mi nyag 'ga'i yul du sku 'khrungs shing / gzhon nu la rgya gar du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta du ma bsten cing mkhas par gyur nas/ dus 'khor 'grel chen bod skad du bris shing / rga lo dang 'ga' rod lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rong gling lo tsā ba/ ra byid lo tsā ba/ se lo tsā ba la sogs pa mang po la gsungs mod kyi/ snga ma bzhi po nas brgyud pa ni chad la/ se lo tsā bas gnyos 'od ma la gsungs shing / de nyid kyis grub thob tu grags pa'i u rgyan pa rin chen dpal la gsungs nas/ dbang khrid bshad bka' rnams kyang yun ring bskyangs shing / sgrub thabs dang / dbang chog dang / bcud len dang / rlung sbyor la sogs pa'i yig cha bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad do/ /shong 'gyur ni la stod lho'i spyad lung shar ka'i bong ra zhes par sku 'khrungs pa shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa de nyid gzhon nu la rab byung mdzad nas/ bla ma go lung pa chen po mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan gyi drung du bsnyen nas rgyud sde du ma dang / rdo rje phreng ba skor gsum la sogs pa mang du zhus shing /

gar dang / thig dang / lnga btus dang / gza' lnga dang / g.yul rgyal la sogs pa rtsis kyi gtsug lag du ma'ang bslabs shing byang par mdzad de/ gza' rnams gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos du ma'ang mdzad nas/ stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan zhes pa pha ri lung du sku 'khrungs shing / chos rje mngon grwa pa las phar tshad mngon gsum dang / dus 'khor 'bro 'gyur gsan cing mkhas par grags pa de nyid kyi drung du tsha snar byon te/ phar tshad mngon gsum dang bod bsdus la sogs pa rnams la mkhas par mdzad de/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhu ba'i yon la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel 'bro 'gyur gyi glegs bam gcig dang / spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad par btags pa'i mtshan brjod 'grel ba dang / 'bro pa'i gsung sgros rgyas pa 'od zer phreng ba dang / dri med rgyan la sogs pa shog deb bzhi bcu tsam phud bu lung dang brag chung gi brag phug tu phyag bris su mdzad de phul cing dbang bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang gdam ngag kyang zhus te dus 'khor rgyud 'grel 'bro 'gyur yongs su rdzogs par gsan no/ /de nas 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa gdan sar snga ma res phebs pa'i drung du byon te/ bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa spel legs par phul nas lo tsā slob tu 'gro bas rdzong pa zhu zhes zhus pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang / gzhung lugs gsar pa 'gyur ba'i nus pa 'ong ba dka' ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta la slob gnyer dang dris gtug legs par gyis shig kho bos kyang chos kyi rje bsten/ yun thung pas rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor me tog gi mchun bu dang tshig gi gter la sogs pa yang tshul bzhin du mi shes par snang bas 'di dag shes pa zhig ci nas kyang gyis la shog gi zhes gsungs nas/ de dag dpe dang / gser srang lnga/

dar yug bcu rnams gnang ste/ rten 'brel yod pas do nub rje btsun gong ma'i gzims khang dpe khang du nyol la song shig ces gsungs nas brdzangs so/ /shong pa'i dgongs pa la skye bas thob pa'i blo gros ni phun sum tshogs/ sbyor ba'i byung pa'i nan tan ni mchog tu gyur na/ legs bshad gsar du ci ste bsgyur bar mi nus snyam du dgongs te bla ma dam pa'i gzims g.yog pa mdo smad blo gros rgyal po dang 'grogs te/ bal yul du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma hen bha tra'i drung du rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga bslabs shing / khyad par sgra rig pa shin tu byang bar mdzad nas gdan sa chen por byon te/ bla ma dam pa'i bka' bzhin dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'gyur mdzad nas/ slar yang rdo rje'i gdan mahā bo dhi mchod pa dang / bskor ba la byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lak+ṣ+mi ka ra spyan drangs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khril shing dang / klu rnams kun tu dga' bar byed pa'i zlos gar dang / snyan ngag me long dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa brirta ma la'i stod dang / tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo la sogs sngon gangs can du ma 'gyur ba rnams gsar du bsgyur cing / a ma ra ko ṣa la sogs pa yang mchan bus gsal bar mdzad nas rig pa'i gnas 'di dag shin tu rgyas par mdzad do/ /'phags pa rin po ches kyang sde snod 'dzin pa chen po shong lo tsā ba'i snyan du gsol pa zhes pa'i 'phrin yig mdzad pa na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya che la gting dpag par dka' la tshig brlings shing / sde snod byings che bas chen po rnams kyis kyang nyams su bde bar len dka' bas/ sngon byon pa'i lo tsā ba dag gis ma 'gyur pa dang / log pa dang rnam grangs gzhan dang / phyogs re ba dang /

thal bar bsgyur pa la sogs pa de dag khyed kyis legs par khong du chud cing / mtha' gcig tu nges te/ zhu chen mdzad pa'i glegs bam dang / klu rnams rab tu dga' bar byed pa'i zlos gar mthong bas/ dga' ba dang rjes su yi rang ba khyad par can skyes zhes pa la sogs pas rab tu bsngags shing / sgra bsgyur rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa yin no/ /de nyid las de nyid kyi gcung po shong ston lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa zhes pa kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa ṭam̐ ka da sha dang / sdom chung gi 'grel pa pad+mo can dang / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud la sogs pa gzhi 'gyur du'ang mang du bsgyur cing zhu chen yang du ma mdzad la/ 'phags pa rin po che'i slob ma'i thu bor gyur cing / se chen rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur ba gcen po'i yon tan la bsgrun du rung ba yod pa de nyid kyis zhus la de dag gnyis la mang gar khra tshang du sku 'khrungs shing 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa la rab byung zhus pa'i tshe/ mtshan mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog ces bya bar rang nyid kyis 'dogs par zhus shing btags la/ phyis lo tsā ba mchog ldan zhes grags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud dang / ral gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs la gzhi 'gyur mdzad cing / bod kyi yul du 'gyur ba'i bka' dang / bstan bcos dang / dbang dang / gdam ngag phal mo che'i lung dang bka' mnga' ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i bla mar gyur pa de nyid kyis gsan pa yin no/ /de nyid la skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsan la/ de nyid la chos kyi rje kun mkhyen dol bu bas gsan no/ /de ltar na dus kyi 'khor lo la brgyud pa mi 'dra ba dang / 'gyur mi 'dra ba mang du byung / da lta'i bshad pa'i bka' dang / man ngag rnams 'bro pa dang ra pa rtsa mi'i lugs gsum las brgyud pa phal che zhing 'gyur rnams kyi nang nas shong 'gyur kho na legs par dus kyi 'khor lo pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad do/

/de dag gis ni bod yul 'dir dus 'khor la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma ra 'bro gnyis brgyud par bcas pa dang / bu dol sogs kyis byon tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa cung zad bshad pa yin la/ da ni gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las brgyud pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor byung ba'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ thog mar dus zhabs pa'i dngos kyi slob ma tsa mi lo tsā ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i grub thob dpal chen rga lo las/ rje sa skya pa chen pos sbyor drug gsan nas/ ma rgyud kyai rdo rje'i sbyor drug ces pa'i yi ge yang mdzad de/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang / khyad par rje btsun la bu ngas khyod la chos bstan pa thams cad 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos/ /dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /'byung ba rlung la sbar zin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu bskyed/ /byang chub chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /ye shes lnga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes gsungs te rkang ba dang po gnyis kyis sor bsam/ gsum pas srog rtsol/ bzhi pas 'dzin pa/ lnga pas rjes dran/ drug pas ting nge 'dzin/ tha ma gnyis kyis sgrub pa ye shes kyi sku bstan to/ /de nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rgyus pa gzhon nu seng ge dol po ye shes mgon po/ kun spangs chen po rnams rim par brgyud de sbyor drug sa lugs zhes grags so/ /de'i rjes su kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī las chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gsan cing dar bar mdzad pa yin te/ de'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ paṇa chen des dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa'i dus su paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ su ga ta shrī/ dza ya darta/ dā na shī la/ saṅga shrī/ su ma ti sā ga ra/ kā la tsa kra/ dzi na gup+ta/ ma hā bo dhi ste 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta dgu dang bcas dza gadha ma nas khro phu lo tsā bas gdan drangs te/
