'di ni lung bstan pa ste/ sngon rigs ngan phyag dar ba gnyis las byed pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la byon/ de'i tshe khye'u rgyal pa zhes pa gcig gis dbul rgyu gzhan med nas phyag dar gyi rdul snyim pa gang phul/ de lhung bzed du bzhes/ khye'u rnam par rgyal po zhes pas kyang rjes su yi rang tsam byas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ni ma 'ongs pa na tshes bco lnga'i zla bas khyab tshad kyi sa dbang du byed cing / phul ba'i rdul dang grangs mnyam pa'i mchod rten byed/ yi rang mkhan po 'di yang 'di'i blon po'i mchog shing rta sbas pa zhes su 'gyur zhes so/ /sngar bsgrubs pa'i sngags dang mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yis bsad par bya ste/ zhes par/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la/ nged bod 'di dad pa che zhus pas/ mi la ras pa la lto phye sus bskyal gsungs/ nged bod mthu che zhus pas/ glang dar ma mdas gsod pa ci yin gsungs zhes grags so/ /ma byin pa len pa ni yi dwags kyi 'gro ba bzlog pa'i don te/ zhes par/ khye'u chu smad kyi ma ser sna'i dbang gis yi dwags su skyes/ bu dgra bcom du gyur pa'i drung du byung / su yin byas pas/ bu gcig gang la skyes pa yin/ /byams pa'i ma ni bdag yin te/ /zas dang skom dang bral ba yi/ /yi dwags rnams kyi nang du skyes/ /zhes sogs nas/ skom pas gdungs kyis chab stsol cig de nas nor rnams dge 'dun la phul bsngos pas/ de nas shi 'phos te yi dwags rdzu 'phrul chen mor skyes/ lha'i longs spyod dang mnyam par gyur to/ /da mthu yod kyis thong cig mi nus zer ba la/ dpyos pas ras zung gcig thob pa dge slong gcig la byin/ de la mos lan gsum gyi bar du brkus/ chu smad dgra bcom gyis blangs te phul/ gsum pa la dge slong des dum bur byas te dge 'dun la phul bas rku ma nus so/ /tshigs bcad go dgu par/

dbang bskur bdun pa 'di dag dkyil 'khor du ni yang dag rab sbyin bya/ /zhes par/ bla ma rong pa rnams cis kyang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas mdzad de phyag len bzang / bla ma sher bzang na re/ ras bris kyang sngon ma la rung zer ro/ /tshigs bcad brgya gcig par/ gong ma la ni dag pa med/ /ces pa/ kha cig gtan mi 'dag zer ba dang / mnga' ris skyi ston na re/ dag par bya mi dgos zer ba lta bu ma yin gyi/ chad las kyi dag pa med/ bsgoms pas dag par bya ba'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya gsum par/ phung po nyon mongs pa las klu/ /zhes par/ kha cig rang lhar bskyed nas snyung gnas byar mi rung ste/ rtsa ltung 'byung bas so/ /zhes pa mi 'thad de/ rang gi phung po lhar shes shing de sdug bsngal gyis gzir bar 'dod pas lus la gnod pa'i sbyor bas byas na rtsa ltung 'byung gi snyung gnas byed pa ni lus la gnod pa'i bsam pas ma yin par lus gtsang zhing dri ma med par bya ba'i phyir lus kyi byi dor du dmigs nas byed pa yin te/ dpung bzang las/ bshang gci snabs dang mchil ma bad kan dang / /'di dag zad par bya phyir snyung ba gsungs/ /dri ma zad nas mi yi lus dag na/ /rang gi 'byor phyir sgrub pa bde bar 'jug /ces gsungs pas so/ /gal te lhar bskyed nas snyung gnas byar mi rung na/ yo ga'i rgyud nas bdag bskyed byas nas snyung gnas bya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /dbang gi le'u'i mdor bsdus bzhi pa'i zin bris so/ /rab gnas byas nas/ zhes pa la/ rwa 'gyur ba rab gnas bya phyir zhes pa yod/ de bshad bde bar snang yang skad dod dang mi mthun/ des na sangs rgyas pa'i tshe spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs kyi rab gnas byas nas zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya bzhi par/ de nas rgyud thams cad shes shing / zhes par/ rgyud 'grel shes nas rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang bskur ba'i phyag len sngar yod par 'dug na'ang /

phyis bka' chad kyi dogs nas rje btsun rga los sngon du bskur ba mdzad do/ /dbang steng la rwa pa pad+ma'i steng du shing stan zer 'bro pa dang shong pa shing stan gyi steng du pad+ma bris zer ba ni phyi ma yin pa 'grel par gsal lo/ /bum pa gcig dang / rnam par rgyal bas bu mo gcig dang / gzhon nu ma gcig gis khrus bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di dang / 'og brgya dgu par/ rang gi chung ma gcig pu yis rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gcig pus mngon par dbang bskur bar bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa gnyis 'dam kha can du shes par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya bcu dgu par/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang / /zhes sogs khyim pa'i dbang du byas pa'i phyag rgya bcu ni sgra ji bzhin pa'o zer ba cung mi 'thad de/ chung ma ni lo nyi shu ma yin la/ chung ma'i ma ni lo bco lnga ma yin pas so/ /dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni bla mas sbyin bya zhes pa dge slong la phyag rgya bcu sbyin pa dang ye shes le'ur/ dge slong dang rgan po la tshig tsam gyis sbyin par gsungs pa dang / phyag rdor bstod 'grel las/ dge slong dang dge tshul la dbang bskur ba'i dus su dam tshig gi rdzas tsam yang sbyin pa bkag pa 'gal lo/ /zhe na/ 'dir phyag rgya bsten par gsungs pa ni/ phyis dge slong gi tshul mi 'dzin par gsang sngags kyi lam bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan la/ gzhan nas tshig gis sbyin gyi dngos su mi sbyin par gsungs pa ni/ phyis dge slong dge tshul gyi tshul bzung nas bstan pa skyong zhing / dge 'dun gyi bdag po byed pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya nyer bzhi par/ 'dod dang dga' ba dang ni 'dar dang 'gyur med bzhi rim pa bzhin du/ sku gsung thugs ye shes te dga' ba bzhi dang / gang ba mchog dga'/ skye ba bus pa rnams/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi mchog dga' ba bzhi dang / 'bar ba khyad dga'/

rgyal ba/ thig le rnams sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi khyad dga' bzhi dang / oṭ+ṭa lhan gcig skyes dga'/ gnyid/ nā da rnams sku gsung thugs ye shes te lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi/ de rnams kyang rim pa bzhin du sprul pa'i sku la sogs pa sku bcu drug tu bshad/ ye shes le'ur/ rdzogs pa ngag gi dga' ba/ 'bar ba sems kyi dga' ba/ oṭ+ṭa ye shes kyi dga' ba zhes sogs mi mthun par 'byung zhing / de bzhin du sku'i dga' ba dang mchog dga' sogs sprul sku/ gsung gi dga' ba sogs longs sku/ thugs kyi dga' ba sogs chos sku/ ye shes kyi dga' ba sogs lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes su bshad pa dang / yang sku gsung thugs ye shes bzhis dga' ba rnams sprul pa/ mchog dga' rnams longs spyod rdzogs pa/ khyad dga' rnams chos sku/ lhan cig skyes dga' rnams ngo bo nyid kyi skur bshad pa ni/ snga ma bshad pa'i rim pa phyi ma skye ba'i rim pa'am/ yang na sgrib bcas kyi dus na/ lus kyi khyad dga' dang / sems kyi dga' ba mi gcig kyang sgrib pa dang bral ba'i tshe ro gcig pas/ 'bar ba sku'i khyad dga' dang / sems kyi dga' ba yang bshad do/ /de bzhin du sku dga' ba sogs sku yi rnams phyogs gcig tu bstan pa ni bshad pa'i rim pa/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dga' ba zhes dga' ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bstan pa ni mngon par rtogs pa skye rim dang sbyar ba yin te/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar bas haṃ zhu ba na dpral ba na sad dus kyi gnas skabs skyed par byed pa lus kyi thig le la sogs pa rnams kyang zhu ste/ sku'i dga' ba la sogs pa dga' ba rnam pa bzhi po dus gcig la nyams su myong zhing / de bzhin du mchog dga' bzhi/ khyad dga' bzhi/ lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi po rnams kyang dus re re la nyams su myong ba yin/ tshigs bcad brgya nyer lnga par/ ma la sogs pa rnam par dag pas so/

/zhes pa'i mchan bur/ 'di dag nang lus kyi rdul la sogs pa dang / zhes pa'i don/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ da ni shes rab brjod par bya ste/ ma zhes pa la sogs pas so/ /'dir thabs ni pha ste khu ba'i khams so/ /shes rab ma ste rdul gyi khams so/ /bskyed pa ni las kyis byin brlabs pa'i dri za'i sems can 'chi ba'i mthar gyur pa skye ba'i char gtogs pa'i kun gzhi rnam par shes pa ste/ de kho na nyid 'gro ba'i sgras brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kye rgyal ba'i sras rnams khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'gro ba ni de kho na'o/ /'gro ba skyed par byed do zhes pa/ shes rab ma ru brjod par bya ste/ rdul gyi khams so/ /de bzhin du bskal pa can ni thabs te khu ba'i khams so/ /gang phyir rnam dbye ston pa'i phyir/ shes rab de kho na sring mor brjod par bya/ khams kyi rnam 'gyur so so'i ba spu dang / pags pa dang / sha dang khrag gi'o/ /de bzhin du thabs ni spun zla ste/ gang gi phyir rtsa dang rus pa dang / rkang gi rnam par dbye ba ston pa de'i phyir khu ba'i khams so/ /yon tan 'jo phyir shes rab de kho na ni bu mor yang brjod par bya ste/ yon tan rnams ni sgra dang reg bya dang gzugs dang ro dang dri dang chos kyi yul rnams te/ de rnams 'jo ba'i phyir ni de 'dzin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du thabs bu ste mig la sogs pa rnams rab tu 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir thabs kyi phyir thabs kyi khams so/ /de bzhin du shes rab ni sring mo'i bu mo ste/ yul la rnam par shes pa rnams 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /thabs ni spun zla'i bu ste mig la sogs pa rnams la rab tu 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du 'pho ba'i bde ba la 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir/ shes rab ni chung mar brjod do/ /thabs kyang khyo bor brjod de phan tshun ltos pa nyid kyi phyir/

gnyis ka yang 'pho ba'i bde ba'i chos las so/ /zhes pa'o/ /chags pa dang bral ba las/ shes rab ni reg min mthar skyes ma/ zhes brjod do/ /thabs kyang ngo zhes pa phyag rgya drug gi nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud las/ gang phyir skye 'gro bskyed pa yi/ /shes rab ma zhes brjod par bya/ /gang phyir bskal pa ston pa yi/ /shes rab sring mo zhes bya nyid/ /yon tan 'jo phyir shes rab ni/ /bu mo zhes ni brjod par bya/ /gang phyir bcom ldan mi reg pas/ /de phyir g.yung mor brjod par bya/ /zhes pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /lam la sbyar ba ni bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim la sbyar ba gnyis te/ 'grel par gsal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya zhe bdun par/ yul can du 'gyur te zhes pa'i yul can gyi skad dod bi ṣa yi zhes pa la/ bi ṣa dug la 'jug pas dug can du 'gyur zhes pa yin nam snyam mo/ /tshigs bcad brgya zhe brgyad par/ mi bskyod pa ni gcin no zhes pa ni/ nang ler dri chu 'du shes kyi phung por bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na/ 'dir dri chu mi bskyod par byas pa ni rgyud sde gzhan nas gsungs pa dang sgo bstun nas bstan pa yin la/ nang ler gsungs pa ni byis pa skyes tsam nas dri chu 'dzag cing 'du shes kyi phung po'ang yod kyi/ lo bcu drug ma lon gyi bar du 'du shes kyi phung po yod kyang khu ba ma 'dzag pa'i phyir/ dri chu 'du shes kyi phung por bzhag ste nges pa'i don no/ /'di ni bsgrub ler byung ba yang shes par bya'o/ /don yod grub pa ni rkang ngo / /zhes par/ sdom 'byung nas rab rkang 'bring klad pa dang gzhungs pa/ tha ma tshil bur bshad do/ /tshigs bcad brgya zhe dgu par/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ni gzugs thams cad 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ mi sha la sbyar ro/ /tshigs bcad brgya nga gnyis par/ rmongs pas gti mug dag las/ zhes par/ pu hrangs lo chung gi slob ma sgom chen gcig gis/

'a zha rgya gar brtsegs dang / mar pa do pa sogs dang 'grogs nas bal po pham mthing pa'i drung du phyin pa'i tshe/ sgom chen de mkha' 'gro mas tshogs gral du bcug mdze po'i sha byin pas skyug bro nas ma zos pas/ zho byin de bla ma la bshad pas/ bod ngan pa dngos grub len ma shes pa 'dug gsungs/ zho de kho rang gi klad par yod pa 'dug ste/ de ma khad shi zhes grag tshigs bcad brgya nga dgu par/ des dam tshig gi rdzas gang byin pa de za bar bya ste/ zhes par/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'bu'i tshod ma ma gsol ba dang / a bha yas rigs ngan las drangs pa'i chang ma gsol ba dang / mai tri bas rngon pas byin pa'i khrag ma gsol bas dngos grub kyi bar chad du gyur pa lta bu ma yin pa zhig dgos so/ /tshigs bcad brgya re gcig par/ rtsa bab pa'i dbye bas thod pa dum bu bcu gnyis zhes pa/ rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma gsum 'bab pa la/ sku gsung thugs ye shes bzhis phye ba'i gnas skabs bzhis phye bas bcu gnyis so/ /tshigs bcad brgya re gsum par/ mig lag phur/ sangs/ spen/ mjug rnams gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa dang rim pa bzhin sbyar ba ni 'gal te/ mig dmar me'i khams yin la/ gzugs rdo rje ma ni chu khams yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gzhan la yang ngo / /zhe na/ skyon med de/ ye ler gza' drug po rim pa bzhin du mig nas yid kyi bar du dbang po drug tu bshad cing / mig gi yul gzugs/ yid kyi yul chos kyi bar du yin pas gza' drug po rnams lus kyi dbye bas dbang po drug yin la bsam pa'i dbang gi yul drug yin pas so/ /tshigs bcad brgya re bdun par/ de ltar byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos/ /zhes sogs su/ bde mchog pa rnams kyi lugs kyis phyi mtshan nyid nas bshad pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs ni mchog yin la/ rnal 'byor ma rnams ni de ltar ma yin no/ /snyam pa spang pa'i don du tshur dag tu sbyor/

de las bzlog par rtog pa la phar dag tu sbyor/ sangs rgyas pa'i byang phyogs so bdun nyid rnal 'byor ma so bdun du bstan pas/ de dag chos skur shes par byed pa ni mar dag rnal 'byor pas rnal 'byor ma so bdun bsgoms par 'bras bu'i byang phyogs so bdun thob pa ni mar dag ces gsungs so/ /tshigs bcad brgya re dgu par/ mchog gi ngang pa'o/ /skal ldan nam/ zhes bar du bcad pa de mi legs pas/ mchog gi ngang pa skal ldan nam/ /zhes sbyar te spyod pa'i bye brag go /skra 'bal/ zhes par dge slong bzang por grags pa zhig rkun pos bcom/ mgo bcag gcer bur phyung ba de/ mu stegs 'ga' zhig gis mthong nas/ 'di bzang po yin pa la gcer bu byed par 'dug pas de kho na nyid de 'di 'o snyam nas/ gcer bu'i brtul zhugs dang kha gcig gis de skra 'bal ba mthong nas de'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa sogs byung bas/ lta ngan 'ga' zhig de 'dra la brten nas byung zhing / g.yang la mchong ba dang / chu la mchong ba sogs mang po zhig mngon shes phra mo la brten nas 'byung bar bshad do/ /dbang gi le'u'i mdor bsdus lnga pa'i zin bris so/ /tshigs bcad brgya don gnyis par/ bla ma sher seng don grub kyi mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad de/ pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du zhes pa dang 'gal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya brgyad cu par/ ḍā ma ru dang / tho ba dang / 'khor lo gsum g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan yin pa la/ g.yon pa'i zla la ston pa 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ ḍā ma ru dang / tho ba thabs kyi cha/ rin po che dang pad+ma gnyis g.yas g.yon gnyis ka'i phyag mtshan thun mong bar bshad pas de'i shes rab kyi cha ḍā ma ru dang / tho ba gnyis kyang thabs kyi cha la ltos nas ma nges par bstan pa'i don du res 'ga' g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan gyi zla la smos/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya la lag pa gcig dang gnyis ka'i phyag rgya yod pas so/ /tshigs bcad brgya go gnyis par/

klu'i sbyor ba klu ste/ zhes par/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yob pa gcig mdzad de/ gdan bzhi nas bshad do/ /tshigs bcad brgya go bdun par/ 'dir dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i sems can gyi nang du rnal 'byor pas brda skad kyis brjod par bshad/ rgyud gzhan dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dus pa'i nang du brda skad kyis brjod par bshad do/ /tshigs bcad nyis brgya par/ rgyal ba'i bdag po'i bka' yis kun spangs la ni sbyin par bya/ /zhes par/ dus 'khor ba kun shes khams pa gcig la kun spangs kyi dbang byed zer nas/ rdor dril sogs gang la'ang rdo gong re gtad pas/ kho na re/ dbang rang da re bas nyon mongs pa rang e byung zer te/ kho bden/ slob ma la med kyang slob dpon la yod yong mod/ de 'dras kun spangs kyi dbang gi go mi chod/ gnyis ka la med na bsgoms pas kyang chog go /tshigs bcad nyis brgya gcig par/ 'jig rten pa rnams ni rang gi gnas su'o/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'dis/ kha cig dkyil 'khor na med pa'i lha 'das pa rnams rang la bsdu/ dbang po la sogs pa rang gnas su gshegs zer te/ de min ye shes pa'i phyir 'brangs pa'i 'jig rten pa dkyil 'khor gyi phyi na 'khod pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa yin no/ /dbang gi le'u'i mdor bsdus drug pa ste/ dbang gi le'u'i zin bris rdzogs so/ /sgrub thabs le'u'i tshigs bcad gnyis par/ zla ba'i sku zhes par/ phyi ru lo gcig nang du zhag gcig dag pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gcig go /de'i dus sbyor drug drug ces pa/ lho bgrod kyi drug ni zhabs g.yas/ byang bgrod kyi drug ni zhabs g.yon/ nang du sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi 'pho ba ni zhabs g.yas g.yon no/ /zla ba so so'i bdag nyid ni dpung pa rnams te/ zhes pa phyi ru zla ba so so dang nang du dus sbyor so so'i bdag nyid do/ /phyag nyer bzhi ste/ zhes par/ 'bro ba gong ma kun dang /

chos rje kun spangs pa la sogs pa phyag nyer bzhi zhes bshad kyi/ dpung pa nyer bzhi ma gsungs zer nas/ mkhrig ma nas gyes par 'dod/ 'bro pa dang / shong pa dang / rwa pa phyi ma rnams gru mo nas gyes par 'dod/ 'di 'thad de dus zhabs pa chung bas bzhengs pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo la 'di ltar 'dug ces glo bo tshul khrims 'od zer zer ro/ /gzhan yang dus zhabs pa chung ba dang / slob dpon a bha yas rdo las bzhengs pa'i chos dbyings gsung dbang la/ dkyil 'khor zlum po'i rtsig pa nang ma'i zur gyis bcad pa mdzad 'dug ces kyang zer ro/ /tshigs bcad bzhi par/ de ltar kha la sogs pa dag par byas nas/ zhes par/ bdud rtsi ril bus kha dag pa dang / mchog gi phyag rgyas lus dag pa dang / stong nyid kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis yid dag par byas/ lha mo rol mo ma dang / gar ma thog mar smos la/ dbang ler dri phreng gnyis thog mar smos pa 'gal zhe na/ sgrub ler nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i skye rim gyi rim pa la dgongs nas bstan/ dbang ler phyogs kyi lha mo rnams thog mar smos la steng gi rnams mjug tu smos pa yin te/ phyogs kyi snam bu la gnas pa mchod lha gtso bo snyam du dgongs pa'o/ /sdig bshags la skyabs 'gro smos pa ni rten gyi stobs mtshon pa'o/ /tshigs bcad lnga par/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang / zhes par/ phyag 'tshal gsol gdab skul ba gong du ma byung yang / dgos par don bsdu 'dis shes so/ /dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad 'di rtsa rgyud na yod zer te/ gsang bsdus na bzhugs so/ /tshigs bcad bdun par/ chu yis me rnam par nyams par byed ces sogs su/ dus 'khor bas lugs la 'chi rim thams cad la sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rim pa yin pa la/ 'di de dang ma mthun no zhe na/ snod me chu rlung gsum gyis 'jig nang gi gnad bad mkhris rlung gsum gyis gcod pas/ 'dir snod chus 'jig pa dang bstun pa'am/

chu rlung gnyis kas 'jig pa dang bstun pa'o/ /kha cig 'di'i skabs kyi stong pa nyid ni chad stong yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sgrub thabs kyi le'u'i mdor bsdus dang po'i zin bris so/ /tshigs bcad brgyad par/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa zhes par/ zlum po'i dbus drang por steng 'og tu gzhu'i rnam pa'o/ /zhes bla ma dpal ldan pa gsungs/ bkra shis kyis mtshan pa'o/ /zhes par/ bkra shis ni/ ri mo la g.yung drung 'khyil pa/ sman la ghi haṃ/ gza' la mig dmar/ zas la zho la sogs pa mang po la 'jug kyang / 'dir g.yung drung 'khyil pa'o/ /de las 'jig rten gyi khams grub par bsam par bya'o/ /zhes par/ bla mar rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa na re/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed pa snga ma ni dbyibs so so ba yin la/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyur nas bskyed pa ni thams cad zlum po'o zhes gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor la 'bri dus zlum por yod pa la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /ma'i lus la dpral bar klung gi dkyil 'khor zhes par/ nam mkha' smos kyang gong du smos pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum mo/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma'i lte bar de rnams 'dus zhes pa'i 'di dang / dbang le'i nga drug par nang du la la nā dang ra sa nā dang / a ba dhu ti dang yang dag ldan pa snying kha'i pad+ma ste zhes pa dang / 'og brgya zhe gcig par/ nang du la la nā dang / ra sa nā dang / a ba dhū ti gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa snying kha'i pad+ma ste zhes bshad pa la brten nas/ grub chen man lung pa 'khor lo drug kha lte bar 'dus par bzhed do/ /tshigs bcad dgu par/ de bzhin du gsang ba'i pad+ma nas/ 'og dang steng du zhes par ma mtha' gsang ba nas te/ snying kha nas 'og tu gsang ba'i pad+ma dang steng du spyi bo zhes sbyar ro/ /khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs zhes par/ bla ma sher seng /

dang po steng nas steng du brtsegs par 'dod/ phyis khyams khra bzhin gcig gi nang du gcig yod par bzhed/ shong pas kyang bre'i nang du bre bcug pa bzhin bzhed ces grag kyang / sku'i steng du gsung / gsung gi steng du thugs/ de'i steng du bde chen 'khor lo/ de las gtso bo'i gnas cung mtho ba ste/ lnga rtseg gi rnam pa tog dang bcas pa/ tog gi rtse mo nas ma mtha'i bar dang / sku'i rtsig pa'i rgya mnyam pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la kha khyer te zhes par/ rong pa chos mgon na re/ kha khyer bya ba 'dug pa/ kha khyer gdan du 'ong pa 'gal/ des na rtsig pa'i steng na phar yod zer ro/ de ni mi 'thad de 'dod yon snam bu rtsig pa'i steng du 'ong ba gang nas kyang bshad pa med do/ /dge bas kra ma shir+ṣi'o zhes par/ kha cig rdo kra ma shir+ṣa las byas pa'i pu shu zer ba blun gtam yin/ des na kra ma rim pa/ shīr+ṣa mgo bo ste/ mgo'i rim pa zhes pa'o/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan ces par/ bla ma sher seng / dang po pha gu'i zur du 'bag sna bzhin bzhed/ phyis de nor 'dug gsungs nas 'gram rtsar 'ong bar bzhed do/ /tshigs bcad bcu par/ zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ a sogs zhes par/ dbyangs yig gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs yig mtshan pa bsgom/ de bzhin du nyi ma la'ang 'dra'o/ /de dag las 'og tu nyi ma'i zhes sogs su/ kha cig nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su zer ba kun gzhan gyi chos skad 'chugs pa yin te/ 'dir nyi ma'i steng du zla ba'o/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig ces dang rdul gyi steng du khu ba'o/ /khu ba'i dbus su kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes gsungs pas/ ga'u kha sbyor mi byed/ dper na nyi ma gza' yis 'dzin pa de yang zla ba bzung ba'i zhar la nyi ma bzung ba yin gyi nyi ma tsha bas 'jug mi nus pa bzhin/ bar do'i sems can yang /

pha'i khams spyi bo'am/ ma'i khams mngal sgo nas khu ba la 'jus nas 'jug gi ma'i rdul la 'dzin mi nus par bshad do/ /zla ba dang khu ba dbyangs dang ldan pa ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes te gzugs kyi phung po skyed par byed pa rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes pa gzhan nas khu ba 'od dpag med du bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na/ skyon med de/ zla stobs kyis gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bshang gci khu ba gsum las bshang ba rnam snang dang / gci ba mi bskyod par byas pa ni khu ba 'od dpag med du 'gyur te/ ji ltar bshad pa rnam snang dang / /gci ba khu ba'i dam tshig ni/ /mi bskyod 'od dpag med yin pa/ /zhes rdo rje snying 'grel las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bdud rtsi lnga la dri chu 'od dpag med du byas pa na/ khu ba mi bskyod pa yin te nang ler bstan pa bzhin no/ /'dir khu ba dang / rdul dang / dri za dang / rlung dang / rnam par shes pa rnams rigs lngar byas pa na/ khu ba ni zla ba yin/ zla ba ni sku rdo rje yin/ sku rdo rje ni sbyang gzhi la gzugs kyi phung po yin pas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang rnam snang du byas pa mi 'gal te/ ye ler/ sku rdo rje'i dbang du byas nas/ rnam snang dkar por gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir gsang sngags la/ ngo bo dang / rnam pa dang / mos pa dang / 'bras bu lam du byed pa yin pa las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes bsgom pa ngo bo dang / de rnam pa zla bar bsgom pa rnam pa dang / de der mos pa ni mos pa dang / 'bras bu me long lta bu nyid rgyu dus nas de'i tshul du bsgom pa 'bras bu lam du byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du mtshan dpe bsgom pa ngo bo/ de dag dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par bsgom pa rnam pa/ yi ge nyid mtshan dpe'i rnam par mos pa mos pa lam du byed pa rnams te rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos so/ /phyi rol nang du ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes par/

bla ma bsod nams 'od zer mngon byang lnga'i steng du phyag mtshan/ de la sku zer te/ de ltar na mngon byang bdun du 'gyur bas mi 'thad cing ma bshad do/ /yang lha rnams skye ba'i dus su rgyan dang bcas par skye zhes pa mi rigs te/ 'di mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas la/ lha mngal skyes mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na skyon med/ lha mngal skyes mi srid kyang / nam skye ba na rgyan dang bcas par skye'i rgyan med par mi skye ba bzhin 'dir yang rgyan dang bcas pa yin no/ /'o na sbyang gzhi dang mi mthun te/ mngal skyes la rgyan dang bcas pa mi skye ba'i phyir ro snyam na/ mthun pa'i bsod nams kyi las bsags pa'i mngal skyes 'ga' zhig rgyan dang bcas par skye ste/ dper na gro zhun skyes rna ba bye ba ri ba rna rgyan dang bcas te skyes pa bzhin no/ /tshigs bcad bcu gcig par/ drag po lus med ces pa la/ dbang phyug dka' thub mi spyod pa'i tshe/ ral pa dang bcas shing mig gsum pa/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can yin pas na drag po/ dka' thub spyod pa'i tshe na de ltar ma yin pas zhi ba zhes zer ro/ /zhes bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta gsungs so/ /lus med ni 'dod pa'i lha ste/ de yang dbang phyug dka' thub spyod pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis 'dod lha la dbang phyug gi dka' thub spyod pa'i tshe bzlog par mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab/ des u ma dka' thub bzlog pa'i phyir btang ste/ rang gi 'dod pa'i mda' 'phangs pas so/ /dang po la ma g.yos gnyis pa dang gsum pa la cung zad g.yo bar gyur/ bzhi pa la chags te u ma la zhugs/ de nas 'gyod de cis lan brtags pas/ 'dod lhas byas pa yin par shes nas kha'i dbugs kyis bsregs/ de nas lha rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas/ lus med pa'i sems can du byas zhes grag go /shar gyi zhal ni nag po zhes par/ kha cig rtsa zhal gyi kha dog sku mdog dang 'dra zer ba mi 'thad de/ sku mdog sngon po yin la/

rtsa zhal nag por bshad pas so/ /nag po dang sngon po 'dra'o snyam na/ ma yin te rgyud gzhan na 'dra ba lta bur yod kyang / 'dir nag po rlung sngon po ye shes yin pas rnam dag mi gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /bla ma 'phags pa'i gsung gis/ dus 'khor 'di mi gshis ngan reg kyang mi bzod pa dang 'dra/ rgyud gzhan rnams ni mi ngang ring rgyu can du 'dra gsungs/ ci rigs nas mdzad par snang ste/ gsang 'dus nas lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal bar ma gsungs pa rgyud gzhan la ltos pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas/ lha'i kha dog dbu/ phyag mtshan ngo mi shes pa mang po yod/ bla ma mtsho mo che bas kyang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i phyag mtshan 'phongs ngo ma shes par/ 'phongs bslabs skyes bus gnam du mda' 'phangs te zhes pa'i tshul du byas pa dang / bla ma smon shes/ gdos dang gdu bu ba nya rgya/ /zhes bya ba gang lags/ zhes zhus pas/ gdos ni ri dwags 'dzin pa'i gdos/ gdu bu ba ni nya skyogs/ nya rgya ni go sla'o/ /ba nya rgya zhes pa ma dag pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du mi gsal ba du ma yod kyang / rgyud 'grel 'dir ni re re tsam ma gtogs pa shin tu gsal lo/ /ral pa'i cod paṇa la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zhes par/ spyir ral pa la gyen brjes/ zur phud/ cod paṇa/ phyed bcings/ gyen brjes la'ang / ser po/ kham pa/ nag po sogs/ zur phud la'ang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs yod/ 'di dang bde dgyes sogs cod paṇa yin/ de skra'i sna thams cad nang du bsdus nas bcings pa'i mdud pa'i sna mo yang nang du tshud pa gcig yod/ rdo rje nor bu dang zhes sogs la/ sga lo'i zhal nas/ mi rus la byas pa rdo rje'i dbyibs can gyi nor bu zhes sogs gsungs/ yang na rdo rje'i don stong pa nyid dbyibs nor bu la sogs pa'i rgyan du byas pa'o/ /stag gi pags pa'i gos 'dzin/ /zhes par/ spyir yum dang mi sbyor na stag lpags mgo g.yas mjug ma g.yon du bstan nas gyon pa la/

yum dang sbyor na grol ba dang 'phyang ba gnyis yod/ grol ba de ka la brla'i phyed na mar 'phyang ba de yin/ 'phyang ba rgyab tu bshugs nas mog g.yon mjug ma g.yas su bstan pa la zer/ de lta min na stag lpags la bug pa phug dgos par 'gyur ro/ /la la na re ye shes kyi snang ngo yin pas de 'dra ga na dgos zer te/ de'i snang ngo na yum dang sbyor ba yang ga na yong ste/ tha mal 'dul ba la de dang tshul mthun tsam gcig 'tshal lo/ /tshigs bcad bcu gnyis par/ mthe'u chung ljang khu zhes pa la/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer ljang khu zer yang sngon po 'o zer ba nor te de gnyis rnam dag mi gcig pas so/ /dang por me'i mda' zhes par/ bla ma sher seng gis mda' dmar po gsum 'dzin pa mdzad 'dug gsum yin nam me rang du yin the tshom du dgongs pa 'dra/ bsod nams 'od zer me rang yin zer/ 'di lan mang po byung yang 'grel pa med pas shes dka' yang / me'i mgrin pa zhes sogs kyi rigs pas gsum du gsal lo/ /tshigs bcad bcu bzhi par/ zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin zhes par/ rwa 'gyur du rkang pa'i mthil la 'dzin zhes 'byung pa la brten nas bla ma shar seng mo reng gnyis kyis khyo bo'i rkang pa la 'then pa yin gsungs te/ thar lo na re de min/ khyo bo gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyis mnan pas chung ma gnyis gdong dman pa ste ngu zhing 'di 'dra mi mdzad pa zhu zer nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'ju bar rtsom pa yin gsungs/ dus zhabs pas bzhengs pa'i rdo sku la yang 'di ltar yod par 'dug pas 'di 'thad do/ /sku de la zhal lnga 'dug zer ba byung ste/ de rgyab zhal g.yas g.yon gnyis ka nas mthong ba'i mu ru byas nas gnyis su mdzad pas 'khrul pa yin par 'dug ste/ glo bo ba tshul khrims 'od kyis mthong zhing nges pa las thos so/ /mi bskyod pa rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa/ mi bskyod pa ljang khu yin/ gtso bo sngon po yin pas 'gal lo zhe na skyon med de/

spyir gtso bo yab yum rigs thams cad bsdus pa yin/ de la chu rlung nam mkha' thabs kyi sku gsung thugs ro mnyam gcig tu 'dus pa gtso bo/ sa me ye shes shes rab kyi sku gsung thugs ro mnyam dbyer med gcig tu bsdus pa gtso mo yin te/ tshigs bcad bco lnga par/ de la ro mnyam pa gcig las zla ba dang khu ba'i rang bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das bskyed cing / nyi ma dang rdul gyi rang bzhin gyis lha mo bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de la dkar dang nag po'i chos can ni zla ba ste/ zhes pas chu thabs kyi sku dkar po dang / rlung thabs kyi gsung nag po gnyis dbyer med du 'dres pas sngon por gyur pa/ de nam mkha' thabs kyi thugs mi bskyod pas bzung ba yin pa'i phyir/ thugs kyi cha nas gtso bo mi bskyod par yang mi 'gal la/ sku dang gsung 'dres pa'i mtshon pa'i cha nas sku mdog sngon por yang mi 'gal lo/ /dmar po dang ser po'i chos can ni nyi ma ste/ des na gser mdog ces par/ sa shes rab kyi sku ser po dang / me shes rab kyi gsung dmar po gnyis ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres pas dmar ser du gyur pa de ye shes shes rab kyi thugs sna tshogs yum gyis bzung ba yin pa'i phyir/ thugs gtso bor byas pa'i phyir sna tshogs yum du'ang mi 'gal la/ sku gsung ro mnyam dbyer med du 'dres pa mtshon pa'i phyir sku mdog dmar ser du'ang mi 'gal lo/ /tshigs bcad bcu drug par bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi dbye ba ji lta ba de bzhin du lha mo rnams kyi ste zhes par/ kha cig thams cad yab kyi zhal 'gros yin zer ba rnams nor te/ lha mo ser dmar rnams yum gyi zhal 'gros dang / dkar nag rnams yab kyi zhal 'gros su bshad/ snying po'i lha mo rnams kyi rgyan dang phyag rgya lnga pa rnams bcom ldan 'das ma'i ji lta ba bzhin/ zhes par/ gong ma rnams kyis sna tshogs yum gcer mo/ nus ma rnams sham thabs can mdzad 'dug ste/

gzhung 'dis 'dra ba gcig dgos par bshad do/ /tshigs bcad bco brgyad par/ gsum pa ni bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu/ zhes par/ 'bro pa rnams a ru ra yin zer/ 'di'ang rung par snang ste/ a ru ra'i shing la bdud rtsi'i shing zhes a ma ra ko ṣar bshad do/ /don la zhim pa gcig yod par mdo las gsungs te sngon bcom ldan 'das dang lhas sbyin gnyis bya lus gcig la mgo bo gnyis yod pa gcig tu skyes/ lhas sbyin gyi mgo de gnyid du song pa'i bar la bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu chus khyer byung pa gsol bas/ gnyid sad pa dang sgregs pa byung nas dris/ 'di ltar zhes bsnyad pas nga la mi ster ba ci zer/ khong par gcig tu song pas so byas pas de ltar yin na zer nas khos dug zos pas gnyis ka shi bar bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa rnams rang gi lus la bzhugs par bya ste zhes par/ 'og brgya zhe gcig pa nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo gang yin pa de thams cad bkun nas a wa dhu ti'i sgo nas gtsug tor dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / snying kha dang / lte ba dang / gsang ba'i lam du bzhugs par bya ste sogs kyis spyi bo nas 'jug par bshad do/ /lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid ces par/ kha cig pad+mar gzhal yas khang mi bskyed zer ba yod de 'dis bkag go /tshigs bcad bcu dgu par/ steng du gtsug tor te kha dog dang zhal dang phyag mi bskyod pa lta bu ljang khu'o zhes bshad pas kha cig zhal gcig phyag gcig par 'dod pa bsal lo/ /tshigs bcad nyi shu par/ kun bzang dang sgra rdo rje ma ye shes yin pas 'og phyogs shes rab kyi cha yin la/ phyag rdor dang chos dbyings rdor ma nam mkha' yin pas steng phyogs thabs kyi cha yin pas thabs kyi cha gnyis po shar dang byang du bkod/ shes rab kyi cha gnyis po lho dang nub tu dgod par rigs pa las bzlogs nas thabs kyi cha gnyis po lho dang nub du bkod/

shes rab kyi cha gnyis po shar dang byang du bkod pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de kun bzang ye shes kyi cha 'og phyogs dag pa yin yang de'i yul chos dbyings rdo rje ma nam mkha'i khams steng phyogs dag pa yin pas/ yum gyi gnas su yab song ba'i dbang du byas nas kun bzang shar du bkod de/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma nam mkha'i khams steng phyogs ma yin yang / kun bzang ye shes 'og phyogs yin pas yab kyi gnas su yum song ba'i dbang du byas nas chos dbyings rdo rje ma nub tu bkod do/ /des phyag rdor dang sgra rdo rje la'ang shes par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad nyer bzhi par/ 'bro pa rnams dang / bla ma sher seng / rdo rje sems dpa' la gri gug rdo rje/ dgra satwa/ thod pa/ dril bu/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa zhes zer ba 'thad 'thad 'dra yang / 'dis bkag ste/ mi bskyod pa sogs ljang khu rnams kyi phyag mtshan bshad nas de bzhin du zhes sngon po rnams kyang 'dra bar gsungs pas so/ /tshigs bcad nyer lnga par/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa yang dpal 'dus pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes par/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer ba/ lha nyer lnga ma byed na gtso bo sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs pa 'dus pa bzhin no/ /'di la bzhengs dgos pa'i skyon med ces sbyor yang / bi bhu ta zhe na zer ba'i mchan bu btab nas/ 'di la bzhugs dgos pa sogs kyi skyon med de/ gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pas gtso bo bzhengs 'khor bzhugs pa la 'gal ba med ces sbyor ro/ /lha nyer lnga ma byed kyang gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa yin te/ 'grel chung pad+ma can dang dus zhabs pa chung bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gi don du zhes pa la/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa na re/ nyer lnga ma bsgom du rung gi dbang la dar dpyangs nus ma'i dbang yin pas/ nus ma dang ming dbang la khro bo dang khro mo cis kyang dgos gsungs kyang nges pa med de/

nang ler lha dgu dang bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bdun gsungs pas so/ /rigs kyi dbang gis phyi'i 'khor lo rab tu dman/ zhes par/ rong pa kun na re/ e pa 'khon ston slob ma dbang bskur ba la yongs rdzogs bkag zer ba yin zer nas thal 'gyur mang po snang ste/ e zer mi shes/ zer na 'dzol/ de'i don gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor med kyang / thugs dkyil la rigs drug tshang bas der dbang rdzogs par bskur du rung zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad nyer drug par/ gdong sna tshogs pa'o/ /zhes par/ bla ma sher seng gsung gi rnal 'byor ma 'di dag thams cad gdong gcig mar bzhed pa la/ khro phu ba'i dge bshes byang seng gis gdong drug ma dang / chu gter gdong ma bya ba gda' lags pa zhus pas/ nges pa med de/ khro phu ba la dge bshes khro brgyad bya ba yod gsungs/ de la brgyad bdog zhus pas/ gtsang drug bya ba yang yod gsungs te/ de'ang sor mo drug yod pas zer ba yin/ kun dga' 'od zer na re/ ra chung re'i ske bregs na sdig pa che zer te/ bla ma pas lha sum brgya lhag pa gcig gi ske bregs zer nas kha gtong / des na tshangs ma gtso 'khor gdong bzhi/ gdong drug ma gtso 'khor gdong drug gzhan rnams gdong gcig pa ste sna tshogs pa'o gsung / 'og gi gdong drug sogs la'ang 'gre'o/ /tshigs bcad nyer drug par/ phag mo lho dang drag mo byang du bkod pa la/ de gnyis me dang chu'i khams yin na/ gshin rje dang drag po'ang me dang chu'i khams su 'gyur dgos pa la de gnyis nam mkha' dang ye shes su bshad pa 'gal lo snyam na/ skyon med de/ gsung gi rnal 'byor ma rnams khams bzhi dag pa'i dbang du byas la/ de thams cad khams bzhir bsdus na/ phag mo me dang drag mo chu'i khams su 'gro ba yin te/ des na gshin rje me dang drag po chu khams su thal ba'ang 'dod pa yin te/ srung 'khor gyi skabs su de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/

/sku'i dkyil 'khor du lo gcig gi dus drug dag pa'i dbang du byas nas khams drug tu phye nas bstan la/ de'i tshe gshin rje nam mkha' dang drag po ye shes su byas pa yin pas 'gal ba med do/ /tshigs bcad sum cu par/ brgyad pa dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma zhes pa la/ bla ma sher seng gis dpal ldan ma dang / 'khor lo can ma zhes gnyis su mdzad de/ rwa 'gyur du dpal ldan rgyal byed ma chad/ de las 'gyur gzhan ma gzigs pas lan no/ /tshigs bcad so gsum par/ shar sgo'i g.yas su 'ong sogs ni/ nang nas phyir la 'gro ba'i g.yas dang g.yon du shes par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad so drug par/ 'di rnams ni gzhan gyi gnas su 'gro ba'i phyir gtso bo ma yin pa nyid du zhes par/ 'od zer can la sogs pa 'di dag pha yul zur na yod cing / dbyug sngon sogs go mag tu len pa gzhan dang 'dra dgos pa la de ltar byas na sgo srung mkhan med pas/ shar sogs su bag ma la song pas mo mi gtso pho gtso ba yin/ mdor na gtso bo la rgyab bstan pa mi gtso/ mdun bstan pa gtso 'o/ /tshigs bcad so bdun par/ de bzhin du shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi sgor gnas pa dbyug pa sngon po dang / zhes sogs kyis khro bo bzhi po 'di zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gsal bar bstan no/ /tshigs bcad so brgyad par/ 'og dang steng du rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba dag go /zhes pa 'di steng dang 'og tu go dgos so/ /rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni zhes par/ lho'i klu gnyis po ther tshugs pa gcig 'dug klu gzhan 'di tsho 'gyur gyin yong ba blo mi brtan pa gcig 'dug ste/ srung 'khor du pad chen dang 'jog po/ skabs 'dir pad+ma dang karko ṭa ro mnyam du'ang pad+ma dang karko ṭa/ rigs ldan dang mtha' yas zhes ci rigs su snang ngo / /'on kyang rgyan 'god dang / sa bon gyi skabs dang mchod sngags gsum mthun par snang ngo / /tshigs bcad so dgu par/

shar du khyi gdong ma sogs la/ 'dir gsal bar ma gsungs/ bde mchog nas mgo brnyan 'di dag yab sbas par bshad cing / shwā nā s+ye zhes pa dang / shwa na mu kha zhes pa khyi'i zhal yin/ mgo bo lha la gdong pa khyir yod pa yin gyi/ rnying ma kun gyis mgo bo ril po khyi sogs su byas pa nor ro/ /de bzhin gzhan la'ang 'gre'o/ /de lta ma yin na bya rog gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma lta bu la rna rgyan gdags pa med par 'gyur ro/ /tshigs bcad zhe gsum par/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la nam mkha'i dang sa 'og na gnas pa'i lha mo gang su yang rung ba de dag shar dang nub kyi rta babs kyi 'og tu blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa ni/ dbang ler/ steng gi lha mo shar nub kyi rta babs dang / 'og gi lha mo lho byang gi rta babs la bkod pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ 'dir spyir steng 'og gi lha rdul tshon la 'god na shar nub ces pa spyir btang gi tshul du gsungs/ lha mo gnyis las med na de ltar yin yang / lha mo bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir dbang ler rta babs bzhi la bgos nas bkod pas dmigs bsal yin pa'i phyir skyon med do/ /bla ma sher seng gi srid gsum bskyed ma dang / gsod 'dod ces gnyis su byas pa nor te/ 'dod ma'i grangs lhag par 'gyur bas so/ /tshigs bcad zhe dgu par/ de ltar sku'i rnam pas thugs rnam pa gsum dang zhes sogs la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la gtso bo mi 'dra ba gsum yod pas thugs gsum/ lha tshogs mi 'dra ba gsum yod pas gsung gsum/ dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba gsum yod pas sku gsum yin no/ /sgrub thabs le'u'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa'i zin bris so/ /tshigs bcad lnga bcu par/ spyan ma bdag ni zhes sogs la/ khams bzhi las sa'i khams dag pa/ lha mo bzhi las spyan ma/ phyag rgya bzhi las yum ste ma/ 'bras bu bzhi las rgyu mthun/ tshad med bzhi las btang snyoms/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin gyi dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/

de bzhin du phyi ma rnams kyang tshul des shes par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad nga gcig par/ de'i snying khar byas pa rnams kyi bzhin no/ /zhes pa bla ma sher seng gis ye shes sems dpa' bsgoms pa la 'chad kyang / rang lugs shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /shes rab thabs kyi rgyal po zhes sogs su/ kha cig dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rigs rnams rim pa bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la bsdus nas zhu/ de nas bzhengs zer te/ de lta na glus bskul mkhan med pa'i skyon yod/ kha cig bskul nas bzhengs de nas lha spros nas sngar gyi lha rnams la ye shes pa 'jug pa ltar thim par 'dod de/ de yang ma yin/ rang lugs la gtso bo nus ma dang bcas pa zhu/ 'khor rnams ma zhu ba lha mos bskul/ de'i ngo bor bzhengs nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar gnas pa rnams lus la bcug de nas shes rab kyi pad+mar spro/ de la bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i thig le las rten dang brten par gyur te spro/ las rgyal mchog tu thig le las sa bon/ de las phyag mtshan/ de las skur gyur te spro zhes dang / mngal du mig sogs dbang po ma grub pa'i sngon du rkang lag sogs grub pas de'i phyir dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu sems dpa'i sngon du khro bo spro ba bstan/ mngal nas btsas nas rkang lag 'gro len sogs kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i sngar mig la sogs pa yul 'dzin pa'i bya ba la 'jug pas las rgyal mchog tu khro bo'i sngon la sems dpa' spro zhes gsungs/ de rigs pa dang mthun yang / sngon bzhin du zhes pa dang mi mthun no/ /'dir bla ma sher seng gi gsung nas/ 'bro pas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu 'khor bskyed pa chad/ rwa pas sngar bskyed kyang / phyi ma mi bskyed pas las rgyal mchog chad/

rang cag sngon bzhin du zhes gsungs pas las rgyal mchog kyang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom gsungs/ de nan tar mdzad cing phyag len bzang pas de bzhin byed/ de dka' bas mi nus na ye mi bsgom par rang sla'o/ /rnam pa nyi shu rdzogs par byang chub ces par/ gyi co lugs pas lha mo bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ yum bzhi/ 'bras bu bzhi/ khams bzhi ste/ rnam pa nyi shu la bzhed kyang / de ni zhu ba glus bskul rkyang pa la 'chad par 'gyur gyi/ las rgyal mchog spyi la bshad par mi 'gyur bas/ des na bskul ba lnga/ de'i ngor bzhengs pa lnga/ ye shes dgug zhugs bcing mnyes ro mnyam lnga/ rgyas gdab bzhi/ dbang bskur te nyi shu'am/ yang na snga ma bcu'i steng du rgyas gdab bzhi dbang bskur drug ste nyi shu'o/ /gnyis pa sgo nga las skyes pa'o/ /zhes par/ rgyud gzhan du/ sgong skyes klu ni med pa ste/ /zhes bshad kyang / 'dir 'jig rten gyi khams bskyed pa ste/ zhes 'byung bas mi 'dra'o/ /tshigs bcad nga gsum par/ rdo rje'i glu'i zhags pa dag gis bcings zhes rdo rje shugs kyis sbrul zhags kyis bcings pa ni phyag mtshan la sbrul zhags med pas mi rigs so zhe na skyon med de/ 'ching bar byed pa la sbrul zhags bsngags pas rdo rje zhags pa nyid la der brjod pa'o/ /yang rdo rje khro bo rnams dbang shes dag pa la sbyar ba ni gzhan nas las dbang la sbyar ba dang mthun snyam na/ gzhan nas spyir phung khams skye mched so drug rigs so drug tu bsdud pa na/ las dbang khro bor byas la/ 'dir las rgyal mchog gi skabs su byas pa la mngal nas skye ba zhu ba glus bskul/ byis pa'i dbang po rab tu sad nas yul la 'jug pa ye shes dgug gzhug gi rnam dag gi dbang du byas pa yin pas rnam dag spyi dang bye brag yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /tshigs bcad nga bzhi par/ zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan dang dus me'i steng du/

zhes pa sgra gcan nam dus me'i steng du zhes go dgos te gnyis po gcig tu 'dzoms mi srid pas rnam dag dang mi mthun pas so/ /tshigs bcad nga dgu par de ltar 'og dang steng du stong pa'i sgo gsum/ zhes pa mthong khungs la zer ro/ /tshigs bcad re dgu par/ rnam snang la mi bskyod pa ni lus la sems kyi rgya/ snang mtha' la rnam snang ni ngag la lus kyi rgya/ rin 'byung la snang mtha' ni grogs la grogs can gyi rgya/ don grub la rin 'byung ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya'o/ /tshigs bcad bdun cu par/ drug gi cod paṇa ral pa zhes sogs su/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer na re/ gshegs pa drug ral pa can/ rin po che sogs kyi rgyan med pa/ lhag ma'i 'khor lo zhes sogs kyis gzhan rnams rgyan can zer te mi 'thad do/ /tshigs bcad don gcig par/ li las gos/ u las bdud rtsi'i snod/ ṛ las me long / ī las dri/ a las rgyud mangs/ aḥlas chos 'byung du byas pa ni/ li sa'i khams yin/ gos reg bya rdo rje ma'i phyag mtshan yin pas khams mi mthun la/ gzhan lnga la'ang de dang 'dra bas 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ drug po 'di thams cad bsam dbang gis bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /tshigs bcad don dgu pa/ ham̐ yig ni gtsug tor tu zhes par/ ha ya ra wa la ham̐ gi rim pas/ ha gtsug tor can/ ham̐ gnod mdzes su rigs so zhe na/ skyon med de/ thugs dkyil kyi khro bo rnams thig le can/ sku dkyil gyi ha ya ra wa la'i rim pas bzhag pa yin pas zla stobs kyis so/ /tshigs bcad brgyad cu par/ shin tu stobs zhes pa stobs po che'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya lnga par/ nyaḥzhes pa ni lugs las bzlog pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ zhes par bla ma sher seng snga ma'i rigs 'ded byas pas lha brgya re brgyad kyi sa bon nor 'dug des na snga ma dbyangs gsal byed gnyis ka skye rim/ phyi ma gsal byed bsdu rim du yod pas lugs bzlog gsungs so/

/mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dag gis hwa hwā'o/ /zhes mtha' yas kyi sa bon hwa/ rigs ldan gyi sa bon hwā ru byas pa ni/ dbang ler de las bzlog pa bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ klu 'di dag la lho phyogs kyi klu gnyis po ma gtogs pa thabs shes rab kyi cha 'gyur ba dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gong 'og gi skabs du mar la lar thabs su gsungs pa rnams la lar shes rab tu gsungs te/ ltos sa tha dad la ltos nas thabs shes rab gnyis ka'i char mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /tshigs bcad go brgyad pa dang go dgu par/ 'di byis pa'i gzugs rdzogs pa'i slad du zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sngar nang le'i phyi nang sdom pa'i sku bzhi bshad pa dang / le'u 'dir de nyid dkyil 'khor la sbyar te bshad pa rnams legs par shes nas sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi thabs shes su sbyor ba ni mngal du mdang skyes kyi byis pa'i lus rdzogs pa'i slad du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang sku rdo rje thabs shes rab ste/ de lhan skyes kyi sku ru 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dang por khu khrag rnam shes ro mnyam bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bde ba 'ba' zhig rig cing phyis zla ba drug song nas mngon shes lnga dang ldan pas dag pa'i sku yin pas so/ /sku rdo rjer 'jog pa ni khu khrag la brten nas 'byung ba bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi gzugs kyi phung po skra ba spu'i mthar thug pa'i gzugs rdzogs pas so/ /de lta bu'i gzugs phung de gzung bya yin pas shes rab yin/ de bde ba 'ba' zhig rig pa mngon shes lnga ldan des 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir thabs yin/ de gnyis gzung 'dzin dang thabs shes su gyur pas mngal 'dzin par byed kyi de gnyis ya bral na mngal rdzogs par byed mi nus pas so/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor la yang ngo / /zhes pa/ gtso bo yab yum nus ma mtshan ma bzhi/ bum pa gshegs pa gshegs ma rnams lhan skyes kyi sku yin/

rten gzhal yas khang sku rdo rje'o/ /rten de gzung bya/ gtso bo sogs brten pa rnams 'dzin byed/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas dkyil 'khor 'grub kyi ya bral na ma yin no/ /de 'bras bu la sbyar na bzhi pa'i gnas skabs sgrib bral du zad pa lhan skyes kyi sku rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid mchog tu mi 'gyur ba thabs yin/ gzugs phung sgrib bral du 'gyur pa tha mal pa'i yul dang dbang pos bgrod bya ma yin zhing spyod yul las 'das pa'i sku rdo rje shes rab/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa 'grub kyi ya bral na ma yin no/ /lam la sbyar ba'ang shes par bya'o/ /byis pa btsas nas so skyes kyi bar sems 'du shes gsal zhing rtog med shas che bas chos sku/ rlung rgyu zhing ngag brjod pa 'byung bas gsung rdo rje/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas ngag 'grub pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor la sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo chos sku/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gsung rdo rje/ de gnyis rigs dang rigs can nam/ bskyed bya skyed byed du gyur pa'i sgo nas thabs shes su gyur pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'grub bo/ /'bras bu la chos sku gnyid mthug po log pa'i gnas skabs sgrib bral du gyur pa thabs yin/ ngag sgrib bral rnam pa thams cad pa'i gsung rdo rje shes rab/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas sems can la chos ston pa 'byung ngo / /des na byis pa'i ngag smra brjod gsal por byed pa longs sku ste thabs/ byang chub kyi sems thugs 'du shes 'dzin pa po ste blang dor bye brag phyed pa po thugs rdo rje shes rab/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas 'jig rten gyi bya ba la 'jug pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor la thun brgyad dang / dbyug gu drug cu dang / thun mtshams bzhi dag pa'i gsung gi rnal 'byor ma dpon g.yog rnams longs sku/ phyi ru lo gcig

nang du zhag gcig steng du rnam par dag pa'i gtso bo thugs rdo rje/ de ltar thun tshod dang dbyug gu la sogs pas kyang nyin mtshan gyi dus bzung nas thabs shes su 'brel pa bzhin/ 'dir yang thabs shes su 'brel pas gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par byed pa yin/ 'bras bu mtha' yas pa'i skad kyis chos bstan pas ma rig pa'i mun pa sel zhing / mtha' yas pa'i chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pas longs sku dang / rnam rtog med pa'i sems thugs rdo rje'i thabs shes su gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa sems can gyi don byed pa por rig par bya'o/ /byis pa rnams la bcu drug lon nas khams rdzogs te bu bu mo sprul nus pas sprul pa'i sku ste thabs/ khu ba 'pho ba'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba ye shes rdo rje shes rab/ de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas 'pho ba'i bde ba ster zhing bu dang bu mo spro nus pa bzhin dkyil 'khor la lha chen bcu gnyis nas rab gtum gyi bar sprul sku/ gtso mo ye shes rdo rje de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas sgrib pa med pa'i bya ba la 'jug cing / ba spu sgrib bral 'byung po'i bar spro nus so/ /de bzhin du 'bras bu la gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs sgrib pa dang bral ba'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i sprul sku dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i ye shes rdo rje'i de gnyis thabs shes su gyur pas ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa dang / yan lag gzhan 'bras bu duḥkha yi bden pa ste/ de gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog pa'i thar pa ster bar byed do/ /de bzhin du lam la yang rig par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya tham par/ shes rab dang bcas pa zhes par/ yum gsum gyi phyag mtshan gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / rigs 'gros kyis sku rdo rje'i yab yum gsung rdo rje lta bu/ gsung rdo rje'i yum sku rdo rje lta bu/

thugs rdo rje'i yum ser mo phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra bar rigs so/ /sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes sngon por byas pa ni gzhan nas nag por byas pa dang 'gal lo snyam na skyon med de/ rigs drug tu phye na nag po yin pa la dgongs nas gzhan nas nag por gsungs pa la/ 'dir rigs thams cad gsum du bsdus nas sngon po'ang thugs kyi rigs su bsdu ba la dgongs nas sngon por gsungs so/ /byis pa phyi rol tu skyes pa na sad pa dang rmi lam dang gnyid mthug po'i gnas skabs yod pas de sbyang ba'i phyir las rgyal mchog la sku gsung thugs byin rlabs yod pa'o/ /mngal du sad pa sogs gnas skabs so so ba med pas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la sku gsung thugs byin rlabs med pa'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya bzhi par/ sku'i khro bo rnams las dbang lnga la dag pa sbyar ba ni gzhan nas thugs kyi khro bo las dbang dang dag pa sbyar ba 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ thugs kyi khro bo rnams ni las dbang lnga dag pa de la khro mo bya ba dag pas tshur 'khyud pa ste/ dper na sems dpa' drug la sems mas tshur 'khyud pa bzhin/ sku'i khro mo rnams ni bya ba dag pa la las dbang dag pa'i khro bos phar 'khyud pa ste/ dper na sems ma drug la sems dpa' drug gis phar 'khyud pa bzhin/ des na sku khro bo rnams kyang las dbang dag par mi 'gal te/ sems ma drug la 'khyud pa'i sems dpa' drug dbang po dag pa mi 'gal ba bzhin/ 'o na khro mo drug gtso mor byed pa thal zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar bstan zin no/ /sgrub thabs le'u'i mdor bsdus gsum pa'i zin bris so/ /tshigs bcad brgya bcu gcig par/ rnam pa sna tshogs la sogs pa'i dbye bas byon pa dang / zhes pa ni/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dang / rnam par smin pa'i dang / rnam par nyed pa'i dang / mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /kyai rdo rje las/

'khyud dang 'o byed la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs bshad/ /rnam par smin pa de las bzlog /bde ba ye shes za ba nyid/ /bdag gi bde ba zos pa yi/ /gros ni rnam par nyed par brjod/ /mtshan nyid bral ba gsum las gzhan/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshigs bcad brgya bcu gsum par/ de bzhin du bsam gtan dang / srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa ste/ zhes yan lag dang po bzhi ka nyer bsgrub tu byas/ 'og nas sor sdud bsam gtan bsnyen par byas pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ gong du dman pa dang mchog la sogs par ma phye bar spyir bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i rgya bskyed nas bstan pa yin la 'og tu dman pa la sogs su phye nas bstan pas mi 'gal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya bcu bzhi par/ dang por stong nyid byang chub ces sogs su/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa gzugs ni rdzogs pa ste/ /bzhi pa yi ge 'god pa 'o/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi 'di dag gis/ /tha mal bsgrub la bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang gsungs pa la/ sbyang gzhi la sbyar ba ni go sla/ de bzhin du lha'i sgrub thabs la yang / las dang pos rtag pas bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes pa dang por stong nyid bsgom pa/ gnyis pa dbyangs gsal byed kyi sa bon bsdu ba/ gsum pa mngon byang lnga las lha gzugs rdzogs pa/ bzhi pa skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa ste bzhi'o/ /'di ni spyi'i bsnyen pa'o/ /zhes pa spyi dang / tha mal dang thun mong ba zhes pa rnams don gcig pas thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes pa'o/ /rdzogs rim la sbyar ba ni gzhung na gsal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya nyi shu par/ lhan cig rkyen du 'gyur ba rnam bcu ste/ /zhes par/ rkyen zhes pa yid ches par bsgyur na legs te/ pra t+ya ya/ zhes pa rkyen dang yid ches pa gnyis ka la 'jug la/

sngar yid ches pa rnam pa gsum/ zhes par yang yid ches par bsgyur pas so/ /nye bar bsgrub la yan lag drug /ces pa ni/ 'khor lo can drug gi bum pa can drug go /tshigs bcad brgya nyer gcig par/ phung po med kyang rnal 'byor pa ni bde mnyam zhes par/ khro bu gnyan mkhar du/ bla ma bkra shis dpal ba'i slob ma gnas sngon pa'i btsun chung gcig gis srog rtsol bsgoms pas rlung gi stobs kyis shi 'phos/ de'i ro ri la bskyal ba'i sha bya rog gis gang du khyer bar 'ja' tshon byung / de la 'ga' zhig na re/ btsun chung gcig gis mi rgan 'ga' la gnod pa skyel ba yod zer ro/ /de lta bu bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rang shugs su byung ba yin na bde mnyam du 'jug kyang / grags pa ma yin pa spang ba'i don du gegs bsal te bsgom par bya'o/ /jo mo nang du sgom chen gnyis kyis srog rtsol gyi stobs kyis 'chi ba'i ched du nan tan gyis bsgoms pas gcig thod pa gas nas shi gcig shi ma shi ro lta bur gyur te zhag 'ga' nas shi de lta bu byas na rtsa ltung brgyad pa 'byung ngo / /tshigs bcad brgya nyer lnga par/ mthe bo'i tshigs nas gtsug tor dag tu zhes par/ yar ngo la khu ba rkang pa'i sor mo'i rtse mo'i tshigs nas spyi gtsug gi bar du 'gro bar byas pa ni/ gzhan nas 'jig rten khu ba thur du 'gro bar byas pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'dir khams dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems gnas de dang / de dag tu de'i tshe rgyas shing bya ba byed pa la dgongs nas mas rim nas 'phel bar bshad kyi sor tshigs rtse mo na yod pa'i khams dwangs ma de spyi gtsug tu 'ong ba ma yin pa'i phyir gzhan dang mi 'gal lo/ /rgyud gzhan nas tshes gcig la sogs pa rnams su byang sems 'phel ba'i tshul gsungs pa ni/ sdom byung las/ a yig mtheb chen rtsa bar 'gyur/ /ā yig byin pa dag la nyid/ /i yig kyang ni brla zung la/

/ī yig gsang ba'i phyogs la 'o/ /u yig lte ba'i rtsa bar te/ /ū yig lte ba mchog la 'o/ /ṛ yig nu ma'i dbus su ste/ /ṝ yig de bzhin lag pa la 'o/ /l̥ yig mgrin pa'i phyogs su ste/ /l̥̄ yig kyang ni mchu la gnas/ /e yig 'gram pa'i phyogs su ste/ /ai yig kyang ni mig la 'o/ /o yig rna ba'i rtsa bar te/ /au yig mgo bor yang dag gnas/ /aṃ aḥspyi gtsug tu lus la/ /mkhas pas 'di ltar bsam par bya/ /dkar po'i phyogs la 'di ltar gnas/ /nag po zlog pas de ltar ro/ /bu med la 'dir rdo rje sems/ /skyes pa rnams la'ang dus kun tu'o/ /zhes so/ /tshigs bcad brgya so gcig par/ phyag de dag bung ba dang ni gser dang mtshungs pa zhes par/ phyag lhag ma gnyis sgra gcan dang dus me'i chos yin pas nag po dang ser po'o/ /lha min dbang po'i khrag gi thod pas phyag ser po'i mthil na/ zhes pa dang / 'chi bdag bdud kyi gdong gi phyag /ces pa'i phyag mtshan gnyis po glang lpags 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pos 'dzin par dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen bzhed zer te/ rang lugs la g.yon pa'i thod khrag 'dzin pa dang / tshangs mgo 'dzin pa las logs na med do/ /nyon mongs bdud ni zhabs kyis bsgyel zhes pa'i 'grel par/ de ni yi dwags te zhes bshad pa dang / skabs gzhan du bdud dang drag po mnan par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni rdo rje shugs kyi spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi dbang du byas la/ 'dir bshad pa ni 'byung po'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ 'byung po'i gtso bo dbang du 'dus na 'khor yang dbang du 'du bas/ yi dwags kyi mgon po mnan pa sgrub thabs bye brag pa'i dbang du byas pas skyon med do/ /tshigs bcad brgya so gnyis par/ gcer bu skra grol ma ste zhes pa 'di'i rigs pas gtso bo'i yum yang gcer bur byas kyi/ gzhan na bza' yod med kyi gsal kha ma gsungs so/ /sgrub thabs le'u'i mdor bsdus bzhi pa'i zin bris so/

/tshigs bcad brgya so brgyad par/ drag po bsad pa la sogs pa la bsam gtan drag po dang / zhes pa la/ slob dpon gcig gis 'bal mo la sbyin sreg byas pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug pas/ mo phyar ba chur bcug pa gcig gis mgo phur nas me nang du mchong ba mthong / de la slob dpon snying rje skyes pas mo me nang nas bros/ de nas bsam gtan gyi stobs kyis bkug kyang ring du ma khugs/ mjug tu phyar ba la gdugs dang / slob dpon gyi mgo bo la tog byas te gzi brjid bskyed nas byung zhes grag cing / gzhan yang drag po'i sbyin sreg byed dus snying rje'i skyes pa la bar chad byung ba'i bgros yod pas/ sbyor ba'i dus su yul de la snying rje bskyed cing / dngos gzhi'i dus su drag po'i sems bskyed dang ma bral ba dgos so/ /skabs 'dir las bco lnga gsungs/ de la gdug pa'i lta ba gzhil ba'am/ dug gzhil ba bsnan pas las bcu drug go /tshigs bcad brgya nga drug par/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la a yig gi rigs kyi dbang gis so zhes par/ 'di aṃ yig tu rigs shing / bi bhu ta'i phyag dpe la yang aṃ yig tu 'dug go /tshigs bcad brgya nga bdun par/ sa'i zad par zhes sogs ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi khams zad 'phel du gyur pa'i gegs sel bstan pa'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya nga brgyad par/ ra yig las byung ba'i gdong lnga pa zhes ra yig las seng ge bskyed pa mi 'thad de/ ra yig me yin la seng ge chu yin pas so/ /zhe na/ skyon med de/ glang po che'i dgra seng ge yin la/ glang po che sa yin/ sa dgra me yin pas ra las skyes pa'i seng ge yang lus chu yin yang bsal ba me yin pas so/ /de bzhin du rkang pa brgyad pa la yang shes par bya'o/ /dud 'gro'i 'tshe ba zhi tshul 'di rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi gnas 'byongs sel ba'i gdam ngag bstan no/ /tshigs bcad brgya drug cu par/

ro dang bdag nyid kyi lus kyang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis bsrung bar bya ste/ zhes par/ pha nag po ro zan gyi ro la bsrung ma ma byas pas khong gi tog tse len gyi bar la/ ro langs kyi g.yog po de'u bsad pa'i gtam rgyud yod do/ /tshigs bcad brgya re gcig par/ rdo rje dmar po'i zhes pas/ las kyi dbang gis rdo rje kha dog 'gyur ba bstan/ nang ler zhi ba'i las yin kyang rdo rje sngon por bshad pas las kyi dbang gis kha dog mi 'gyur ba byas kyang rung bar bstan pas gdam kha can du shes so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor dang thab khung gi dbus su yi dwags so/ /zhes sogs kyis bar der ro rkang pa lho phyogs su brkyangs te bzhag par bshad pa dang / sngar dkyil 'khor dang thab kyi mtha' gnyis kyi bar du khru gnyis bshad pa snga ma spyir btang / 'dir bshad pa dmigs bsal lo/ /tshigs bcad brgya re gnyis par/ dgra grogs brtsi ba'i skabs su/ oṃ gyi yi ge spangs nas kyang / /zhes pas mtshon nas/ na maḥdang / tad+ya thā dag kyang ma gtogs so/ /yi ge gsal byed gzhan brtsegs na/ /de tshe thog ma brjod pa'i slad/ /de dag las ni dang po bzung / /zhes pa bzhin du/ dpung gzhibs yi ge dang po bzung / /zhes zer ro/ /tshigs bcad brgya re bdun par/ brgya lam na sngon gyi skye ba la bsgrubs na bklags pas 'grub bo/ /zhes par/ bla ma sher seng gis sku tshe 'dir sgrub pa yun ring por ma mdzad kyang / thal mo brdabs pa tsam gyis nyes byed tshar gcod nus pa lta bu'o/ /tshigs bcad brgya bdun cu par/ mdun du 'khor ba rnyed na bsgrubs pa med par mkha' la spyod pa rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes par/ sngon rgyal po rkang khra'i chung ma rnams kyis kho la re mos kyis bsnyen bkur byed pa las/ dus re zhig na chung ma ngan shes kyis sha gzhan ma rnyed par/ dur khrod nas bu chung gi ro blangs te/ btsos nas khyer phyin pa dang / mo rkang pa sa la mi reg par 'gro ba khos mthong /

ci'i sha yin smros shig de min gsod do zhes bsdigs pas/ mi 'jigs pa stsol cig smras par bgyi'o/ /zhes zer/ de bzhin du byas pas lhag ma kun kyang khyer shog zer thams cad zos pas nam mkha' la 'gro zhing mi mang po za ba byung / de ni sangs rgyas ko san+ta bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la byung / zhes mdo las gsungs/ des na mkha' spyod ces pa nam mkha' la 'gro ba tsam la zer yang / de tsam gyis brtan pa thob pa ma yin gyis/ bla ma rang byung rdo rjes/ bla ma rngog pa la/ khyed kyi bla ma rngog chos kyi rdo rje de mkha' spyod du gshegs par gda' ang byas pas/ de skad zer gyin 'dug zer/ mkha' spyod de ji 'dra gcig la byed byas pas/ de cha med ngas ni 'gro ma myong zer/ de la 'ga' zhig na re/ rngog pa thu zer te/ de ltar ma yin/ sngags pa'i bla btsongs pa yin mod/ des na mkha' spyod la chen po dang / chung ngu gnyis/ chen po yon tan brgyad ldan/ chung ngu la lus ma spangs ba'i dang / spangs pa'i mkha' spyod gnyis/ ma spangs pa la'ang lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mkha' spyod thob pa dang / gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa bsgrubs pa'i stobs kyis mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa'o/ /de dag la'ang 'dod khams kyi dang / gzugs khams kyi mkha' spyod gnyis/ 'dod khams kyi mkha' spyod la'ang / mi yul gyi dang / lha yul gyi mkha' spyod gnyis/ mi yul gyi ni mi yul du gnas nas las dag pa'i gang zag re re tsam gyis mthong ba dang phrad pa srid kyis/ gzhan phal pa rnams kyis ni mthong par mi nus so/ /lha yul gyi mkha' spyod la'ang / 'dod lha rigs drug gang dang gang du spyod nus pa der de'i longs spyod la spyod cing / de dang de'i tshe tshad mnyam pa'am/ de bas kyang lhag par spyod pas mkha' spyod drug tu 'gyur ro/ /gzugs khams kyi la'ang / gzugs khams gnas bcu drug gam/ bcu gang dang gang du spyod nus pa der/

de dang de'i longs spyod la spyod cing / de dang de'i tshe tshad dang mnyam pa'am lhag par spyod pa'i dbye bas mkha' spyod bcu drug gam bcu bdun du 'gyur ro/ /de la gnod sbyin mo bsgrubs pa la sogs pa'i stobs kyis de dag gis khrid pa'i mkha' spyod ni/ mtho dman gang du spyod cing / yul ji tsam yod kyang phugs kyi btsan sa zin pa med do/ /lam zab mo bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i mkha' spyod ni/ lus spangs ma spangs gang yin yang rung ste/ lus 'ja' lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du dengs shing / ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pas lam gong nas gong du bgrod pa ni btsan sa zin pa'i mkha' spyod do/ /de bas na mkha' spyod chung ba 'di la rnam grangs shin tu mang ngo / /pu hrangs lo chung lta bu ni lus ma sbangs pa'i kha spyod do/ /yang che 'bring bar ma gsum du byed na/ chen po sngar dang 'dra/ 'bring grub chen brgyad/ tha ma rang dang gzhan gyi stobs kyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba tsam mo/ /tshigs bcad brgya gya drug par/ 'khrul 'khor chu'i dkyil 'khor bam̐ yig gis bskor bar bya'o/ /zhes par thar los rgya yig gi bam̐ yig gcig gi nang du chud par bzhed/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa bam̐ yig gi phreng bas bskor bar bzhed/ gzhan yi ges bskor ba kun la'ang 'gre'o gsung ngo / /'khor lo 'di la las bco lngas phye bas bco lnga rim pa lnga pa'i yi ge spos pa dang ma spos pa de nyis 'gyur ro/ /tshigs bcad brgya gya brgyad par/ shar du ma zhes par/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis/ 'di bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed zhal lhor bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lho la shar du byas pa yin gsungs/ dang po de e yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom byung na'ang / phyis de yin par nges te/ de ltar byas pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin 'byung bas so/ /tshigs bcad brgya gya dgu par/ re mig nas re mig bar 'gyur te/

bsgrub bya'i ming dang sngags 'di'o/ /zhes par/ re mig re la sngags 'di tshar re 'bri ba 'dra byas pa slob dpon rdo rje dpal g.yung ston pa na re/ dang por oṃ hrīḥ gnyis par che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭ/ gsum par ṣ+ṭiḥbi/ bzhi par spel tshig ste/ de bzhin bri/ de nas bzlas pa byas pas gshin rje'i gzugs kyi mche ba ring du 'gro/ tshad la khel ba dang las la sbyor ba yin/ khyed kyi 'di bshad pa skam po yin/ nged la lag len la bkal bkal ba yod zer/ de mi bden re shi snyam pa gcig byung / zhi rgyas la ni kha cig dang po nas mi 'bri zer/ kha cig bris nas bsub zer ro/ /tshigs bcad brgya go gsum par/ nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis 'gyur ba med pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes par/ sngar brgya bcu dgu par bshad pa mi 'gal te/ sngar ting nge 'dzin thob nas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyis ye shes kyi lus 'grub par bshad pa yin la/ 'dir ni 'dzin pa man chad brtan nas ting nge 'dzin thob pa la lo gsum phyogs gsum dgos pa'i dbang du byas pas so/ /sgrub thabs le'u'i mdor bsdus lnga pa ste/ sgrub thabs le'u'i zin bris so/ /ye shes le'u'i tshigs bcad dang por/ rgyud 'di la sngar yang gsol ba gdab pa med do/ /zhes pa la/ kha cig rtsa rgyud 'di la zer/ kha cig bsdus rgyud 'di la zer te/ skabs don/ rgyud gzhan bzhin du bris lan spel te mi 'byung par le'u'i mgor gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad smos la/ de nas le'u rdzogs kyi bar du gsol gdab med ces pa'o/ /tshigs bcad gnyis par/ dbus su khu ba rnam par dag pas rdul tshon gdab bo/ /gang du rdul tshon drug po yin pa der ni rdul tshon rnam par dag pas rdul tshon gdab pa zhes pa ni/ dbus ljang khu'am sngon por byed pa'i shes byed do/ /tshigs bcad bzhi par/ de bzhin du ni ye shes rdo rje sogs kyis gtso mo ye shes rdo rje bstan no/

/tshigs bcad bdun par/ gtsug tor chen po'i rigs chen po/ /zhes pa rigs kun la khyab byed rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs so/ /rigs gsum la ni rnam par gzigs/ /zhes pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha rnams ni snam snang gi rigs so/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs mchog ces par/ lha tshogs rgyas 'debs pa'i rigs lnga ni don grub kyi rigs so/ /'jig rten snang byed rigs chen zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i lha rigs so drug ni rin 'byung gi rigs so/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs zhes pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gsung sku'i lha dang bcas pa stong brgyad cu ni snang mtha'i rigs so/ /gsang sngags mtha' dag rigs chen po/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /zhes pa gtum mo brgyad lta bu'am/ dgyes rdor gyi lha mo brgyad lta bu ni mi bskyod pa'i rigs so/ /shong lo bstan gyis gsang sngags rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /zhes pa lha'i tshogs stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya nyi shu mtha' dag ste/ ka sogs sde pa brtsegs pa brgyad las byung ba rnams so/ /zhes bshad/ de ltar rigs drug tu phye ba de rnams dkyil 'khor re re gang rung la'ang rig par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu par/ 'dir gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo thig le la mi bskyod pa la'o/ /zhes sogs su/ phung po drug ni lus kyi cha yin pas thabs sangs rgyas drug gi sa bon gyi rgyas gdab/ de yang khams mthun pa gtsug tor du nam mkha' la a zhes sogs/ des na phung po drug rigs drug rang bzhin thung ngu lnga thig le can dang drug rnams thabs lus kyi cha yin pas des rgyas gdab pa sku'i rgyas gdab bo/ /ngag rlung yin pas srog gi rlung las rgyas gdab ste/ srog gi rlung lte ba yan chad kyi 'khor lo lnga la rgyu bas de dag tu rlung shes rab yin pas go rim yang bsdu rim du ste/ sa rlung lte bar gnas pas l̥ yig gis rgyas 'debs pa sogs ni gsung gi rgyas btab pa'o/

/rtsa 'khor lo bzhir gnas skabs bzhi'i rtog pa bskyed pa'i thig le bzhi gnas pas der rgyas gdab pa ni/ thugs kyi rgyas gdab ste/ rtog pa sems kyi chos yin pas so/ /de yang lus kyi thig le dpral bar gnas pa lus dag pa dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ yig gis rgyas gdab pa sogs/ chags pa ni ye shes yin la ye shes dang a yig gnyis ka stong pa'i khams yin pas/ rdo rje nor bu la a zhes pa ye shes kyi rgyas gdab ste/ nor bu ni chags pa'i gnas yin pas so/ /rgyas gdab pa'i don ni/ rgyas gdab bya 'debs byed khams mthun zhing / rgyas 'debs byed de las mi 'da' bas so/ /btab pa'i dgos pa ro mnyam par byas pa'o/ /'dir bshad pa'i ye shes kyi rgyas gdab 'di shong ba'i phyag len la chad 'dug ste/ gal chen po yin pas ma chad par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu gcig par/ phyi rol tu lag gdub la sogs pa dang / nang du sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa 'dis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rgyan med yin zhes bla ma bsod nams 'od zer gsungs pa bkag go /tshigs bcad bcu bdun par/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad khro bo'i rgyal mo dang / khro bo'i dbang phyug la ste gsum bsnan pas khro bo khro mo bcu gnyis su byas pa ni/ las dbang drug khro bor byas nas de la khro mos 'khyud pa drug bya ba drug khro mor byas nas de la khro bos 'khyud pa drug yin la/ sems dpa' sems mas phan tshun 'khyud pas gcig tu yod pa dang mi 'dra ste/ 'dir khro bo khro mo rigs tha dad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rdo rje shugs la khro mo me'i rgyal mos 'khyud pa ni mchog gi dbang po la dri chu 'dzag pa'i bya bas tshur 'khyud pa yin/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la khro mo'i dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa ni dri chu'i dbang po la khu ba 'dzag pa'i bya bas tshur 'khyud pa yin/ de gnyis thugs dkyil gyi sgo bzhi'i steng du bsnan pas las dbang drug la bya bas 'khyud pa'i cha bstan/

sku'i sgo ba steng 'og gi khro bo dang bcas pas bya ba drug ma las dbang gis 'khyud pa'i cha bstan pa yin/ de la dkyil 'khor du 'god tsa na/ rdo rje shugs dang hūm̐ mdzad gnyis med pas/ gtsug tor can dang gnod mdzes kyis gnyis go chod pa'i dbang du byas nas res thugs dkyil du bkod/ res sku dkyil gyi sgo bar yang bkod pa yin no/ /'dir slob dpon a bha yas sku'i lha rnams thams cad phyogs mdog tu mdzad pas lha brgya nyi shu'i kha dog nor/ de la bla ma sher seng na re/ slob dpon la a bha yas dus 'khor mi shes 'dir yang lha lug khyu tsam gyi kha dog nor gsungs pa bden te/ khyab 'jug dang gshin rje gtso 'khor rnams ljang khu/ drag po dang dzam+bha la gtso 'khor rnams sngon por gsungs pas so/ /zla ba'i chos la rnam par snang mdzad dkar po dang / zhes sogs su zla ba'i chos las zhes pa sku yi rigs yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ste/ gzugs phung yin pa dang / sa'i khams kyi sku yin pa'i phyir dang / sku'i rigs kyi rtsa la la nā chu khams yin la de dang dri chen 'bab pa'i rtsa rgyud gcig pa'i phyir dang / shu tra rus pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi ma'i chos las zhes pa gsung gi rigs yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ste/ snang mtha' lus kyi dbang gis chu yin yang bsam pa'i dbang gis mer byas shing / rgyud gzhan nas gsung gi rigs su bshad pa dang bstun pa'o/ /sgra gcan gyi chos las zhes pa thugs kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ste/ mkha' khams dang rnam shes thugs yin la de rtsa dang sbyar na/ dbu la sgra gcan te/ mun pa'i yon tan las nag po'o/ /dus me'i chos las zhes pa ye shes kyi rigs te/ lte ba ngo bo nyid sku yin la/ lte ba sa yin pas dang / nub ye shes kyi zhal ser po yin pas dang / sgra gcan nag por byas pa na de'i shes rab yin pas dung can ser po'o/ /dus me'i chos las rdo rje sems dpa' ser po'o/

/zhes pa 'dir/ bla ma sher seng gi zhal nas/ rigs pa 'dis rigs lnga ser 'byams 'ong ste/ 'dir rdor sems ser por bshad/ rnam snang ser por dus 'khor ba'i lugs yin/ don grub ser po lus bsam gyis 'ong / 'od dpag med rnam snang gi rgyas btab pas ser po'o/ rin 'byung rgyud sde gzhan nas ser por gsungs pas gsungs na'ang / rigs lnga ser 'byams 'di dang po jo bo rjes rigs lnga la gser gsol ba'i bris sku mdzad pa la 'khrul te byas pa yin gyis rgyud gang nas kyang ma bshad/ gcig ser por byung tsa na gzhan tsho kha dog 'gyur 'gro bas ser por mi 'ong bas so/ /kha cig na re yo ga nas bshad zer te/ yo ga'i rgyus med par mtshon no/ /rdo rje rtse mo nas rin 'byung ser po lha ser po bzhis bskor ba gcig yod de rigs lnga ma yin/ nor pa de 'dra la sgrub byed bkod kyang dgos pa med do/ /de bzhin du mi bskyod pa ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas gdab bo zhes pa ni/ 'gyur cung zad nor te/ kyis zhes pa'i byed tshig skad dod la med cing don la mi 'grig go /des na rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad nyer bzhi par/ rtsa rgyud kyi lung / gnyis dang gcig dang gsum phyed bcas/ /sogs la/ snye mdo bas cha chen la cha phran bzhi'i rtsis kyi gnyis sogs su byed pa mi 'thad de/ de'i rgyu mtshan lhag ma ra ba sogs dus 'khor bzhin no/ /zhes pas sor phyed dang drug tu gsal lo/ /tshigs bcad nyer brgyad par/ sgo brgyad kyi bar rnams su dur khrod brgyad kyi 'khor rnams te/ zhes par/ la la sgo phyi'i bar du dur khrod yin zer na'ang / sgo'i bar rtsa thig nang gi'o/ /lhag ma sgo la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni dus 'khor gyi maṇ+ḍal bzhin no/ /zhes pa sgo 'khor lo'i brgyad char bshad cing / cha chen la sor phyed drug tu bshad pas/ shar dang nub kyi rtsa thig gi bar gyi brgyad cha yin gyi 'ga' zhig zur thig nas zur thig gi bar la 'dod pa mi 'thad de/

gru bzhi la 'dra yang zlum po la mi 'grig ste/ sdom chen la zur thig nas zur thig gi bar gyi brgyad cha la sor bcu gnyis med kyang / nyi ma rnams kyi sgo dang zhes pas sgo tshad sor bcu gnyis su bshad do/ /tshigs bcad nyer dgu par/ de'i p+lī rlung gi rtsibs la'o/ /zhes sogs su/ mtshams kyi lha'i sa bon sngon la bkod nas/ phyogs kyi lha'i sa bon rting la bkod pa ni/ sdig pa dang gzhu mo dang srang zhes sogs kyi rim pas ltos pas dgod pa gsungs la/ de la sdig pa shes rab kyi cha yin pas mtshams la 'ong / gzhu thabs kyi cha yin pas phyogs su bkod/ des na mtshams sngon la 'ong la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'dir 'khor lo sdom chen ni drang don du shes rab kyi rgyud yin pas mtshams sngon la bkod pa yin no/ /tshigs bcad so lnga par/ sems can gyi lus la skra'i mthar khyab par byed pa nyid de/ zhes pas gyen du skra khru gang pa/ 'phred la sen mo sor bcu gnyis re'i dag pa brtsis pas khru lnga'o/ /kong ka na dang zhes pa'i mchan bur/ sku mchog bzhi ni/ dz+nyā na ka ye shes kyi sku ste lho phyogs 'gro lding pa'i yul na mtsho'i gting nas mi gson po nyal ba 'dra ba gcig yod/ de la nang pa rnams 'jam dpal sha'i sku can zer cing mchod/ phyi rol pas kyang rang gi lhar byas nas mchod pa gcig yod/ ru pa kā ya mchod rten gyi sku ste/ 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten yin/ ru pa kā ma gzugs kyi sku ste rdo rje/ gdan ni byang chub chen po/ bim sa ka ya grib ma'i sku ste/ bar snang na thogs pa med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku dus bzang ba la klu rnams gdugs 'bul zhing mchod pa gcig yod ces grag go /tshigs bcad so drug par/ lte bar 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ chu srin gyi 'dab ma nub phyogs kyi char srog rab tu 'bab ces pa/ lte ba na rtsa chen bcu gnyis po re re la 'dab ma lnga lngar gyes pa'i dbus na stong pa/

shar nas rlung / lho nas me/ byang nas chu/ nub nas sa'i dkyil 'khor 'bab/ de la g.yas chu srin gyi 'dab ma'i nub nas sa'i dkyil 'khor chu tshod dang po la dbang byed/ de'i tshe chu'i dkyil 'khor la thim zhes sogs so/ /dus sbyor gsum gyi mthar bzhi ni dbu ma la rig par bya'o/ /zhes pa thun bzhi dbu ma la'o/ /zhes so/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'di rnams la zhes par/ 'dis gtsug tor na'ang rtsa 'dab brgyad pa gcig yod par bstan no/ /tshigs bcad so dgu par/ brgyad ni ye shes rnam par dag pa dur khrod brgyad po rnams la'o/ /zhes pa ni/ dur khrod brgyad kyis mtshon nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad bstan pa yin te/ gsang gnas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang dag pa sbyar ba'i phyir ro/ /tshigs bcad bzhi bcu par/ 'dir dpa' bo gcig pa'i gdan zhes sogs su/ gdan gyi dag pa gsungs pa gsang 'dus lha bcu dgu pa la nyi gdan bdun/ zla gdan bcu gnyis ni rin 'byung snang mtha' don grub gsum/ sgo ba khro bo bzhi ste bdun nyi gdan/ gtso bo dang rnam snang gnyis yum bzhi sems ma drug ni zla gdan no/ /lha nyer lnga ma la gshegs pa bzhi/ sems pa drug lho dang nub kyi khro bo gnyis te bcu gnyis la/ lo gcig gi gnam stong bcu gnyis dag pa'i nyi gdan sems dpa' bzhi/ sems ma drug shar dang byang gi khro bo gnyis la lo gcig gi nya bcu gnyis dag pa'i zla gdan bcu gnyis/ gtso bo la zla nyi gang rung gi gdan te nyer lnga'o/ /de'i steng du mtshams bzhi steng 'og gi khro bo dang drug dbus kyi khro bo dang bdun gyi nyi gdan bdun bsnan pas so gnyis so/ /'o na da lta'i 'phags lugs la sems ma lnga dang / khro bo bcu las mi 'dug pas gsal zhe na/ skyon med de/ sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang byams pa gnyis lhag yod pas de dag lus sam rnam dag gi sgo nas gnad gcig tu yod pa'i phyir ro/ /tshigs bcad zhe gcig par/

sgyu 'phrul dra ba la zhes sogs su/ lha zhe gsum ma la yum bzhi/ sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis la/ lo gcig gi nya bcu gnyis kyi zla gdan/ sangs rgyas gsum/ byang sems bcu drug ste bcu dgu la gnam stong bcu gnyis kyi nyi gdan bcu gnyis/ gza' bdun gyi nyi gdan bdun/ sangs rgyas gcig khro bo bcu ste bcu gcig la nyi rkang bcu gcig gi nyi gdan bcu gcig ste zhe gnyis/ gtso bo la nyi zla gang rung gi gdan te zhe gsum mo/ /yang na khro bo bcu sangs rgyas rnam snang dang bcu gcig pa la bsam pa'i dbye bas zla gdan bcu gcig ste nyi rkang bcu gcig ni zla ba yi yang rkang pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i steng du lha sras gnyis kyi nyi zla gnyis kyi gdan bsnan pas zhe lnga ma'o/ /de'i steng du nyi ma'i rkang pa nor dang bu lon 'phel 'grib gnyis te/ gzhi dag pa sgo ba bzhi'i gdan nyi gdan bzhi'am yang na bsam pa'i dbang gis zla ba'i gdan bzhi ste/ nyi rkang gi nor dang bu lon 'phel 'grib ni zla rkang gi'ang nor dang bu lon 'phel 'grib yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tshigs bcad zhe gsum par/ shes rab dang thabs zhal bcu pa ste/ zhes pa ni/ shar rlung la reg bya'i zhal gcig de nub pa'i dri reg ro gzugs kyis 'khyud pas zhal lngar 'gyur la/ nub pa la zhal bzhi/ de shar rlung gi zhal gcig gis 'khyud pas lngar 'gyur la de gnyis phan tshun 'khyud na zhal bcur 'gyur bas shar nub phan tshun 'khyud pas zhal bcu'o/ /lho me'i yon tan gnyis kyis zhal gnyis byang chu'i yon tan gsum gyis 'khyud pas zhal lngar 'gyur zhing / byang chu'i yon tan gsum la lha mo'i yon tan gnyis kyis 'khyud pas lngar 'gyur te/ de gnyis phan tshun 'khyud pas zhal bcu ste/ byang dang lho phan tshun 'dus pas zhal bcu'o/ /yon tan rnam pa gsum gyi dbang gis zhal ni bcu gnyis te/ zhes pa ni/ sa sogs khams thams cad la rdul mun snying stobs kyi yon tan gsum gsum yod pas lha thams cad zhal gsum pa yin la/

shar nub phan tshun lus la bsam pa rab tu zhugs pas zhal drug drug tu 'gyur zhing / de gnyis phan tshun thabs shes rab tu 'dus pas zhal bcu gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du lho byang la zhal bcu gnyis/ steng 'og la zhal bcu gnyis so/ /'dus pa la sangs rgyas gang dbus su bzhugs pa de'i gnas su mi bskyod pa 'gro ba ji lta ba de bzhin du mtshan ma la yang nges pa'o zhes par/ 'dir de tsam las ma gsungs kyang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams rigs lnga po gang dbus su song ba de'i gnas su mi bskyod pa 'gro la/ rigs lnga las gzhan pa'i 'khor dbus su song na de'i rigs bdag gang yin pa de la bstim nas/ de'i rigs bdag gi gnas su mi bskyod pa 'gro/ gal te gtso bor song ba de dkyil 'khor ba'i lha ma yin na/ dkyil 'khor pa gzhan rnams gnas ji lta ba bzhin 'god la/ gal te dkyil 'khor pa gcig yin na/ rang gi gnas su rang gnyis pa gcig 'god par bzhed do/ /snyim pa'i me tog las/ gal te rgyal gzhan dbus mar gyur/ /de yi gnas la mi bskyod 'gyur/ /gal te 'khor gtso sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /phyung pa der ni bstim par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gtsor gyur/ /de yi rigs bdag bstim par bya/ /rgyal ba las gzhan dkyil 'khor pa/ /gal te 'khor lo'i gtso bo byed/ /dbus ma de'ang gzhan nyid de/ /rang gnas su'ang gzhan de nyid/ /tshogs rnams bsags pa de nyid ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slar yang de dag phan tshun ltos pa dang bcas pa nyid kyis zhal nyer gnyis pa'i 'dus pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ sngar gyi zhal bcu pa'i 'phro 'chad pa yin te/ steng rnam par shes pa'i khams yon tan lnga'i bdag nyid zhal lnga/ 'og ye shes kyi khams kyi bdag nyid yon tan drug gi bdag nyid zhal drug de la steng zhal lnga la bsam pa'i dbang gis 'og gi zhal drug dang 'dres pas bcu gcig 'og zhal drug la steng gi zhal lnga bsam pa rab tu zhugs pa la bcu gcig

de gnyis phan tshun thabs shes su 'dus pas zhal nyer gnyis so/ /tshigs bcad zhe bzhi par/ dus sbyor dbye bas kha dog gsum/ /zhes par/ chu srin bum pa gnyis gsum thugs rdo rje/ lug glang 'khrig gsum gsung rdo rje/ kar seng bu mo gsum sku rdo rje/ srang sdig gzhu gsum ye shes rdo rje bshad pa ni/ dbang le'i zhe drug par/ ma rig 'du byed rnam shes gsum ye shes rdo rje/ ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa gsum sku rdo rje/ tshor ba sred pa len pa gsum gsung rdo rje/ srid pa skye ba rga shi gsum thugs rdo rje bshad pa dang 'gal te/ chu srin la sogs pa'i khyim bcu gnyis ni/ grangs bzhin du ma rig pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis dang gnad gcig du bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ der sems can skye ba'i dbang du byas te/ ma rig 'du byed rnam shes gsum mngal du khu khrag rnam shes 'dus pa pha ma gnyis sprod kyi bde bas byin brlabs pa dag pa'i sku ru bshad cing / dag pa'i sku dang ye shes rdo rje gnad gcig pas ye shes rdo rjer byas/ ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa gsum lus rdzogs par byed pa yin pas sku rdo rjer byas pa la sogs pa yin la/ 'dir zhag gi dus sbyor bcu gnyis thun mtshams bzhi dbang gis rdo rje bzhir bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas skyon med do/ /yang 'dir/ chu srin dang 'khrig pa dang seng ge rnams nag po/ bum pa dang lug dang bu mo dang sdig pa rnams dmar po/ nya dang glang dang karka ṭa dang gzhu rnams dkar po/ srang ser por byas pa ni/ 'og brgya dgu bcu par/ chu srin bum pa gnyis lug glang 'khrig pa nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kar seng bu mo srang sdig gi gzhu ye shes sa chu me rlung nam mkha' zhes bshad pa'i khams kyi kha dog dang ma mthun zhing / 'jig rten khams le'i dbyangs 'char gyi skabs dang / nang le'i rtsa 'chad pa'i skabs dang /
