'khums pa dang 'byar ba tsho phrel ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ gal te de mi shes shing na zug gis sgom gyi gegs su gyur na zhes pa'i skabs su/ mkhan chen thar lo ba'i slob ma sde tsha phya ru ba bya ba'i mi nyag gcig gis mdo khams su phyin/ kho la khrid zhu 'dra byung pas de la lus gnad rdo rje skyil krung bslabs pas ma shes pa la/ khos skyil krung 'breng pas bkyigs bzhag pas/ khrid zhu de la rkang pa'i na zug gis sgom skyer ma 'dod yod par 'dug dus phyis kho yar la byung / de dus des rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ de 'dra byas pas 'ong dogs gcod/ lus gnad mi shes na kho rang gang bde'i ngang nas rgal tshigs srangs pa'i ngang nas sgom du 'jug pa yin mod gsungs so/ /'o de bzhin bya/ 'bro ba'i phyag bzhes la srin lag gi rtsa ba na 'dre rtsa yod pas mthe bong gis srin lag rtsa ba mnan te/ rdo rje khu tshur brla steng du snol ba 'di mdzad de/ de lag pa thung ba rnams la sgur por 'gro'i 'dug pas mi zab/ rdo rje phyag rgya'am/ phyag na pad+ma can te/ 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya 'di mdzad/ 'di bla ma ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i zhal nas/ lag pa g.yon pa gan brkyal du byas pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag pa'i mthe bong lto sprad pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya 'di sngar bod du ma grags/ 'di nga'i ring la byung pa yin te/ ngas 'di gcig pu la rgya gar du 'gro rin chog pa yin gsung ngo / /sor bsdud kyi dmigs pa gnyis la/ bla ma kun spangs chos rje'i gsung gis/ lus ngag yid gsum mi g.yo gsum ldan du bzhag ste/ lus lha khang lder so ltar/ ngag mi ro ltar/ sems ri bong sbos non pa ltar 'jog gsungs/ res 'ga' sems nam mkha' ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag ces kyang gsungs/ rgal tshigs gser gyi dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar drang por bsrangs la/ g.yas g.yon mdun brgyab tu ma 'khyogs cing dgyes dgu med par byas te/

lus g.yas su yo na zhe sdang skye/ g.yon du 'dod chags/ mdun du gti mug skye zhing / ske nar 'ong / phyir sgyid na mig tsha zhing rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phror 'ong bas lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis srong la/ de gnyis bsrongs pas dbu ma bsrongs shing rlung rnams kyang gnas su tshud pa'i dgos pa yod pa yin gsungs/ 'di gnad che ste/ sngon rang sangs rgyas la spre'u'i 'dug stangs bslabs pa'i gtam rgyud yod do/ /zhes pa'i thad du/ sngon ri bo rtse u shi ra zhes rtse mthon nam/ mgo bo che zhes bsgyur/ mthon po zhig la logs gsum yod de/ ngos gcig la rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya'o/ /ngos gnyis pa la ni drang srong lnga brgya'o/ /ngos gsum pa la ni spre'u lnga brgya'o/ /spre'u'i rgyal po de'i kun tu spyod pa ni/ spre'u mo rnams phru gu skyes pa dag gsod par byed pa zhig yod de/ de nas spre'u ma de dag phru gu'i mya ngan gyis non pas phan tshun gros byas pas/ spre'u mo dag nyon cig 'u cag gi phru gu rnams btsas ma thag sde dpon 'dis gsod par byed na/ 'u cag rnams thabs shig byas te/ da spre'u mo su sbrum mar gyur pa na rgyal pos mi thos par bya'o zhes dam bcas/ dus gzhan zhig na spre'u mo zhig sbrum mar gyur pa de/ de rnams kyis dben pa'i sa phyogs shig tu bzhag nas/ rtsa dang 'bras bus sos pas de la phru gu skyes te/ de yang de rnams kyis dben pa zhig tu gsos te/ de chen por gyur pa de'i tshe/ des sde dpon de rang gi khyu nas phud do/ /sde dpon de ri bo rtse 'thon na phar 'khyam/ 'khyams pa na rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgra thos nas de rnams kyi drung du song ngo / /der bag phebs par gyur to/ /rang sangs rgyas de rnams la rtsa ba dang lo ma dang / 'bras bu dang so shing dag 'bul bar byed do/ /de rnams kyis de la ltung bzed kyi lhag ma ster bar byed do/

/rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa ni zas zos nas skyil krung bcas te sgom byed do/ /spre'u des kyang de rnams kyi spyod lam mthong nas skyil krung gis 'dug go /de nas rang sangs rgyas rnams phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de rnams ldang ba'i dus su ldang bar ma gyur nas/ spre'u des de rnams ma mthong nas sems skyo zhing mi dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas spre'u des rang sangs rgyas rnams 'dug pa'i phug der bzhugs te/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos gos rnams nas bzung ste bsigs par brtsams pa na phug de na gnas pa'i lha de 'di snyam du sems te/ spre'u 'dis rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis sku shig na mi rung snyam ste/ rdo leb chen po zhig gis sgo bcad pa dang / spre'u de mya ngan gyis smre sngags 'don gyin song ste/ mi snying la 'dod pas mi dga' bar gyur te/ ri bo rtse 'thon la 'khyam zhing mi'i sgra nyan zhing song ba dang / drang srong de rnams smra ba'i sgra thos nas 'gron po lam stor ba bzhin du de rnams kyi drung du song ngo / /drang srong de dag rnams kyang dka' thub drag pos gdung bar byed do/ /kha cig ni lag pa bsgrengs nas 'dug go /kha cig ni rkang pa ya gcig bsgrengs nas 'dug go /kha cig ni me'i gdung pa lngas gdungs nas 'dug ste/ de'i tshe spre'u de de rnams la bag phebs par gyur te/ drang srong de rnams la spre'us rtsa ba dang lo ma rnams dang me tog 'bras bu dang so shing dag sbyin par byed do/ /de rnams kyis kyang de la zas kyi lhag ma ster bar byed do/ /spre'u des de rnams kyi spyod lam dkrugs te/ sngar gyi rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod lam ston par byed do/ /de rnams kyi lag pa bsgrengs pa de rnams kyi lag pa phab nas se gol gyi sgra byas te sbran nas de rnams kyi mdun du skyil mo krung gis 'dug go

/gang dag rkang pa ya gcig bsgrengs pa de rnams kyi rkang pa phab nas mdun du skyil krung gis 'dug go /gang dag gdung pa lngas gdung pa de rnams me gsod par byed do/ /se gol gyi sgra byas te mdun du skyil krung bcas te 'dug go /de nas drang srong de rnams kyi gdam ngag 'bogs pa la smras pa/ mkhan po spre'u 'dis bdag cag gi dka' thub la bar chad byas so/ /zhes rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa/ spre'u de dag ni dran pa dang ldan te/ gdon mi za ba 'dis drang srong kha cig gi spyod lam de lta bu mthong ba yin gyis/ khyed rnams kyang skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug cig zer ro/ /de rnams kyis kyang skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug pa dang / de rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams mngon du gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas tshogs spyod lnga brgyas rang byang chub mngon du byas so/ /de rnams spre'u de la chos las byung ba'i dad pa skyes te/ de rnams kyis ljongs nas bsod snyoms blangs pa rnams gang rnyed de'i phud de thog mar spre'u la/ de nas bdag nyid de la longs spyod do/ /dus gzhan zhig na spre'u de 'das te/ de nas rang byang chub de rnams kyis yul khams na yod pa'i shing dri zhim po rnams blangs te phung por spungs nas spre'u de bsregs so/ /de'i spre'u de dgra bcom pa nyer sbas 'di nyid do/ /des na lus gnad 'di gal che ba yin gsungs so/ /mig lta stangs nges pa'i skabs su/ chos rje kun spangs pa'i gsung gis/ 'dir lta stangs kyang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lta stangs su blta zhing / lus ngag yid gsum dben par 'jog gsungs te/ de la'ang don legs po a tsi ba yod mod kyis/ 'on kyang mkhan chen thar lo pa'i gsung gis/ sna gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i man ngag bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rlung ji tsam sleb pa'i tshad du mig khrig gis blta/ sems kyang der ma yengs bzung bas rlung yang der 'ching nas 'ong /

der ma yengs par blta ste bltas nas blta rgyu rang mi bdog gi sems ma yengs par 'jog pa yin gsungs/ spyir sbyor ba drug pa la blta stangs bzhi las/ 'dir gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i blta stangs bya ba/ steng gi nam mkha' la blta ba yin te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bltas pas nam mkha' la blta ba'i go chod gsung ngo / /bla ma bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra rnal 'byor zla ba ni yul rgya gar shar phyogs bha len+t+ra pa/ dgos dza gad da la ba yin/ rigs ni rgyal rigs/ mang pos bkur ba'i sde la rab tu byung / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing / khyad par nang gi gsang sngags la mkhas pa/ thog mar 'jam dbyangs dang bde mchog la sogs pa'i thugs dam gyi lha du ma zhal gzigs shing / grub thob du ma la gdams pa thos pa de nyid bal yul thang bi ha ri na 'chad nyan mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar nas byon pa'i rnal 'byor pa rna ba la ri dwags khri snyan sa le'i rwa bcug pa/ de'i pags pas smad dkris pa/ ras kyi ras 'ga' 'char stabs su bsnams pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa gcig byon nas/ nga 'dir zhag 'ga' sdod pa yin gsungs/ der sgra slob pa'i grwa pa gsum yod pas brang khang du bzhugs su bcug pas/ sgra slob pa'i grwa pa de rnams na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di ni ngo mtshar can gcig gda'o zer/ bla ma bi bhu tis spyan drangs te chos kyi gsung gleng byas pas/ gang dris pa thams cad shar shar byung pas/ sha ba ri dbang phyug yin par mkhyen nas/ yin nam byas pas yin gsungs/ de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi bcad bsdus pa'i snying po bskyed rdzogs kyi chos gcig zhu byas gsol ba btab pas/ sbyor ba la yan lag drug gi gdams pa 'di gnang nas nga 'gro gsungs/ gar gshegs byas pas/ nub phyogs kha cher 'gro gsungs/ las can gyi gdul bya yod gsungs/ de nas dpal gyi ri la 'gro gsungs gshegs so/

/lar thang bi ha rir de dus zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs skad do/ /de dus ri khrod dbang phyug dzo ki'i cha byad du byon nas sbyor drug gi gdams pa bstan pa'i blta stangs kyi lugs la/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad ka nas sa rlung sor bcu gnyis nas nam mkha'i rlung cha ste bcu drug gi bar gyi mdun gyi nam mkha' la sa gcig tu mig gnyis dril nas blta ba 'di mdzad de/ de bas thag ring yang mi lto gsung ngo / /don de la dgongs nas dbang mdor bstan gyi 'gyur sgra tshad rin rgyal gyis byas pa na/ bkab dang ma bkab mi dag gis/ /zhes dang / 'gyur gzhan dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga sogs kyis lung 'dren gsung ngo / /rwa 'bro gong ma'i phyag bzhes la/ mig gyen la log byas nas steng gi nam mkha' la blta ba de mdzad de/ cung lta stangs dam pa'i stobs kyis mig gi mchi ma mi thub par sdug drags te bros pa yang mang po byung yod par 'dug 'on kyang dge brag pa'i bla ma bsod rin la ni mig mar mi phebs pa gyen la blta ba 'di ka bde zer te/ gang zag la la de rang 'phrod pa 'dug go /gang zag la la lta stangs 'di gnyis la khyad med pa 'ong gin 'dug phal che ba zhig la/ sha ba ri dbang phyug gi lta stangs kyi lugs 'di bde bar snang / de gnyis gang ltar yang mig gi phyed pags pas g.yog phyed ma g.yogs par mdun gyi nam mkha'i rgya lag mthil tsam mam/ sen mo zlum po tsam pa de'i dkyil du sa gcig tu mig gnyis mi 'gyur bar hrig ge blta/ sems kyang der ting nge 'dzin gsungs so/ /dbang po'i byed bcing la sogs nges pa khrid yig bzhin las/ thur sel then tsam byed/ bsgom bya'i skabs su 'dir ci yang mi sgom pa yin te/ chos kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ da ltar gyi shes pa bcos pa thol gyis shar ba de'i steng du ting nge bzhag de la rtog pa thol skyes na/ thol skyes rbad chod du gtong pa yin/

mdor na lus mi g.yo ba spang la phur pa btab pa lta bu'am/ lha khang gi ldor so lta bu/ ngag mi g.yo ba ro lta bu/ sems mi g.yo bar ri bong sbos non pa lta bur bzhag ste/ don de la dgongs nas/ hi ma dpal ye shes kyi sbyor drug tu/ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis/ /dhu tir rlung bcu tshud gyur par/ /rtog 'gags rtags bcu mthong gyur pa/ /so sor gcod pa'i yan lag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de la zhag 'ga' bzhugs la sgom gsungs so/ /de ltar mi g.yo gsum ldan du mnyam par bzhag pas/ sems stong nas sgom min gnyid min du gyur pa'am/ sems had por lus te skabs su gtam col byung pa'am/ nyams snang 'ur ches nas smyon par 'chor ba lta bu byung na de'i gegs sel dang bogs 'don lta bu la/ chos rje kun spangs pas spre'u sgo ru btags pa lta bu'i man ngag ces ming du btags te/ dper na khang pa rgyas skar drug yod pa zhig tu spre'u gcig khrol lur bzhag na kho rig pa phra bas sdod mi zug par gsal skar thams cad du nyug nyug byas pas/ khang pa'i phyi na snang ba'i mi rnams kyis khang pa de spre'us khengs pa'i snang ba 'byung / spre'u de gsal skar gcig tu lcags thag gis btags bzhag pas/ gsal skar gzhan thams cad kyi 'grul chad nas spre'u gcig por shes pa bzhin du/ sems 'di'ang dbang po drug gi yul la 'phro ba rnams rbad rbad bcad la sngar gyi mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi lta sa de nyid du yid mig rlung gsum gcig tu dril te zhur gyis bzhur la/ de'i rjes mi bcad/ 'bar tag mi btang / bsngo 'grang mi bya bar rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas sems zhi lhag zung 'jug tu mer gyis gnas pa 'byung / 'di nyid la mkhan chen thar los/ sgo gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i man ngag ces don ming du mdzad do/ /rtsa rgyud nas/ bha gar ling ga rab bzhag ste/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bha ga la gsum yod kyang /

skabs 'dir nam mkha'i bha gar sems kyi ling ga bzhag nas/ byang chub sems ni ste rtog pa spro bar mi bya'o/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa ste/ khams gsum ni 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi blos rnam rtog bcad bsgoms pas sangs rgyas de stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dbang po'i sgo ma bsdams na rnam shes yul dang 'jug pa gcig pas phyi rol gyi yul la brten nas yul sna tshogs su 'jug par 'gyur te/ gsang 'dus las/ rlung ni phra ba'i gzugs kyis su/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas/ /dbang po'i sgo nas zhugs nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni 'jug par byed/ /ces gsungs/ sems rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ye shes 'byung ba yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung tshul du gnas bya zhing / /bla ma'i lung la sgrim ste gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung ba the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas/ sngar gyi mi g.yo gsum ldan du yid mig rlung gsum gcig tu dril nas mnyam par bzhag pas/ sems lta stangs sam nyams snang 'ur ches te blo 'phro na/ g.yas g.yon du nyams kyi rjes su mi blta bar lta stangs de nyid du nyams snang phra ba gcig la mig 'bru tshugs su blta/ sems kyang de nyid du ting nges bzung bas rtog pa'i 'gyu ba tshar chod par 'gyur gsungs/ de la zhag 'ga' hur gyis la bsgom mdzod gsungs/ de ltar byas pas grims na mi g.yo gsum ldan bzhin du byas pa'i khar sing de dmigs pa 'jur so gcig yod pas de grims drags na yer zhing rtog pa gcig tu mi gnas par sna tshogs su 'thor ba'am/ shes pa mi gsal bar thim nas gsal cha med par gyur na/ de'i gegs sel lam bogs 'don lta bu la dbu ma brten pa'i man ngag ces kyang bya/ spun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa'i man ngag ces kyang bya ste/ dper na 'jig rten gyi grogs po 'tshol ba rnams la dpe byas na/

bu spun gsum 'dug na/ rang bas rgan pa de dang yang shed mi snyoms pas mi sdeb/ rang bas gzhon pa dang yang shed mi mthun pas mi sdeb/ rang dang na mnyam pa de dang sdeb pa bzhin du/ shes pa 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod de/ sngar 'das pa zin nas med pas rjes su 'brangs kyang rtog pa'i bzo min pas mi 'ong ste/ dgra gcig yid la byung na zhe sdang skye/ /gnyen gcig yid la byung na chags pa skye/ /lung ma bstan byung na'ang gti mug las ma 'das pas/ /des na 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu ste/ ma 'ongs pa ni 'byung 'gyur bdags rung tsam las grub pa med pa'i phyir/ des na grogs na mnyam lta bu da lta'i shes pa so ma gang shar yod/ chos grub bzhin pa de ka'i ngo bo la bltas pas 'dzin med du shigs kyis 'gro ste/ yang rtog pa thol skyes pa so ma'i ngo bo la bltas pas rkun ma ngos zin pa bzhin kho rang rang log la 'gro ste/ de ni rang dang na mnyam dang rogs pho byed pa bzhin no/ /yang dbang mdor bstan 'grel pa'i lung ltar/ thog ma tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /bar pa tsam zhig brten par bya/ /de la gnas shing de spong gang / /'di yi snang ba bcu bdag nyid/ /ces te/ dang por thog mar te sngar 'das pa dang / tha ma ste ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu zhing / de las grol ba'i da ltar gyi shes pa so ma dbu ma tsam la gnas pa'o/ /shes pa so ma'i ngo bo la blta ba dang / der gnas pa de ka'i ngo bo la bltas pas rtog pa kho rang rang log tu 'gro ba 'di snang ba bcu'i bdag nyid ces so/ /don de nyid mdo sde'i dgongs pa yang yin te/ dge slong zhig rgyal po'i khab chu dron can gyi 'gram gyi gtsug lag khang zhig na sgom gyin yod tsa na/ gtsug lag khang de'i gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha gcig byung nas dge slong mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo shes sam zer ba la mi shes byas pas/ 'o na mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo de zab mo gcig yod pas bcom ldan 'das la zhus shig zer mi snang bar song /

de la dge slong des 'od ma'i tshal du bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin nas bdag la mdang sum gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha gcig gis lung bstan nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo zhus shig zer gyin gda'/ mdo de gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ de lha'i bu de bden/ mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo de med kha med gcig yod gsungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ 'das pa'i rjes su 'gro mi byed/ /ma 'ongs pa la re ba med/ /da ltar byung chos gang yin pa/ /de dang de la rnam lta ba/ /mi 'phrog kun tu mi 'khrugs pa/ /de ltar mkhas pas spel bar bya/ /zhes dang / res 'ga'/ de ltar skye ba'i rgyun rnams ni/ /mkhas pas yongs su bskyang par bya/ /zhes kyang gsungs te/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod ma 'ongs pa la re ba mi byed de/ re na slu dogs na 'ching bya ba yin te/ ma byung gi dogs pa dang / yong la re ba la sogs pa gang yang mi byed gsung / des na da ltar gyi shes pa so ma'i ngo bo la hrig ge gsal le lhan ne yer re 'jog cing gang la'ang ngos mi 'dzin/ sems mi gtod/ 'dzin pa bshig nas bzhag pas/ rkun ma ngos zin pa bzhin du kho rang rang log tu 'gro ba legs pas de ltar mdzod cig gsungs so/ /yang kha sang gi de 'jur drags nas dmigs pa gtad par ma zin par shes pa 'thor ba'am/ sems yas par gyur te sems ma zin pas yom yom zing zing byas mgo na zhing mi rus na na grims drags pa yin pas/ glod nas rang grol du bzhag pa rnga mo bcings pa lta bu'i man ngag la bslab ste/ dper na rnga rdzi zhig rnga mo 'tsho yi yod pas khos rnga mo de rtswa bzang pa zhig tu gtod phur la btags bzhag pas/ rtswa ye mi za ba tsab tsab ka byed kyin 'dug da 'di btang na ji tsam zhig 'gro lta'i bsams nas/ rnga mo de dkrol btang pa dang da phyin nas thang chad pa'i stobs kyis pha tshad bros te song nas der 'khyul gyis nyal song /

der rnga rdzi nang du log ste grogs mo la snying gtam smras pa bcings na phyogs bcur brgyug ste 'gro/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag la phyin ci log par snang / /zhes khrid yig bzhin te/ dpe de bzhin du sems 'di'ang dmigs pa'i gtod phur la btags nas 'dzin pa skad byas na/ rtog pa 'phro ru song nas sems mi gnas na/ shes pa khong nas lhod kyis glod nas dmigs pa'i gtod phur dam po de las lhod du btang na dran pas bya ra bas ma yengs tsam du bskyangs na/ rnga mo dkrol ba ltar rang gnas su gnas te/ zhi lhag zung du chud nas 'byung ste/ a ma na si'i skor/ phyag rgya chen po gzhung gi skor/ rang byung gsal ba las kyang / ma bcos chos rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /de nyid mngon par rtogs 'dod na/ /yid la yul la mi spro bar/ /lhod kyis glod la lhan gyis zhog /ces dang / lho phyogs dpal gyi rir sha ba ri dbang phyug gi drung du/ rgyal sras me tri pa dang / rgyal po rat+na ā kā ra sid+dhi gnyis kyis phyin pas gnyis ka'i spyi bo ru sha ba ri bas phyag gnyis po re re bzhag nas gsungs pa/ /sgoms shig sgoms shig ma bsgom zhig /bsgoms pa yis ni 'ching bar 'gyur/ /ma bsgoms pas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /ltos shig ltos shig ma lta zhig /bltas pa yis ni mi mthong zhing / /ma bltas pas ni mthong par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ sgom rgyu ci yang med pa'i ngang 'phral lhod pa dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i ngang la phugs grims pa ma yengs pa'i bya ra ba dang ldan pas bram ze mo mdzangs mas skud pa 'khal ba bzhin lhod de shig ge ba sbu gu seg ba ma grim pa'i cha cis kyang med pa bzhin du sems lhod de shig ge ba la ma yengs par bzhag ste/ mdor na sems lhod drags nas mi mthun phyogs kyi rtog pa kha rgyu yul sna tshogs la ma shor ba/ 'og 'gyu'i rtog pa phra mo rang gis 'gyus pa ma tshor bar sog ma'i 'og nas chu shor ba lta bur mi rig dgu rig la ma shor bar grim lhod ran par byed pa gal che bas rtog pa kha 'gyu mgo 'gyu'i 'jab khyis ma khyer bar byas nas bsgom pa yin no/

/yang de ka gcig bu bsgom pa ma yin te/ lhod drags na dmigs pa snga ma rnams bsgoms/ grim drags na phyi ma 'di bsgoms te/ mdor na skyes bu kha ba gnyer byed pa'am/ gser 'jal ba'i zhol lce ltar mnyam khad de ba la rgyun bskyang ngo / /gro zhun skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i rnam thar la bslab ces pa'i thad du 'di gsungs/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gro zhun skyes ni yul tsam pa ka pa yin/ yab gru 'dzin zhes bya/ yab kyis bu'i rkan dbab pa'i rin la/ gser srang bye ba nyi shu byin cig ces pa'i spring yig bskur ba dang / skar ma gro zhun la skyes pas na gro zhun skyes bye ba nyi shu pa zhes bya/ de'i tshe gro zhun skyes ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog gis bsnyen rdzogs byas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos brtson 'grus brtsam ste gnas pa ji snyed cig yod pa de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu lung bstan to/ /de nyid slob dpon kun dga' bo la gtad nas/ gro zhun skyes rgyal po'i khab kyi bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du gnas nas rtag tu bsam gtan la 'grus par gnas pa na shes pa ha cang byings te/ de kun dga' bo la zhus pas/ bying na bcags shig gsungs nas der bsil ba'i tshal gyi ri g.yas gdong g.yon gdong bar la bcags pas ji zhig nas rkang mthil gyi spu ster gyis zad kyang sems kyi gnas pa ma rnyed do/ /der yang bcags pas brtson 'grus drag po'i stobs kyis rkang mthil la rma byung zhing khrag zags te/ g.yas kyi ri gdong du slebs tsa na g.yon gyi ri logs kyi khrag rnams la bya rog thib thib pa byung / g.yon gyi ri gdong na slebs na g.yas kyi ri logs kyi khrag rnams la bya rog thib thib pa byung ste/ de lta bu'i brtson 'grus brtsams kyang / res byings res rgod pa'i stobs kyis gnas pa skad cig kyang ma skyes par sems khong du chud nas/

rang gis bsam pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos brtson 'grus can gnas pa ji rnyed yod pa rnams kyi nang nas bdag mchog yin no zhes so/ /bdag gis ni zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar ma gyur gyi/ de bas bdag gi nye du rnams la longs spyod chen po yod pas/ ma la bdag 'dug la 'dod pa rnams la longs spyod cing sbyin pa dag sbyin bsod nams dag bya'o snyam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gro zhun skyes kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong gro zhun skyes can song la sang la 'dir shog cig ces sgos shig btsun pa de bzhin bgyi zhes mnyan nas/ gro zhun skyes la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gro zhun skyes khyod la ston pas shog gsung ngo / /zhes gro zhun skyes la smras nas/ gro zhun skyes kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin nas/ zhabs la phyag byas nas 'dug pa na/ btsun pas gsungs pa/ gro zhun skyes khyod gcig pur dben par song ste nang du bsgoms pa na khyod kyi sems la rtog pa'i 'di lta bu skyes te/ nga ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos brtson 'grus can gnas pa rnams kyi nang nas bdag mchog yin na/ zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar ma gyur gyis/ de bas nye du rnams la longs spyod chen po yod pas/ ma can bdag 'dug la/ 'dod pa la longs spyod cing sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag bya'o snyam pa khyod la ma skyes sam/ zhes pa la gro zhun skyes 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i bsam pa mkhyen 'dug snyam ste/ 'jigs skrag spu zing zhes byed nas/ btsun pa de ltar mad lags so zhes smras so/ /de'i phyir gro zhun skyes khyod la ngas dri yis/ ji ltar dris pa bzhin lan thob cig khyod kyis sngon khyim par gyur pa na pi waṃ bsgreng shes sam/ btsun pa pi waṃ bsgreng ba la mkhas lags so/ /zhes zhus pas/ gro zhun skyes la pi waṃ zhig gtad nas gro zhun skyes pi waṃ gi rgyud shin tu bsdams pa de pi waṃ gi sgra snyan par 'gyur ram/

btsun pa ma lags so/ /'o na pi waṃ gi rgyud lhag par lhod na pi waṃ gi sgra snyan par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /'o na pi waṃ gi rgyud shin tu bsdams pa'ang min/ lhod pa'ang ma yin par rgyud dang lhod ran par 'dug pa de pi waṃ sgra snyan par 'gyur/ btsun pa de ltar lags so/ /gro zhun skyes dpe de bzhin du ha cang brtson 'grus brtsams drags na rgod par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang brtson 'grus brtsams zhan na bying bar 'gyur ro/ /grim lhod ran pa nyid la sgra snyan po 'byung ba bzhin du gro zhun skyes khyod kyis kyang sems grim lhod ran pa'i sgo nas mnyam par zhog gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi pi waṃ gi dpes tshe dang ldan pa gro zhun skyes la gdam ngag phog pas/ tshe dang ldan pa gro zhun skyes gro zhun skyes 'di sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus su bram ze'i khye'u bkren pa zhig yod pas bslangs byas nas gnas khang brtsigs/ der khye'u kho rang gi gos chung btings/ de'i grwa bzhir kar+sha pa ni lnga lnga bzhag dom gyi pags pa zhig yod pa gnas khang de'i sgo drung bting ste/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs 'khor lnga brgya la bsnyen bkur byas nas smon lam btab pa/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi zhabs mthil gnyis la gser gyi spu sor bzhi tsam skyes pa 'di dang / yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ bye ba nyi shu pas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /dmigs pa bzhi po 'di bla ma bi bhu ti tsan+d+ras bod du byon dus slob ma dgu la khrid phog /de rnams kyi nang nas slob ma'i mchog bzhi la gsungs pa ni/ grub chen ko brag pa/ dpyal a mo gha/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ lho pa tshul gzhon dang bzhi la gsungs/ bla ma dpyal pa la bla ma chos sku'i 'od zer gyis zhus/ bla ma mar ston g.yang 'bar la bla ma sang 'bum gyis zhus/ bla ma de gnyis la bla ma jo mo nang pa kun spangs chen pos gtugs te khong bzhi po la gsan pa'i zin bris kyi shog ril rnams bsdus pas bzhi byung ba'i nang du sems kyi 'dzin lugs mi 'dra tsam re re byung ba yin par 'dug

mkhan chen thar lo'i dus su ni mi g.yo gsum ldan las spo rgyu med gsung ngo / /nyin mo'i rnal 'byor kyi skabs su/ khang pa'i g.yas sam/ yang na ri gdong mtho bar rang gi mdun nas rtsig pas skyor bas mis mi mthong bar mig la ser bus mi gnod pa'i dgos pa yod/ gangs dang 'khyag pa dang nyi zer dang brag dkar po la sogs mig la gnod pa med na legs/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa nas chu rgyun mi 'chad par na ra ra 'gro ba yod na sems mi gnas pa'i rten 'brel yod pas med na dga'/ mtsho'am rdzing chung ldeng nge pa mthong ba'i sa de lta bur khams 'dus 'jug pas mi bsgom/ bla ma gong ma rnams nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dus su/ kha nub byang du bltas la mi bsgom/ 'di la gnad gcig yod gsungs te/ nub byang rlung gi mtshams yin pas sems ma gnas kyi dogs pa yin pa 'dra gsungs/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la lta ba'i dus su nam mkha' dwangs po ma byung na/ sprin pha ka tshu ka'i bar stong du nam mkha'i skabs dum pa byung pa der lta/ de lta bu'ang ma byung zhing zhag sprin la sogs byung nas nam mkha' khengs te blta sa ma byung na/ smin mtshams sor bcu drug gi thad so tsam gyi bar snang la hong stong gi dkyil du sems 'dzin/ de ka'i rjes thob la bya ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par mun khang du zhugs te bsgoms na bogs chen po 'ong ba yin gsungs/ de ltar gyi skye ba sbyong par byed pa mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang / 'chi ba sbyong bar byed pa nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gcig yin gsungs so/ /so sor bsdud kyi spogs chog 'di gsum mi dgos pa byung na 'dir ngo sprod byas te srung sdom drug ldan rnams rgyas par gsungs/ spogs chog dgos par byung na rim par phog nas ngo sprod rjes su srung sdom drug ldan gsungs/ sor bsdud kyi thad du des kyang sems ma zin na/ dngos po thams cad nam mkha' la bstims la/

sems kyang nam mkha' la yas su gzhug 'di'i gnad bla ma'i zhal las shes pa yin/ rang gi sems 'di mar me chung ngu'i 'od lta bu gcig tu dmigs la/ de nyid mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'phar te 'od de'i mtha' ma nas 'od de srab the re re song ste/ mthar nam mkha' la yal bar bsam mo/ /de'i dpe ni rdzing ngam zangs chus bkang ba'i dkyil der rtsam pa dum tsam gcig blugs pa dang / phyogs sgor mo ru tsam pa de the re re khyer te mthar dngos med du yal ba de lta bu bsgoms pa yin gsung ngo / /'di do ha nas btus pa yin gsungs so/ /zangs gzhong chu la dmigs pa gcig bug pa zlum po la rtsi nag bug pa la dmigs pa gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i chos drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do/ /zhes pa'i thad du/ sor sdud rgyal po'i dbang po bsgom pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu ye shes kyi phung po gnas gyur pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ rnam par shes pa'i khams gnas gyur pa sher phyin ma sngon mo/ yid kyi skye mched kun bzang / sgra'i skye mched sgra rdo rje ma/ mchog gi dbang po khro bo gnod mdzes/ dri chu 'dzag pa shin tu sngon mo ste drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do/ /rdor sems ye phung sher phyin sngon mo rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / /kun bzang yid kyi skye mched sgra yi rdo rje ma/ sgra'i skye mched/ /gnod mdzes mchog gi dag po shin tu sngon mo dri chu 'dzag ste/ /ye shes phung sogs gnas gyur drug /ces so/ /lam zab mo'i rtogs pa dang mi ldan pa'i sdig grogs la bsten na chos la smod cing / the tshom skyes pas shin tu gsang dgos zhes pa'i thad du/ khro phu ba'i dge bshes bsod nams gzungs zer pa gcig gis jo nang du sbyor drug zhus/ der nyams bzang po a tsi ba byung / chos rje ba yang mnyes po byung / dge bshes des dus phyis bsam ldings su mkhas grub mkhas btsun gzhon nu pa la ni gu zhus/

de dus mkhas grub la/ bdag gis jo nang du chos rje kun spangs pa la sbyor drug zhus tsa na/ bla ma'i gsung gis nyams bzang po a tsi ba yin gsung gi gda' na/ de ji 'dra lags sam/ 'di 'dra 'di 'dra byung lags zhus pas/ de 'dra a tsi ba min zer te phyin ka log tu bshad pas/ dge bshes de kho bla ma kun spangs pa la log lta chen po skyes te dus phyis bshang gci kha nas 'ong ba'i na tsha gcig gis thebs te de'i ngang nas shi yod par gda'/ de kun dmyal bar skye nges shes su gda' ba skyes yod mchi mod/ de 'dra gcig ma cig ri ma la'ang 'o yug pa dge bshes don pas zer byung gda' ste/ mo la mo tshod yod pas sgom nya ra byung gda' gsungs so/ /yi dam lhas lung ston pa dang zhes pa'i thad du/ dbus pa'i jo gdan 'phan yul ngos pa zhig gis bla ma rje btsun chen po'i grags pa rgyal mtshan/ snyan pa thos nas dbus pa'i snam 'tshong pa gcig dang 'grogs nas 'ongs nas/ ru 'tshams su slebs pa dang / kho sngar nas tshes bcu la phag mo'i lag mchod re rgyun du byed kyi yod pas/ de'i dus la babs nas tshong pa rnams la khyed rang rnams 'dir sdod/ nga sa phug ya kir 'gro zer nas phyin te/ grong nas chang gcig nyos nas tshes bcu'i mchod pa gcig byas pa'i nub mo/ mtshan ji zhig nas bu kha gcig nas 'od zer gcig byung / de nas rim gyis 'od zer rnam pa lnga byung ste/ nang mchod kyi steng du rdo rje phag mo'i sku byi ru ltar shin tu dmar zhing / 'od zer lnga 'phro ba zhig byung nas/ de na re/ bu khyod sa skyar ma 'gro bar/ skye med ston pa'i bla ma bde chen gyi drung du song zhig der khyod grol bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas sang tshong pa rnams kyi gan du sngar yin na/ da sa skya la ji tsam yod ka dri ba la/ de'i snga dro nas nga sa skyar 'gro ba'i nges pa med zer zhing lam du mi 'phrad tshad la/

skye med ston pa'i bla ma bde chen gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri/ de nas rim gyis tshong pa rnams dang 'grogs nas sa skyar phyin/ rje btsun chen po'i drung du mjal bas/ rje btsun gyis/ de la bdud zhugs par mkhyen nas/ 'dir zhag 'ga' sdod gsungs pas/ 'dir mi sdod skye med ston pa'i bla ma bde chen ga na yod zer/ de nga la rgyus med gsungs/ rje btsun gyi drung na khams pa sbas ston zhes bya ba sa cha gang du'ang phyin pa'i rgyus can zhig yod pa de na re/ skye med bde chen gyis khyod la ci byed/ de dgos na spa spro stag tshang seng ge phug na yod zer/ der kho dga' nas spa spro stag tshang phug gi lam lung legs par dris/ khams pa sbas ston la phyag 'tshal/ rje btsun la phyag kyang mi 'tshal bar phyin nas/ der bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos rnams zhus pas smyon pa chen po zhig byung ba/ dus phyis rje btsun gyi drung du 'khor nas byung ba na lto ba'i zhwa la pho rog dang skyag ka la sogs pa'i sgro sna tshogs btsugs phyar ru'i phyi ru snam sbyar gog po zhig gon nas byung / de dus su'ang thugs rjes bzung thabs ma byung bas bdud kyis khyer zhing bar chad du song zhes gsung ngo / /de lta bu'am/ gnas brtan bsod she'i gtam rgyun yang gsung ngo / /khrid 'debs lugs sogs mi bshad pa bka' rgya'i dam tshig gis bsrung ste/ sbyor drug pa 'di tsho rang gi nyams snang chos rgyud mi gcig pa rnams la ma bshad byas kyang ye mi nyan par brang bshags phad kyis mnan pa bzhin byas nas bshad pa de 'dra byed pa min gsungs/ kho pa rdzogs chen pa la gtor ma mgo thog bzhag nas mna' sgog gi yod pa 'dra/ ye mi bshad par 'dug gsung ngo / /yi dam lhas lung ston pa dang 'dre dmag la sogs pa'i nyams snang byung na/ nyams snang phal dang nor sa yod pas khyad par shes par byas la zhes pa nas/ gzugs rnams dag gis bdud ni gegs byed do/

/zhes pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'dre dang srin po la sogs pa'i mi sdug pa dang sdug pa sogs gang snang de dang / sems gnyis shes rab kyis gcig tu bsres/ rtog pas de'i ngo bo la ce re blta zhing 'dzin med du bzhag pas/ bdud kyi bar chad yin na nyams snang de yal nas 'gro la/ nyams snang phal yin na/ slar la nyams snang de dwangs pa gsal ba rgya che ba 'byung gsung ngo / /bsam gtan gyi mtshan don ni/ 'dir bla ma 'ga' zhig sor sdud bsgoms pas bsam gtan shugs la 'ong ba yin gsungs nas sor sdud bsam gtan gnyis khrid 'chun gcig tu mdzad pa yod de/ snyan rgyud las/ rab kyis dang por rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la dgongs te/ dbang po rab kyi de 'dra 'byung srid mod/ tha mas drug po rim bzhin bsgoms zhes pa ltar dbang po tha ma la phral nas so sor sgom pa zab pas/ 'dir de'i lugs su byed de/ mtshan don la/ chos rje kun spangs pas/ bsam gtan la/ bsam pa ni sems te/ de gtan par byed pas na bsam gtan te/ ba 'og rab brtan yin zhes gsungs te/ de 'dra gang nas kyang bshad pa med/ bsam gtan gyi skad dod la dh+yā na bya ba yod de yid 'dzin pa bya ba yin te/ stong gzugs la yid ting nge 'dzin ma yengs par rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin na mtshan don yin gsungs so/ /dus mtshams ni/ snyan rgyud las/ nam mkha'i rlung rgyu dus su bsgom par bshad de/ de 'dra rgyud 'grel nas ma gsungs/ dbang mdor bstan las/ rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /gzugs de rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs su grub la/ reg pa'i rdzas su ma grub pa mthong ba de dus mtshams yin gsungs/ bsam gtan yan lag la/ ye shes dang gcig rtog pa dang gnyis/ dpyod pa dang gsum/ dga' ba dang bzhi/ bde ba dang lnga'i yan lag gi dbye ba'i skabs su/ gsang 'dus las/ rtog pa dang ni zhes sogs gsungs/

rgyud las shes rab sogs gsungs pa'i rgyu'i yan lag shes rab dang rtog pa gnyis po de so sor bsgoms pas ngo bo'i yan lag spyod pa de 'byung / de bsgoms pas 'bras bu'i yan lag dga' bde gnyis po zhar la 'byung bas de gnyis dmigs pa'ang chun gcig tu mdzad pa yin gsungs so/ /sems kyi 'jog tshul gyi skabs su/ nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gang byed kyang lus gnad sngar bzhin las/ gsang 'dus su bshad pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / dus 'khor gyi rgyud kyi shes rab gnyis gcig pas/ dang por shes rab bsgoms te/ sor sdud kyi stong nyid gang mthong ba'i yul de dang / de 'dzin pa'i sems de gcig tu bsres nas bsgom pa ni/ shes rab yin pas stong gzugs gang yin de'i ngo bo la ce re blta zhing bsgom mo/ /sems mi brtan pa 'ga' zhig la stong gzugs la la yar 'gro la la mar 'gro/ g.yas g.yon du 'gro ba la sogs 'ong bas de'i rjes su bltas na lta stangs 'jig pas lta stangs sngar bzhin hrig ge bzhag byed pa lnga la bcing ba gnyis/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /zhes gong du bshad pa ltar byed pa dbang po'i sgo lnga bcing ba steng 'og gi rlung gnyis 'ching ba ste/ lus gnad lta stangs sngar bzhin las/ sems ma bcos par sing nge bzhag rtog pas ma brtags par yer re bzhag gang shar de ka'i ngo bo la tse ne bzhag 'dzin pa med par lhod de bzhag ste/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug gis rgyal sras mai tri pa la gsungs pa'i rgya gar gsang spyod las/ ma bcos ma bcos blo ma 'chos/ /blo yis bcos pa'i chos rnams ni/ /ri bas lci zhing mtsho bas zab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems ma bcos par yul yun 'dzin pa med par gcig tu bsres la bsgom/ yul rnams la 'di sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi rnam 'phrul yin te dga' snyam pa dang / 'di 'gong po'i cho 'phrul yin te 'jigs snyam du dga' mi dga'i mtshan 'dzin gyis rtog pa bzung na/

snang ba dgrar langs kyi gegs 'byung bas/ rtog pa kha 'gyu nyams 'di 'dra yin/ 'di 'di 'dra'o snyam pa dang / rtog pa 'og rgyu sog ma'i 'og tu chu shor ba lta bu ma tshor bar phyam ce song nas/ sngar brjod pa'i mna' dus kyi don dran pa lta bu 'byung / de la 'phral du nyams de mi 'gag pa snyam byed kyang / phugs su kho rgyas nas sgom 'chor du 'ong bas bcad pa gal che ste/ gang ltar yang sgom 'dre la mi bskur te/ 'dre ji lta bu yin na/ kun dgas/ pha dam pa la zhus pa/ dam pa lags/ ma jo dge 'dun skyid na re/ ngas ji tsam bsgoms kyang sgom ye rang ma byung / nga la sgom gyi las 'phro med pa yin nam zer te/ mo la sgom gyi las 'phro med pa lags sam zhus pas/ ye gdod ma nas lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes de sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod pa ma go 'am gsungs/ sgom gyi las 'phro med pa'i mi ga na 'ong gsungs/ de dang go lags te/ de yin na sems can thams cad la sgom gtad med du 'ong thang pa la zhus pas/ de dang yod de ngo ma shes pa yin mod gsungs/ de shes pa la ci 'tshal zhus pas/ de bla ma dam pa'i gdam ngag gis ngo sprod dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'o na mo la dam pas ngo sprod ma mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ ngo sprod byas te/ mo'i sgom 'dres khyer ba yin mod gsungs/ 'dre de ci 'dra gcig gis khyer ba lags zhus pas/ mnyam bzhag rtog pa'i 'dres khyer nas rtsa ba ma zin/ rjes thob dran pa'i 'dres khyer nas blo dang ma 'brel/ 'dre de gnyis mor ma zad sgom chen pa phal la gnod pa yin gsungs/ de ltar na du sogs kyi steng du sems bzhag ste yul 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi 'byung gi bar du bsgoms te/ de la zhag 'ga' bzhur la bsgom mdzod gsungs/ 'dir rgyu'i yan lag shes rab dang rtog pa bsgom pa'i skabs yin/ de gnyis bsgom pas ngo bo'i yan lag dang gcig 'bras bu'i yan lag dang gnyis po de khrong gis 'byung ba yin pas/

shes rab kyi yan lag gis yul yul can gcig tu bsres te bsgoms pas sems nang du gnas tsa na stong gzugs nang du gnas/ sems phyir gnas tsa na stong gzugs phyir gnas/ sems gar bzhag tu stong gzugs gnas tsa na shes rab mthar phyin te rtog pa'i yan lag bsgom ran pa'i mtshams yin pas gzhan bzhi so sor sdud dang 'dra/ bsgom bya sems kyi 'jog tshul de shes rab dang cung mi 'dra bas/ rtog pa la 'bar tag mi gtong skyon du mi blta/ yon tan du mi 'dzin/ gang shar de ka'i ngo bo la rjen cher gyis blta/ 'di la phyag rgya chen po bas kyang sems kyi ngo bo la blta ba zer/ de dang bdar sha chod mi chod cung mi 'dra/ de ni kha nang du log ste zhi gnas ldings po sems lhan ne ba de la bltas pas/ stong par shes pa de yin/ 'dir shes rab kyi yan lag gi yul yul can gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa'i sems de yang blta mkhan gyi sems gcig yod pa de'i ngo bo la ce re blta/ de'i ngang la rtog pa thol skyes rbad chod la gtong / sems kyi ngo la blta ba de ka rtog pa yin te/ 'grel chen bstod 'grel las gsungs pa/ rtog pa zhes bya ba ni sems kyi dngos 'dzin zhes pa'o gsungs/ gsang 'dus las/ gsang ba gsum zhes sogs la yul yul can rnam par shes pa gsum gcig tu 'dres pa la bshad pas/ yul yul can gcig tu gyur pa la blta ba'i sems de ka'i ngo bo la ma yengs par cer re blta ba de ka rtog pa'i yan lag yin pas de la zhag 'ga' zhur la bsgom gsungs/ de ltar rgyu'i yan lag shes rab dang rtog pa gnyis la legs par sbyangs pas/ ngo bo'i yan lag gcig 'bras bu'i yan lag gnyis/ bya ba gsum zhor 'byung du rang gi rig pa de la bla mas ngo sprad pa rkyang gis chog pa yin te/ nags gseb na stag yod/ de 'di 'dra zhig yod do zer ba lta bu ma yin par/ rang gis mngon sum du ngo bo sprod pa'i yan lag gi dus su yul stong gzugs kyi snang ba de sems stong pa dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa de la/

lta mkhan de'i sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pas/ rtog pas sgro btags ma yin pa/ gsal rig 'dzin pa med par dwangs sang nge sel le hrig ge mthong ba rjen cher gyis nges pa gcig 'byung ste/ de ni spyod pa'i yan lag ste/ 'di la phyag chen pa rnams kyang sgom ngo mthong zer nas sems kyi ngo bo mthong bar 'chad cing mthong lam du ngo sprod par 'dug ste/ ngo sprod cung mthos tsam yin gsungs/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba yin mod kyis mthong lam ma yin gsung ngo / /de ltar ngo bo'i yan lag dpyod pa mthong na 'bras bu'i yan lag dga' bde gnyis shugs 'byung du de'i steng du gnas pa yin te/ dngos po gang gi steng du sems bzhag kyang mi g.yo bar gnas pa/ mya ngan dang sems kyi zung du ci byung yang sems bde lhan lhan gnas shing yid bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa de dga' ba yin te/ de yid kyi yul du 'byung ba yin no/ /g.yo med bde ba ni lus kyi yul du 'byung ba yin te/ phyi rol tu gog thug zer ba dang / tsher ma zug pa la sogs pa ji byung yang zug rngu med kyi steng du lus la bde ba khyad par can 'byung ba ni lus shin tu sbyangs pa'i rgyu can gyi bde ba zhes bya ba yin te/ de ni g.yo med bde ba'o/ /de ltar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga/ yul yul can gyi dbye bas bcu ste/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis sbyangs pas gzung 'dzin dbyer med stong pa nyid gcig pu'i mthar thug pa 'di byung tsa na lam thams cad tshegs med par bgrod pa yin gsungs so/ /de ltar gong du bstan pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag de rnams legs po byung na/ spogs chog dgos pa'i lugs min/ gong ma rnams ma byung na spogs chog 'di rnams byed pa yin pas de la sprin med pa'i nam mkha' dwangs pa'i nyi ma de la rgyab bstan te/ lus gnas byas la/ lus kyi grib ma de'i snying gar/ sems gtad pas grib gzugs zhig pa'am/

skya 'o la sogs pa ma gyur gyi bar du bltas la/ de ma thag ste mdun gyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis bltas pas skya bo'i gzugs 'byung / de sangs pa'i rjes su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nyams sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ de ltar mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang gnyis res mos su byas te yang yang bsgoms na bsam gtan dag nas zla ba drug gis sa 'og gi gter mthong ngo gsung / de bzhin du ljon shing dang nyi ma la rgyab bstan te/ shing de'i grib ma dang g.yas g.yon gyi shing gi grib ma 'dus pa'i 'doms sa de ru bsam gtan gyi yan lag gi lta stangs sogs gong dang 'dra'o/ /don gnyis pa snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal bzung ba la gnyis kyis/ dang po ni snang ba de dkar po'i steng du sems bzung na mig la gzan pas mi bya/ spang dum sam lci ba lta bu la sogs mig la mi gzan pa'i steng du 'dzin te/ de dang stong gzugs dang sems gsum bsres nas bsgoms pas/ ci zhig nas de gnyis 'dres 'gro/ de ka'i ngang la bsgoms pas/ snang ba nag phyang pa'am skya phyam gyis 'gro/ de'i rjes su snang ba thams cad gnag sing ba la sems dwangs la gsal ba 'byung / de'i rjes su srid 'das kyi nyams sna tshogs 'char/ de'i 'phro la gog thug la sogs byung nas sad na sngar gyi spang ngam/ gci ba la sogs de nag ril le sngar bzhin 'byung / spang ngam gci ba la sogs de dma' sa na yod na stong gzugs kyang gci sogs gang snang de'i thog tu ga le phab la bya gsung ngo / /gnyis pa lha'i mig gi mngon shes la rang sdod pa'i thad ka nas/ phyi'i khang pa'i spen bad dam/ spang bad nag khyi re ba'am/ gzhan gyi rgya dkar nag dang nge ba la sems gtad de bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis bsgoms pas/ dang po dngos po thams cad ji bzhin mi mthong yang than thun ra ri mthong / phyis ji zhig nas bsgoms pa dang / gzhan gyi khang pa'i nang gi gang dang gang gi dngos po thams cad mthong ba lta bu'i gsal snang 'char/

mthar de dag nas/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes su 'gyur ba yin gsung / de yang mngon shes ma thob bar du mthong snang tsam gyis dngos por grub pa'i nges pa med gsung ngo / /de la snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal gzung bya ba rang gi shes pa tha mal pa'i mig sngar du gzugs kyi snang ba nag po de gnyis gang rung gi steng du bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis 'od gsal bzung bas/ phra ba'i 'od la brten nas ni zhes pa/ nyams snang phra ba du ba smig sgyu'am/ srin bu me khyer sogs 'byung ngo / /de la brten nas rags pa'i 'od chen ngo sprad pas nyams rags pa de cher 'phel ba de la bsam gtan gyis yan lag gi ngo bo dang ngo sprad nas bsgoms pas/ rtog med 'od las srid 'das snang zhes pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis gzung 'dzin gnyis dbyer med cing rtog pa med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas srid pa las 'das pa'i nyams snang khyad par can 'char te/ 'di goms pas lha'i mig gi mngon shes su 'gyur ro gsungs/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes sgrub pa'i skabs su/ chu sgra rgyun mi 'chad pa'am/ rang 'thag gi sgra'am/ tshong 'dus lta bu'i mi dang dud 'gro sna tshogs pa'i skad khu dir dir ba tshig 'bru mi go ba de 'dra la bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis sgra de dang bsres nas bsgoms/ 'di bsgrub sla bar 'dug ste/ 'di byas pa dang ji zhig nas rna ba na tshur la/ che ge mo 'di skad zer zhes pa'i sgra glog cor mang po 'byung / de lta bu'i sgra de la sems mi gtad/ gtad na sgom 'chor du 'ong / la la de'i sgra la sems ma gtad byas kyang mi lo ba yong gi 'dug 'di las dang po pa la gegs che ba gcig 'dug bsam gtan la brtan pa thob nas 'di grogs su 'gro ba yin gsung ngo / /srog rtsol sgo ru 'dom gsal gzung / /zhes pa 'di sems 'dzin kyang zab po gcig yin gsung / 'di la nyams bzang po yod pa yin na rang gi sna bug gi 'dom so'i sgo ka ba de mi mthong yang der nyams lta stangs dang bcas pa de sna bug gi sgor ga le phab ste bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis bsgoms pas de la sems gtad pa min yang ji zhig nas rlung phyir 'gro tsa na stong gzugs rnams kyang rlung gis khyer ba bzhin phar 'gro/

rlung nang du 'ong tsa na stong gzugs kyang bun te tshur la 'dus 'ong / de ltar 'ong yang sngar gyi sna bug gnyis kyi 'dom pa sna sgo'i ka ba de nyid du dmigs pa gtad de bsgoms pas rlung dang stong gzugs gnyis phar 'gro tshur 'gro la sems mi gtod par shes rab kyis cher re bltas te bsgoms pas ji zhig nas rlung gang rgyu'i kha dog rnams mthong ste/ sa'i rlung ser po lte ba nas langs te rgyu ba de'i tshe sna bug g.yas pa'i mchu la bdar te de nas phyir la sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du dar skud ser po phra mo 'then pa ltar ser nar ba 'byung / de nas tshur la ldog ste sor re re phyir 'phel lo/ /de bzhin du sna'i rgyud kyi phyogs su chu rlung dkar po phyir la sor bcu gsum du rgyu/ mkhur gdong nas me rlung dmar po phyi la sor bcu bzhi/ sna bug gi steng gi cha la rlung gi rlung nag po phyi la sor bco lnga/ sna bug gi dbus nas nam mkha'i rlung sngon po phyir la sor bcu drug tu rgyu ste/ de nas nang du bsdus pa ltar bzlog ste nang du 'grib cing phyir sor re re 'phel lo/ /de bzhin du sna bug g.yon nas kyang nam mkha'i sor bcu drug rlung gi rlung bco lnga/ me rlung bcu bzhi/ chu rlung bcu gsum/ sa rlung bcu gnyis rnams go bzlog nas nang du sor re re 'phel zhing rgyu'o/ /de la nam mkha' sogs bsgoms pa ni rtog sgom du 'gro bas bzo med du bzhag pas mthong ba 'byung ngo / /de ni rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong bar 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /zhi rgyas la sogs dbang du 'du zhes pa ni/ ser pos rmongs rengs pa'i 'o/ /chu rlung dkar pos zhi rgyas/ dmar po'i dus su dbang dgug nag po'i dus su bsad skrad/ ljang khu'i dus su slar gso ba la sogs pa'i las rab 'byams tshegs med du 'grub ste/ rlung de rnams la brtan pa ma thob kyi bar la las la sbyar na de rnams rtsa ba nas 'chor du 'ong bas brtan pa thob par byas la/

nad pa la tsha nad lta bu dang / gdon zhi bar byed na rang gi chu rlung dkar po rgyu ba de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ nad pa de'i nad g.yog sdig sgrib dag pa sogs rgyas par gong bzhin du 'grub bo gsung ngo / /dhū ti'i sgo ru 'od gsal bzung ba ni/ a wa dhu ti'i yar sna smin mtshams dang / mar sna gsang gnas na zug yod par bshad de/ da lan la 'dir mthong ba yin yang / mgo bo bkug pa min pa'i lta stangs stong gzugs dang bcas pa gnyis dal bus mar phab la/ lte ba'i 'og tu spu dkar nag mtshams kyi thad kar bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis bsgoms pas/ nyams snang bzang po rang ma byung yang / lte ba'i 'og tu 'phral la drod tsha lam pa 'byung / de ka la rgyun bskyangs te bsgoms/ de'i ngang la rtog pa skyes na thol skyes rbad chod du btang ste/ snyungs bsrings kyis bsgoms pas/ ji zhig nas re kha nag po rta rnga tsam pa las rtog byas pa lta bu bar bar na skya seng seng yod pa lta bu/ dang po phyi rol tu mthong ba 'byung / de la lta stangs mi 'gyur bar sngar bzhin du bsgoms pas rang gi mdun du gyen thur du nag phreng nge sbom phra ci rigs su mthong ba 'byung / de la yang sngar bzhin lta stangs kyis gcun nas bsgoms pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang du re kha nag po skra yi tshad tsam mthong / de la yang mnyam par bzhag ste bsgoms pas/ de'i nang du 'gro drug gi snang ba dang / sku dang zhing khams ci rigs pa mthong zhing / de la'ang rgyun bskyangs pas rtsa dbu ma gsal sing nge ba mthong / de nas ro rkyang gnyis po mthong / de nas lus po'i nang gi rtsa thams cad me long dag pa las mig dag pas bltas pa bzhin gsal sing nge mthong zhing / de'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la sogs pa mthong pa dang / srid pa'i chags lugs thams cad shes shing / rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs shes pas rtsa 'di'i nang du rlung sems 'dus pa las skyon 'di 'ong /

'di'i nang du rlung sems thig le 'dus pa la yon tan 'di 'byung rnams shes par 'gyur zhing / de tsam na gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad bslab mi dgos par shes par 'gyur te/ 'di ka rkyang pa la 'bungs pas chog pa de yin par gda' gsung ngo / /de'ang rgyud las/ gang zhig kho nar yid dag ni/ /bkod pa de yi phyogs su snang / /mtshan ma'i mthar ni re kha gang / /de la sna tshogs rgyu mi rgyu/ zhes pa ni dbu ma'i mar snar sems 'dzin pa'o/ dus rtsa nag po'ang zer/ re kha nag po'ang zer te lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma mthong ba'o/ /rtsa dbu ma de'i nang du rgyu ba sems can dang mi rgyu ba re re khang khyim sogs dang / srid rtse nas lha gnas/ ngan song gsum te srid pa dang mi srid pa'i snang ba sna tshogs dang / sku dang zhing khams la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gzugs can yin pas so/ /yang dwags po rin po che bas rje btsun chen po la sgom zhus dus/ dwags po rin po che'i gsal snang la rta rnga tsam gcig gi nang nas nyi zla gnyis yar 'gro mar 'gro byed kyin gda' lags/ 'di ci lags zhus pas/ de 'dra la i ta mod de sgoms gsungs pa lta bu'o gsungs so/ /ma lus sgom par byed pa la/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan sogs de yang / /zhes pa'o/ /man ngag las/ dhu ti'i nang du 'od gsal bzung / /rtog med sems kyi de nyid shes/ /zhes pa sems kyi ngo bo gsal rig 'dzin pa med pa mthong ba'o/ /rdo rje lus kyi de nyid shes te lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad mthong ba'o/ /gsang sngags chos la mkhas par 'gyur zhes te de'i dus su gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad ma bslab par shes pa gcig 'ong ba yin gsung ngo / /nyin par mnyam rjes bsre ba'i thad du/ nyin par 'gro 'dug la sogs kyi bya bas lus thang chad pa'i skabs su/ bsam gtan la cung brtan pa ma thob pa yin na/ bya ba gzhan gyi bar skabs su mi g.yo gsum ldan du dran pas zin tsam du mnyam par bzhag pas mi rtog par phyam 'gro/

de la sems 'dzin gyi man ngag gzhan mi dgos te/ bya las 'gro 'dug sogs des lus sems gnyis kar thang chad nas/ des rtog pa gcod pa'i rgyud de byas yod pas/ de dus dran 'dzin btang ba tsam gyis sgom du phyam gyis 'gro ba yin/ chos bshad pa lta bu'am/ blta rtog 'jur po byas pa'i rjes de la yang dran pas zin tsam gyis sgom du phyam 'gro ste/ da ci nas blta rtog 'jur po byas pa des rtog pa gcod byed du song nas ka pa li'i nang thams cad nyams snang du bun shig pa 'byung / de yang bsam gtan la brtan pa thob pa gcig yin na/ kha sang ya kar bshad pa'i snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal bzung ba de byas la/ gang snang ba'i steng du bsgoms pas snang ba de dang sems gnyis ro gcig tu gyur nas nyams snang sna tshogs bun shig pa mun khang la bltos mi dgos pa 'byung / de lta bu med pa yin na'ang bsgoms tsam gyis 'jog pa min/ de 'dra byas na bsgom pa'i skabs mi 'ong bas/ skabs dang sbyar la mun khang che 'bring chung gsum bsten/ de yang mun khang med par grogs mang po dang lhan du sdod dgos pa'i rigs yin na mun khang bar pa bya ste/ phyam ce'am bem po la sogs des mgo phur nas kha rlung mi thum la mun pa 'thib par bya/ de'i long med pa'am/ gos med pa'i rigs byung na/ mun khang chung ba bsgrub ste/ mig lpags 'og nas mig hrig gis lta stangs byas te bsgoms te de gnyis ka la rgal tshigs drang po'i ngang nas gyang la bsnyes pa'am/ ka ba'am/ gyeng gi ur cor de 'dra la bsnyes se byas bsgoms pas/ grogs kyi yid la kho gnyid log 'dug snyam pa la/ rang sgom du phyam du 'gro ba yin/ na ning tsa na tshong dus kyi bla brang shar du rin po che bsod nams grags pas gtso mdzad/ jo gdan chos lung pa tshogs pas bzhugs/ de jo gdan rnams la/ slob dpon thub pa mgon gyis/ snga thog stag gru khar sbyor drug bskyangs pa'i 'phro dang /

la la mgo nas btsugs te/ de dus jo gdan gtsos khrid zhus/ der mun khang med par tshogs gral de ka na lus gnad cer re bcas nas mig mchi ma khral le bsgoms/ der yon bdag 'dra byung ba kun 'di 'dra ci mdzad par gda' na zer/ 'di pa sgom byed pa yin zer pa la/ sgom mam de a to tsam med par 'dug 'di ka 'dra rang zer nas ma dad lags so/ /de 'dra byas na gsang sgrog mtshan nyid par 'gro bas/ mis mthong ba de 'dra byar mi btub gsung ngo / /mtshan mo gnyid 'od gsal du log pa'i thad du gnyid thams cad kyang 'od gsal du log dgos/ de lta bu'i gdam ngag gis ma zin na/ mi tshe'i phyed sum gnyis gnyid dang za ma'i g.yo ta la sogs kyi bya ba la chud zos su song nas thar pa thob pa'i dus mi 'ong bas gnyid thams cad dge sbyor du log dgos/ de la srod thun dang po de 'jur du byas/ nyal kha ru bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la/ gnyid thams cad 'od gsal du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gti mug 'od gsal du gzhug tu gsol/ gnyid 'od gsal 'dre bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes mos gus dung dung pa byas la/ mgo shar ram byang du bstan/ sngas mtho bar byas te rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs la/ seng ge'i nyal stabs su byas la/ mig lpags 'og nas mig 'bras mi 'gyur bar mig bar snang la hrig ge byas pa'i ngang nas sems grim lhod ran par byas la gnyid log pas 'od gsal zin ma zin gnyid du song ba dang shes te/ 'od gsal zin pa yin na/ byad kyi mdangs sol le ba dang / rngur pa mi 'byung ba rlung 'byung 'jug bde zhing khams bde la shes pa gsal ba dwangs seng nge ba nyams dang bcas pa 'byung zhing gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal zin pa yin no/ /gnyid srab pa'i 'od gsal ni rmi lam du sgom byed kyi 'dug pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa 'byung zhing / gnyid sad pa dang shes pa dwangs la gsal ba bde ba'i nyams dang bcas pa 'byung /

ma zin na mgo bo cung zad lci zhing khams mi bde ba 'byung ngo / /ston pa gnya' nam pa zer ba zhig yod pa de khong / bla ma chos sku khong pa mnal kar 'gro ba gcig yod pa de la khong ma dad nas/ ba ri ba'i bla ma spyil dkar ba de mnal tsam mi log par dge sbyor la brtson po zhig yod par gda' zer ba la/ bla ma chos sku ba'i zhal las/ go lags/ de rjes su yi rang lags gsungs pas/ khong de skad yang yang zer ba lan gcig tu song ba dang / bla ma chos sku ba'i zhal nas/ nan tar song na ngo mtshar che rgyu yang med/ gnyid thams cad dge sbyor du log pa gcig ma byung na/ gnyid 'di khams kyi zas yin pas/ gnyid 'di spang du mi btub/ gnyid spangs na khams ldog pa min pa mi 'ong gsung lo/ yang 'gro mgon chos rgyal chu mig tu chos gsung ba gcig tsa na/ bla ma chos sku ba dang / bla ma kun spangs pa dpon slob gnyis bsgrigs nas chos gsan pa gcig yod pa'i dus na/ bla ma chos sku ba khong mnal kar gshegs pa gcig byung / lan gcig tu song ba dang / grogs mched grwa pa rnams na re/ slob dpon khong chos nyan la byon nas gnyid ka log sdod par 'dug ces yang yang zer bas/ der kun spangs pas/ bla ma chos sku ba la/ khong grogs mched rnams ma dad pa skye bar gda' bas/ phar seng mdzad nas mnal mi ldog par zhu zhes yang yang zhus pas/ de skad zhu/ mad lags zhes gsungs kyang / yang nangs par nas mnal ka mdzad pa gcig byung / yang chos la byon dus su chos nyan kun na re/ btsun rgan gnyid po che de byung ngo zer byung / der yang bla ma chos sku ba mnal du song / der chos grol ba dang / bla ma kun spangs pas/ bla ma pa la'ang zhus ma zhus rang mi gda' lags zhus pas/ bla ma chos sku ba'i zhal nas/ 'am bu gnyid log kyang chos la mi gnod pa bdog gsungs pas/ kun spangs pa'i thugs la/ de 'dra rang ci yod dam snyam nas/ 'o na de ring chos kyi mtshams gang la bdog

kha sang dang de ring gnyis la chos kyi khyad par zab chos ci 'dra byung lags zer ba la/ bla ma chos sku ba'i zhal nas/ de ring chos mtshams 'di la bzhag kha sang dang de ring gnyis chos kyi zab khyad 'di 'dra 'di 'dra byung lags/ 'am bu chos nyan pa la gnyid kyis mi gnod par bdog lags gsung / don de la dgongs nas kyang / brtag gnyis las/ gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste/ /dbang po rnams ni mi dgag go /zhes dang / grub thob la ba pas le bcu gnyis gnyid log pas grub pa thob yod par gda' gsung / de bzhin du rkyen gang byung la bsre dgos te/ phyag rgya'i sgom chen pa rnams na re/ sbyor drug de rkyen la mi phan pa gcig 'dug zer te/ de khong bden par gda'/ rkyen la bsre ba'i sdug goms bya ba ma byung pas lan pa yin/ de yang snyi sar brkos la sra bar brod bya ba yin pas/ dang por tsher ma zug pa tsam la bsres pas da gdod rkang pa gtum rtse chag pa tsam la'ang bsres pas chog pa yin/ de la dang po na zug lhang lhang pa de'i steng du sems bzung ste na ba de dang sems bsam gtan gyis bsres la sems gzhan du sris kyang ma shor ba byas la/ de'i steng du mi g.yo gsum ldan du bzhag pas ji zhig nas/ na lhang lhang ba de rang la yod pa'i snang ba mi 'byung bar gzhan zhig na yod pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong / de nas sems bzung ba des gnas cha de byas/ zug lhang lhang ba des gsal cha des byas pa gcig 'ong ste/ de la phyag rgya ba rnams ro gcig zer ba yin gsung / de ltar sdug na sdug thog tu sems dang 'dres 'dres su bsres la bsgoms/ de'ang sdug thog tu bsre ba dang de ka yin te/ skyid na'ang skyid thog tu bsre dgos pa yin te/ chos rje rgod tshang ba'i gsung gis sdug thog tu chos sleb pa len re 'ong gin 'dug ste/ skyid thog tu chos sleb pa de rang nyung ba 'dug sdug nas chos shor ba rang re re tsam las mi 'ong bar 'dug ste/

skyid nas chos shor ba de ka mang bar 'dug gsungs te/ de shin tu mad par gda'/ des na skyid na skyid thog tu bsre/ sdug na sdug thog tu ma bsres na/ de rang dga' ma la btang na/ bsgom sha bye rus bye la song nas gsha' ma mi 'ong bas lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi du kha la sogs pa ci byung sgom dang bsre dgos pa yin te/ gzugs rnams sna tshogs blta ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor rgyud du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar ram/ rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid du/ /zhes pa nas/ sgyu ma lta bur rab tu bshad/ /ces pa'i bar ltar gang byung sgom dang bsres te/ mdor na chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bskyang bar bya'o gsung ngo / /tshad ma ni sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid gsal rig 'dzin pa med par mngon sum du mthong bas dbang po'i mngon sum tshad ma'o gsungs so/ /mi bskyod rdo rje rnam shes kyi phung po dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha'i khams/ phyag rdor rna ba'i dbang po chos dbyings chos kyi skyed mched rdo rje ma/ /gtsug tor rtags dbang can dang drag can ma/ khu ba 'dzag pa/ /rnam shes la sogs gnas 'gyur drug /ces so/ /rgyal ba mi bskyod pa la sogs pa drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do zhes pa'i thad du bsam gtan mi bskyod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur pa mi bskyod pa/ nam mkha'i khams gnas gyur pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rna ba'i skye mched gnas gyur pa phyag na rdo rje/ chos kyi skye mched gnas gyur pa chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ rtags kyi dbang po gnas gyur pa khro bo gtsug tor can/ khu ba 'dzag pa gnas gyur pa drag can ma ste drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do gsungs/ de yan chad sor sdud bsam gtan gyi gsung bgros so/ /'dir sor sdud bsam gtan sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag srog rtsol 'dzin pa gsung rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yan lag

rjes dran thugs rdo rje nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje bsgrub chen gyi yan lag dang bzhi yod pa'i gsung rdo rje'i skabs su babs la sogs pa'i sa gcod 'debs/ srog rtsol gyi mtshan don gyi skabs su/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus par/ rlung nang du 'jug pa srog phyir 'gro ba rtsol zhes zer/ ma rgyud kyai rdor ba dang / lam 'bras pa 'ga' zhig sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba srog g.yas nas rgyu ba rtsol ba zhes zer ba 'dod de/ de yang rgyud kyi dgongs pa min gsung ste/ 'di bod kyi bla ma dag gi dgongs pa yin pa 'dra/ rgyud gzhan gnyis po'i yang rgya gar ba'i 'grel pa nas dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad gsung / pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med gsum dgongs pa gcig srog rtsol gyi skad dod la saṃ skri ta'i skad du a ya ma bya ba yod/ sgra'i dbyings las ya mu nye bar 'gog pa'i zhes bshad/ a ni nyer bsgyur yin te/ kun nas zhes par 'gyur bas/ kun nas nye bar 'gog pa ste/ steng gi rtsa gsum dang 'og gi rtsa bshang gci khu ba 'bab pa'i rtsa gsum ste/ dus kyi 'khor lor steng 'og gi rtsa chen drug la gnas pa'i dbugs 'byung 'jug gnyis po 'di la phyir 'jig rten pa'i grags tshod la'ang / dbugs 'byung 'jug chad pa la kho'i srog chad shi'o zer bas/ des na rang gi dbugs 'byung 'jug 'di la srog ces zer/ de rtsol bas g.yas g.yon du mi rgyu bar dbu mar 'gog par byed pa de la rtsol ba zhes zer bas/ srog de rtsol bas kun nas nye bar 'gog pa ni srog rtsol gyi mtshan don yin gsung ngo / /dus mtshams ni 'bro ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas chos rje kun spangs pa na re/ srog rtsol zhu na srog yin dgos te/ longs sku nges pa lnga ldan dgos gsung / gnas nges pa thig le'i dbus/ ngo bo nges pa longs sku/ mtshan nyid nges pa smin ma sogs mtshan dpe cha phra mo rnams kyang tshang ba/

grogs nges pa yum dang bcas pa/ dus nges pa mnyam gzhag rjes thob med pa thams cad du mthong dgos gsungs te/ de 'dra nyams bzang po khyad par can 'ga' re la srid mod kyis/ 'di 'bro pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la mdzad de/ rgyud 'grel nas nges pa lnga ldan gyi gsal cha ma bshad pas/ 'o skol rgyud 'grel bzhin nges pa gsum ldan zhig dgos te/ du ba la sogs mtshan ma mthong ba dang bsgom yang mi zer/ gnas nges pa thig le'i dbus/ ngo bo nges pa longs sku/ dus nges pa de mthong ba'i skad gcig de nyid la bum pa dang snam bu dang ras yug la sogs pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs mthong ba'o gsungs/ gzhan rtsa mi lugs pa dang / rtsa mi nas brgyud pa lan nam/ paṇa chen shākya shrī gyi slob ma sbyor drug 'phrul gyi lde mig dpyal lugs pa dag sor sdud kyi sngon du srog rtsol bsgom par bzhed de/ de ni kha ning / sor sdud bsam gtan gyi gzhung na/ bdud rtsi lnga dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa yis ni dang por bsnyen pa ste/ zhes 'byung bas/ de'i sngags bzlas pas srog rtsol du bshad pa la 'khrul pa 'dra/ de ni rtsa dang rlung las su rung bar byas pa tsam la dgongs pa yin gyis/ srog rtsol sngon la bsgom pa'i gzhung min/ sor sdud bsam gtan gyi rtsa lam sbyangs/ rlung las su rung bar ma byas par srog rtsol bsgoms na gegs chen po 'byung ste/ dper na yur ba legs po ma bcos par chu drangs na yur ba 'jig cing chu gnas su mi 'drongs pa dang 'dra ste/ chu 'dren pa'i sngon la yur ba legs po bco dgos pa bzhin du/ sor sdud bsam gtan gyi rlung cung zad brtan par byas pas rtsa chad pa dang zhal ba rnams gsos/ 'khums pa rnams bsrongs/ gcig la gcig 'byar ba rnams phrel nas de rnams kyi nang du rlung las su rung bar song bas rtsa lam sbyangs pa gcig nges par dgos par rgyud 'grel las gsungs so/

/zhes gsungs/ srog rtsol gyi mtshan nyid ni/ steng 'og gi rlung phyir rgyu ba 'chi rim/ nang du rgyu ba skye rim yin pas 'chi rim de 'gog pas lus 'grub par byed pas de sgrub pa ste/ phyir rgyu ba 'chi rim yin pa'i rgyu mtshan phyir rgyu rtsa na sa nas mgo 'dzin te/ lte ba sa/ snying kha chu/ mgrin pa me/ dpral ba rlung / spyi bo nam mkha'i bar rim pas thim nas/ de nas nam mkha' sna bug gi sgor 'od gsal la thim nas rlung rgyu bas na 'chi rim/ nang du 'jug tsa na de las zlog ste/ rim pas lte ba'i bar du thim nas 'jug pas skye rim/ de bzhin du 'og la'ang shes par bya ste/ de ltar na steng 'og gi 'chi rim 'gog pas lus 'grub/ de grub pas 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi dngos grub thams cad 'grub par bshad pa yin gsung ngo / /'dir rlung sbyor sgom pa'i khrig chags 'tshal te/ snga ma gang bsgom de'i phyed phyi mas thub pa gcig bsgom mo/ /thar lo'i rdor bzlas kyi thad du/ mkhan chen thar lo'i rlung sbyor rnams la/ rtsa ba'i rlung sbyor drug tu bzhed de/ rdo rje bzlas pa dang / brngub pa dang / dgang ba dang / gzhil ba dang / bum pa can/ rdul mtha' can drug dang po rdo rje bzlas pa la/ rgal tshigs drangs por bsrangs/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gang rung gi rting pas bshang sgo'am rdo rje'i rtsa ba drag tu mnan la/ mgrin pa sgur byas la lkog ma ske la sbyar/ des ro rkyang gi rlung rgyu ba zhar 'gro ba yin/ dpung pa phyir deng byas la sna'i rtse mo dang lte ba gnyis thad sor 'ong ba byas pas lus drang por bsrangs so/ /kha dang mig dal gyis btsum pa'i ngang nas/ sna gnyis kyi rlung 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa hūm̐/ phyir 'byung ba āḥ'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la rlung 'byung 'jug la sems gtad gsungs te/ de 'dra byas na gegs shar 'ong gi yod/ dang po khong pa rang la ma byung bar gda' ste/ 'di rlung gi 'chun che bar 'dug ste/

gegs che bar 'dug pas/ lus gnad rdo rje grags pa'i lugs de rlung bsgom pa'i lus gnad yin no/ /sngar gyi sor sdud kyi de la gnas pa'i ngang nas 'og rlung cung zad drang gsungs so/ /srog rtsol gyis mig gi lta stangs thad du/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lta stangs la/ drang don nges don gnyis las/ drang don du bdud rtsi'i gnas smin mtshams su lta ba yin/ nges don du 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la lta bar byed pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rlung 'khyil na 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi ster bar byed pas na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lta stangs zhes gsungs so/ /bzlas pa la lugs mang po gsungs kyang / dus 'khor ba'i dgongs pa rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin du shes par byed/ bsgom bya rdor bzlas ni khrid yig bzhin sgom du 'jug la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga bzhin/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po sogs kha dog mi bsgom par/ de'ang g.yon pa sku/ g.yas pa gsung / dbus ma ye shes rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed gsung / gsang 'dus dang ma hā ma ya'i bzhed pa la/ bla ma sngar gyi la las dgag pa mdzad de rgyud so so'i dgongs pa yin pas dgag tu mi btub/ 'dir rang lugs su bsgom pa yin mod gsung / rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la sems la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la bsgoms te/ de'ang 'jug pa oṃ ma rdzogs tsam la gnas pa hūm̐ de byas na bde ba gcig 'ong gsungs/ bzhi pa byed bcings nges pa ni zhes pa'i thad du/ byed pa mig sogs dbang po lnga yin la/ bcings pa ni steng 'og gnyis kyi rlung gnyis 'ching ba yin te/ sor sdud bsam gtan gyi dus su thur sel ba bcing ba gtso bor 'don cing srog rtsol gyi dus su srog dang thur sel gnyis ka bcing dgos gsung ngo / /ci zhig nas rlung rgyu ba mi gsal bar gyur pa dang zhes pa'i thad du/ rlung rgyu ba mi gsal byung na de 'dod pa yin/

mkhan chen thar lo'i zhal nas/ rlung gi rgyu ba mi gsal na sna sgor lag pa'am gos bzhag gsungs te/ lag pa la rngul 'ong gi 'dug de bas gos bzhag na rnam pa gsal ba 'dug gsung / rim lnga pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bal la byed/ de'ang bal tshi can la byas na kham la gzan pas bal gyi tshi legs par bkrus la bsal te snar bcug na dmigs pa gsal gsung / de nas yar rlung 'byung 'jug mi gsal bar song ba dang / snying khar hūm̐ la sems gtad la bzhag gsung ngo / /snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig drug ces pa'i skabs su/ chos rje bu ston gyi zhal nas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī gyis rdo rje'i tshig lnga las med pa la/ chos rje kun spangs pas 'dzin pa'i thad du/ rdo rje'i tshig gnyis bsnan nas tshig drug tu mdzad pa yin gsungs/ 'di paṇa chen gyi snyan rgyud du mdzad nas/ tshig shes pa tshig khrid/ don shes pa don khrid/ nyams myong skyes pa nyams khrid/ yon tan skyes pa 'bras bu'i khrid bzhi bzhis skyong / de la tshig shes pa tshig khrid dang po ni/ sngon 'gro dang gegs sel gyis rlung sbyor/ rdo rje bzlas pa rtsa lam sbyangs zhes pa de blo la zin pa tshig khrid don khrid ni de la 'bru gnon byed pa yin te/ sngon 'gro dang zhes pa ni/ rlung sbyor 'di yan chad kyi sngon 'gro yin pas na sngon 'gro dang / gegs sel gyis zhes pa ni/ 'dis gegs thams cad sel la/ yon tan thams cad bskyed pas na gegs sel lo/ /rlung sbyor zhes pa ni/ sngon 'gro'i rlung sbyor yang 'di yin/ gegs sel gyis rlung sbyor yang 'di yin pas rlung sbyor zhes so/ /rdo rje zhes pa ni sna'i rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum/ sngags yi ge 'bru gsum/ sems gsal rig stong pa nyid dang / rlung sngags stong pa gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i don yin pas na rdo rje'o/ /bzlas pa zhes pa ni rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzlas pas na bzlas pa'o/

/rtsa lam sbyangs zhes pa ni/ bzlas pa 'dis rtsa mdud rnams 'grol ba dang / rtsa chad pa tsho mthud pa dang / zhar ba rnams sos pa la sogs pa 'byung ste/ sngar rlung ma bsgoms pa'i gong du zhag re la rtsa gnyis gnyis kyi sbubs zhar nas rtsa skam pa la/ 'dir rdor bzlas byas pas rtsa sbubs zhar zhing skams pa rnams sos pa'i rtags su/ rmi lam du phug dog po dang / kyi khung ngam/ bug pa chung ngu de 'dra na phar mi shong bzhin du 'tshangs kyin phyin pa rmi ba 'byung ste/ dper na zhing la chu gtong ba'i sngon la ka yur rnams gad dar byed pa dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ 'dir yang lus gnad lta stangs rnams gong gi thar lo'i dang 'dra ba la/ 'dir phyag len la gnas pa hūm̐ gi dus su bzo byas nas cung zad nas ring ba gcig byed de/ 'bro pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ chos rje kun spangs pa la sogs kyang bzhed de/ de bzhin du byas na 'phral du ro stod tsha khang ste 'ong zhing / rgyud kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di min te/ 'di bzhin byas na rgyud nas zhag gcig la rlung gi bzlas pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gro bar bshad pa la/ gnas pa de yun ring du btang na bzlas pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya zhag gcig la mi 'gro bar/ rgyud dang 'gal bas/ bla ma thar lo'i lugs kyi bzo med du 'jog pa rang zab gsungs/ ma ning gi bzlas pa la/ rlung nang du 'jug pa na oṃ aḥhūm̐ ho ham̐k+ṣamalawaraya zhes/ oṃ gyi rang bzhin du thim gnas pa dang / phyir 'byung ba na yang hūm̐ dang aḥ'i rang bzhin du thim par byas te rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa bzla bar bshad/ chu srin sa dang / bum pa chu'i khams nas brtsams te 'pho mtshams ye shes kyi rlung dang bcas pa bzla gsung ngo / /ma ning gi bzlas pa 'di lung thob tsam las nyams khrid du bsgom pa mi gda' gsung / 'gog pa las slong ba zhal las shes zhes pa'i thad du/ rdor bzlas la mnyam par bzhag pas rlung 'gags te/

'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'byams par 'gyur bas/ de dus 'gog pa las slong ba la u tshugs kyi sgra chen pos ming nas bod pa dang / lus la 'jus te mur mur phrug phrug la sogs mi bya/ dal bu'i sgo nas bla ma'am mched grogs dam tshig gtsang bas spos dri zhim po'i rigs/ chos g.yang ngam/ sih+la 'am/ spos reng zhim po la sogs pa'i dud pas thag nye mo ma yin pa'i sa nas bdug cing / ting shag snyan po'am/ dril bu snyan po la sogs pa'i sgra thag nye mo rang min pa'i sa nas dkrol lo/ /des 'gog pa las ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /de dus mar la sogs pa'i byug pa dal bus bya/ 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhag phyed dam/ gcig gnyis la cang mi sto/ zhag gsum bzhi la sogs pa song ba ma tshor na zas 'ju sla ba tshod dang sbyar la btang zhing rlung zon bya gsung ngo / /'dir chos rje kun spangs pa nas brgyud pa'i rlung sbyor lnga'am bzhi/ mkhan chen thar lo'i rlung sbyor drug man lungs gu ru'i gsum/ rtsa mi'i bzhi yod pa las/ 'dir chos rje kun spangs pa nas brgyud pa'i paṇa chen snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig lnga las/ rlung sbyor bzhi yod pa'i dang po ston par byed/ de la paṇa chen lugs kyi rdo rje'i tshig gnyis pa ni/ nyams kyi khrid dang / yon tan bskyed pa 'bras bu'i khrid dang gnyis gong 'dra ba la/ tshig khrid la 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas/ srog dbu ma'i thig ler gzud ces pa'o/ /don khrid la gong dang sbrel nas 'bru bsnon te/ rdor bzlas kyi rtsa lam sbyangs pas 'byongs pa na/ 'dir 'byongs nas zhes pa'o/ /'jam rlung zhes pa la/ gzhan la pho rlung mo rlung ma ning rlung zhes pa'ang yod de/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi 'jam rlung rtsub rlung / drag rlung gsum yod pa'i nang nas 'jam shos yin pas na 'jam rlung ngo / /dgang gtong gi sbyor bas zhes pa ni sna bug gcig nas rlung rngubs te dgang ba de gcig nas gtong bas na dgang gtong gi sbyor bas so/

/srog dbu ma'i thig ler gzud ces pa la/ srog ces pa 'byung 'jug gi rlung la'o/ /dbu ma'i thig ler gzud pa ni/ rlung de dbu ma'i thig ler 'dzud pa la zer te/ de yang tshud tsam min pa'i dpral ba'i thig le la reg pa'i bar du'o/ /de rnams don khrid yin gsung ngo / /'di bsgom pa'i phyag len la dang po rlung gang nas rgyu brtags la/ da lan g.yon pa nas rgyu ba'i dbang du byas te/ rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang / g.yas pa bskum/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ g.yon phyogs su bltas la rlung ro bus/ de nas mgrin pa kyog por ma song ba'i khog nas ske dal bus g.yas ngos su rtse chung g.yas pa non tsam du gcus la g.yas phyogs su sna bug gi ldebs la bltas pas nyams snang rnams bun gyis 'byung / de dang bsres la bsgom/ de bzhin du sna bug g.yon du'ang blta/ sna bug g.yas mdzub mos bkab ste/ 'og sgo 'then tsam byas te/ sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung 'jam la ring ba dal bus rngubs la/ khengs pa dang lte 'og mnan tsam byas te rlung bzung la sna bug g.yon pa mdzub mos bkab ste/ ske dal bus g.yon du rtse non tsam gcus la g.yon du blta/ rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang / g.yon bskum/ mig sna g.yas pa'i sbo logs la gtad de bsgom/ de nas mi bde ba med tsam du bzung ba de sna bug g.yas pa nas 'jam la ring ba dal bus btang la phyir bus/ yang de ka'i ngang nas g.yas nas dal bus 'gengs/ khengs pa dang bzung la sna bug g.yas mdzub mos bkab ste/ ske dal bus rtse g.yas non tsam du gcus la g.yas su blta/ rkang pa g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums/ sna bug g.yon pa'i sbo logs la dmigs pa gtad de sgom byed/ yang mi bde ba med tsam du sna bug g.yon pa nas dal bus bus/ yang de ka'i ngang nas rngubs lugs gtong lugs lus gnad bsgyur ba sogs byed de/ sna bug g.yon pa gcig lta bu'i rtsis bzung la rngubs thengs bzhi/

'bud thengs gsum ste bdun la rlung sbyor gcig tu byas te/ de song ba dang rlung mnyam rgyur 'ong bas sgom byed/ de bzhin g.yas nas rgyu na de las go bzlog ste g.yas pa'i rtsis bzung pa'i rngub thengs bzhi/ 'bud thengs gsum ste bdun la rlung sbyor gcig tu byed pa sogs sngar dang 'dra zhing / thun mgor rdor bzlas ci mang du btang zhing nyams len khams tshod dang sbyar gsung ngo / /mkhan chen thar lo'i rlung sbyor drug ni/ rngubs pa'i thad du 'jam rlung dgang gtong la lugs mang yang / da res kyi 'di rgya gar nub phyogs yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal ma la ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug go pi pa zhes pa la mkhan chen thar los rngubs dgang gzhil ba'i rlung sbyor gsum po 'di gsan par 'dug 'di'i rlung sbyor 'di gegs med la rno ba zab pa gcig 'dug gsung / 'di la'ang lus gnad sngar dang 'dra ba'i ngang nas rdor bzlas rlung shugs bskyed pa bdun brgyad re byas/ de'i rjes la rlung sor ma chud bar la ngal gso la mi bsgom/ ngal sos pa dang / de nas sna leb byas la rlung nang du sna sgor rdul bzhag kyang mi ldog tsam du shed bskyed la 'jam por drangs la rngubs pa rdzogs pa dang lte bar mnan pa gcig byas la/ de ma thag phyir gtong / gtong tshe'ang rdul mi ldog pa tsam du bsris la gtang / de ltar rdo rje bzlas pa'i sum cha thub pa tsam bsgoms/ 'di 'chun che la 'dus che ba gcig 'dug gsung ngo / /dgang ba'i skabs su/ lus gnad lta stangs rlung 'dren gtong rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ khyad par rlung nang du rngubs pa dang mnyam por gsus pa phyir ca ca nas 'bor ro 'ong bar byas la/ mer khengs pa dang steng 'og mnan pa gcig byas la sngar bzhin btang / des ro stod tsha khang byung na phyir gtong dus rlung ro lhag ma nang du lus pa'i skyon yin pas/ dal bus rlung zhabs med par sangs btang / sangs btang bas mgo na khang byung na/

rlung gtong dus su dus gcig la hags pa'i skyon yin pas dal bus phyir bsris la btang / mgo na ba dang / snying tsha lam pa gnyis kar rdor bzlas gang rung ste rlung shugs bskyed byas pas sel gsung / yang rtsa nang rlung gis khengs nas na ba lta bu la/ lus la bu ga mang po bsam la/ de na phar rlung rnams hur ru ru song bar bsgomasapas phan zhing / der ma zad rlung gegs kyi rigs thams cad la phan gsung ngo / /thar lo'i gzhil ba'i thad du/ lus gnad lta stangs dang rngubs pa'i gnad rnams rngubs dgang dang khyad par med/ khyad par rlung gtong ba'i dus su gsus pa rgal tshigs la bsrangs nas dal bus ca ra ra car btang / rlung zad pa dang byung tshad kyis gsus pa rgal ba la thad ka nas car te sbyar gyis/ rgyu zhabs kong mi bya/ gal te rgyu zhabs kong na kho'i nus pas 'og rlung zhor la drangs pa'i thigs bsags nas stod 'tshangs 'ong bas rgyu zhabs kong mi bya ba gal che/ mkhan chen thar los rlung sbyor drug po 'di rnams gzhan la'ang thob mod kyis/ khyad par rngubs dgang gzhil ba'i rlung sbyor gsum po 'di grub thob go pi pa la thob pa yin gsung / don de la dgongs nas kyang rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ rngubs dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang / /'phang ba dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rlung sbyor bzhi ldan ma shes na/ /las rnams kun la 'bras bu med/ /ces 'byung bas nan tar rno la zab pa gcig 'dug gsung ngo / /yang rtsa mi'i rlung sbyor bzhi la/ rdor bzlas/ rngubs pa/ dgang pa/ bum pa can no/ /de'i phyag bzhes kyi lus gnad la sogs pa mkhan chen thar lo pa'i dang 'dra/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rngubs pa thar lo dang mi 'dra/ 'bud pa kha nas sī sgras 'bud de gnyis ka la lus khrol chags lta bur bsgoms/ bum pa can la gtum mo'i me'i dmigs pa byed de/ de ltar gtum mo'i me a thung shad kyi rnam pa la dang po sor gcig de nas sor gnyis/ de nas sor gsum/

de nas sor bzhi'i bar du bsgoms/ dbyung ba dang gzhil ba ni/ ming gi khyad par ram rnam grangs su gda' gsung ngo / /de ltar bum can bzhi po thams cad la gtong dus su/ dus gcig la ma hags par ga le btang ba la ma mkhas na/ kha mig rnams tsha zhing rna ba 'on pa la sogs gegs 'ong bas/ de thams cad kyi tshad ni sdom 'byung gi lugs bzhin rab 'bring tha gsum du shes par bya zhing / 'on kyang las dang po pas tha ma yang mi nus pas/ ci tsam nus nus su byas la/ mtha' dga' tshad du longs pa dang / rlung 'dzin pa dang tshad byed pa mi 'khob pas/ rlung ma bzung bar thal mo skor ba dang / se gol brdab pa'i grangs grib tshod dang / spos me la tshad byas la/ de nas rlung sbyor byas te tshad shes par bya'o gsung ngo / /man lungs gu ru'i bum can thad du/ dgug dgang gnyis ka la lus gnad rkang pa rdor skyil lam sems skyil gang bde byas/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol ba'am pus steng dgab pa gang rung byas la/ g.yas nas dgug pa dang g.yon nas dgang ba gnyis ka la 'gram pas 'phar rtsa non ma non tsam du ske gcu bya/ kha btsum lce rkan la sbyar la/ rlung dal bus 'jam drag tu rngubs la bya/ lta stangs ni sgra ba'i skad dod la gzugs la blta zhes te/ don la mig gi 'bras bu gnyis la zer te/ rlung g.yas nas rgyu ba dgug pa'i dus su sna g.yas kyi ldebs la lta stangs bya zhing / rlung g.yon nas rgyu na dgang ba la g.yon gyi ldebs la lta zhing sems mi rtog pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /dgug pa/ dgang pa gnyis 'byongs nas/ rengs pa la slob pa ni bum pa can gyi nang gnyis ka la nang gis go sla/ phyi bum can la rlung phyir sangs kyis btang la thub tshad nang du 'ong mi gzhug rengs pa la lta stangs dbu mar rengs pa'i lta stangs nyid bya ba yin pas sna'i rtse smin ma'i dbus su blta zhing sems mi rtog pa la'o/ /rlung mi thub na sud tsam drang / yang thub tshad bsdam/

ma thub na sud tsam drang / yang thub tshad bsdam/ ma thub na sangs rtse drang ngo / /de la rangs pa'i rlung sbyor byed pa na gnyis/ log non te rlung nang du 'dzin dus su/ gnyid log kyang ran tsam gnon/ phyir rlung sud tsam btang ba na gnyid log kyang lhod tsam lhod tsam gtong ba yin/ rangs pa'i lus gnad la lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur la stegs 'bol mtho ba gcig yod na lus drang la bde ba gcig 'ong gsung / gnyid log gnon pa rengs pa la mdzad kyi/ dgug dgang gnyis la mi mdzad do/ /bum pa can phyi nang gnyis po dgug pa/ dgang ba/ rengs pa gsum ka la gang bde bya gsung ngo / /man lungs pa'i gsung gi ro rkyang gnyis po sor bsam gnyis kyi rtsa lam 'byongs shing / dbu ma kha legs par phyed pas/ rlung mnyam rgyur mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par song ba dang / de nas rlung 'dzin pa de rlung rtsa nang du gnas pa la yon tan 'byung gi mgar gyi sbud pa 'bud 'gengs bzhin rdzogs par rngubs te rdzogs par gtong ba la yon tan mi skye gsungs/ 'on kyang smad kyi grang pa'i nad rlig pa skrangs pa dang tshang ra drod med pa sogs la ro rkyang bum pa can gyis phan gsung ngo / /khong pa rang thub tshad du bsdoms pa 'di la rtsis can du mdzad de/ stod du bud skyon ma byung na de ltar bogs che bar gda'/ khong pa de la ngar ngar shan shan mang po mdzad pa yin pas de ltar mdzod cig gsung ngo / /mkhan chen thar lo nas brgyud pa'i rlung sbyor drug yod pa'i rngubs dgang gzhil gsum rnams song nas/ gal che shos bum can 'di yin/ 'di la bod rnams 'dod lugs 'ga' re yod de/ rgya gar ba'i 'di tsho dang cung mi 'dra/ de la dang por rlung bsgom 'phro man na/ 'di la lus gnad ni khong pa rang gi lugs kyi lus gnad kha ning rdor bzlas su bstan pa de yin te/ de cung gegs che bas/ 'dir rdor skyil lam skyil krung chung ba gang bde bya/ rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rgal tshigs bsrangs/

g.yon du ske gcu byas la/ mtshul pa'ang de ngos su gcu byed pa dang mnyam por rlung bus pas rlung mi 'bud pa ngos kyis sna leb bkab pa bzhin song nas/ rlung 'bud pa ngos su 'gril ba gcig 'byung / de'i ngang nas g.yon du gsum/ g.yas su gsum bsnol mar myur po myur por bus la/ dbus su gcig ste bha ti'i sbyor ba rlung ro bsal/ res 'ga' lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol mar 'jus la/ g.yas nas g.yon du ske gcu ba dang rlung ro 'bud pa mnyam por bya/ de bzhin g.yon nas kyang g.yas su rlung ro sel ba bha ti'i sbyor bas bsal lo/ /de nas mar rta nas mgo mjug med par mnyed/ de nas lag pa'i sor mo rnams kyang re re bzhin g.yas g.yon 'then res byas la rang sar lag pa gnyis sprug des rtsa zhar ba dang 'khums pa rnams 'brongs nas rtsa mnyen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de ka'i 'phro la bzung na rlung rngam pa 'thug thug por song yod pas/ cung zhig ngal bso la/ rlung sor chud pa dang / dang po 'og sgo yar 'then pa dang / mnyam por 'phongs phar khrud tshur khrud byed pa mnyam por byas nas drangs la lte bar bzhag des rlung gnas su chud pa'i dgos pa yod/ de bas mtho bar mi drang / de nas steng rlung rngub lugs bum pa can thams cad la rlung yas len mas len yo gdams gsum gang bde bas rlung rngubs te/ yas len byed na ol ko skyer byas nas rngubs/ gnyis ka rngubs zin pa dang / mgrin pas ol mdud non tsam byed/ yo gdams la rlung rngubs pa dang mtshul pa bskor ba mnyam po byas la rngub zin pa dang mgrin par thad kar byas la lto bar 'og rlung dang gnyis kha sbyar ba de gsang gnas thug mar kha mnan/ de nas dang por lto ba 'bor re ba'i ngang nas 'dzin te nang tshe 'phel ka bskyed pa'i don yin/ de ltar kha sbyar du bzung la/ de nas myos byed kyi bdud rtsi sgra med du blud pa ni/ sgra med de dka' mo gcig yod pas/
