lkog ma skyer tsam byas la mchil ma dal bus mid la/ rlung lte 'og jir mnan la mi bde ba med tsam du bzung / de nas rlung 'bud pa na rlung zhabs 'dzin mi 'dzin gyi lugs gnyis yod pa la/ chos rje kun spangs pa'i gsung gis rlung zhabs mi 'dzin/ lte ba 'bor byas la rlung drag po rang min par lhag ma med par sangs btang gsungs te/ de la don la lhag ma gcig 'ong ba yin pas 'di la yon tan bskyed dgos pas gsus pa was brus pa bzhin btang na yon tan mi 'byung gi steng du stod 'tshang du 'ong bas rgyu zhabs kong mi bya gsung / 'di bla ma mi la ras pa nas mar brgyud pa'i de dang / mkhan chen thar lo'i bla ma paṇa chen kha cig lto ba tshigs pa la sbyor ba de mdzad de/ de drod skye ba myur bar 'dug ste gegs che ba gcig 'dug pas/ bum pa can la yon tan skye dgos pas/ a tsa la na tha mi g.yo mgon po'i lugs de zab pa gcig 'dug gsung ngo / /yang 'bro ba'i phyag len la/ gzhan thams cad 'di dang 'dra ba la khyad par rngubs nas mi thub pa dang / yang brtsegs la rngub mi thub cing gtong ba na rlung sud tsam gcig phyir btang nas yang lte 'og nan byas te 'dzin/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra/ paṇa chen gyi snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig lnga las/ gsum pa tshig khrid dang / nyams khrid yon tan skyes pa rnams gong dang 'dra/ don 'khrid la chud nas rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu ma'i thig ler bcing / zhes pa la/ chud nas zhes pa gong dang sbrel te/ gong gi 'jam rlung gang gtong gi srog dang thur sel gong bu gcig tu gyur pa de nyid dpral bar dbu ma'i thig ler ma chud na/ ro rkyang gnyis mgar gyi 'bud pa bzhin dgang gtong gis bum can bsgoms kyang gnad du mi 'gro zhing / 'jam rlung gis lte ba nas zhugs bum pa chus mer khengs pa dang 'dra bar lus kyi nang thams cad rlung gis mer gang ste dbu ma'i yas sna dpral ba'i 'khor lo'i thig ler srog thur gyi gong bu de dang /

der tshud pas na chud nas zhes pa'o/ /rtsub rlung zhes pa ni/ 'di pa la 'jam rlung rtsub rlung drag rlung gsum yod pa'i 'jam rlung bas kyang cung rtsub/ drag rlung bas kyang cung 'jam pas na rtsub rlung zhes pa'o/ /bum can gyi sbyor bas zhes pa ni/ rlung srog thur gnyis kyi sbyor bas ro rkyang gnyis dbu mar tshud tsam min te/ chud pa kha sang yang 'jam rlung dgang gtong gis dbu ma'i mas sna nas yar chud de/ tshud tsam gyis mi chog dpral ba'i 'khor lo gong bu de der bcing dgos pas bum pa can gyi sbyor ba zhes so/ /srog ni g.yas g.yon gyi rlung / dbu ma'i thig ler bcing zhes pa ni/ dbu ma'i thig ler te/ dpral ba'i 'khor lor bcings te/ sngar 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas/ dbu ma'i thig ler tshud pa de nyid brtan par bcing / zhes pa'i don yin gsung / bum can 'di'ang gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ rlung ro bsal dus su sngar ltar myur la thung ba de mi byed par/ rlung 'bud dus su ske gcu byas/ 'gram pas 'phar rtsa non tsam byas rlung shugs bsing bsing ba ring po g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du re re 'bud/ rlung ro thon pa'i tshad ni glo byung na byed pa yin gsung / yang re 'ga' lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol mar 'jus la/ gzhogs g.yas phyogs nas rlung 'bud pa mnyam por ske'ang dal bus g.yon gyi 'phar rtsa zhar zhar du gcu zhing rlung 'bud/ de bzhin g.yon nas yang de ltar du rlung 'bud zhing g.yas su gcu ba yang mdzad de/ rlung sbyor 'phro la med na dgu phrugs su 'bud do/ /'di paṇa chen lugs so/ /de rjes gong bzhin du rlung sor ma chud bar la gegs sel rdor bzlas byed cing ngal bso/ de nas khong pa'i 'di la lus zlum po'i 'dug stangs byed dgos/ de la rkang pa'i 'khra mtshams su long gnyis bsnol/ zlum po'i 'dug stangs byas la rgal tshigs bsrangs/

lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol la/ yo ga ma'i rngub lugs kyis rngubs la rgyu zhabs thug jir gyis non pa dang / bshang lam 'bor 'ong bar bya/ de nas bshang sgo tshums kyis thur sel lte bar 'dren pa gong dang 'dra/ lte ba las yar mi drang yang mar la rgyu zhabs thug 'bor gyis mnan/ de nas jir gyis mnan la bzung / de nas cung zad nas rlung gi kha yun sud pa gcig phri ste/ de nas bdud rtsi sgra med blud la/ de lte bar jir gyis mnan la bzung / 'di rtsa mi dang 'bro pa rnams kyi lugs yin/ chos rje kun spangs pa'ang 'di bzhed de/ chos rje kun spangs pa'i zhal nas/ rje'u chus gang ba de'i kha'i chu de la gra mag la sogs rdul yod pa de 'bod pa dang 'dra bar/ khad kar rlung gi snyigs ma gcig 'byung bas/ de sna nas sud pa gcig btang / de'i 'phro la rbad kyis bcad la phyir yang mi gtong nang du yang mi rngubs par mi bde ba med tsam du bzung de ltar bsgoms pas lus la kor le ru zug tsha tsig pa'am/ skrangs nas rtsa zug ces pa yin pas/ der bu ga'i sbyor ba dang ma da na'i sbyor bas bsal lo/ /'dir chos rje kun spangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon spyang ston gyi gtam rgyud kyang gsungs so/ /sgra rings kyi thad du/ 'di mkhan chen thar lo bas bal por byon pa'i dus su/ nyin gcig 'phags pa shing kun gyi nags gseb na phar la skyo bsang la byon pas/ sgra gling bu'i sgra ltar snyan pa zhig gsan nas 'di lta bu'i sgra snyan pa zhig ji yin dgongs nas/ sgra de rtsad gcod cing nags gseb na phar byon pas shing sdong zhig gi drung na/ rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can bkrag dang mdangs su ldan pa zhig gi lag na gling bu thogs te 'dug pa'i drung na/ spra dang spre'u mang po 'dus nas spre'u de rnams kyi rna bar gling bu de btsugs te 'bud kyin 'dug de'i drung du phyin pa dang / spre'u de rnams bros song /

der 'dug nas chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas/ thar lo dgyes te rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas/ sgra rings kyi gdams pa 'di gnang ba yin gsung / de'i mtshan ni mi g.yo mgon po/ a tsa la nā tha zer bar gda'/ 'di la lus gnad gong dang 'dra ba la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnal ba'am/ brla steng 'jog pa'am/ mnyam gzhag gang bde ba la rgal tshigs bsrangs la sgra rings gtong tshe mgrin pa sgug byas la sgra ngar ra ra ba de skad che na rlung shugs chung ba zhig 'ong gi gda' gsung / mkhan chen thar lo pa'i gsung gis 'di la mig dang mchu btsums la so gnyis ma reg tsam bya gsung ste/ mig btsums na mig la gnod kyi gda' bas/ mig zim me byas pas mig la mi gnod/ 'di la yon tan mang po yod de/ khyad par thig le 'ching ba la bsngags pas rmi lam du thig le 'dzag na nyal khar brgya brgya tsam byas pas/ thabs gzhan gyis mi phan pa'ang 'di byas pas sbrengs kyis khegs kyis gda'/ gzhan yang 'di byas pas rtsa mdud rnams grol ba dang / rtsa zhar ba rnams sos pa dang / rlung gis ro stod gang ba la'ang phan/ rlung zug dang rlung gegs kyi rigs la'ang 'di byas pas phan/ tshad pa'i rigs la'ang phan/ gzhan yang bsngags pa chen po yod gsungs/ 'di'ang rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe lte 'og mnan pa gcig byas la gtong gsung ngo / /paṇa chen gyi btsan thabs kyi thad du/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig lnga las/ bzhi pa ni tshig khrid/ nyams khrid/ yon tan skyes pa 'bras bu'i khrid rnams gong dang 'dra/ don khrid ni ma chud cing ma 'ching na/ drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i rgyu ba dgag ces te/ gong dang 'brel la ma chud cing zhes pa ni gong gi 'jam rlung dgang gtong gis dbu mar rlung ma chud cing ma 'ching na zhes pa ni rtsub rlung bum pa can gyis der ma 'ching na zhes pa'o/ /drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas zhes pa ni/ drag rlung ni ro rkyang gi rlung ste de nyid btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas zhes pa glo bur du 'gegs pa'o/

/nyi zla'i lam dgag ces pa ni/ sna bug g.yas kyi rlung nyi ma/ g.yon gyi rlung rgyu ba zla ba/ de gnyis 'gegs pa ni nyi zla'i lam dgag ces pa'o/ /de ltar longs spyod kyi rlabs la 'phar ba'i rtsa gnyis tshan gsum yod de/ thig le rgyu ba'i phal rtsa gnyis/ khrag rgyu ba'i gnyis/ rlung rgyu ba'i 'phar rtsa gnyis te gsum yod de/ de la thig le rgyu ba'i 'phar rtsa gnyis ni phra bas mi rnyed/ rnyed na bde stong gi nyams khyad par can skye ste mi rnyed/ khrag rgyu ba'i 'phar rtsa gnyis ni gtar ka byed pa de yin te/ de btsir yang skyon min pa yon tan mi 'byung / rlung rgyu ba'i 'phar rtsa gnyis ni ol mdud pa'i sbo g.yas g.yon na rtsa phra mo krim krim 'phar ba re re yod/ de gnyis yin/ de gnyis gnon pa la mthe bong dang srin lag gi sen mo brag la zil med par bya/ rang 'dug pa'i mthong phyir gnad yar 'ong ba'i rtsa po mi bzhag mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon snyes 'bol bcug la/ lus gnad rdor skyil la sogs dam po ye mi bya/ tsog pur 'dug ste rgal tshigs drang por bsrang / mgrin pa sgug byas te rlung dum pa gcig rngub la/ gzhan gyis brtsir mkhan med na rang gi mdzub mo rnams kyis ltag khung nas 'khyud/ mthe bong gnyis kyis ol mdud pa'i g.yas g.yon nas 'phar rtsa btsal la rnyed pa dang thad kar mnan pas non pa sla gsung / ran tsam mnan te rtsa bzang ba kun la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ rtsa ngan pa rnams la zi bun pa'am/ sbrid chil ba las mi 'ong / 'di mang na 'phos pa'i khrims yod pas thengs re tsam bya/ sba ba can dang ske sbom pa la rtsa mi rnyed pa 'dug gsung ngo / /paṇa chen gyi snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig lnga las/ lnga pa tshig shes tshig khrid dang / nyams myong khrid dang / yon tan skyes pa 'bras bu'i khrid gsum gong dang 'dra/ don khrid la bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng srog btang ba'i sbyor bas dgrol zhes te/

bkag pas zhes pa ni steng du nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na zhes pa ni/ dri chen dang dri chu 'bab pa'i rtsa 'gags zhes pa'o/ /de la steng du g.yon pa zla ba'i rtsa de dang / 'og tu dri chen dbus nas 'bab pa'i rtsa gnyis gcig ste/ steng du sna bug g.yon 'gags na 'og tu dri chen 'gag go /g.yas nyi ma'i rtse de dang / 'og tu dri chu g.yon nas 'bab pa'i rtsa gnyis gcig ste/ steng du sna bug g.yas 'gegs na 'og tu dri chu 'gag steng du dbu ma sgra gcan mnyam rgyu'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa dang / 'og tu g.yas thig le 'bab pa'i rtsa gnyis gcig ste/ 'og tu khu ba 'bab pa 'gags pas na/ steng 'og gnyis 'ching grol dus mnyam gcig tu bstan te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ steng du rtsa gsum po 'di rnams grol na 'og gi rtsa gsum po 'di rnams grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas na/ steng srog btang ba'i sbyor bas dgrol zhes pa'o/ /de la bsgoms ka bsgoms pa'i stobs kyi rim gyis nyi zla'i lam 'gags na yon tan skye ba gcig phugs su 'o cag de ka 'dod do/ /'dir gong gi btsan thabs byas pas gcig car du nyi zla'i lam 'gags pas rtswa chu bsdams na pho log lta bur song zug chen po byas/ de ka la las na 'chi bas/ de lta bu ma yin pa'ang bshang 'gags kyi nad dam po 'byung bas/ de bsal ba ni dri chen 'gags na rdo rje bzlas pa sna bug g.yon nas bya/ rlung nang du rngubs dus su rgyu zhabs su rlung jir mnan la gtong dus su bshang sgo tshums byas pas steng dang thur sel gnyis dkrugs te 'dre ba'i gnad yin/ de nas rlung shugs dang bcas pa'i gtong ba mang du byas pas sel lo/ /de bzhin du dri chu 'gags na sna bug g.yas nas bya/ des ma sel na ha thung ha ring bya ste/ ha thung la lag pa gnyis bsnol mar dpung par 'jus la rkang pa rdor skyil sems skyil gang bde bya/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs la/

ha 'don pa dang sked pa skyog skyog byed pa mnyam por byas la ha thung 'don/ ha ring byed na skyil krung 'dal bskyed la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab la/ dang por lus bsrangs nas de nas ha skad med shugs dang bcas pa 'don gyin dpral ba sa la lhan song song du ha 'don/ yang de ka nas ltag pa dgyed song song ha 'don/ ha ring ha thung gnyis ka la mig bgrad/ lce nar brkyangs la ha 'don pa'i tshad ni zi phyad pa dang / kha 'tshul sbrid chil ba byung byung 'don/ thun shol tsa na gnyis ka la rlung ro med par ha byas la sangs kyis gdon no gsung ngo / /de ltar yid la rdo rje rab tu bsad pas yul dang bcas pa mkha' la spyod pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes pa'i thad du/ 'di gal che ste/ bla ma rang byung pa rol pa'i rdo rjes/ rngog pa'i gdan sa ba bla ma rngog pa gzi brjid grags pa la/ khyed kyi bla ma rngog chos kyi rdo rje de mkha' spyod du gshegs gda' ang byas pas/ bla ma rngog pa na re/ de skad zer gyi gda' gsung / rang byung bas/ mkha' spyod de ji 'dra gcig la byed kyi gda' zer ba la/ de cha med ngas 'gro ma myong zer te/ sngags pa'i bla btsongs bya ba yin mod gsung ngo / /mkha' spyod chen po yon tan brgyad ldan mchog gi dngos grub thob pa sa dang po nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sa dang po thob par mang po nas bshad/ mkha' spyod yon tan brgyad ldan thob par bshad gsung / mkha' spyod chung ba la tshe 'di nyid kyi mkha' spyod dang / lus brjes pa'i mkha' spyod gnyis/ de dag la'ang 'dod pa'i lha dang lus dang longs spyod mtshungs pa 'dod pa'i mkha' spyod dang / gzugs khams dang lus dang longs spyod mtshungs pa gzugs kyi mkha' spyod gnyis gnyis yod cing / ral gri dang skye bdun gyi sha sogs rdzas la brten pa'i mkha' spyod shas che gsung ngo / /yang gsung bgros gcig la/

spyir mkha' spyod la che 'bring chung gsum yod pa la/ mkha' spyod chen po ni dus 'khor nas/ lus ni dwangs shing zhes sogs dang / gsang 'dus nas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku zhes sogs dang / rgyud gzhan nas kyang yon tan brgyad ldan la sogs par bshad pa ni mkha' spyod chen po yin/ 'bring po la tshe 'di'i mkha' spyod dang / skye ba 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod gnyis las/ de re re la'ang 'dod pa'i mkha' spyod dang gzugs kyi mkha' spyod gnyis/ gzugs kyi mkha' spyod la/ bya spyod nas bshad pa'i sngags la sogs pa bgrangs pa'i nus pas gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa dbang du 'dus nas de dag gis khur te gzugs khams su phyin pa dang / gzugs khams kyi lha dang / tshe dang longs spyod gzugs byad la sogs pa khyad med du 'gyur ba la sogs yin gsung / 'dod pa'i mkha' spyod ni/ 'dod khams kyi lha de dag gis khur sogs dang cha 'dra ba la/ da lta lam 'bras pa tshos jo mo nags rgyal la 'chad mo nam mkha' yod zer ba dang / ri che ge sogs la rig 'dzin che ge mo yod zer ba 'di lta bu yin/ skye ba 'phos pa'i mkha' spyod ni tshe 'phos ma thag de 'drar skye ba la zer ba yin/ tha ma rdzas kyi mkha' spyod ni/ rgyal po rkang khra'i chung ma rnams kyis re mos kyis kho la bsnyen bkur byed pa la/ dus re zhig na/ chung ma ngan shos kyis sha gzhan ma rnyed par/ dur khrod nas bu chung gi sha gcig la gtubs te btsos nas khyer phyin pa dang / de'i rlangs pa byad la phog pas/ mo rkang pa sa la mi reg par 'gro ba de khos mthong nas/ 'di ci yin snyam nas/ mo bzung ste bsdigs pas bred de/ mchog sbyin nas bshad pas/ lhag ma kun yang khyer shog zer/ thams cad zos pas kho nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / mi mang po bsad nas za ba gcig byung gda' 'o/ /mkha' spyod nam mkha' la 'phur ba tsam gyis brtan pa zin pa'i lugs su mi gda' gsung ngo / /hūm̐ yig brjod pa'i zhes pa'i thad du/

lus mnyam gzhag lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ lus bsgrims/ srin lag drag tu bsdam/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du bgrad la/ pha las thob pa'i yi ge ham̐ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa la shes pa drag tu gtad la/ rgyu zhabs kong byas la/ hūm̐ zhes sgra drag la ring ba brjod pas thig le gyen du drang gsung ngo / /srog rtsol nges pa'i thad du/ rin chen chos dar zhes pa gnas mngon pa ba gcig yin pa'i/ nga'i slob ma'ang yin/ dus phyis khro phu'i gnyan mkhar gsang rdzong du/ bla ma bkris dpal la sbyor drug zhus/ srog rtsol gyi skabs na mar sleb dus/ kho rang yang don zhags kyi tshes brgyad bsrung gi yod pas/ der tshes brgyad kyi dus la bab nas tshes brgyad srung gi yod 'phro la/ khos srog rtsol gyis bum pa can byas pas tsog pu de ka la shi der grogs mched rnams kyis kho'i ro de ri la khyer te gtubs nas bya rgod la byin pas/ bya rgod rnams kyis sha gang khyer sar 'ja' tshon nar du byung skad/ de sgom chen dge bshes bgres po rnams na re/ btsun chung gcig gis da mi rgan rnams dma' 'bebs par yod zer lo gsung ngo / /yang chos rje kun spangs pa'i drung du khrid tshar gcig gi dus na khong gsum gyis gros byas nas srog rtsol skabs su babs pa dang / khong gsum na re/ srog rtsol 'chi med gan med du bsgoms na 'chi zer/ shi na mkha' spyod du 'gro zer zhing / mkha' spyod 'gro na de bas lhag pa med pas/ rang re gsum shi ba gcig byed pa yin no zer nas/ gsum kar gyis shi med gan med du bsgoms pas/ gcig gi spyi bo shag ste gas nas shi gcig shi min ma shi min zhag gsum bzhi gcig lus nas shi gcig la man ngag gi gegs sel rnams byas pas sos so/ /khong gsum gyi de lta bu byas na/ 'pho ba'i skabs nas/ dus la babs na 'pho bya zhing / /dus min lha ni gsod par byed ces bshad pas/

rang gi lha bsad pa'i ltung ba 'ong nges su gda' gsungs/ spyir srog rtsol byas nas mgo bo na zhing spyi bo tsha ba la sogs pa byung na/ na dang tsha bzhin par mi bsgom/ mi sgom byas nas cam gyis 'jog pa'ang min gyis/ de lta bu'i gegs rnams bsal nas bsgom pa yin no/ /sor sdud kyi gegs 'di rnams kyi dus su rjes dran gyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dran par byed dgos te/ gnad zur du shes par bya'o/ /sor sdud kyi thad du/ g.yas g.yon gyi phreng bsdoms pa'ang gnad yin te lag len zur du blta bar bya'o/ /spyir sgom chen pa la gegs chen po gnyis 'byung ste/ srog rtsol gyi rlung bsdams grags pa'i skyon dang / sor sdud bsam gtan gyi dus su ma bsdams pa'i rgyu las thur sel stod du hags pa dang / srog rlung rmad du blugs pa gnyis byung ste/ de la bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis srog thur la dbang thob pa la/ steng rlung 'og tu 'drongs/ 'og rlung steng du 'drongs te/ srog thur la dbang ma thob cing / tha mal pa'i gnas skabs su thur sel lte ba thug rgyu/ de las mi 'da' bar ltos che thur du rgyu'o/ /gyen rgyu de lte ba thug rgyu/ de las mi 'da' bar ltos che gyen du rgyu ba yin pa la/ thur ser la lte ba la 'das te steng du hags pa smad kyi drod btul/ stod du drod me ltar 'bar/ mgo bo na yar rlangs phyur ba dang / snying nas yar shing ljang pa lta bu 'byung / srog rlung thams cad spyi bor 'dus nas spyi bo 'gas pa bzhin na la/ dbugs nang du bsdu mi shes pa 'byung / khog pa na yar rlung rnams phug skor ba bzhin gyen du 'khor zhing 'gro la/ de dus nyams snang la dang po skar khung khrol mig tsam pa 'byung / de nas yar la lta snying 'dod pa 'byung / de nas skar khung gsal por bye ba'i snang ba 'byung / der thig le'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi sku'am/ sku med pa'i snang ba 'byung ba sogs khrid yig na gsal zhing /

mi rtsa na med pa la dbugs song 'dug na legs par brtags la bya/ mig 'bras gyen la zlog gin sbar ba bsdams 'dug na da rung 'tsho srid pas thabs bya/ la la mig btsums pa'i 'og nas mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa 'byung bas legs par brtags la/ de bzhin 'dug na 'tsho srid pas phyar khud du bzhi 'dag byas la/ dbugs cung zad ma byung bar du sa la gdab cing / mgo bo mdun du bkug la rgal tshigs dang po nas rgal tshigs zad po'i bar khu tshur gyis brdung / rjes la rang gi sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor thig le sngon po spur sgong tsam la shes pa drag tu gzhug cing / so ma zin gyi bar la 'bebs kyi rigs dang / mar khu lo len gyis byug pa bya zhing / spa'u bsros pas rkang mthil bdug gegs ma sel bar bum can mi bsgom/ rdor bzlas rlung shugs dang bcas ji nus bya/ lus la rdo khang lta bu'i bu ga'am/ tshags mig lta bu'i bu ga 'am/ /tshags mig lta bu'i bu ga nas/ nad rnams rlangs pa'am dud pa lta bur 'thon pa'i tshul du dmigs pa bya/ des phan no/ /srog rlung ltos cher steng du rgyu/ thur du rgyu na'ang lte ba thug rgyu/ de las mi 'da' ba yin/ gal te lte ba las 'das na srog smad du blug ste bshang gci gcig bsdoms shing zug chen po 'byung ba'am/ yang na bshang lam bsdu mi shes par dus gcig la smad du blugs pas smad du drod me ltar 'bar ba 'byung la/ de zhag gcig lon nas 'chi bas/ de bsal ba ni/ grogs dam tshig gtsang ma gnyis tsam gyis byed du bcug la/ grogs gcig gis nad pa'i rkang pa nas bzung la mgo bo sa la ma reg par byas la rgyab tu khur/ gcig gis 'phangs kyi tshigs pa zad po nas mgo bo'i tshigs pa zad po thug rim pas brdung / de nas mkhal khung gnyis su 'bol to bcug la snam bu tsha ring ba dkris pa'i steng du ras sam ther ma'i shag mas ran tsam bsdams te/ spyi rti glog la/

rkang mthil dang / de nas rim par gong dang 'dra bar tshigs pa zad po thug rim gyis brdungs pas sel te/ lag len las shes par bya'o/ /yang bum pa can bsgoms pas lus la skor tshe na tsha byung na dal bus mnyes na phan/ rdo khang ngam/ bu ga'i sbyor ba gong bzhin bsgom/ skor le ru 'brum pa dmar tsi tshim pa byung na dri chu la bong nga dmar po bdar ba byugs la skams pa dang dri chus bkrus na phan no/ /yang ro stod tsha phram phram pa'am/ mgo na zhing snying kha na phar cung zad 'tshangs pa 'dra ba la/ rdo rje gtun brdungs te rta lcags 'phyongs dang 'phar chen rnams kyis phan/ thur la bang ting tig tu 'gro ba 'di yang phan po gcig yod/ gzhan yang snying ga tsha lam byung ba'am/ rtsib chung na yar cung zad tsha hreng hreng pa byung na/ lus stod kyi cha la las mi 'chol bar 'og rlung rang sar drag tu bsdams/ rkang sor rnams drag tu bskums/ brla dang byin pa'i nya khrims bsgrims pa'i ngang nas rkang pa brkyang bskum mang du byas/ gegs ma sel bar dge sbyor mthil ma rdor bzlas la bya gsungs so/ /don yod grub pa la sogs drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do zhes pa'i thad du/ srog rtsol don yod grub pa'i yan lag bsgom pa'i 'bras bu ni/ 'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub pa/ rlung gi khams sgrol ma/ sna'i skye mched nam mkha'i snying po/ 'du byed kyi phung po <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/don grub sgrol ma rlung khams nam mkha'i snying / sna yi skye mched/ reg bya'i skye mched <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!> /reg rdor ma dang bgegs mthar byed/ kha'i dbang po/ bshang ba 'dzag pa <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/rab brtson ma ste drug tshan ni/ /'du shes phung por gnas gyur ro/ /zhes so/ reg bya'i skye mched reg bya rdo rje ma/

kha'i dbang po bgegs mthar byed/ bshang ba 'dzag pa rab brtson ma ste drug tshan gcig sgrib bral du dag gsungs/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan don gyi thad du/ nyi zla lam 'gog byed srog rtsol dang / 'byung 'jug 'gog byed 'dzin pa gnyis kyi srog rtsol yan chad thal/ da 'dzin pa byed pa la/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan don ni/ 'bro pa'i bzhed pas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le/ las rgya dang sbyar yang mi 'dzag par 'dzin nus pa de la 'dzin pa'i mtshan don du bzhed de/ de rgyud kyi dgongs pa min/ 'khor lo drug gi lte bar 'dzin nus pa gcig yin gsung ngo / /'dzin pa'i dus mtshams kyi rtags gsum thad du/ srog thur dang 'dres na'ang phyi'i rtags/ nang rtags/ gsang rtags gsum 'byung / phyi rtags la thur sel gyi rlung la dri mi 'byung / steng srog gi rlung dang bsgrags pa dri chen gyi dri ma 'ching pa 'byung / nang rtags su gtum mo'i me 'bar nas lus la drod chen po skye/ sgom bzang ba kun la khog par me 'bar ba lta bu'i nyams snang mthong ba 'byung / gsang rtags la lte bar srog thur kha sbyar te bum can du gzung nas gsang gnas su jir gyis mnan nas srog thur gnyis gang rung gcig bzung nas gcig btang bas sangs tse song nas srog thur ma 'dres pa yin/ ma song bar ril ba zhabs chags can bzhin du mer re 'dug na srog thur 'dres pa'i rtags yin pas/ snying ga la sogs 'khor lo drug po rnams su rim pas bum can 'dzin te/ 'dzin pa'i thad du/ snying kha chu'i 'khor lo byed pa ni phyi snod rtsa gtsor ston pa yin gsung / de'ang srog thur gnyis 'dres shing lte ba'i bum can la dbang thob nas bum can sgom pa yin gyi/ srog thur ma 'dres par snying ga sogs kyi bum can sgom na spus kyi gegs nyos pa rang yin/ de bas lte ba'i bum pa can bsgom gsung ngo / /de la brten nas snying kha'i bum can ni 'og rlung snying gar drangs te kha sbyar gsung /

re bka' lte bar kha sbyar la/ de nas snying kha sogs su khyer la bsgom gsung ngo / /a wa dhu ti'i zhabs brten pas/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bsgom par bya zhes pa'i spog chog gis lus gnad gong dang 'dra ba la/ lag pa mnyam gzhag rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol ba gang bde byas la/ gser gling 'byed 'dzum mang du byas pas/ rdo rje las su rung ma khad pa'am lte ba tsha lam ma byung gi bar du bya/ de nas rlung nang du rngub tsa na sgra dum pa yod kyang rung bas rlung bum can bzung nas/ gsus pa sgal tshigs la bcar gyis thad kar sbyar la/ lte ba sa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar/ rgya gar ba'i yi ge a shad lta bu de'i steng du thig le a dmar ser la dmigs pa gtad res dga' dung la pha tshos bkus pa lta bu dkar la dmar zhes kyang gsung ngo / /ma lus li khri ltar bsgrims lte ba'i am̐ gi na da'i ye shes sor gnyis me'i rang bzhin du dang po rgya khab lta bu phra ba la/ de la je cher dmar lam 'bar te gro sog 'bring po tsam bsgoms pa'i ngang nas rlung phyir gtong tshe 'dzin pa'i rlung rnams sgra med dal bus gtang gsung / gang gis srog rtsol thams cad du bstan pa'i spog chog btsan thabs de nyid bla ma gong ma rnams kyi srog rtsol spog chog tu bstan to/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi spog chog tu rigs gsung / phyag len la srog rtsol gyi thad du mdzad/ de ltar 'dzin pa rim pas bsgoms pas/ gtum mo'i me 'bar bas bza' btung ci zos pa thams cad gtum mo'i mes sregs pa'i rtags su bza' btung sngar bas mi mnyam pa lhag pa zos kyang snyigs ma'ang mi 'byung ba dang / dri chen dri chu byung yang sngar bas nyung zhing skam po mi thongs pa 'dra ba 'byung gsung / 'dzin pa'i thad du chos rje kun spangs pas mdzad pa'i snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig drug pa ni/ gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar byed drag rlung srog thur 'dre ba'i sbyor bas bdud dang nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i 'chi med sgrub/

lce chung gis bdud rtsi btung ba'i skabs su/ lam 'bras pa'i dge bshes rta rgan zhes bya bas byang se mo de la sgom du byon pas/ lo gsum mtsho rul nas rgyags len sa ma byung / der lce chung gi bdud rtsi ka gsol bas lus dkar la dwangs pa rgyas pa byung / lo gsum na dar chags pa la/ khong gi nye 'khor rnams kyis bltar phyin pas/ khong bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan pa mdzad 'dug der khong rnams dad nas/ 'tsho ba chad nas yun de tsam thal/ nyid cag gis ci gsol zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa'i gdam ngag la brten pas a to byung gsungs so/ /chos rje bu ston pa nyid kyis zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa 'phags pa 'od kyis kyang / lho ru thog re bzhugs dus su 'tsho ba chad pa'i dus su gdams pa 'di ka mdzad pas/ bkres pa sel la bogs che ba byung gsung ngo / /'di la thog ma nas mang na lce chung babs nas nar 'ong bas thog mar ran tsam btung / de nas je mang la mthar mang po 'thungs pas chog thog ma'i dus su ko rdul chings ba 'byung / de nas je mngar la mthar bdud rtsi lta bu 'byung gsung ngo / /'di la dmigs bcas dmigs med gnyis las/ dmigs bcas la dbyangs yig bcu drug gi yi ge rnams rtse mo la thig le zil pa'i rnam pa'am ba thag gi rnam pa ltar bsgoms/ de la bdud rtsi babs par sgoms gsung / rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan la sogs pa drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed ces pa'i tha dad du/ 'dzin pa rin 'byung gi yan lag bsgom pa'i 'bras bu ni/ tshor ba'i khams rin 'byung / me'i khams gos dkar mo/ mig gi skye mched sa'i snying po/ ro'i skye mched ro rdo rje ma/ lag pa'i dbang po shes rab mthar byed/ tshor phung <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>rin chen 'byung ldan me khams gos dkar mo/ /mig gi skye mched <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/sa snying ro'i skye mched <!TCC

Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>ro yi rdo rje ma/ lag pa'i dbang po <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/shin tu stobs dang rmug byed ma/ 'gro ba'o/ /tshor phung la sogs gnas gyur drug /ces so/ /reg bya'i skye mched rmugs byed ma/ 'gro ba rmug par byed ma ste drug tshan gcig sgrib bral dag gsung ngo / /rjes dran gyi mtshan don gyi thad du/ sor sdud kyi steng gzugs de bsam gtan gyis brtan par byas pa de la rjes su dran pas na rjes dran zhes bya gsung / 'bro pa'i bzhed pas/ ltogs na zas dran/ skom na btung pa dran zer te/ de rgyud kyi dgongs pa min/ de ni dbang po brtul po la dgongs kyi/ de min na dbang po rnon po dang 'bring po la dbye sgo mi dgos par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod gsung / chu skyes las ni byung par mi bya ste zhes dang / 'dzin 'dren gyi nus pa thob pa la dgongs pa yin gsung / dbang po rnon po phyag chen la brten pa'i tha dad du/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ rang yang lha dang rig ma yang lha mo'i rang bzhin 'od lus su snang ba 'byung la/ de la lta zhing bsgom pa ni rang don gyi lta stangs yin la/ nges don du snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba de la dmigs pa gtad pa ste bde stong du ldang ba'i sems kyi ngo bo de la cher re blta ba'o/ /de ltar bltas pas bde mkhan stong par shes pa'i ngang nas dbang po rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi nyams 'char ba'i bzang ba sku dang zhing khams sam/ 'bring rtags bcu'am/ tha ma dmigs med dam/ nyams snang ngan na nyams snang gang snang de dang bsres nas bsgoms pas bde stong gi nyams 'char zhing / de'i steng du 'jog pas sngar 'dzin pa la sems gtad pa tsam gyis dga' ba mchog dga' rnams kyi nyams rim gyis 'char zhing / lte ba la sogs par bde chem gyis 'byung / de las 'gyur ba'i skabs byung na bum can gyis bcings kyi/

yin rung min rung bum can gyis mi bcing gsung ngo / /rjes dran dbang po 'bring po rnal 'byor gtum mo la/ lam 'bras pa dag rnam tog sngon song gi drod ces pa rtog bsgom gsal snang cung zad bsgoms pas lam gyis 'byung ste/ khams pa bkra shis seng ge gtso mdo ru kho rang gi brang khang na sgom gyin yod pa'i tshe na/ srang khar grogs mched rnams gri 'don res byas 'khrug pa byas pa'i tshe/ khong gis mar phyin nas bar byas/ phrel ba dang nang du phyin nas bsgoms pas/ sngar 'khrug pa byas pa'i rnam rtog de lam gyis shar bas de ka la sgom khang gi nang thams cad gri 'khrug byed pa'i mi rnams kyis khengs pa'i snang ba byung / de lta bu 'byung ba yin/ 'dir yang rang gi lus kyi 'khor lo drug po gsal gdab/ 'khor lo drug gi bzhi ni stong pa'i rtsa zhes ni/ de rnams su nam mkha'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par mi 'jug par bzhi cha tsam gyi rlung rgyus par stong pa'i rtsar ming btags so gsung / 'khor lo drug gi dpral ba dang / mgrin pa gnyis me chu thabs shes rab tu byas pa ni dpral ba'i rtsa rlung gi rang bzhin yin kyang / de'i nang gi dbyangs yig rnams thig le gtsor bstan pas chu'i dkyil 'khor yin gsung / lte ba na yar la rtsa dbu ma dang ro rkyang gsum po gsal gdab/ dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams/ mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa'i lte ba'i 'khor lo'i steng 'og tu zug yod do/ /rtsa dbu ma la 'dod lugs mang ste/ la la rgyungs pa la bshad/ la las rgyungs pa'i nang na yar la yod par bshad/ la las srog pa rtsa la bshad pa la sogs pa'i 'dod lugs mang du 'byung yang / rgyud sde rnams dang mi mthun gsung / rtsa dbu ma'i gnas lugs ni/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ srog pa rtsa'i nang na yar yod par bshad/ srog pa rtsa'i ming la tshangs pa'i dbyug pa dang / srog gi dbyug pa zer te ming gi rnam grangs so/

/de'i nang na yar la yod cing mdud pa drug yod par bshad de/ spyi bor chos 'byung lta bu'i mdud pa/ de nas mar sor bcu gnyis gcal ba'i mgrin par gzhon nu ma'i nu ma lta bu/ snying khar ba'i mig lta bu/ lte bar pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa bar rdo rje rgya gram lta bu/ nor bu'i rtse mor til gyi me tog lta bu'i rtsa mdud yod par bshad cing / ro rkyang gnyis kyang srog pa rtsa'i nang na yod/ mdud pa drug gi thad du srog pa rtsa phug ste/ rtsa 'dab gyes nas yod par bshad/ de'i dpe tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po la bshad de/ tsan+dan gyi khog na sbrul yod pa 'dra bar bshad pa yin/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i rten rtsa shes dgos pas/ 'di gal che ste/ de'i don ye shes thig ler/ 'khor lo drug gi lte ba'i dbus/ /phra mo'i lus ldan rtsa ni drug /thig le dang bcas de rnams sbyor/ /srog gi dbyug pa'i nang du 'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba yi/ /zla mo tshe dang ldan pa ste/ /de ni srog dbyug rtsa ba yin/ /zur gsum gyi ni rnam pa'i tshul/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i lte ba yi/ /lce la bde ba ldan pa ni/ /de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i ske /rigs kyi me tog dang 'dra ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /nam mkha'i ma ni ye shes ldan/ /de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i snying / /ba yi mig gi rnam pa'i gzugs/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i nang / /'od ma dang ni dus ldan ma/ /de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i lte/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i rnam pa bzhin/ /me yi 'khor lo'i snying kha yi/ /'dod pa dang ldan rab 'od ma/ /de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i 'doms/ /rdo rje'i rnam pa bzhin du gsal/ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /stobs ni brtson 'grus ma dang ldan/ /srog gi dbyug pa de yi mtha'/ /til gyi me tog rgyas pa bzhin/ /de ni sbyor drug gi rnam shes/ /rtsa dang thig le dang ldan no/

/rtog med mas ni 'khyud yin phyir/ /de tshe tshangs pa'i dbyug pa yin/ /de yi dus ni bdag gis bshad/ /shar dang nub la rnam gnyis so/ /gang tshe tshangs pa'i dbyug pa la/ /mdud pa sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ /de la lte ba'i 'og tu 'pho ba bcu drug steng du 'pho ba bcu drug byang chub kyi sems dang rlung gnyis phrad pa'i phyir 'pho ba ste/ steng 'og gcig pu'i dngos po sbyor ba'i rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /byang chub kyi sems dga' ba dang ldan pa'i gdub bu'i rnam pa sku dang gsung dang / thugs kyi ngo bo gcig pu'i rtog med bde legs yid mas tshangs pa'i dbyug pa 'khyud nas/ bde ba chen po'i gtsug tor nas gsang ba bde ba chen po'i nor bu'i kha rlung gi 'khor lo man chad ji ltar tsan+dan gor shi sha'i shing la sbrul chen po yod pa lta bu'o zhes te/ de'i don srog gi dbyug pa ni srog pa rtsa ste/ ka ba'i gzugs kyi 'khor lo rnams kyi dbus na gnas pa de'i nang du rtsa gsum mo/ /de'i spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba ni zla mo tshes dang ldan pa ste/ rtsa dang thig le dang srog rlung la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes de ni srog gi dbyug pa ste/ srog pa rtsa ba yin pas chos thams cad kyi rtsa'o/ /der zur gsum pa'i rnam pa ste dbyibs su tshangs pa'i bug tu gnas pa la rnam pa'i tshul zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi ro longs spyod pa'am/ mtshan so gnyis la sogs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar rtsa lce ma bde ba thig le dang / bcas pa'i gyen rgyu la sogs pa'i rlung dang ldan pa ni srog gi dbyug pa'i ske ste/ rtsa'i mdud pa'i dbyibs rigs kyi me tog ste/ gzhon nu ma'i nu ma'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'o/ /de'i steng nas tshangs phug gi bar rang gi sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad ni/ srog rtsa mdud pa med par seng nge 'dug pa'o/ /sems las chos 'byung ba'i phyir snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba/

sems nam mkha' dang mnyam pas na rtsa nam mkha' ma/ bde ba ye shes dang rlung ldan pa ni srog gi dbyug pa'i snying ste/ ba'i mig gi rnam pa'i gzugs su gnas so/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'byung bas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar gtum mo'i me 'od byung nas rtsa 'od ma dus ldan ma ste/ rlung kro dha dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i lte ba yin la/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i rnam pa bzhin gnas so/ /me'i 'khor lo ni gsang gnas 'dab ma gsum pa me'i gnas sngar bas ches khyad par 'phags pa'i me 'od 'bar bas rab 'od ma rlung 'od dang bcas pa'i bde ba dang ldan pas 'dod pa dang ldan pa ste/ de srog gi dbyug pa'i 'doms yin la/ dbyibs rdo rje'i rnam pa bzhin du gsal lo/ /'dab ma drug pa'i gnas rlung gi 'khor lo'i lte ba la rtsa stobs ma ste brtson 'grus ma gsal ba'i rlung dang bcas pas na brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ de ni srog gi dbyug pa'i tha ma yin la/ dbyibs til gyi me tog rgyas pa bzhin no/ /rtsa rtog med ma gnyis su med par rol pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ye shes dang ldan par 'khyud pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir tshangs pa'i dbyug pa zhes bya/ gzhan gyi tshe srog gi dbyug pa zhes bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i dbyug pa la mdud pa bcu drug phrag gnyis ni steng dang 'og tu dbugs 'pho ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi gnas su rtog med ma gcig bu/ dngos po 'dzin ma dang srog pa rtsa sbyor ba rlung dang byang chub kyi sems ro gcig pa byang chub kyi sems dga' ba ldan pa ni ri bong can gyi rnam pa/ byang sems gdu bu'i rnam pa ni rdo rje rin po che nor bu dang bcas pa'i gnas kyi gdu bu sku srog ma/ gsung ro ma/ thugs 'dzin ma/ ngo bo nyid gcig pu ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa med pas rtog med ma/ de'i ming gi rnam grangs/ pu shu man de tshangs pa'i dbyug pa la 'khyud nas/

yas mtha' bde ba chen po'i gtsug tor nas/ mas mtha' gsang ba'i bde ba chen po'i nor bu'i kha/ rlung gi 'khor lo yan chad du gnas te/ tsan+dan gor shi sha'i nang na sbrul yod pa bzhin du/ tshangs pa'i dbyug pa'i g.yas na ro ma/ g.yon na 'dzin ma/ dbus na rtog med ma gnas la/ 'dzin ma ni 'gyur gyi khyad de/ lā la na zhes pa ni/ la las rkyang ma/ la las 'dzin ma/ la las mdzes ma zhes bsgyur bas so/ /rtog med ma ni/ a wa dhu ti'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ 'grel par/ srog gi dbyug pa ni sku'o/ /lā la na ni gsung ngo / /rā sa na ni thugs te/ gcig pu rtog med ma ni sku gsung thugs gsum dang bral ba a wa dhu ti'i rang bzhin dga' ba zhes bya'o zhes so/ /kha cig srog gi dbyug pa sgal tshigs yin zhes pa dang / kha cig srog pa rtsa nyid a wa dhu ti yin zhes pa mi 'thad de/ srog gi dbyug pa tshangs bug thug yod/ sgal tshigs med pa'i phyir dang / ye shes thig le las/ srog gi dbyug pa gang zhig ste/ /sor bcu gnyis ni mdud pa med/ /'og gi cha ni bcu gnyis phyed/ /de bzhin sprul pa'i pad+ma nyid/ /bug phyed pad+ma mig dang 'dra/ /rtsa ba dang bcas lte nang du/ /rtsa ba rtsa yi nang 'ongs nas/ /'dab ma'i ske ru car te gnas/ /dgug pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bor grags/ /bu ga phra mo nang na ldan/ /de ni srog pa rtsa nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /'dab ma'i ske ru bcar te gnas/ /zhes pa/ 'dzin ma dang ro ma dang / rtog med ma dang bcas pa ste gsum gyi 'dab ma la gnas pa'i rtsa'i rtse mo dum gcig bkug ste gnas zhes 'grel pa las bshad la/ srog pa rtsa dhū tir 'dod pa la/ 'grel pa dga' ba'i spyan las/ 'dzin ma ro ma rtog med ma/ sa'i myu gu'i rnam pa lta bu srog gi rtsa dang lhan cig skra rtse stong cha tsam gyi kha gsal bar byed do zhes pas so/ /'o na ye shes thig ler/ tshangs pa'i rus pa'i dbyug pa'i snying po zhes pas sgal tshigs su bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/

tshangs pa'i rus pa'i dbyug pa dang / tshangs pa'i dbyug pa mi gcig ste/ 'grel par/ tshangs pa'i rus pa ni tshigs pa'i nang tshan no/ /dbyug pa'i snying po ni srog gi dbyug pa dang rtsa gsum par ldan pa'o/ /zhes sgal tshigs pa'i nang rol na srog pa rtsa/ de'i nang na rtsa gsum yod par bshad pas so/ /phyag chen thig ler/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan/ /zhes pa ni mdud pa'i gnas bcu drug la g.yas dang / g.yon gyi rtsa'i mdud pa'i cha nas so gnyis yin la/ de gnyis kyi bar du dga' ba re re skye ste/ de nyid las/ mdud pa'i nang du g.yas dang g.yon/ /ro ma dang ni rkyang ma gnas/ /mdud pa gnyis dbus gcig gcig ste/ /sum cu gnyis kyi bcu drug dran/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gnas pa'i dbu ma'i mas sna'i thad du ma las thob pa'i dmar cha a shad dam/ ho yig gtum mo'i me ser po la/ me rgya khab 'bring po tsam gsal zhing phra la rno zhing reg bya tsha ba gcig bsam la rig pa rtse gcig tu gtad pas/ des nyams skyes skyes bsgom/ de nas me cher 'bar te bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rang shugs kyis dbu ma'i nang na yar zhugs te/ spyi bor pha las thob pa'i yi ge haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa gcig bsam la/ rgyud sde gzhan nas ham̐ yig mgo med kyang bshad do/ /de nyid zhu ba'i dga' bde stong par lhag pa de la sems gtad pas 'dzin pa'i rlung sbyor dang 'dra bar rlung 'jam pos bzung la/ gtum mo'i me la dmigs pa gtad la bsgom/ me de nyid ji cher 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad la rlung mi thub pa dang glod la sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pas spyi bo'i ham̐ yig zhu bas ye shes kyi dgug gzhug 'byung ste/ thig ler rang gnas nas rdo rje shugs kyis dgug rmug byed kyi dpral pa nas rim pas 'khor lo rnams su bzhugs pa'o/ /rengs byed kyi thig le dga' ba bcu drug tu 'dzag med du bcing ba'o/

/khengs byed kyi thig le 'khor lo rnams su bde stong du mnyes par byed pa'o/ /shin tu stobs kyi rtsa thams cad du thig le rnams bsres shing thig le bde ba la zhen 'dzin med par mnyam pa'o/ /rjes dran du/ thur sel rlung ni gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes pa la/ bde 'phel rgyun 'grogs rab 'jug dang / /zhes pa'i bde 'phel rlung ni shes rab kyi dmar cha dang / rang gi dkar cha gnyis tshur drangs te gnyis med du bsres nas bzung dus bde ba lhag par skye byed kyi rlung de yin no/ /'di la dbang thob na lus la rak+ta 'ang khrem mo/ /rgyun 'grogs ni thig le dang lhan gcig tu 'grogs 'gro ba'i rlung gcig yod de/ de yin gsungs/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ dper na me 'bar ba la mar thig pa lta bu'i nyams 'byung zhing / de ltar 'og nas yar la'ang me 'bar bar bsgoms pas lus la bde stong gi nyams khyad par can skye ste/ sngar sor sdud bsam gtan bzhin mnyam par bzhag la bde mkhan stong par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo drug gi lte ba rnams su dmigs pa gtad la lte ba'i bum can bsgoms pas/ dper na gso ba la sbud pas bkang nas mnan pa bzhin no/ /dbang po 'bring po gnyis la ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa ni sngar dang 'dra bar bsam pa tsam gyi gsal snang du lam gyis 'char bas/ rang dus 'khor du gsal la/ rang gi yum yang sna tshogs yum gsal bar dmigs pa tsam gyis lam gyi dmigs pa gsal bar 'char la/ yab yum gnyis kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ thugs kha/ lte ba/ spyi bo/ gsang ba rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho swā hā rnams te yi ge drug dgod/ rdo rje pad+ma byin gyis brlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas dbu ma na yar zhugs pa la/ spyi bo'i ham̐ yig dkar mer gyis zhu zhing rim gyis babs pas/ dpral bar dga' ba/ mgrin par mchog dga'/ snying gar khyad dga'/ gsang gnas su lhan gcig skyes dga'i bde ba rnams rim gyis babs pa la sems gtad pa ni rjes dran gyi dngos gzhi yin la/

de las mi 'dzag par rang zin ni ting nge 'dzin rjes mthun pa yin/ de las 'dzag pa'i gnas skabs su gyur na/ 'khrul 'khor dang rlung bum pa can gyis bcings la/ hūm̐ gi steng du drangs la/ yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi la sems gtad do/ /de'ang rang 'grel la ma song na de rjes 'grel la brtson par byas pas rjes dran dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rnal 'byor gtum mo dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya gnyis ni dbang po 'brang po'i rjes dran no/ /de ltar byang chub sems kyi thig le bdud rtsi'i gtso bo yin pas mi 'dzag par btung zhing zhes pa'i thad du/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi bdud rtsi bsten dgos/ de la phyi'i bdud rtsi ni/ dngul chu/ mu zi/ ar bar skyur gsum/ lhang nga lhang rtser/ bh+ring gi ra dza ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga/ nang gi bdud tsi lnga ni/ khu ba/ dri chen/ dri chu/ khrag klad pa ste lnga lnga la ril bu byas la brten/ gzhan gyi bdud rtsi lnga ni/ byang chub sems kyi thig le bdud rtsi'i gtso bo yin pas mi 'dzag par bsrung dgos te/ de 'chor ba'i gnas shin tu mang / dri chen/ dri chu dang rngul/ snabs/ mchil ma/ mchi ma/ sna khrag so khrag gdon gyis rmi lam du 'dzag pa/ gang 'dzag drag shul gyi 'dren la 'dzag rnal lpags dang bsdongs nas 'dzag dri chen dri chu dang bsdongs nas 'jag pa la gnyis te/ snyigs ma dang / dwangs ma'o/ /snyigs ma ni skabs skabs su chu bong bu'i 'dra ba 'byung / de ni thig le rul ba rnams dang nad rnams chu dang 'dres nas 'byung ba yin/ de nad du 'gyur bas dor/ dwangs ma 'chor ba'i rtags la/ chu 'dor ba'am/ rtsa chu gnyis 'dor ba'i rjes la 'dar shig pa/ skyur bcug pa gcig 'byung / de dwangs ma shor ba'i rtags so/ /de mi 'dzag pa bsrung ba ni/ rtsa chu mi dor tsam gong du steng rlung gang bde la bzhag pa'am/ kha sbyar gang rung la 'og rlung lte ba thug drangs de las mi drang /

yang lte ba nas rgyu zhabs thug mnan/ de ltar lan gsum bzhi tsam byas la/ gtong dus su'ang lte ba thug drangs la/ de nas lce'i rgyab rkan la sbyar/ mig gnyis mi 'gyur bar nam mkha' la hrig ge lta/ rkang lag gi sor mo rnams bskum byas la rtsol bas mi btsir bar rang 'gros la btang / des thub/ rngul sib tu 'chor ba la lus drod du 'bar zhing lus rngul du bcab ste 'gro des ma chod na nyams snang thams cad 'chor/ lus zi ldab ldab por 'gro zhing stobs kyang 'chor/ de la chu rlung bzung la ba spu'i bu ga thams cad thig le dkar po zla ba lta bu skya khyil bas gang bar bsam zhing lus bsil bar bsgoms/ des ma zhi na/ bla ma'i dri chu'am/ rang gi dri chu la gla rtsi dang tsan+dan btab la lus bkru/ de nas mar gyi byug pas khyab par byugs la/ de phyi zhib po'i dril phyis byas pas phan/ so khrag dang bsdongs nas 'dzag na khrag nag por 'dug na nad yin pas dor/ mtshal khar 'dug na mchu btsum so bsdam pa'i ngang la cib kyis 'jib pa dang mnyam por bum can bzung la ltag par 'then te mid la btang / yang 'gros gcig la mas yar khyer yong bar spyi bo rang du bum can bzung la mig nam mkhar bltas pas thub gsung / sna khrag dang bsdongs te 'dzag pa la/ khrag smug nag tu 'dzag na dor/ mtshal khar 'dug na lus kyi zungs 'chor/ gegs shin tu che bas 'o dod 'bod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bya ba g.yabs yugs byed/ de yang sna g.yon nas 'chor na lag pa g.yon/ g.yas nas 'dzag na go zlog ste gnyis ka la bum can bya/ rmi lam du gdon gyis 'dzag pa la/ ma dang sring mo la spyad pa rmi ba dang / rta bong sogs dud 'gro'i rigs la spyad pa rmi ba dang / de la zhon nas rgyug gi rmi ba la 'chor ba dang / bya zhon gyis rmi ba las 'chor ba 'byung / de rnams bsrung ba la rang gi lus 'di lcags kyi rdo rje mgar gyi sol mes dngar ba bas kyang me tsha ba dmar ba zhig tu bsgoms/

des thub/ rmi lam du ma tshor ba'i 'chor ba'i gang 'dzag dang gdon 'dzag gnyis las/ rang gi rdo rje de'i rtse mo nas nang logs su gsus pa'i nang na yar la song / spyi bo 'bor gyi mtho gang tsam du 'thon pa la dmigs pa gtad pas sbrengs kyis thub bo/ /snabs dang 'brel nas 'dzag pa la/ snabs sngo sang la tshwa mi bro ba 'byung / de bsrung ba ni/ snabs lud mi 'chor ba'i gong du/ snabs lud nang du rngubs la bum can bzung ba dwangs snyigs 'byed 'gro de rjes snabs lud dor gsung ngo / /dbang po rtul po rang rigs kyi phyag rgya mo gcig la snyoms par zhugs pa ni/ dbang po rtul po'i rjes dran no/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i spog chog las rgya'o/ /bu ston chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ ngas bla ma zla ba rtogs ldan zla ba seng ge la/ rjes dran gyi rtags bcu po 'di u rgyan pa gang la bzhed dris pas 'am bu la tig pa med/ bla ma sprul sku ba rgya yul gshegs dus/ bla ma sprul sku ba dang / bla ma bsod nams 'od zer ba gnyis/ bla ma dbu ma bas mar res shangs su gdan drangs te tshogs 'khor bshams pa'i gral du/ bla ma dbu ma pas/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer la/ 'u cag gi sbyor drug gi rjes dran thad ka'i rgyud tshig bsam dang 'dod dang lus la rims dang kha mchog pad+ma skom dang zas la rab tu mi 'jug dang / /'dar dang smyo dang rab tu rmongs par gyur dang yid ni rnam par 'khrul dang rab tu brgyal ba rnams/ /rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste srog chags lus la 'jig rten du/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis po 'di rjes dran gyi rtags bcu po 'di la 'byed dgos par 'dug pas/ bsam dang 'dod sogs tshig rkang gong ma 'di la 'byed dam/ rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs tshig rkang 'og ma la 'byed dris pas/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa na re/ dris pa'i sos khos sam/ lan gyis 'debs lugs sam/

wa dmar po zer te chang 'thung 'phro'i blug gu gdab ste/ dris pa'i lan de ma nges pa gcig byung / bla ma zla ba pa gsungs/ rang re'i lugs kyi bsam dang 'dod zhes pa ni dpe yin te/ rdo rje can gyi du ba sogs la zhes pa 'di la 'byed do gsungs/ bsam dang zhes pa ni chags yul yid la lam byung ba'o/ /'dod dang ni de nyid 'dod pas dung ste gdungs pa'o/ /lus la rims dang zhes pa ni phyag rgya de la shin tu chags pas gtum mo'i me 'bar te lus la drod skyes pa la sogs pa'i rtog rtags bcu ni dpe yin la rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste zer ba la byed do gsung ngo / /rjes dran 'od dpag med bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ 'du shes kyi phung po snang ba 'du shes kyi phung po <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>snang ba mtha' yas chu khams <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>mā ma ki /lce'i skye mched/<!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs kyi skye mched rkang pa'i dbang po <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>gzugs rdor ma/ /pad+ma mthar byed len pa khengs byed ma/ /'du shes phung po gnas gyur drug /ces so/ /snang ba mtha' yas/ chu'i khams mā ma ki lce'i skye mched 'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs kyi skye mched gzugs rdo rje ma/ rkang pa khro bo pad+ma mthar byed/ len pa khro mo nga rgyal byed ma ste/ drug tshan gcig sgrib bral du dag go gsungs/ de ltar dbang po rnon po phyag rgya chen po'i rjes dran dang / 'bring po ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rjes dran dang / tha ma las kyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i rjes dran gsum ci rigs par bsgoms pas byang chub kyi sems dpral ba nas mas rim gyis 'bab pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong zhing /

rlung gi stobs kyis byang sems phyir mi 'dzag pa'i nus pa thob/ sngar gyi gsal snang las ches gsal zhing dwangs la phra zhing rgya che ba'i du ba la sogs mthong / sngar sor sdud kyi du ba sogs mthong pa nas rjes dran rdzogs kyi bar gyi tshogs lam nas sbyor lam bzod pa chen po'i bar du bsdus so/ /de nas rjes dran gyi mthar ting nge 'dzin gyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig ma gcig thob/ dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya las gcig 'gags pas na ting nge 'dzin gyi mgo tshugs/ 'jig rten chos mchog gi mgo tshugs/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung nyis khri chig stong drug brgya las dbugs stong brgyad brgya 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig stong brgyad brgya thob/ byang sems yar 'phel nas gsang gnas kyi phyed gang / de'i bar nas byang sems mar babs nas 'jig rten pa yin la/ mi 'dzag pas 'jig rten pa gzhan las mchog yin pas 'jig rten chos mchog yin no/ /'jig rten chos mchog rdzogs te sa dang po thob/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ mthong lam thob bo/ /yang bsgoms pas dbugs stong brgyad brgya 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig stong bco brgyad thob/ byang sems yar 'phel te gsang gnas gang / sa gnyis pa thob/ de tsam na dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya las/ dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags/ dbugs khri brgyad stong gis nyin mtshan 'khor bar byed/ de ltar dbugs 'gags nas nyung du song ba tsam gyis dbugs lhag ma rnams ring du 'gro/ 'jam du 'gro/ rgyu ba mi gsal du 'gro /tshul de ltar bsgoms pas sngar gyi steng du yang dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig sum stong drug brgya thob pas/ byang sems kyis lte ba gang / sa gsum pa dang bzhi pa thob/ de'i tshe dbugs khri bzhi stong bzhi brgyas nyin mtshan 'khor/

yang bsgoms pas byang sems mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig sum stong drug brgya thob/ dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags/ byang sems kyis snying kha'i bar du gang / sa lnga pa dang drug pa thob/ de'i tshe dbugs khri brgyad brgyas nyin mtshan 'khor/ yang bsgoms pas dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig sum stong drug brgya thob/ byang sems kyis mgrin pa'i bar gang / sa bdun pa dang brgyad pa thob/ dbugs bdun stong nyis brgyas nyin mtshan 'khor/ yang bsgoms pas dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig sum stong drug brgya thob/ byang sems kyis dpral ba'i bar du gang / sa dgu pa dang bcu pa thob/ dbugs sum stong drug brgyas nyin mtshan 'khor/ yang bsgoms pas dbugs sum stong drug brgya 'gags te/ dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya rdzogs par 'gags/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig sum stong drug brgya thob ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig nyis khri chig stong drug brgya rdzogs par thob/ byang sems kyis gtsug tor rdzogs par gang / sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa rdzogs par thob ste/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya pa yin/ de ltar na rten rlung ci tsam 'gags pa ltar de la brten pa'i rtog pa 'gag rnam rtog ji ltar 'gags pa ltar mi rtog pa'i ye shes gsal bar skye/ de yang / yang bsgoms pas mthar thug pa'i spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs te 'tshang rgya ba chos nyid yin no/ /de ltar na gang zag khams drug dang tshogs gnyis ldan bla ma dam pas rjes su bzung bas lam zab mo 'di brtson pas bsgoms nas/ sor sdud bsam gtan la lo gcig srog 'dzin la zla ba drug gam/ yang na lo bzhi dang zla ba gnyis/ de nas rjes dran lo gsum phyogs gsum bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin thob/ byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor zin te mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig gcig thob/ de nas ting nge 'dzin la lo gsum phyogs gsum bsgoms pas dbugs stong brgyad brgya 'gags/

mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba stong bco brgyad thob/ byang sems kyis gsang gnas kyi phyed gang / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sa dang po thob/ de nas byang chub sems kyi myu gu kha gyen du bltas te yar 'phel/ de nas brtson pas bsgoms pas tshegs chung ngus 'tshang rgya bas gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'am/ rab mthong ba'i chos la sangs rgya zhes gsungs pa'i don de yin/ lam gyi ngo bo mngon sum bzhi ste/ sor sdud bsam gtan ni/ sha'i mig gis stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan mthong ba dbang po'i mngon sum/ srog rtsol 'dzin pa ni dbu ma'i nang du chud pa'i shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba yid kyi mngon sum/ rjes dran ni gtum mo ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis byang chub kyi sems zhu bar gyur pa 'og tu bgrod pa las dga' ba rab tu thob pa'i sems rtog bral ma 'khrul ba rnal 'byor mngon sum/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba'i shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba rang rig mngon sum mo/ /lam gyi tshad 'dzin spyan lnga ste sha'i mig tshogs lam na/ lha'i mig drod rtse bzod pa gsum na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan chos mchog na/ shes rab kyi spyan 'phags pa slob pa'i lam sa bcu gcig na/ ye shes kyi spyan sa bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi sa na'o/ /de dag kyang 'dir mdor bsdus nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam bgrod tshul gyi rim pa tsam ma gtogs/ rgyas par chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig na gsal lo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnam snang bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni gzugs kyi phung po rnam snang / sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lus kyi skye mched sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ dri'i skye mched dri rdo rje ma/ bshang lam gyi dbang po gshin rje mthar byed/ brjod pa rengs byed ma ste drug tshan gcig sgrib bral du dag gzugs phung <!TCC Tibetan

character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>rnam snang sa khams <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>sangs rgyas spyan ma dang / gsungs so/ /lus kyi skye mched <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>sgrib sel dri'i skye mched <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>dri mi bskyod rdo rje ma/ bshang lam gyi dbang po <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>gshin rje mthar byed brjod pa <!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>rengs byed ma/ /gzugs phung la sogs gnas gyur drug /ces so/ /ngo sprod kyi rgyu sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de la rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'i thad du/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i 'od gsal ba yab 'od gsal ba dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i rgyu rgyud/ dang / de'i rten yum rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ nā da rgyu rgyud yin zhing / mdor na ye shes rnam shes dbyer med de rgyu rgyud yin zhing / 'od gsal pa 'dod lugs mang ste/ mdo sde bas gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mthong ba tsam la 'dod/ sems tsam pas nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres tsam la 'dod/ dbu ma pa gzung 'dzin gyi mun pas ma sgrib tsam la 'dod gsung / rtags bcu'i thad du g.yas kyi du sogs lnga/ g.yon gyi nam mkha' sogs lnga ste bcu/ de steng thig le chen po/ re khwa nag po/ de las longs sku sogs dang / brtan pa bum pa/ snam bu/ ri/ rtsig pa/ khang khyim/ g.yo ba sems te/ nyin rtags mtshan rtags kyi steng bsnan pas rtags bcu bzhi'am/ bco lnga 'byung gsung ngo / /de nyid la sna tshogs gzugs 'od gsal ba zhes gsung ngo / /dang po sprin dang 'dra bar snang ba ni stegs bu'i gseb tu mi bgrang gsung / gnyis med dus 'khor las/ rlung bcu kar gsal por gsungs/ 'dus pa la sogs pa la/

sa rlung sogs lnga gsung / sgyu 'phrul dra ba las nam mkha' la sogs pa lnga dgongs pa'i skad gzhan gyis gsungs gsung ngo / /nyams dang po ri gzar gyi rbab lta bu/ rong khung dog mo'i chu/ phu gsum gyi rdzing chung / mtsho chung rlabs dang bcas pa/ rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu'i nyams te lnga dang sbyar gsung / 'di'i thad du shar pa'i 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal rgya yul gshegs pa'i phyi ma jo gdan sgom bzang po byas pa gcig khrid pa'i gtam rgyud dang / rje btsun rga lo'i gtam rgyud dang / 'phags pa nam tshul gyi gtam rgyud dang / yang ri phug gi spyi khang yod sa 'di na grang chung gcig yod/ der khams pa gcig gis bsgoms pa'i gtam rgyud dang / thar par mkhan chen thar lo'i drung du/ khams pa dar rgyam gyis sgom zhus/ grogs po dbang phyug dpal gyis/ phar phyin la nan tan byed kyin tsha dro khos g.yos nas ster ba gcig yod/ de dus dar ma rgyal mtshan la ye shes babs pa'i gtam rgyud gsung / bsam gtan dag pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa ston nus pa 'byung zhes pa'i thad du/ grub thob yu mos wa brag dkar ba'i nyams sad du 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ g.yas ru grong chung nas grub thob yu mos skyag ga gcig tu brdzus te wa brag dkar du byon nas/ wa brag dkar pa khong brag thog gcig na nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sgom gyin bsdad skad/ der grub thob yu mos wa brag dkar pa'i steng du phar la phar zhud tshur zhud gcig pa mdzad nas/ pha tshad der rtug pa gcig gi steng na chags nas rtug pa de la mchu gcig brdar nas skyag skyag gsungs pa dang / wa brag dkar ba kag bzhengs nas phyag gsum byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rin po che de 'dra mi mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas/ grub thob yu mo zhal skyengs te skyag skag gsung gin 'phur gshegs skad/ de la bla ma sher seng ba'i zhal nas/ khong dpon slob gnyis kyis bla ma btsongs par gda' ba gsungs gsung /

'o de 'dra 'ong ba lags gsung / yang khams pa rga los gnam lce ldang gi phu na ngang tshang bya ba'i brag khung gcig na sgrub pa la bzhugs yod pa na/ lan gcig wa brag dkar bas sha gcig nyos btsos te g.yam pa'i steng du bton te rtsa pha tshad na bzhag nas bzhugs yod pa na/ rga los wa brag dkar ba'i nyams sad pa'i phyir pho rog gcig tu brdzus te wa brag dkar du byon nas/ wa brag dkar ba'i sha de nas 'then 'then byas kyin gag gag gsungs pas/ wa brag dkar bas rga lo yin par mkhyen nas/ rga chung nga bya ba 'di sha za na der sdod la zo/ de na phar 'then nas ci byed zer ba lags so/ /bla ma sher seng ba/ 'o kho gnyis kyis kyang bla ma btsongs par gda' gsung / yang la stod byang pa'i sa cha na yod pa'i dgon pa 'khyog zer ba gcig gi mkhan po dang / de'i dbu mdzad jo gdan sman lha zer ba'i thugs dam pa sman bla byed dus dpral ba sa la thug pa'i phyag btsal bas dpral ba'i dkyil de na skrangs nas sha 'bor song yod pa gcig yod/ khong dge sbyor la brtson po byed pa'i a tsi bar thams cad kyis bsgom pa gcig yod pa na/ khong dpon slob 'ga' zhig gis/ chos rje kun spangs pa la jo nang du mjal du phyin/ mkhan po dang gzhan rnams kyis phyag byas phyag rten btang / byin rlabs zhus nas gral du khad kyis bsdad yod par gda'/ jo gdan sman bla ba khong da dung dpral pa sa la thug thug pa'i phyag 'tshal gyin 'dug zer/ de la chos rje kun spangs pas zhal 'dzum legs par bsdus nas spyan che re ba gzigs nas/ da sdod/ zog rgan khyod kyi phyag gus gus dang / de skad gsungs kyang da dung phyag 'tshal gyin 'dug zer/ mkhan po de na re/ de skad mi gsung par zhu/ khong thugs dam la a tsi bar byed/ sman bla don zhags mang po song ba'i a tsi bar byed pa lags zhus pas/ yong / kho khyim mtshes kyi ra tshe lug tshe rnams brkus kyin zos nas rus pa dang pags pa rnams dong du skyur gyin sdod pa'i bla 'tshong po zog rgan sdod byas so a gsungs yod par gda'/

der phyag 'tshal 'phro bzhag ste gral der bsdad nas/ byad nong nge ba la rngul phra la la bsdad yod par gda'/ kho la ngo tsha ting pa gcig btang yod par gda' ste/ mad lags kyang mi zer bar yod par gda'/ phyis kho'i spyil por bltar phyin pas/ khong gsungs pa ji bzhin du byung zer/ 'o de 'dra 'ong par gda' gsung / yang kun spangs pa'i slob ma yin pa zhig kho nags phug nas lo re bzhin mjal du yong ba zhig yod/ nags phug dang jo nang gi bar de na grong gcig yod/ de na btsun ma gcig yod pa de la kho nam yong res kyis byugs kyin mjal du yong pa gcig yod pas/ lan gcig khos btsun ma de la byugs nas mjal du byung pa la/ khyod nam yong res kyis btsun ma de la byugs kyin nga la 'phrad pa a/ sdom shor po ma rabs gsungs pas/ kho zhed nas/ drung pa mad lags/ drung pa'i mngon shes la thogs pa mi gda'o/ /mthol lo bshags zer legs so/ /kho 'gyod nas bshags pa byas gda' ba/ 'o de kun la a togs yin par gda'/ sman bla ba kun gyis mad lags kyang ma zhus par gda' gsungs so/ /srog rtsol ngo sprod kyi skabs su/ me shas chung ba yin na thig le 'khyags nas thod pa dang klad pa'i bar du rdo gong ngam/ ting phor kha phub nas yod pa lta bu'i nyams snang dang / mgo na zhing 'khor zhing 'gyel ba dang / lus kyi sha 'gyur te kha tshul yon por shor ba dang / sha 'bar 'bur du skrangs pa la sogs pa 'byung gsung ngo / /me shas che na nyams snang thams cad kha sna sogs dbang po'i sgo nas 'tshang ba 'byung / de dus rlung 'bud snying 'dod pa byung ste/ rlung mi 'bud par glod nas bsgoms pas bzod bder 'gro ba yin gsung ngo / /gal te mi stobs chung na nyams snang rnal ma spyi bor sprin lding ba bzhin 'khor ba dang / smin mtshams sam mgo bo nas sbrul gyis za ba lta bu'am/ phag pa'i lag bar du mgo bo bcug nas klad pa na mar za gin yod pa lta bu'i snang ba 'byung gsung ngo /

/rlung gcig car dbu mar 'dus na lus 'dar du 'byung ste/ rtsa dbu ma la kun 'dar ma zhes pa'i don yin gsung / nyams snang rnams ston gnam dwangs pa'i skar ma bzhin bkra ting pa'i 'phro la mar ting gis 'gags nas sems rtog med du brgyal lus 'gyel te rkang lag shag shag kha lbu ba 'jog 'jog skad ngan sna tshogs pa 'byung / de la grub thob dbu rgyan pa nang gi gza' phog pa zer bar gda' gsung / phyi'i drang srong dang 'dra rung 'ong bar gda' gsung ngo / /sa sgra mes 'phel na zhes pa'i thad du/ rdza rog pa'i dbon po gcig la mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par me'i snang bas sun pa gcig byung / blo dpon dge slong shākya dpal gyi bla ma gcig gi dbon mo yin zer/ shangs pa gcig yod pas/ de la gegs sel gyi gdams pa gcig zhu zhes/ chos rje'i drung du zhu ru byung pas/ de la chu rlung gi gdam pa bstan gsung ngo / /chu dgra rlung 'phel na zhes pa'i thad du/ chos rje kun spangs pas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus na lan gcig nye gnas la/ kho te sgom chen zhog la 'khrug pa bsdums bya ba yin/ nga sa 'bri gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bsdum du 'gro zer/ 'di bsod nams che gsungs/ der nye gnas kyis 'o skol sgom chen mi gcig gis sa 'bri'i 'khrug pa rang mi zlum lags kyis bzhugs par zhu byas pas/ der btsog tu ngos song nas shor yod par gda'/ der nye gnas des bal grwa gcig khur nas ting la mar bltar phyin pas dro lam gcig tshod na ltogs chad 'dzom pa gcig byas nas bzhugs 'dug zer/ de 'dra ma bkag par gtong pa de gnad yin gsung / yang bde chen du byang sems rgyal ye'i slob ma gcig gis lo gsum gyi sgrub pa'i dam bca' blangs/ lo gcig song ba dang kho thon nas/ nga rdo rje gdan bskor du 'gro zer byung / de mi brag khyod sgrub pa la yod pa yin mod byas pas kho'i de btsog tu song nas/ nga rdo rje gdan bskor du 'gro rang 'gro zer te shor/

der bla brang na dgyel po de 'dra rta dang mgyogs kob mnyam zer ba gcig yod pa de la/ khyod kho'i shul na mar rgyug la kho bsdad 'dug na nga yang rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba yin gyis la/ legs par nyen nyen du khrid la/ nyen pa dang ga ler khrid la shog gsungs/ der dgyel po des ma mkhar na yar ga le phyin pa dang / kho'i yid la 'dzin du btang pa yin par 'dug snyam nas kho mgyogs steng par sngon la song / der mgyogs kob byang ched nas nyi ma ring ba las ma byung / der ji zhig nas dril chen nas dgyel po des kho'i rjes zin nas/ der sgom chen pa de la khyed gar gshegs byas pas/ nga rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba yin zer/ dgyel po des rdo rje gdan du nga yang 'gro ba yin te/ 'o cag bsdad pas mi sleb/ rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la nyin mtshan med 'gro dgos zer nas thang tha khrid byas nas phyin pa dang / ji zhig na rlungaphebs/ gtugs kyi chad yod par gda' ste/ de ka la ma bzhag par/ 'o cag rdo rje gdan du do re sleb bam blta 'deng byas khrid phyin pa dang / da khyod shes zhu/ nga rang mar la ga le log 'gro zer/ rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la 'di nas log pas ga na 'ong zer/ 'deng ka byas pas/ da khyed de skad ma zer zhu zer byung yod par gda'/ 'o de ka 'dra'i rigs la 'gro zer na mi 'gog par gtugs kyi chad chad kho rang 'cham du 'dzud pa'am/ 'khrid pa de gnad yin/ la la nga 'phur ba yin zer ba 'ong / de la'ang sa bde sa de 'dra nas gyen la khrid la 'phur byas kyin 'khrab tu btsud pas ji zhig nas gtugs kyi chad nas rlung rang mal du phebs nas phan 'gro ba yin gsung ngo / /nam mkha'i rlung dbu mar tshud na bzang shos la rtsig pa dang khang khyim la thogs pa med pa 'byung ste grub thob kub tshig pa'i gtam rgyud gsung ngo / /nam mkha'i rlung shas cher 'phel na zhes pa'i thad du/ rang lus med pa dang / g.yang za ba dang /

rang 'dug pa'i 'og thams cad stong pa dang / mdor na stong pa dgrar ldang gi gegs bya ba 'byung / de yang phyi stong pa bzhin du nang yang stong par song na mi so ste/ phyi stong par song nas skrag pa min gsung ngo / /na ning rtsa na dgon pa sle lung bya ba bla ma mus chen pa'i dgon pa gcig yod/ de na mus chen pa'i slob ma gdan sa de 'dzin pa'i phyar bu ba bzang po zhig yod/ de'i drung du bshes gnyen skyabs sbyin dpal dang / khong ston pa shākya bsod nams pa dang / bla ma dge brag bsod rin dang / khong 'ga' zhig gis sbyor drug zhus bshes gnyen skyabs sbyin pa de la spyod 'jug dga' mo yod pa las/ dbu ma'i grub mtha' 'di nga min pas go ba med zer nas nga rgyal byed pa gcig kyang gda'/ der khos stong nyams dang gzhan yang nyams ci rigs pa byung yang / bla ma la ma zhus par bsdad/ der bla ma na re nyams 'di 'dra byung / khams mtho dman 'di 'dra byung ma bshad na skyon du 'gro lags pas nga la 'di 'dra byung gsung 'tshal lo dba' gsungs/ bshes gnyen skyabs sbyin dpal na re/ yon tan skyes na a'u tsi mno lags zhus pas/ yon tan skyes na a'u rtsi legs gsungs/ ston pa shākya bsod dang skyabs sbyin dpal gnyis ltab na yod/ ston pa shākya bsod gtor ma gcig gtong gin yod tsa na/ skyabs sbyin dpal sgom khang nas phyir byung / gtor theb gcig la mdzub mo btsugs te/ 'di stong pa yin nam snang ba yin zer byung / shākya bsod kyis de 'dra yin snyam pa ma byung par/ stong pa yin byas pas/ de ka la gtor theb blangs nas brdabs te bla ye phyir bud song / der phyi de na mi gsum gyis btag na thegs tsam gyi rdo gong chen po tsen gyis blangs nas phrag pa la phyar te/ mkhas btsun pa la dmag brdeg pa yin/ g.yas ru'i dmag dpon la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yod/ g.yon ru'i la 'gro mgon chos rgyal yod/ sbus ru la gur mgon gnyan po yod/

mkhas btsun chen po'i mgo bo la rgyob ya zer nas rdo gong rgyangs kyis bskyur byung / de nas zla ba de'i zla ba phyi ma'i tshes grangs de la/ dpon chen 'od zer seng ges bzhi thog la dmag brgyab byung / der shākya bsod kyis khong gzung gis mno ba de la khong ma zin par shor/ der kho pa'i spyil po de'i a to gsham na bla ma bsod rin gyi spyil po yod/ khong rnams bla ye na snyeng 'dug pa de la/ spyil po de la mdzub mo btsugs nas/ snang ba yin nam stong pa yin zer/ shākya bsod kyis/ kho te ba spyi po snang ba yin gyis byas pas/ bla ma bsod rin pas ma thos par yang khong shor song / der lung pa de'i mda' na gzhung chu nyang chu tsam gcig yod pa de'i rtsa na lug rdzi gcig spu bu'i zhwa mo gon pa gcig lug mtsho yi yod pa de la/ khyed pha dam pa rgya gar yin par 'dug khyod pha dam pa yin nam min byas pas/ lus rdzis tab tob la nga pha dam pa yin byas pas/ 'o na dga' tshad yin zer/ min byas na kho'i lag na chag rdo gcig 'dug pa de rdeg par 'dug der chu pha kha de nas kho zin nas byung zer/ de la bla mas gegs bsal bas sel yod pa 'dug ste/ lar rang la nyams 'di 'dra byung ma byas na rting la sel ba dka' mo 'ong ba yin bshes gnyen skyabs sbyin de'ang rting nas khams 'dus langs nas/ kho la rtsa na sha tsha ba'i mi med pas tsha mig tu kho rang gang byed kyis spyod pa zhag drug tsam byed bcug pas rlung rengs nas nyin mtshan med par zla ba gcig tu rkang bro dang chos gzhas byed/ gang thod thod lab/ de nas rting la ka ba la zhag gnyis bkyigs bzhag de nas kyang drag tu ma song / bcu drug mdo la dbyug pa byas pas zag pa skam po mdzub mo'i rtse mo tsam rug rug dang sla mo 'dres pa bre do tsam 'thon byung / de'i mod la shi yod par 'dug de ka la bzhag na 'ong ste/ 'chi ka der kho la a to ka byung 'dug gsung /

bla ma kun spangs pas/ bla ma chos sku ba la sbyor drug zhus pa'i dus su/ bla ma kun spangs pas rkyang thur du bzhugs/ bla ma chos sku ba ma ngag dge sdings na bzhugs dus/ skabs su dmigs pa spod du rkyang thur du gshegs pa gcig yod pa la/ lan gcig rtsa na bla ma kun spangs pa la stong nyams shar ba de bla ma chos sku pas dge sdings nas mkhyen nas rkyang thur du byon pas/ chos rje kun spangs pas kyang bla ma pa 'byon pa sgom khang nas gzigs nas bla ma kun spangs pa'i zhal nas bla ma pa 'byon gyi 'dug nga bsu ba la 'gro zer te steng skas gcig la yar shor te/ skas gdang rnams kyi steng du rkang pa 'jog pa dang mnyam por sa gcig sa gnyis/ sa gsum/ sa bzhi zer gyin sa lam bsgrod pa bzhin byed cing steng du shor ba'i thu ba nas kho rang gi nye gnas kyis zin/ de nas mar 'og tu babs/ der bla ma pas kyang phebs byung ste/ bla ma pa'i zhal nas slob dpon pa 'ur che'i bdog gam gsungs pas/ bla ma kun spangs pas zhal nas/ 'ur che la g.yang za ba gcig ka bdog gsung / der bla ma chos sku bas/ dmigs pa lte bar bla ma'i sku gser gyi mdog can shin tu brjid pa gcig bsgom du bcug pas sel yod par 'dug gsung ngo / /sor sdud bsam gtan bsgoms pas bden tshig 'grub par bshad de/ mkhan chen thar los rgya gar la byon pa'i rting ma gcig la bal po dang yangs pa can gyi bar na yod pa'i yul/ ti ra ho tir byon dus grong khyer la me shor byung pa la/ se gol mdzad nas me 'di zhi bar gyur cig gsungs pas me zhi ba lta bu/ yang chos rje kun spangs pas sag thang byang na phar byon pas/ rlung gis mi 'khyer ba ka 'dra byung de dus chos rje kun spangs pas sdigs mdzub mdzad nas rlung 'di zhi bar gyur cig gsungs pas zhi ba lta bu'o gsungs/ chos rje bu ston/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ gnas 'byongs 'byams pa bcad pa la/

gnyis med dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba'am/ gsang gnas sogs su 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i thig le rlung sems 'dus pa'i byed lugs kyis 'byung bar bshad/ lte ba'i thig ler rlung sems 'dus pa na/ nyams dag snang gnyis med kyi lha tshogs dang / ma dag pa'i snang ba dud 'gro dang / sdug bsngal dang / 'jigs nyams 'byung / grub mtha' dbu ma'i lta ba rgyud la 'char/ snying kha'i thig ler 'dus pa la brten nas dag snang rgyud lha tshogs dang / ma dag pa mi'i snang ba/ 'dod chags rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye/ dpral ba'i thig ler rlung sems 'dus pa la brten nas dag snang bya rgyud kyi lha tshogs/ ma dag pa dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char/ de lta bu shar bas gnas 'byongs sam skye ba mkhyen pa'i nyams zhes pa yin te/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khong pa chos nam gsung res kyis grub chen ko brag pa la bka' bkyon gsungs so/ /ko brag pa bya ba 'dis klog ni mi shes/ lam 'bras 'bogs pa dang rang ci gcig ka byed kyin yod dam gsung gin bka' bkyon lo/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob ma yin/ rang re sbyor drug gi brgyud pa yin pa'i/ rgyus pa gzhon seng zer pa des rgyu 'grul gcig la glang kor ngos na yar byon pas/ lung pa gzhan zhig na ston mo gcig 'dug de'i tshogs dpon la ko brag pa byon 'dug der khong gis kyang byon pas de ru mi smyon pa gcig la snga thag phyi thag btags nas mi 'ga' zhig gis khrid byung pa na/ ko brag pa'i zhal nas/ kho te ba/ mi de la de 'dra ma byed/ kho rang rang lugs su thongs gsungs pas/ smyon pa 'khrid mkhan rnams na re/ 'di btang na mi la gnad yar byed par bdog zer/ ko brag pa'i zhal nas ci'ang mi lto 'ong gis thongs gsungs/ der khong rnams kyis thag pa bkrol btang pas/ smyon pa de ngo nong nge dang ko brag pa'i drung na bsdad 'dug der ko brag pa'i gsung gis/

rgyus pa gzhon seng la/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ smyon pa 'di'i khams skyon 'di ji ltar lags gsungs pas/ rgyus pa na re/ de ma shes lags/ bla ma'i drung nas ji ltar du mdzad lags byas pas/ ko brag pa na re/ 'am bu'i lugs kyis dud 'gro'i rtsa gnas su rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel du 'dod/ de'ang khong la rta'i bag chags yod par 'dod ma chags gsungs pas/ rgyus pa khong ko brag pa la brnyas se yod pas/ khong gi thugs la/ ko brag pa 'di khos gtam rgyud 'dra rna bar thos pas/ de'i rjes su zhugs nas lab pa yin/ de min 'dis ci 'ong mi shes snyam nas/ smyon pa 'di la rta'i 'du shes yod pa'i rtags ci la mdzad zhus zhes zhus pas/ ko brag pa nye gnas gcig la shub shub pa gcig mdzad kyin 'dug der nye gnas gcig gis rtswa rlom po gang smyon pa de'i mdun du spungs byung / gcig gis rta sga gcig de'i rgyab tu bstad de zhon nas yob thab thab byas pas smyon pa de rta'i skad 'don gyin 'dug pa dang / ko brag pa nas/ rta yin pa'i rtags de la byed lags gsung / da 'di sel thabs la/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i lugs kyis ji ltar mdzad ces gsungs pas/ rgyus pa na re/ 'am cag gi lugs kyis dang po dbang bskur/ de nas dmigs pa 'dra dang / 'khrul 'khor 'dras 'don lags/ bla ma pa'i lugs kyis ji ltar du 'don zhes zhus pas/ ko brag pa'i zhal nas/ 'am bu lugs kyis 'di ltar du 'don lags gsungs nas/ smyo ba de la mdun 'dir skyil krung chos la sdod gsungs/ der bsdad 'dug pa na khyod rang rlung sangs sangs pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bus gsungs kho rlung 'bud pa dang mnyam por ko brag pas rlung nyi shu rtsa gcig rngubs nas/ da ngas mi mthong ba'i sar khrid la song gsung ba'i brda gcig mdzad pas/ ko brag pas mi gzigs pa'i phag cig tu khrid song ba dang / ko brag pas rlung ro sangs pa gcig bus nas/

'am bu'i sel lugs de 'dra gcig byed lags gsungs pas/ jo btsun rgyus pa ko brag pa la brnyas se yod pa de thul yod pa 'dug gsung / de nas jo btsun rgyus pas/ sa skya ngos su 'khor byon pas/ yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas chos gsung ba gcig gi nyin/ ko brag pa la bka' bkyon mdzad byung / der jo btsun rgyus pas/ paṇa chen la/ drung pa ko brag pa la de 'dra'i bka' bkyon mi btub pa gda' zhus pas/ paṇa chen pas de ci 'dug gsungs/ der rgyus pas/ ko brag pas gegs bsal lugs kyi gleng mo rnams paṇa chen la zhus pas/ 'dug gsungs/ kho rta med po gcig rta brgya zhon/ nga rta brgya'i bdag po rkang thang lus gsung lo gsungs/ yang slob dpon dpon slob gnyis kyis/ lam 'bras pa gcig can khrid zhur phyin dus/ slob ma des tsha chos bskol gyin 'dren du 'gro ba gcig yod pa na/ lan gcig slob dpon khong cha ba gsol lugs sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i za lugs gcig mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ slob dpon 'di la ji 'dra gcig byung 'dug snyam nas/ bla ma'i drung du phyin te/ slob dpon la ji 'dra gcig byung gda'/ ci drag gam zhus pas/ ci byung 'dug gsungs/ kho na re/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i za lugs 'dug lugs rnams khyi bzhin byed kyi gda' zhus pas/ bla ma pa nas/ ci'ang mi lto'i/ slob dpon la slob dpon du ma bsgom par/ khyi'i 'du shes gyis la/ lto ster tsa na khyi la ster ba bzhin gyis dkru bshal gyis la byin cig zer/ de khos slob dpon yin pa mi rung lags sam byas pas/ cang mi lto/ slob dpon la phan pa yin gyi gsungs pas der khos slob dpon la dkru bshal blud pas/ slob dpon khong khyi'i za lugs 'dug lugs gzhan byed/ khyi skad 'don byed kyi 'dug pas/ yang bla ma'i drung du phyin nas bla ma pa/ de ni legs par 'gyur gda'/ khyi smyon gyis rmugs pa ni mi gsha'/ ci lags sam/ khyi skad kyang 'don gyin gda' byas pas/

da de ka yin/ khyod rang seng ge ru bsgoms la slob dpon khong zhu mi zer bar rdungs shig gsungs pas/ slob dpon yin pas de 'dra rung ngam byas pas/ bla ma na re a'u rtsi/ slob dpon la phan pa yin pas de skad gyis shig zer/ der slob dpon can phyin/ khos seng ge ru bsgoms nas rdung gi mno ba de la/ slob dpon khyi nyen pa bzhin ngo nong nge byas/ bsing bsing zer ba byung / de ka la brdungs pas khyi nyen pa bzhin du ang skad lhang lhang du song / de ka la'ang brdungs pas ci zhig tsa na/ kho te nga yin no/ /ma byed zhu zer byung / der bzhag pas de la sel yod par 'dug kho kun la bla ma a rtsi bar yod par 'dug da lta slob ma sgom mkhan tsam med pas slob dpon la ga bcad gda'/ slob ma snying rus can byung na slob dpon tsho la wa skad 'chor nyen gda' ste/ sgom mkhan med pa'i go cad gda'i gsungs/ yang gnas 'byongs la/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi slob ma yin pa'i slob dpon jo gdan zer ba/ mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor la brtson pa yod pa zhig la/ dmyal ba'i gnas 'byongs yong ba gcig yod pa 'dug de yang dgong phyogs 'ong ba gcig yod pas/ lan gcig sa skya paṇa chen gyi drung du phyin pas/ paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ slob dpon jo gdan byon nam/ nyid thugs dam la ni brtson/ 'dang zhag 'phel lam gsungs pas/ khong na re/ bdag dge sbyor rem yang sod mi gda'i zhus/ sod med pa ci gda' lags gsungs pas/ de bdag la da lta nas dmyal snang 'char gyi bdog gi zer/ de ji ltar 'ong gi 'dug gsungs pas/ de snga dro mi 'ong dgong phyogs su song ba dang / mdun du khron pa lta bu'i bug pa gcig 'ong / de na mar phyin pas dmyal snang dpag med myong gi bdog gi zer/ paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ de ka lags kyis/ de ring 'am bu'i rtsar bzhugs shig gsungs nas der bzhugs/ snga skad dge sbyor rem po mdzad/ dgong mo grib so phyor byung ba dang /

slob dpon jo gdan khong dbu de gug song nas/ dbu gug ge ba de'i ngang nas kha sbu 'jog go /so khrig khrig sdug bsngal gyi skad dang bcas nas mchi ma nar re dbu gug ge 'dug de ltar nyi ma rgas pa dang sangs kyis 'gro ba zhig 'dug de'i gegs de sa skya paṇa chen gyis bsal yod par gda' ste/ ko brag pa bzhin tsher ma 'don pa 'dra ba de lta bu ni ma byung yang / 'khrul 'khor 'dra dang dmigs pa 'dra la ga le bcun pas sel yod par 'dug gsungs so/ /bu ston chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ nga la rta'i gnas 'byongs byung ste/ de la bse ru bsgoms pas sel gsungs/ bla ma mgon po dpal ba la lug tu snang ba'i nyams shar/ de la hik bton pas sel gsungs so/ /yang bdag gzhan du snang ba'i nyams ni/ dam pa kun dga' khong nam sgom dus su spre'u gcig 'ong gin mdun du khong gi mnyam gzhag gi lad mo byed/ khong g.yas su yo na kho'ang g.yas su yo byed/ g.yon du yo na kho'ang g.yon du yo byas kyin gang byed kyi lad mo byed du byung / der kun dga' dam pa'i drung du phyin pas dam pa'i zhal nas/ kun dga' dge sbyor 'phel lam gsungs pas/ bdag la mdang zhag mi ma yin gcig gis dge sbyor byed du rang ma ster zhus pas/ mi ma yin ci 'dra gcig 'dug gsungs/ bdag dge sbyor nam byed pa na spre'u gcig yong nas lad mo byed kyin ka gda' zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ da kho byung ba dang / 'dis sna zhur gyis la bskus shig gsungs nas rlangs dreg mar dang bsres pa gcig gtad/ de kun dgas khyer te sgom gyin bsdad pas kho byung / der ga le byas nas rlangs dreg mar dang bsres pa de kho'i dpral ba nas sna rtse thug bskus btang / der dam pa can phyin pas dam pa'i zhal nas/ mdang kho byung nge gsungs/ byung lags zhus pas/ kha sang gi de bskus se gsungs/ bskus lags zhus pas/ dam pas me long gcig bstan te bltas pas/

kho rang gi dpral ba nas sna rtse thug bskus 'dug lo/ /de 'dra'i rigs de la de bzhin byas pas de ma thag sel 'gro yi 'dug 'dir yang dbon po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa la de 'dra zhig byung ba la/ de char ma rgyal ltogs yin nam snyam ste drung du zhus pas/ de ka yin/ kho nam byung pa na 'gram pa ya gcig la rtsam pa gcig skus shig gsungs pas/ der khong gis rtsam pa gcig 'chad du btags nas bsgoms pas kho byung zer/ der khos bros kyi dogs nas lag pa gcig gis kho'i lag pa nas bzung ste gcig gis bskus bzhag de nas ji zhig na gcin snod gcig yod pa de pho yis snyam nas khyer phyin te gcin la bltas pas kho rang gi byad la rtsam pa bskus 'dug pa de mthong nas de ma thag sel 'dug gsung ngo / /sems can gzhan bdag tu snang ba'i nyams ni/ 'brog mi'i slob ma yin/ khong gi yul mang mkhar ba yin/ khong dpon slob gnyis yod pas/ slob dpon des sgom gyin yod pa'i dgon pa de'i ltag na spang gshong gcig yod pa de la 'brog yod pas g.yag gcig gis lci ba gcig btang ba'i 'khris na yar ko ko yag gcig 'gro ba nyams snang la shar mthong ba dang / rang re ko ko yag de yin pa'i 'du shes byung nas/ de'i ltag na mar g.yag gnyis brdung ka brdag gin byung / skyon che/ ya ka'i 'og tu ma song na dga' ste/ ma leb na dga' ste snyam pa na khong gi steng na mar brdung ka rdeg gin byung ste/ g.yag gcig gi rmig pa'i 'og tu car gyis zhar/ de'i bred thabs la ting nge 'dzin sad de snying thug bug 'dug pa dang / nyams gsal drag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis g.yog de la 'di ka la rgyug las ltos la shog zer te/ bltar phyin pas ko ko yag gcig car gyis leb nas shi yod par gda'/ de la/ la la zhig de'i bar ko ko yag tu skyes pa yin mod zer te/ de ka yod mod/ lus gcig ma shi bar gcig tu ka skye mod/ phar phyin dang mngon pa nas gcig ma shi bar gcig tu skye ba'i gnas med go skabs med par bshad gsung ngo /

/yang sa skya paṇa chen gyi slob ma zhig la/ lus po bltabs nas rkang pa'i mthe bong dang / sna bug gnyis sprad nas/ de gnyis kyi bar sha'i thag pas sbrel bar snang ba'i gegs gcig byung / der kho na re/ nga'i 'di la ci phan nam zer sdug bsngal ba la/ paṇa chen gyis/ mthe bong dang sna'i bar la 'jag ma phar yul tshur yul byas bton nas/ khyod rang 'khrul 'dug pa/ sna bug dang mthe bong gnyis 'byar ba ga na 'ong / 'di na gsungs pas/ nga'i 'di 'khrul na khyed rang gis de bas kyang 'khrul lo zer nas kho'i de ma sel skad/ der ko brag pas phan po shes kyi 'dug zer ba thos te/ ko brag pa can phyin nas/ 'am bu la 'di 'dra gcig byung / 'di la phan pa 'dra mkhyen mkhyen zhus pas/ ko brag pa'i de rtsa mdud kyi byed las su mkhyen te/ 'di la phan pa dang shes te/ 'di la khyod rang gi nor snying phyung ba gcig nga la ster dgos/ de byung na phan pa bya/ de min dka'o gsungs pas/ de 'dra ba'i tsa po mi bdog ci drag lags sam zer/ ko brag pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis gser sbram chen po'am/ g.yu sbram chen po 'dra g.yar sa mi rnyed dam/ rnyed na lan gcig nga la sbyin dgos/ phyis nad phan pa dang khyod rang la gtad kyis gsungs pas/ 'o na g.yar po 'dra rnyed mchi yis zer te/ g.yu sbram dang gser sbram gcig pa g.yar pa byung / der ko brag pas/ phag tu zhabs tog pa rnams la ar ba'i chas su zhugs la de lta bur nga gnyis dos shig ces zhal ta bcug nas/ nad pa de las cha dben sa ya gir bgyi yi gshegs shig gsungs nas/ gcig gis nad pa khur te byon/ de ru slebs pa dang gser sbram g.yu sbram rnams ko brag pa'i phyag tu phul te/ der gsung gleng mdzad kyi yod pa'i 'phro la zhabs tog pa rnams kyis ar bar rdzus te go cha gon nas nags sib nas thon byung / de ma thag ko brag pas/ 'o ar ba byung / ngas ni khyod kyi g.yu nya ra mi 'ong ngo gsungs nas/
