kho rang gi phang par bskyur te/ khong pas 'khyus pa dang / kho yang bred nas g.yu de pa am brag tu bcug ste rtab rtab tu khag langs te ko brag pa'i shul na mar 'khyus pas/ de ka la kho'i rtsa mdud de grol nas gegs de sel yod par 'dug gsung ngo / /yang ko brag pa khong ra sa shar gyi phu na sgrub pa mdzad kyin yod pa'i dus su/ bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma gcig dpe cha 'dra bzhengs 'dod pa la ca po med par/ de'i rkyen gyis kho smyos yod par 'dug de la gtar kha me btsa' sman la sogs pa sus bcos kyang ma phan pa la/ de ko brag pas smyon pa 'chos pa la tshegs mi 'dug zer ba thos nas/ ko brag pa can 'chos su phyin pa na/ ko brag pa'i zhal nas/ slob dpon ston pa byon nam/ nyid cag bshad nyan 'dra byed pa la dpe cha 'dra dgos pa lags te/ nyid la dpe cha 'dra ba bdog ge gsungs pas/ de ka mi bdog lags zer nas/ ye nas khams 'dus pa de la/ de skad gsungs pas/ kho'i khams 'dus su ka song / der ko brag pa khong ra'i mgul khug nas gser srang gang bton nas/ ston pa 'di la nyid kyi dpe cha bzhengs pa'i ca po mdzod gsungs nas gnang ba dang / kho'i nad de sangs kyis drag yod par gda'/ gser de zad pa dang / yang smyos nas/ der ko brag pa gnas gzhan zhig tu gshegs kha cig yod pa na/ smyon pa kho byung nas/ yang 'am bu'i nad de langs/ da ci drag lags sam zhus pas/ de ka yin gyis gsungs nas spyil po stong pa gcig tu bskyal te/ 'dir do zhag dge sbyor gang nus mdzad kyin bzhugs shig de nas blta yis gsungs/ der zhag 'ga' zhig bsdad pas/ kho'i bsam pa la 'di 'dra'i rig pa so mi zin pa rang gzhan gnyis ka sdug pa 'di bas lceb pa rang drag gam snyam nas ko brag pa'i drung du phyin te/ 'am bu ni nad 'di ni mi phan par gda'/ bla ma pa yang 'o brgyal ba las mi gda'/ de bas lceb bsam mno bdog lags te zhus pas/ ko brag pa na re/

'o de ka nga'ang mno/ los kyang drag lceb na sus kyang ma tshor ba gyis la/ spyil po rtso'i ltag ya ki na sa 'jam po gcig yod kyis/ de nas 'goms la lcebs shig gsungs pas/ der khos phyin nas/ sa 'jam po de snyim pa gang blangs nas 'gam gyi snyam pa de la/ sa gseb de na gra mag ngar ma gcig 'dug pas a kha/ gra mag 'di gre ba la zug pa'i khrims yod snyam pa dang / de'i ngang la khos rig pa so zin nas/ ga re/ lceb pa dang gre ba la gra mag zug gi dogs pa gnyis mi 'khrugs snyam pa dang / de ka la nad de sangs kyis rtsa ba nas thon yod par 'dug gsung ngo / /yang ko brag pas kho rang gi slob ma gcig la/ ko brag tu khrid phog nas khong brag khung gcig na sgom gyin yod pa na/ nub gcig kho can du mi gcig byung nas kho'i snying lcur gyis bton te/ brag khung gi sgo'i phyi logs der snying de lcag pa gcig brdabs song / der kho'i yid la/ da nga la snying med skyon che/ da 'chi ba las ma 'das/ do re ma shi na/ sang bla ma rang mjal la/ de nas shi na'ang shi snyam nas/ de'i nub mo mtshan yal te gnyid ma byung / sang nam mkha' dag ma thag de la brag khung de'i sgo'i phyi logs la snying brdabs pa yin nam min bltas pas kyang snying brdabs pa'i shul dmar chab be 'dug pa dang / skyon che/ snying bton pa rtags can du 'dug da nga bla ma dang ma mjal bar la 'chi'am mi 'chi'am snyam gyin bla ma'i drung du phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ snying med po kho byung ngo gsungs pas/ 'os cod bla mas kyang mkhyen 'dug snyam ste/ de bas kyang sdug bsngal che bar song yod par 'dug de la ko brag pas/ kho bsdad pa'i mdun du bzang gzhong gcig bzhag de'i dkyil du bum pas chu rgyun ma chad par nar ra ra blugs pa'i chu'i lbu ba rog rog pa de la sems 'dzin du bcug pas gegs sel yod par gda' ste/ ko brag pa de rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs gzigs shing mngon shes la thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyis/

'khrul 'khor dang dmigs pa la ltos mi dgos par/ gegs sel ba la tshegs med par gda' ste/ de 'dra 'ong ba la sgom nus dgos par gda'/ sgom nus na de lta bu 'ong ba yin gsung ngo / /chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ gnas 'byongs 'byams pa bcad pa la/ gnyis med dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyis/ lte ba snying kha mgrin pa dpral ba'am gsang gnas sogs su 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i thig le rlung sems 'dus pa'i byed las kyis/ dag pa'i snang ba dang / ma dag pa'i snang bar shar bas/ gnas 'byong sa skye ba mkhyen pa'i nyams zhes pa 'byung la/ de rnams kyi gegs bsal ba la/ dud 'gro'i 'tsho ba nye bar zhi tshul zhes pa de'i steng nas go ba blangs te/ khyi la sogs pa'i gcan gzan rnams kyi gnyen por seng ge gtong la/ seng ge la seng ge rkang brgyad btang / de bzhin du sbrul sogs kyi gnyen por nam mkha' lding / rta la ma he/ ma he'i gnyen por bse ru la sogs te/ snang ba gang yin gyi dgra gang yin de dang sprad pas gnas 'byongs drag po min tsam la ni de rnams kyis sel cing / rdzas kyis sel ba gong gi gnas lte sogs su 'khyags pa'am/ sa 'og gi rdo 'khyags sam/ lcags byang ma 'khyags pa'am/ ga pur kyi chus gnas de nyid du byugs la/ grang lhang pa gnad nas ma zin bar du brlan/ des sel bar 'gyur ro/ /'khrul 'khor gyis sel ba gcig la/ rtsog pu la rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mchan khung gnyis por 'bol rdo khur tsam pa re re g.yas g.yon du bcug la/ de'i steng du bar lhu bcar byas la/ de'i steng nas ras kyi shag ma'am/ ska rags sam/ ther ma srab mos ran tsam bcings la/ de nas mig 'bras gyen du bzlog la lce rkan la sbyar ba'am gang bder bzhag 'pho ba sbyong pa bzhin hik 'don te tshod zin dgos/ nyi shu'am de lhag na'ang khams tshod dang sbyar la bya gsungs/ 'khrul 'khor gcig ni bka' rgyas btab ste zhal las shes pas 'dir ma bris so/

/de dag gis ni bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rgyun las 'byung ba'i sngon 'gro dang bcas pa'i thog mtha' bar dge'am khrid 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos bshad pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa de las 'phros pa'i legs bshad bstan pa ni snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang bu ston lo tsā ba chen po de nyid kyis/ zha lur khrid mo che gnang ba'i dus su khrid gnye ba rgyal ba mchog grub kyis zin bris su btab pa'i gegs sel kyi yi ge gnad dril bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de'ang / chos rje bu ston rin po ches/ gdul bya dus la babs pa na/ rgya bod hor gsum/ mnga' ris skor gsum la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la/ man ngag gi bka' sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid gsang 'dus rim lnga/ sems nyid ngal gso/ shin tu spros med/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ bde mchog rim lnga la sogs khrid mang po bskyangs/ khyad par khrid mo che'i lo/ sbyor drug pa dgu bcu/ gsang 'dus rim pa lnga bcu/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid pa sum cu tsam la khrid bskyangs pa'i thad du/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring rnams la nyams skye tshul/ mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba rnams dang / gegs kyi rigs byung pa rnams la rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas gegs sel gyi rim pa gang la gang 'tshams gsungs pa mtha' dag brjed pas 'jigs nas/ rags rim yi ger bkod pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ gegs kyi sel dang po ni/ thugs sras lo tsā bas/ chos rje'i drung du thugs dam zhus nas bsgom pa'i dus na/ sor sdud kyi thad du/ rtags bcu la sogs pa'i nyams snang shas che ba gcig rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ 'jam nyams dang rtsub nyams 'dres mar byung gsung / de'i rjes su gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar nas/ drod chen po byung zhing / de dus lam rim gyis sa'i thog mar dge ba'i nyams shar te/

nyams snang thams cad thugs la kha char bzhin 'bab pa'i snang ba dang / spyi bo nas byang chub kyi sems rdul phran tsam lus phyi nang thams cad la char pas gdungs pa bzhin snang ba byung / rlan che rab yod dam snyam nas lus la lag pas reg tsa na med pa dang / gang du reg kyang bde nyams che zhing / bde ba chen po 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba byung / de'i dus su/ dga' ba dang / mchog dga' dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rnams rim pa bzhin nyams su myong zhing / khams byang chub kyi sems rnams rdo rje'i rtsa bar 'dril zhing / rdo rje legs par rengs te/ rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu'i g.yas su byang chub kyi sems khreb khreb mthe bong tsam 'gar te/ de la reg mi bzod par bde ba'i zug rngu 'phar ba dang bcas pa byung / der bdag gis drung du zhus pas/ rdo rje gyen du langs pa de ni thog mar dge ba ste bya ba yin gsungs/ sbyor drug pa la thog mar dge ba'i nyams/ bar du dge ba'i nyams/ tha mar dge ba'i nyams zhes bya ba gsum yod pa'i thog mar dge ba'i nyams bya ba lus la shar ba yin te/ rab yin gsungs nas shin tu mnyes 'dug da de la 'khrul 'khor gyis drangs te gnas su skyel ba dang / lus la ma bkram na 'dzag pa'i nyen yod/ ma 'dzag na'ang der chu ser 'dril te/ rnag tu smin nas gegs su 'gyur srid pas 'khrul 'khor la gnad du bsnun dgos gsungs/ de la 'khrul 'khor gang gang bgyid lags zhus pas/ rlung sgo 'byed pa la gyen du 'dren pa gnyis/ gling bzhi bcud 'bebs kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyis gyen du drangs/ se gol mas rtsa gnas su 'grems pa rnams dgos te/ tsog pu pus brang bcas pa'i 'khrul 'khor thengs dgu bya/ rlung thub tshad du bya/ yang cung zhig ngal bso/ yang snga ma bzhin thengs dgu bya/ de nas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'dra ba la/ gan rkyal du byas te bum pa can 'dzin pa thengs dgu bya/

yang ngal gcig bso la bya/ de la gnyis kar gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khrul 'khor se gol ma byed pa yin gsung / de byed pa'i dus su rlung rang sor 'jog de ltar snga ma'i 'khrul 'khor tsog pu dang gan rkyal gnyis ni gyen du 'dren pa gtso bo yin la/ de'i rjes la se gol ma bco brgyad byed pa ni lus thams cad la khyab par 'grems pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin pas/ dal la dod pa snyugs bsrings la/ ngal bso yin byed gsungs/ de ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ drung gdan sa pa la zhus pas/ khong pas de rnams gnad du bsnun pas/ rdo rje sba ba sbubs su nub la khad du gyur/ 'bras bu'i sbo logs kyi thig le srom srom du skrangs pa de rnams kyang med par song gsungs/ de'i rjes nas khong pas thugs dam mdzad pas/ rdo rje me la srog zhugs pa bar du dge ba'i nyams dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams dpag tu med pa bshad kyis mi lang pa byung zhing / de rnams rin po che'i drung du zhib par zhus pas/ thugs sras pa nga la sngar bas kyang lhag par mnyes pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/ 'dir 'khrul 'khor gyi zhib cha rnams zhal las shes/ gegs sel gnyis pa ni/ yang dpon po naṃ chog pa la/ sor sdud bsgom pa'i thad du/ rkyen 'di las byung khong gis ngos ma zin par 'dug ste/ dge sbyor 'phel rab kyi skabs shig la/ tshig pa za ba sgom khang du sdod snying mi 'dod pa/ thon nas mdor phyin na steng du 'gro snying 'dod/ steng du phyin na/ sla yer 'gro snying 'dod pa byas pa'i sems 'tshub po byas pa gcig byung / der sems ma bde bar/ dge bshes bde legs rin chen rtsa na yod pas/ nga la 'di 'dra zhig byung ste/ 'di ci yin dris pas/ des ci yang mi sto/ byung rgyal du btang nas bsgoms pas chog zer/ der bsgoms pas kho je rtsog la song nas/ chu la snga dro re khrus re byed cing yod pas/ nam khrus re byed res sdangs nas 'chi ba ka 'dra byung zhing /

rin chen dpal yod tsa na/ sgom khang du 'gro tsa na/ sgom khang gi sgo gdangs nas mal sar lus gnad bcas zin pa dang / nye gnas rin chen dpal gyis sgo sdom dgos pa byung / nye gnas med tsa na sgo bsdams pa dang / sdod pa mnyam por ma byas na/ subs nas 'chi ba ka 'dra 'ong gin 'dug gsungs/ der bdag gis kha ning nas de 'dra'i gsung mi gda'/ gsung byung na kha ning du rin po che pa'i drung du zhu rgyu yin pa la byas pas/ kha sing de skad zer ba la dge bshes bde lags na re/ ci yang mi sto byung rgyal du btang pas chog zer nas des lan pa yin/ da 'di la ci phan nam/ drung du zhus gsungs nas/ der bdag gis drung du zhus pas chos rje'i zhal nas/ rlung 'thums 'dug pa gsungs/ da rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / rlung rang mal du 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / 'khrul 'khor rnam pa gnyis gnang nas/ der mgu tsher chu la khrus byas pas sngangs nas byung / der byung ma thag rlung ro bton/ cung zad ngal bso/ de nas rting 'bebs kyis phab/ de ltar 'thab cing bsal bas zhag gsum la phan no/ /'khrul 'khor ni zhal las shes so/ /gegs sel gsum pa ni/ yang dpon dge bshes bsam grub dpal mgon pas/ gsang 'dus rim lnga zhus nas sgom pa'i dus su/ dpon dge bshes pa na re/ bdag la 'di skad gsungs/ ngas dang po slob dpon ye shes dpal grub sogs grogs mched rnams kyis sbyor drug zhus pa'i dus ni/ khrid gnyer ba slob dpon dge slong shākya dpal bzhugs/ des dus su sngon la dge sbyor 'phel rab gcig byung pa yin te/ gting nas nyams rtsub rab 'ga' gcig kyang byung / ji 'dra gcig la nyams kyi snang ba la/ lcags kyi dra mig 'dra ba gcig gi nang na nags sub sub gru gsum lta bu gcig 'dug de'i dkyil na me bya mo'i sgo nga tsam dmar ril ba bzod par dka' ba gcig 'dug de skabs skabs su 'dar phril phril ldeg ldeg 'dug

de ci tsug gcig la 'phar ba dang sgra thog sgra dang bcas pa byung / des skrag nas dran med du yug gcig brgyal 'dug dran pa sad tsa na nga ga na yod par 'dug snyam pa gcig byung / der lag pas nom nom byas tsa na/ brlan ljag ljag gcig kyang 'dug der bsam mno btang pas/ sgom khang na yod par shes/ der ga ler langs nas sgo phye ste bltas pas/ tsha ba zos pa'i zas rnams bskyugs 'dug der g.yog po de slob dpon dge slong shākya dpal gdan 'dren du btang pas/ khong byon byung / der khong la nyams byung tshul rnams bshad/ skyugs pa tsho bstan pas/ khong na re/ rlung zhig yin yong byug pa gyis gsungs/ der nyi ma phyed yol gting du song ba'i stobs kyis/ rlung yin snyam nas byug pa byas/ de nas bsgoms pas yang da ci'i de byung nas mgo zi sgyi ri ri byung nas thog sgra dang bcas nas dran med du 'gyel/ dran pas zin tsa na zi sgyi ri ri 'dug de'i ngang la 'gyel gyis dogs nas/ lag pa gnyis sa la btsugs te rig pa ngar bskyed pas/ 'o le ma 'gyel so zin tsam byung ste/ bskyugs ma bskyugs bltas pas kyang dum gcig bskyugs 'dug der sgom la 'tsher ting nge song nas/ yang g.yog po de gdan 'dren btang pas byon byung ste/ lo rgyus rnams bsnyad pas/ rlung ma non pa yin yod/ skam po'i thug pa gcig thongs zer te gshegs song / der dgong mo de skam po'i thug pa gcig kyang btang / byug pa gcig kyang byas te/ de'i dgong mo bsgom pa 'tsher nas nyal bsdad/ nangs par nam langs tsa na yang / sgom blo gcig byas pas/ yang kho sngar bzhin byung / der g.yog po de slob dpon shākya dpal tsha ba la gdan 'dren par btang bas byon byung / tsha ba tshar ba dang / da khyed dpon slob la gegs sel de las med pa yin na/ da 'di sgom du mi btub pa 'dra/ mdang skam po'i thug pa btang byug pa byas nas kyang ma phan da 'di la ci byas na drag byas pas/

da gzhan bya rgyu med ma bsgom par bskor ba 'dra gyis/ yengs su chug zer nas khyed ri phug pa la gegs bsal rgyu ni mi 'dug da res kyang dang po'i de 'dra yong na ni bsgom du mi btub pa 'dra/ dang po'i de da yong ngam mi yong zer/ de sgom 'phro la byung bar 'dug pas/ da rung yong byas pas/ kyag pa 'o na da ci drag gam/ de la thabs 'dra med dam zer/ de khong rang gis 'phrang byung byung sgugs la/ de nas rin po che pa'i drung du zhu dgos byas pas/ dang po'ang bya rgyu mi 'dug pa'i da rung bya rgyu byung dogs med zer byung / de bdag gis/ de dus su slob dpon shākya dpal gyis rang bzos mdzad nas/ chos rje'i drung du ma zhus pas lan pa yin/ zhus na rin po che pa rang la 'di la 'di mdzad kyi phyag len zhal ta gcig 'ong ste/ ma zhus pas lan pa yin byas pas/ 'o na de dus su man ngag tsho bsdams nas ci bya rgyu yod pa zer byung / der bdag gis/ da gang yin kyang nyid cag rang sgoms shig bdag gis drung du rgyu mtshan zhus la 'ong gis byas nas drung du phyin te/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ de rtsa na ma thos te/ 'phrang de da rung yong gsungs/ de byung dus su man ngag 'di 'dra byed dgos gsungs zhal lta byung / der bsgoms nas zhag gnyis song tsa na/ kha ning gi de byung bas shog dang zer byung / der bdag gis phyin pas/ kho byung pas/ da gang byed zer byung pa la/ chos rje'i man ngag 'khrul 'khor gling bzhi bcud 'bebs su 'gro ba'i 'grems bstan pas/ der zhag drug tsam 'gyangs nas ma byung / der khong gis bla chos byas te 'khrul 'khor ma byas par bsgoms pas/ yang sngar bzhin byung / de la yang sngar gyi 'khrul 'khor bzhin du/ bcun du bcug pas skyon de las grol lo/ /de nas dpon dge bshes na re man ngag 'di 'dra 'dug pa la/ gdam ngag rnams mi ster bar rul du bcug nas ci byed/ ban rgan da gegs mi sel bar 'dug zer ba'i grags pa 'di 'dra gcig sgres rgan 'dis byas nas/

gzhan tsho ni/ khyed kyis bla ma mang po la man ngag sna tshogs zhus pa yin zer gyin 'dug zer byung / bdag gis chos rje rin po che dang / bla ma mgon po dpal ba dang / smon mkhar ba bla ma grags byang gsum po ka las bsten pa med de/ man ngag 'di tsho'i gnad la/ rin po che rang bka' drin che ba yin pas/ man ngag rnams rul du ma bcug par spel nas gzhan la byin na yong zer byung / sngar gegs sel yod pa'i skad rang mi 'dug da'am gcig yod pa yin nam zer byung / khong rang gegs des gnyen po byung pa'i rgyu mtshan des gegs ni ri phug pas mi sel/ gegs sel la log skyog pa'i dge slong rin rdor 'bod snyam pa gcig byung yod 'dug khong gis phag nas dge slong rin rdor la yi ge'ang bskur yod par 'dug ste/ khong byung na kha skyengs gcig btang dgos pa yin te/ tshig sngon la ma thos pas lan/ phyis da lan gyi de tsho'i gsung gleng dang byung yod par 'dug ste/ de 'dra'i nyams kyi snang ba ci yin nam ma shes/ nged kyi 'di ru de 'dra yong ma myong zer byung lo/ /'di'i gegs sel gyi gnad rnams zhal las shes/ dmar khrid lag len la ltos/ gegs sel bzhi pa ni/ yang de'i res dpon chen mo smon 'gro bas/ sbyor drug zhus pa'i dus su/ shes pa rgod/ nyams snang la rlung tshub chen po byas/ mdun rgyab brgyangs mig dmar por song / snga dro snga dro lces snyil gyi rtsa ba mchu lcibs byas pa dang / snyil gyi rtsa ba rnams chad pa'i bsrubs na tshur khrag smug nag mang po thon nas snga dro bzhin khrag rul skyur dgos pa byung / sngas mgo lud pas dmar chab la btang / srod la phyi mo thug gnyid ma phebs pa byung / de rin po che pa'i drung du zhus pas/ rlung gi rlung nyams bya ba yin/ de'i steng du 'phyur pa'i skyon gcig byung yang byung ba yin gsungs/ de la nyi ma stod 'bebs kyis phob/ rlung gsang rnams 'thebs par bstems la phob/

phab pa'i rjes su/ dgong mo skam po'i thug pa thongs/ byug pa gyis kha nad bzhin snyil chad yong pa de la a ru ra sha chen bzang po gcig zhib par brdungs/ de'i zla la spyi shul/ mtshal dkar snon la sbrang dang sbyor la lcags skyong nang du snag tsha bzhin du song song za ru chug de rang gi dri chu grang mo ran tsam la snur la snga dro tho rangs kha ru yun ring du gzung la/ yun ring po song ba dang pho la btang / de snga dro bzhin byas pas snyil chad pa rnams sos shing kha nang gi nad de la phan no gsungs/ de ltar byas pas khong gi skyon de las grol lo/ /gegs sel lnga pa ni/ yang khong gi sras po de la'ang mdun rgyab gzer/ dang kha mi bde nas/ shes pa yer ba la/ drung du zhus pas/ stod 'bebs kyis phob/ byug pa gyis/ rkang pa bskyed pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis gsungs pa la/ de la stod gnon 'khrul 'khor rang gi de ltar gnad du bsnun pas skyon las grol lo/ /gegs sel drug pa ni/ yang khong gi g.yog po dpon bzang zer ba gcig la mgo bo na/ mdun rgyab gzer lus 'khrum gzer khyer ba byung / de dus su khong pa dpon g.yog gsum pos gegs byung gis dogs nas/ bla ma bsod she ba gdan drangs te/ dpon smon 'gro ba dang khong rnams stabs na yod pa la/ khong gsum po'i gegs la/ khong gis bsal ba'i thabs ma shes shing / khyad par du dpon bzang na ba la/ khong pas cham par bzung nas/ lto bkug nas zhag gcig bzhag 'dug der bdag 'tshol du btang bas ma rnyed/ phyis rting 'khrid pa bskor du phyin pa'i dus su/ kho la kha sang nas 'di 'dra byung zer/ de rnams drung du zhus pas rlung re 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / rlung 'don par stabs gcig par bcun gsungs/ des mkhris rlung langs par yong gsungs/ mkhris gsang gi 'tshog ma nas skra thogs/ des ma phan na dbyug pa rgyobs gsungs/ de ltar zhal lta bzhin rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang /

rlung 'bud pa'i sbyor ba byas pa dang / mgo bo na ba de lhag par zug che ba gcig byung / mi phan par na ru 'gro ba 'dra zer/ a'u ci'i/ da rung snying rus bskyed la 'bungs byas pas/ der yug pa gcig nas 'tshog ma nas/ skra btogs pas 'tshog seng dbye mi dgos par phan song / der lto bkug na mi yong pas skam po'i thug pa btang / byug pa byas pas/ der bla ma bsod shi'i gsung nas/ nged kyi bsam pa la cham pa yin nam snyam pa byung pa yin te/ mkhris rlung la'ang de 'dra'i na lugs yong ba 'dug a zer byung / de 'dra'i gegs sel lhan thabs 'dra yod de/ yod na nged 'dri ba yin te zer byung / nged la mi bdog byas/ dpon rgyal po dpal na re/ lha rje'i sman la'ang / sman 'ju long dgos kyi 'dug ste khyed kyi 'di tsho la sman 'ju ba'i yun tsam yang mi dgos par phan gyin 'dug zer/ de lta bu'i man ngag rnams la/ nad ngos 'dzin pa dang / khams ris shes pa dang / gnad nas zin pa rnams gal che ba yin no gsungs pa/ 'di rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad zhib par zhal las shes so/ /gegs sel bdun pa ni/ yang dpon dpal ldan bzang pos sbyor drug zhus dus/ sor sdud kyi thad du/ ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba'i thad nas/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya rang gis rtsol ba byas pa min par/ dbu mar rlung tshud pa'i stobs kyis rtsa gnad kyi rten 'brel gyis lag pa mnyam gzhag de nyid dang po ca bteg tsam mang dag tu byung / de nas bteg bteg song ste pho ba'i thad tsam du phyin/ yang mar rim gyis babs te mnyam gzhag la gnas/ yang bteg bteg byung ste mthe bong gnyis thur du bstan/ lag pa'i rgyab steng du bstan pa de rim gyis spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkha' la khyer te/ de nas yang mdun gyi nam mkha' la mar ga le babs nas mnyam gzhag la gnas/ yang bteg bteg bteg byung ste/ spyi bo'i steng gi bar snang las/ yang rim gyis babs te mnyam gzhag la gnas/

de lta bu rang gis rtsol ba ma byas kyang / lag pa'i mnyam gzhag 'du byed khor ro ro 'khor ba de rgyun ma chad pa byung / der 'di skyon can yin nam min nam snyam nas g.yog po 'bod du byung pa la bdag gis phyin pas/ der gong gi lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di 'dra ba byung nas mnyam gzhag la cung zad gnod cing 'dug 'di skyon can yin nam men zer byung pa la/ bdag gis mdo ru bton nas/ mnyam gzhag bcas te bsgom du bcug pas lag pa'i mnyam gzhag de gong du bshad pa bzhin 'khor cing 'dug der nyi ma dro ba tsam gyi dus yin pas/ bdag gis drung du phyin nas/ dpon bzang la gong du bshad pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams byung pa zhus pas/ da lan la 'khrul 'khor yong pa dang mnyam sor sgra rings kyi sbyor ba 'di tshugs la ji 'dra yong ltos/ des phan yong gsungs/ nyams kyi skye tshul rgod bro/ rgod bro ba'i rnam 'gyur yin gsungs nas bzhad/ der bdag gis mar phyin nas/ khong sgom khang nas bton te bsgom du bcug pas mnyam gzhag gi 'khrul 'khor sngar bzhin byung / der lus gnad bshig nas/ rig pa hur thon la nga'i 'di bzhin gyis gcig byas te/ bdag gis lus gnad bcas nas rdul mtha' can gyi rlung sbyor byas te/ da mnyam gzhag gi 'khrul 'khor yong 'dod pa dang / 'khrul 'khor 'di bzhin gyis byas pas sems mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la thing song pa dang mnyam gzhag gi 'khrul 'khor mgo btsugs byung / der rdul mtha' can gyi rlung sbyor byas/ de ka la mnyam gzhag 'degs 'phro de lhan gyi la song / der rdul mtha' can gyi rlung sbyor de byas pas/ nyi ma'i grib ma mtho gang tsam song pa dang / mnyam gzhag gi 'khrul 'khor de chad thal/ gegs sel brgyad pa ni/ de nas yang khong gis dbyar po de bsam gtan zhus pa'i dus su/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ thog mar/ snang ba thams cad skya ding rtser shar/ de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas lta stangs kyi thad ka rang der 'od dkar po gcig dbyibs gru gsum/

res gru bzhi/ res sgor mo 'char cing / de'i ngang du yal/ yang de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas/ me lta bu'i 'od gsal lag mgo tsam pa'am/ la la cung zad leb na re ba'i rnam pa skud pa la phreng pa brgyus pa lta bu/ de'i sna mo g.yas g.yon du zug pa/ 'od 'phro ba/ mdun du me 'od gru bzhi'i rnam par snang ba/ de'i ngang la bzhag pas/ mdun nas g.yas yo tsam du/ me ser skya'i rnam pa 'phrod la ring thung khru gang lhag tsam/ dbyibs gru bzhi'i rnam pa byung / de'i ngang la bzhag pas/ gong gi 'od skya ding pa cung zad dwangs par song nas/ nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu la skar ma dang bcas pa lta bu/ de'i ngang la bzhag pas/ lta stangs kyi thad der/ thig le nag po la mtha' dkar por byas pa snang / de'i ngang la de'i mdun du/ snang ba dkar po leb pe ba la bal 'dab kyi rnam pa lta bu gnyis bsgrigs te zur leg leg byed par snang / de la bzhag pas/ 'od bal 'dab lta bu'i bar nas mas shar 'od dkar po phra sbom mthe chung tsam la mtho re tsam de dang dus mnyam du/ dpral ba'i thad nas yang 'od ring thung sbom phra de tsam zhig snang la/ de gnyis ma phrad tsam snang / de'i ngang la bzhag pas/ de thams cad 'dres te/ dkar po de sngar bas mi gsal bar snang ba de phru ma tsam gyi dkar mi dkar de la bzhag pas g.yas g.yon nas 'od dkar po smyug ma tsam pa gnyis byung / spyi bor sna rtse phrad nas/ mdun gyi dkar po phru ma lta bu de chu'i gnyer ma ltar du 'od dkar po smyug ma tsam de la g.yas g.yon rnams su rim par thim pas 'od skor de rang la zhwa lta bu gon pa'i rnam pa la/ 'od skor de je cher song / gur phub pa ltar kho'i nang du tshud par snang / de'i ngang la sems gsal zhing bde stong du snang / de'i ngang la bzhag pas khog pa'i nang gi rlung rnams 'phrog cing / gyen du cung zad 'byung ba'i rnam pa dang bcas nas/ sgyu ma dang pho ba 'phrog pa byung /

de nas pus mo'i lha nga nas brla sbom phra can la yar la grang sib byung / der rjes rkang sen lag sen gyi mdzub mo sgye rgu sgye rgu byung / de dang dus mtshungs par thig le rlung dang bcas pa'i bde ba dang bcas pas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo nas rim par bde ba dang bcas nas lte ba thug rgyu zhing / de nyid du bde ba'ang cher 'phel/ der rting pus mo gnyis re mos su yar 'degs pa byung / de rjes sngar gyi lte ba'i thig le dang rlung gi rnam pa cung zhig lte bar bsdad de/ de nas rlung gi rnam par gyen rgyu dang 'grogs te/ mgrin pa thug phyin/ de nas gyen rgyu dang 'grogs pa'i rlung gcig phyir 'gro rgyu gcig dang mnyam du lus kyang dpung pa nas dma' zhong gis 'gro zhing thad kar shig ste 'gro ba byung / stod du bsnyong zhing / mgo bo yang ljog ljog cung zad dang bcas pa byung / de dang mnyam por mgrin pa nas rgyab gyes su rlung gcig mar 'gro ba'i snang ba dang / de dang dus mnyam du lus kyang dpung pa nas dma' zhong gis 'gro zhing thad kar shig te 'gro ba byung / der rjes mgo cung zad 'dar ba byung / der rjes la 'jigs tshub pa zhig byung / der rjes mgo bo dang 'jing pa bsgyur zhing / saṃ skri ta'i skad lta bu sna tshogs lab pa la/ de'i bar thams cad la snang stong bde gsal gyi nyams dang mi 'bral bar gnas so/ /de'i ngang nas lus 'dar zhing mdun du ljog ljog pa byung ngo / /de'i ngang la bzhag pas/ sor re tsam spar spar 'phar ba byung / de nas je drag la 'phar ba khru re tsam/ de rjes la lang nge nyal le sems ma zin na ma zin/ zin na mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par 'phar ba byung ngo / /de ni rlung dang thig le gcig char du dbu ma'i ma sna nas tshud pa yin gsungs/ de la sgra rings byas pas dang po ji ltar byung ba bzhin du log nas song ste/ rlung sbyor de kas sel lo/ /de'ang kho langs byung byung lta stangs la bcun gyin bsgom/

langs byung pa dang lus gnad de ma 'chugs par byas nas/ sgra rings byas te lta stangs smad pas sel lo/ /de'i rjes la'ang langs byung ste/ de la'ang snga ma dang mi 'dra bar dang po rgyu ma 'khrog cing gyen du 'gro ba sngar dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas g.yon na yar cha mnyam du 'gro ba byung / de nas gzer gcig gi ma sna mkhal steng yas sna rtsibs chung sgrol tsam du gzer hrings hrings pa gcig byung zhing / nu ma'i thad du slebs pa dang g.yon phyogs kyi nu ma'i thad nas gzer gcig gyen bsigs la mtho gang tsam pa'i gnas de la rang sar tsha hrings pa re byung / de nas gsus pa sgal pa la car te 'gro ba dang mnyam par dpung pa gnyis stod du zengs pa/ mgo rgu ba/ mjing pa hring pa byung / de nas mgo bskur g.yas dang g.yon du byed pa byung / de nas sems nyams la pus mo gnyis po mdun du je nye je byas/ gnyis po phrad de gcig la gcig 'byar nas zhu ba snyam pa'i nyams snang byung / de nas dpung pa g.yas kyi phyir bskor ba bcu gcig dang ldeg ldeg pa gcig byas/ yang dpung pa g.yon gyis bcu gcig de'i ngang nas lus thams cad bca' gzhi nas 'degs pa'i snang ba byung / de nas lus g.yas g.yon leg leg pa dril bu bsil ba'i lce lta bu byung / de nas de cher gyur te/ pus mo g.yas nas mgo brtsams nas/ pus mo gnyis mtho lding dma' lding re mos byed pa byung / de nas pus mo gnyis ka gyen du btegs nas/ yang sa la cabs rtse 'jog pa gcig byung / pus mo g.yas sa la lcab lcab pa gsum byed/ de bzhin g.yon pa la'ang byed pa byung / de nas lus g.yas g.yon du gcu zhing phyir 'gros khru gang / de bzhin nang du yang khru gang de'i ngang nas phyir 'gyel la khad pa gcig de nas rkang pa gnyis bskyod pa dang mnyam por phyir 'gyel/ yang mgo bteg pa gcig byas/ yang 'gyel/ yang de'i ngang nas kha g.yas su gcu/ g.yon du gcu/ de'i ngang nas g.yon phyogs su hril 'dril te/

rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum/ lag pa mnyam gzhag de ltag par bkab/ de bzhin du g.yas su hril 'gyur zhing / rkang pa g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums/ mnyam gzhag de ltag par bkab/ de nas tsog langs te sngar gyi skyil krung du gnas pa'i ngang nas yang rkang pa g.yas pa brkyangs nas g.yas su rkang pa sdig sdig bzhi/ yang rting pa sa la 'drud pa dang mnyam por g.yon du phyin/ de thug thug bzhi/ de cog 'dra ba rkang pa g.yon pas byed pa byung / de'i ngang la rkang pa g.yas brkyangs pa'i ngang nas lag pa mnyam gzhag gi ngang du yob nang rkang pa bcug pa bzhin byed/ de nas rkang pa g.yas bkug brla steng bzhag yang bshig yang bzhag yang bshig de bzhin g.yon pas kyang byed/ de nas mnyam gzhag de pus mo g.yas g.yon du res 'jog de nas sbo g.yas su khyer/ g.yon du khyer/ de nas snying khar bskor/ de nas pad skor byed pa sogs 'ga' zhig byung / de nas kyang rgyun mi 'chad na'ang / bdag gis zhog byas pas/ de'i ngang dang rjes thog pa sems nyams ji 'dra 'byung gin 'dug dris pas/ de'i ngang thams cad du rig pa ngar che la rnam rtog mi 'phro/ cung zad 'phro ba byung na'ang rnam rtog dang / nyams rnams rlung gis gyen du khyer ba lta bu dpral ba'i thad na yar yal 'gro yi 'dug zer/ lus nyams bshigs pa'i rjes la sems skyo phyed pa/ mgo na ding pa gcig 'dug zer/ kho langs pa'i gnas skabs su/ rlung g.yas g.yon bsdus te dbu mar 'dus dus mtshul pa legs par bsdams shing / phan du 'gro ba'i gnas skabs su/ bsdams pa de nyid kha rlangs gyen du 'thul ba lta bu rnam rtog dang bcas pa dpral ba'i thad na yar mdongs lta bu'i rnam par bun gyen du 'gro ba dang mnyam por bde ba gsal ba'i snang ba dang sang nge ba byung zer/ de nas bdag gis drung du phyin nas gnas lugs zhus pas/ de la 'dren pa za ra tshags kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis gsungs nas/ lta stangs phab ste 'thab kyin bsgoms pas phan pa byung ngo /

/gegs sel dgu ba ni/ yang shangs pa'i swi tu dbon po la/ mgo dang ro stod na/ tshig pa za/ mig tsha/ sgom mi 'dod pa byung / de la stod gnon gyi 'khrul 'khor dang / rkang pa'i thor to nas bzung pa'i 'khrul 'khor bslabs pas ma phan par drung du zhus pas/ rlung ro 'thums 'dug pas/ rkang pa'i thor to nas bzung pa la/ rlung ma 'dzin gsungs/ rdo rje gtun brdungs kyi 'khrul 'khor byas/ de nas snga ma'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas sor tshud do/ /gegs sel bcu pa ni/ slob dpon rgyal thang pa la/ brang gi mdun rgyab gzer/ ro stod brgyangs/ gnyid yer/ dbugs thag thung / dang kha med pa la drung du zhus pas/ nyi ma stod gnon gyis phob gsungs/ phab pas ma phebs par/ yang zhus pas/ 'bol to chings byas pa'i ngang la dbyug pa dkar nag mtshams la gyis gsungs/ de nas rdo rje gtun brdungs kyis/ des phan gyis gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan bad rlung gnyis bsgrags pa yin gsungs/ dbyug pa byas pas bad kan dang rlung gi rlangs de 'thon nas/ gzod phan 'gro ba yin gsungs/ gegs sel bcu gcig pa ni/ yang kad shid lung pa dpon slob bcu tsam gnas khang gcig na yod pa'i gcig la/ sor sdud kyi thad du/ rtags bcu la sogs pa'i nyams rnams 'phel rab byas pa'i ngang nas/ stong gzugs rnams 'khor zhing gyen du 'gro ba dang / drod rkang mthil nas bsdus nas byung pa la/ grogs mched rnams kyis 'dza' ti chang sbyar dang / skam po'i thug pa btang pas/ 'thung pa ma byung par so khrig ste song nas lus pa la/ der bya thabs zad de/ bdag 'bod du byung ba la/ chos rje'i zhal gdams sngar na yod kyang 'tsher te/ 'on kyang gdams pa gzhan gnang srid snyam nas/ nga yong gis/ khyed rang bzhud byas pas/ da tsam shi yong / la'u 'deng zer byung / der khyed rang rgyugs shig byas nas/ chos rje'i drung du phyin nas/ shid lung pa la sror sdud kyis 'gags byung nas/ thug pa 'thung sa ma byung par/

phyi dbugs song ngam zer gyin gda'/ ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas sor sdud kyi gegs kyis shi 'dug snyam pa la sos pa yong ba yin te/ blo zhib la blangs nas/ mig lpags glog nas mig 'bras gyen la log ste song na 'tsho srid/ mar babs na mi sos gsungs/ 'on kyang da res ci yang mi lto yong gis/ mgyogs par chas la rlung gsang gi sgo rnams bstams/ mdun rgyab stod gnon gyis phob/ sgal tshigs dang po nas bzung la bcu drug mdo thug 'dzog gis brdungs gsungs/ der bdag gis phyin pas kho dbugs song nas mi 'dug bdag gis bsur dud gcig btang / rlung gsang rnams bstams/ spyi gtsug nas bzung ste sgal tshigs rnams bcu drug mdo thug rim gyis brdungs/ yang stod gnon gyis phab/ rlung gsang rnams bstams/ rkang mthil brdungs/ mjug to'i tog tog brdungs pas dbugs cung zad cig byung / mig kyang hur te byung / der thug pa tshan mo gcig skol shog byas/ de bskol ba'i bar la yang / spyi bor thal lcag brgyab/ an tong dang po nas tshigs pa dang po'i bar 'dzog gis brdungs/ gyen rgyu gnad dbab/ yang an tong dang po nas mjug to'i bar brdungs pas/ cung zad lab pa yong tsam byung / de nas skam po'i thug pa blud/ de'i bar la chos rje'i drung du phyin pas/ chos rje'i gsung gis 'bebs chen gyis phob la/ skam po'i thug pa da rung lhud/ cung zad ngal bso ba yang 'bebs chen re gyis de 'dra re mos gyis la/ de nas byug pa gyis gsungs/ phab pa'i rjes la rkang mthil la dug gyis gsungs/ de nas yar phyin/ skam po'i thug pa blud/ 'phar chen gyis phab/ cung zad ngal bso 'dza' ti chang sbyar btang / yang 'phar chen gyis phab pas srod chil rting pa sor chud do/ /gegs sel bcu gnyis pa ni/ yang rdza pa'i bu grags bzang la/ sor sdud kyi thad du/ nyams rtsub po/ mthong snang la/ spre'u chen po dang /

zhum po ngar ba dang / dpung pa'i steng du bya pho dkar po skad 'don pa la sogs pa byung nas/ des rkyen byas te/ tshig pa za/ snying mi dga'/ sems gnas su ma 'dod de/ tshig pa za nas steng du phyin pas/ ka bzhi pa seng rgyal yi ge 'bri yin 'dug rla'o 'dra zer ram snyam na/ ci yang mi zer bar skad cag 'dug pas/ des slar tshig pa za ru song nas/ ting phor cig bcag 'dug de'i tho la pu shu nas rdo blangs te/ rgyas skar la nang nas brgyab pas/ rgyas skar phyir 'phir/ de ston pa kun shes mthong ste/ bdag 'bum steng na skor ba byed kyin yod pa la/ 'bod kyi 'dug nas/ ci dgos byas pas/ grags bzang kho ya ki na chob byed kyin 'dug pas/ lta ru rgyugs zer der brang khang du bltar phyin pas/ brang khang na dge bshes dbus pa gcig dang / dka' bzhi pa seng rgyal gnyis 'dug der dka' bzhi pa la grags bzang la ci byung dris pas/ ci byung pa yin nam ting 'phor dang / po ti tsho sdeb kyin 'dug zer/ der khyed khrid g.yog la bzhag pa min nam byas pas/ skad cag bsdad 'dug der grags bzang gi rtsar phyin nas/ ci byung gang byung rgyu mtshan dris pas/ skyag pa rgyus yod/ mkhan chen gdan sa pas nga la a tho byas pa med/ wa mar po/ zer cing gyang logs thams cad 'dzog gis brdungs/ der bdag gis/ kho'i ro stod nas bzung nas/ de 'dra ma byed/ ci byung dris pas/ khyed kyis ma go ba yin/ phar rgyugs zer nas ro stod sprug tu byung pa la/ ma go bas ka 'dri ba yin/ gang 'dra gcig byung shod byas pas yang khyod kyis ma go zer nas ro stod sprug tu byung / yang ro stod sbring gis bzung ste/ khas spyang byas nas dris pas/ nga chung chung nas mkhan chen gdan sa pas bskyangs pa yin pa la/ na ning ston pa dngos grub mgon la bu len brdo yin yod pa brdas pas/ kho mi 'jam gyi kha la kha stong du byung 'thab mo shor nas/ nga la mkhan chen pas mang ja bkal/

kho'i phyogs byas nas nga la a to ma byas kyi steng du/ da nga gsod pa yin zer nas/ khrab can bdun sgo 'gug na slebs 'dug wa mar po/ skyag pa nga zer nas brang brdungs so/ /der bdag gis/ khyed bden/ de rin po che pas kyang gsan nas/ de lta ru rgyugs gsungs nas btang pa yin/ 'o rang gnyis po dpung gzhibs nas 'thabs pas chog gis/ 'o cag gis ma thub na/ bla brang nas nye gnas shākya dpal la sogs pa rogs btang gis gsung gi 'dug de min 'thab dgos pa mi yong gis/ lhod glod la nga la nyon byas pas/ kho na re/ 'o na rang re gnyis rgyug pa khur 'thab tu 'deng zer byung pa la/ sngon la nga ro stod na'i 'dug 'di la khyod kyis 'khrul 'khor gcig byas na nga la phan par 'dug de nas rang re gnyis phyin pas chog byas pas/ khyod ro stod na ba la ngas 'khrul 'khor byas pas ci la phan zer byung / de rten 'brel gyi dgra grogs brtsis pas khyod kyis 'khrul 'khor byas na nga la phan par 'dug byas pas/ ngas byas pas chog khyed la phan na bya'i zer/ 'o na 'khrul 'khor 'di gyis la ha then gcig byas te/ 'khrab cing ha 'don pa bslabs pas/ glags che che ma 'dra/ der kho na re/ ji tshod phan zer/ tsa bde ru song ste da rung na bas/ khyed kyis da rung ha thon la 'khrobs byas pas/ khos ha drag po bton te 'khrabs so/ /yang da ci 'dra 'dug zer te/ de'i bar la pha ka de na dpe cha gcig 'dug pa de blangs nas/ skyag pa kha gzhang zer nas dpe cha de la lces ldag byas so/ /der bdag gis kho la/ nga la phan pa byed na da rung 'khrul 'khor gnad du thongs byas pas/ was zer nas/ ha 'don cing 'khrab kyin 'dug go /de'i bar la shad de phyir la thon nas/ sgo la bskor log bcug ste/ drung du phyin nas/ grags bzang la 'di 'dra byung / bdag gis 'di 'dra bgyis zhus pas/ da grogs gnyis g.yobs la rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ de'ang khams bzang na/

snga dro phyi dro bzhi bzhi ste nyin re la brgyad thongs gsungs/ de la bdag gis/ bla ma zla seng ba nyi ma re la re re las med/ de'ang snga skad phyi skad gang rung re byed zer lags zhus pas/ de la nges pa med/ nad pa de zungs bzang ngan dang / rlung shas che chung dang / 'thums che chung dang / rgan gzhon dang / nam la'i dus tshod rnams shes par byed pa gal che gsungs/ der grogs la ston pa kun shes bos nas/ der da ci nas 'khrul 'khor 'dra phog pa yin te/ phan phan mi 'dra/ da khyod kyis rogs gcig byas nas steng du 'khrul 'khor gcig byed dgos par 'dug byas te/ nang du phyin tsa na/ grags bzang kho na re/ da skyag pa 'thab tu 'gro zer 'thab tu 'gro ba la lham gon dgos par 'dug pas steng du 'deng byas nas/ yar la kha drangs te steng du slebs pa dang / mdun 'di ru skyil krung gcig chos dang byas nas/ khong gsum po kho'i dpung pa gnyis nas 'dzin du bcug nas/ rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas/ 'khrul 'khor snga ma la kho hud de shor nas/ khong gsum gyis ma thub pa la/ de 'dra ma byed par rig pa khrims gyis la zungs byas pas/ khong rnams kyis bzung / yang rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas/ kho dran med du dum gcig song 'dug ste/ de nas kho dran pa rnyed nas da ci'i rig pa'i ngar de chag nas/ gnyid sad pa bzhin du byas te/ 'am bu la ci byung pa gda'i dba' zer byung / bdag gis ci yang ma byung gis bya tsa na/ ston pa kun shes/ smyon gegs ci byung rang yin zer gyin 'dug der ston pa la de 'dra ma byed byas pas/ der kho mal du khyug te nyal song / nag thug yos la sbyin nam byas pas/ gsus pa ltogs pa mi gda' 'am bu nyal nas bsdad lags zer te nyal song / der bdag gis/ ston pa kun shes la/ khams 'dus pa'i bya ba yin mod/ sems gso dgos pa la nangs par nas de 'dra ma 'thabs shig byas/

de tsam na bla ma rdza bas kyang slebs byung nas/ da nyid shes/ kho'i nad 'di la phan pa gcig gyis la blang zer/ der de nub bdag gis ma bsdad par/ nad pa nya ra gyis byas nas/ de'i nub mo drung du phyin te/ de ring byung lugs 'di byung / sang ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ snying dkar nag mtshams la dbyug pa gyis gsungs/ sang phyin te/ mdang nad pa gnyid che'am byas pas/ gnyid chen po 'dug zer/ der nyin mo khrid pa rnams la skad gtong dgos pa yod pa dang / grags bzang la'ang dbyug pa gcig brdeg dgos pas snga bar phyin te/ dkar nag mtshams su dbyug pa brgyab/ ston pa kun shes la de ring nad pa nya ra gyis byas/ de'i nyin mo dge tsha'ang yod pas/ bdag gis khrid pa rnams la skad gtong du phyin/ ston pa kun shes/ kho ri sgang der khrid 'dug pas/ grib rkyen lta bus/ yang kho'i khams 'dus de langs nas/ ston pa'i lag nas shor nas/ gom pa bdun tsam shor ba dang / ston pas zin/ de ma zin na tsha tsha 'debs mi rnams la rdo char byed par 'dug de nas nang du khrid byung pa dang / khos kyang khrid pa rnams la skad gtong pa thos nas/ khrid pa rnams la skad gtong gi 'dug nga yang do red chos la 'gro zer byung pa la/ bdag gis drung du zhus pas/ khos ma thos na dga' ba yin te/ da kho la shog ma byas na khams de tsog tu 'gro/ spyir yang / khams 'dus pa rnams la kho rang gi blo dang mthun pa'i gtam dang / khams gso ba yin/ gong gi de bzhin du brdzun byas nas kyang khams gsos su 'gro ba gcig dgos gsungs/ bdag gis phyin pas chog gis byas nas/ sngon la 'khrul 'khor gcig bya dgos byas nas rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi tsam byas so/ /de nas bdag gis sngon la phyin te/ ston pa la kho khrid la shog byas/ de nas bdag gis phar phyin nas 'khar rnga brdungs pas/ khrid pa gtso thams cad 'tshogs byung / der ston pa kun shes yod dam bltas pas mi 'dug

der ston pa btsal nas grags bzang gar song dris pas/ seng rgyal la bcol zer/ seng rgyal la dris pas lha khang nang du song zer/ des chob byas kyi dogs nas/ khyed nya ra mi byed pa byas nas 'thabs pas/ gcig na re nang na grogs mched gcig yod zer/ de nas sgo brdungs pas nye gnas rin skyabs thon byung nas/ 'a rdzi de ni shes pa 'gyur 'dug go zer/ der kho la chos la shog byas pas byung / der maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ chos nyan cing yod 'phro la/ kho'i mdun na dge bsnyen lhun bzang yod pas/ de'i mjing pa la 'jog brdeg tshad byung pa la/ bdag gis kho'i gos nas 'then nas/ rin po che pas bka' bkyon yong ngo zhes brda byas pas bskum ste song / yang kho brdeg gi mno ba la/ gos nas 'then nas sngar bzhin brda byas pas bskum tsam song / de ltar chos nyan pa'i bar thams cad de ka byed dgos pa byung / de nas chos nyan byin po grol/ kho la byin brlabs cig drung du zhus pas/ byin rlabs nan che ba zhig mdzad nas mar yong pas/ skras pa gong ma la mchong ma stabs su babs song / bdag gis kyang shul na mar mchong ma stabs su phyin te/ 'og tu zin nam snyam tsa na ma zin/ yang 'og gi skras pa de la mchong ma stabs su song na/ khos mi la gnad par byas kyi dogs nas/ bdag gis kyang mchong ma stabs su phyin no/ /der kho nag tshang rnying pa na yar song nas sgo bcad byung / der sgo phul nas/ der khyod ci byed/ shog byas pas byung nas skras pa 'og ma de la yang mchong ma stabs su song pas/ gzhan la gnad yar chen po byed snyam tsa na/ ston pa kun shes dang / nye gnas bsod grub gnyis kyis bug sgo'i rtsar kho bsgugs nas bzung 'dug der kho'i lus po phyam rtses gril te khrid phyin rtsa na phyam rtse'i 'og nas lag pa bton nas rngo btus te/ lam na yod pa'i mi rnams la brdeg pa'i snang ba sha stag byed/ der nang du slebs/ rlung ro 'ga' zhig bton pas zhi nyal te song /

der mchod pa zhig byin nas/ bdag gis grwa khang du nyal du phyin/ sang yang 'ongs nas/ snga skad 'khrul 'khor bzhi bzhi/ phyi skad bzhi bzhi byas pas/ zhag gsum nas rlung khams sor tshud byung ngo / /gegs sel bcu gsum pa ni/ yang shangs pa gcig la/ ro stod na/ shugs ring mang / mchin pa dang rgyu ma dang pho ba rnams na/ gnyid mi phebs pa byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ rlung gi lam sbyongs gsungs nas/ ha'i dmigs pa gnang / zhag 'ga' ha bton/ de nas rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / ha spel nas byas pas zhag drug la ni sor tshud do/ /gegs sel bcu bzhi pa ni/ yang dge bshes rin tshul la sems mi dga'/ dang kha 'gags pa byung pa la drung du zhus pas/ yun ring rab kyang song 'dug pa/ da lan khrid zhus pa'i skabs su nad zhugs pa min par 'dug sngar kho pas ci byas dris gsungs/ bdag gis dris pa lags te/ sngar byung nas yun ring rab song ste/ lha rje la bstan pas kyang / 'di ltar yin gyi gsal kha ma byung / rlung zhig 'dug pas byug pa 'dra gyis zer ba men pa 'di bzhin yin tsam ma byung zer cing 'dug zhus pas/ da sngon ma 'di ma gsal na gnad du mi 'gro bas/ ha'i dmigs pa 'di tsho phog la/ zhag 'ga' rlung lam sbyongs gsungs/ de nas yang zhus pas/ rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis gsungs/ de ltar gsung bzhin byas pas/ nyi ma gnyis pa la rlung ro mang po thon nas rkang lag tsho thams cad sbrid rengs pa na chag tshir byas te/ rlung ro thon pa'i skad ngan khyim mtshes rnams kyis thos pa byung / rkang lag rengs pa rnams mnyes/ tshigs pa dang po nas zad so thug khu tshur gyis brdungs/ yang yan lag tsho legs par mnyes/ rkang mthil brdungs byas pas skar khongs gcig tsam la cung drag tu song / de nas 'phar chen gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis phab/ rdo rje thur phebs kyis bcud/ de ltar yang yang nangs par nas kyang snga dro bzhi/ phyi dro bzhi ste/

nyin re la rlung ro 'don thengs brgyad brgyad btang pas/ zhag bcu tsam la khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel bco lnga pa ni/ yang gcig la srog rtsol gyi skabs su/ rlung bsgoms pas/ rlung gsus par ldig se bskyur ba de/ gsus par 'gro rgyu med par/ mgrin par rlung zad pa bzhin song nas/ de nas sgyu ma dang mchin pa dang / pho ba rnams na zhing / rlung bsgom du ma btub pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ sngar nas gegs rnying pa gcig yod par 'dug gsungs/ de la ha'i dmigs pa phog gnya' shing 'gyel gyis rlung ro thon/ rdo rje gtun brdungs kyis phob/ rlung ro yang yang thon gsungs/ de ltar byas pas skyon de las grol/ gegs sel bcu drug pa ni/ yang gcig la srog rtsol gyi thad du/ rlung bum pa can rngubs pas/ rlung gsus par mi 'gro bar mgrin par zad nas rlung zin pa dang dran med du 'gyel 'gro ba byung / drung du zhus pas/ rlung ro lus pa'i rtags yin pas sngon la ha'i dmigs pa phog de rjes bum pa can bsgom du bcug pas gnad du 'gro ba byung ngo / /gegs sel bcu drug phyi ma ni/ yang gcig la sor sdud kyi thad du spyi bor rtsa'us 'tshogs pa bzhin tsha zhing / sgom yun ring na spyi bor skrangs yong pa byung / de drung du zhus pas/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor thig le sngon po spur sgong tsam gcig la shes pa gtod du chug gsungs/ de ltar byed du bcug pas/ thig le sngon po la dmigs pa gtad pa'i dus su kho phan pa la/ dmigs pa sngar bzhin thad kar bsgoms tsam na yang sngar bzhin spyi bo tsha ba byung / de drung du zhus pas/ nam mkha'i rlung 'thums pa'i rtags yin pas ma ning gi ha slobs gsungs/ der de bzhin byas pas skyon de las grol nas/ lta stangs mtho dma' ci byas phyis ma byung / gegs sel bcu bdun pa ni/ yang gcig la bsgoms pas mig mchi ma ma thub par/ de ka la'ang snying rus bskyed bsgoms pas/

mchi ma nyin mtshan med par byung nas/ der rjes mig har por lus te mig 'tshum mi shes pa byung / drung du zhus pas/ dga' tshad yin/ rnying rus che rab 'dug gis/ da 'di bzhin gyis gsungs nas/ bar gyi rlung bzung / mnyam pa'i rlung bsdams/ dgong mo rdo rje gtun brdungs kyi de rjes dbyug pa gyis gsungs/ mig gi ltag rtsa la yun ring po'i bar nan tan gyis/ de'i rjes la'ang snum skus la/ yang nan tan gyis/ de ltar byas pas cog sgong tsam skrangs yong / de'i rjes su gtun gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas de'i khams de sor tshud do/ /gegs sel bco brgyad pa ni/ yang gcig la rlung sgom 'phro la/ glo rgyal langs nas mig skya log song nas/ 'chi ba 'dra byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ mnyam pa'i rlung bsdams/ rdo rje gtun brdungs bya/ des phan gsungs/ de ltar byas pas skyon las grol lo/ /gegs sel bcu dgu pa ni/ yang gcig la khams dwangs po la/ lus po phub sgyir ba bzhin yom yom byed pa gcig byung / de drung du zhus pas/ ye shes kyi rlung bzung / rdo rje gtun brdungs gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas phan no/ /gegs sel nyi shu pa gong ma ni/ yang chos 'byung grub la/ rlung stod du 'tshangs nas/ tshigs pa bdun pa dang / dkar nag gnyis po gzer/ dbugs thung byas pa byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor/ thig le pur sgong tsam gcig la shes pa gtod la/ rdo rje gtun brdungs gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas gzer de drag tu song yang / ro stod rgyang / de byas nas ma phan par/ dang kha 'gags zi phyod de ba la zhag bzhi lnga gcig lus pa la drung du zhus pas/ 'bol to chings gyis/ skam po'i thug pa'am/ 'dza' ti chang sbyor thongs/ der rjes 'phar chung gyis la phob/ de nas 'bol to khrol la/ de nas kha sang nas za ma ma tshud na byin gsungs/ de ltar byas pas zas kyi dri tshor ba dang /

skyug mer langs te/ zas ma tshud pa byung na/ za ma mi za la skyug log log byung na/ skyug log dus su rkang mthil du g.ya' sgogs la/ skyug log pa sangs pa dang yang zar chug yang skyug log byung na g.ya' sgogs/ skyug mer sangs pa dang / zar chug gsungs/ de ltar byas pas khar sang nas za ma ma tshud pa la/ zan 'dzog tsam gcig tshud song / de'i dgong mo na mar je bde la song nas khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel nyi shu pa ni/ yang gcig la rlung thor bu ba byung nas 'bebs byas pas ma phan/ dbyug pa byas kyang ma phan pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ mkhris rlung langs pa yin gsungs/ de la 'bebs byas kyang mi phan gsungs/ sngon la a ru ra bzang po gcig ru rta cig kha ru tsha gcig dang gsum gyi thang thongs la/ des phan jo yod kyis ma phan na sbyongs btang la mkhris pa de dbyung dgos gsungs/ mkhris pa thon na rlung rang bzhin gyis mal du tshud nas phan 'gro ba yin gsungs/ der gong gi sman gsum po'i thang btang bas/ phyi dro bder song ste/ yang dgong mo skam po'i thug pa dum gcig 'thungs pas/ yang langs nas/ de drung du zhus pas/ mkhris pa de ma thon na da rung ldang bas/ khar sang byas pa'i sbyongs thongs gsungs/ der rigs gsum mgon po'i sbyongs ril btang bas/ mkhris pa mang po thon cing sbyongs thengs sum cu byung / de'i sang na phar khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel nyer gcig pa ni/ yang gcig la pho ba na/ dbugs ngan mi thongs/ gnyid yer/ drung du zhus pas/ pho bskor drag tu gyis gsungs/ pho ba yar bsdebs mar bsdebs dang / g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gsor dkyil dang / gtun brdungs mang du gyis la/ mal du gos dro bar gon te nyol la/ rkang pa g.yas pa skums/ g.yon pa shad de skyongs/ nu ma g.yas kyi thad nas phar 'phar rtsa gcig yod pas/ de lag pa g.yas pa'i gru mo dang bzhag shas brtsir/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa 'gebs pa'am/

dar ram ras la sogs pa'i 'bol tos 'gebs pa gang rung bya ste/ rlung rgyur mi gzhug sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyus byung pa dang / bshang lam 'bor byas te phul bas dbugs ngan byung yang mi to 'dod pa yin/ rus thang bskol ba'i ro ma'am/ tshwa'am/ med na chu rdo hrug hrug pa sogs to khug chung du blugs te bcu drug mdo dang / brla'i rtsa 'o che gnyis dang / pho ba'i thad ka'i rgyab tu dugs byas/ de ltar byas pas phan no/ /gegs sel nyer gnyis pa ni/ yang gcig la zag pa 'gags nas na/ zag pa btang yang mi thongs par shed bskyed nas brtsir bas khrag dang bcas pa byung / de drung du zhus pas/ thur sel gyen du log pa yin pas/ de la 'di bzhin gyis/ gnya' shing 'gel gyi 'khrul 'khor nyis brgya tham pa gyis/ der rjes gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu tshud la 'phongs mtho bar gyis la sna bug g.yas pa mdzub mo'am/ 'bol tos 'gegs pa gang rung bya/ nu ma g.yas pa'i 'phar rtsa sngar bzhin gtams/ rlung 'byung 'jug la rdor bzlas kyi dmigs pa bya/ sna bug g.yon du rlung 'phos pa dang / snga skad phyi skad tsam rdor bzlas kyi dmigs pa bya/ rkang pa g.yon pa shad kyis brkyangs/ g.yas pa bskums la/ rlung shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ sna bug g.yon nas rdor bzlas byas pas/ mgyogs na yug gcig tsam la phan/ bul na snga skad phyi skad tsam gnad du bsnun dgos/ de ltar byas pas/ snga skad tsam sgug ma dgos par shad kyis grol lo/ /gegs sel nyer gsum pa ni/ yang gcig la khang thog na sog phon chen po gcig yod pas/ de lhags pas bskyur nas/ mthongs khung na mar lhung byung pas nyen blangs nas/ skrag po zhig byung pa dang / des rkyen byas nas/ sngar gyi rlung rta ma zhig yod pa langs nas/ mdun rgyab gzer/ pho ba na/ dbugs ma bde byas pa byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ khams 'dus chen po gcig de'u bcug 'dug gsungs/ da 'di bzhin gyis/ 'bol to'i chings gyis la dkar nag mtshams su dbyug pa brgyab/

'phar chen gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ de nas cung zhig ngal bso la/ chang gar ma la sha yis thob la khol gyis bskol la de blud/ de nas yang 'phar chen gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas nyi ma rgas pa dang sor tshud song / gegs sel nyer bzhi pa ni/ yang gcig la pho ba na ba'i nad gzhi yod pa'i steng du 'dril nas na/ ro stod tsho rgyangs byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor byed du chug gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas khos ma nus par/ slar na ru song / de drung du zhus pas/ rgyab la dbyug pa rgyobs gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas chen po 'dzog tsam gcig skrangs te/ de khab btsags kyi btsags pas de ma thag sel lo/ /gegs sel nyer lnga pa ni/ yang gcig la sgyid pa skyur/ mgo bo na/ mig sbring / mdun rgyab gzer/ dang kha ma bde ba la/ drung du zhus pas/ bad 'khris langs pa yin par 'dug de la tshigs pa bdun pa la dbyug pa gyis/ mkhris gsang dang / 'tshog ma la dbyug pa gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas gzer sangs nas stod rgyang sa pa gcig byung / de la ha'i dmigs pa dang / rting 'bebs byas pas phan no/ /gegs sel nyer drug pa ni/ yang gcig la ro stod thams cad rgyangs/ pho ba na/ de la rlung bcos byas pas bad rlung ldan par song nas khag po byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ stod kyi chings gyis la/ pho ba'i thad ka'i rgyab tu byug pa gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas/ der sder ma tsam zhig skrangs byung / de la khab btsags byas pas pho ba bder song ste/ da rung na ba la/ drung du zhus pas/ bad kan 'khyil ba yin/ na ro pa'i skyugs dar gyis gsungs/ sing po 'thung gin skyugs dar byas pas 'jab 'jib mang po thon byung / de nyi ma gsum tsam byas pa'i rjes la pho skor dang 'bebs gnyis bstun pas phan no/ /gegs sel nyer bdun pa ni/ yang gcig la pho ba na/ langs pa dang / 'gro tsa na mgo zi sgyi ri byas te/ skyug mer te byas nas 'gyel 'gro ba byung /

der khong gis lha rje sher bzang la bstan pas/ tshwa sman gcig pa sbyar bas/ des ma phan gyi kha la na ru song / yang lha rje la bstan pas/ chu sngon ma sog pa yin pa 'dra zer gyin yod par 'dug der bdag la de skad zer nas/ drung du zhus pas/ gnya' shing 'gyel byed du chug gsungs nas/ de byed du bcug ste/ de la grangs gyis gsungs nas/ snga dro tho rangs nas mgo btsugs te/ sngan ma bcu/ de nas sum cu/ de nas lnga bcu/ de nas nyis brgya/ de nas zhag re la nyis stong nyis stong byed du bcug pas/ zhag gsum nas pho nad drag ste/ de'ang byed du bcug pas/ sbyongs byung ste/ sbyongs mi chod pa 'dra ba byung / de drung du zhus pas/ sngags mdud gyis gsungs nas byas pas sbyongs chod de khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel nyer brgyad pa ni/ yang shangs pa gcig ro stod rgyangs pa bzhin byas nas/ mgo bo lci/ sgom du ma btub pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ thang sha gcod pa'i 'khrul 'khor slobs gsungs nas/ byas pas phan pa snyam byed pa las phan pa tsam ma byung / der drung du zhus pas/ kho rlung bzung ngam ma bzung gsungs/ rlung bzung gda' zhus pas/ des lan pa yin/ rlung ma 'dzin par thang sha gcod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis la de'i ngang nas skabs su ha thon gsungs/ de ltar byas pas khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel nyer dgu pa ni/ yang gcig la ltag khung na zhing / 'jing pa rgyangs/ ro stod nar byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ thang sha gcod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis rlung ma 'dzin gsungs/ de ltar yun ring po zhig byas pas/ skyon de las grol lo/ /gegs sel sum cu pa ni/ yang gcig la sor sdud kyi thad du/ rkang tshigs na/ blo thangs ko dang bcas/ mgo bo na byas pa gcig byung pa la/ cham pa yin nam snyam nas sran bskyed pas/ der khong tsog tu song nas khos gnya' shing 'gel byas pas/ des rlung yar bton pa bzhin song nas/ ro stod mjing pa tsho thams cad brgyangs pa/

nyal mi shes par/ tsog ge bsdod dgos par byung / der drung du zhus pas/ rlung yar 'phyur ba'i skyon yin pas/ spyi gtsug nas rim gyis rlung gsang rnams bstims rtsa 'ded kyis/ gling bzhi bcud 'khor gyis bcud/ de'i rjes la ngal bso/ ngal bso ba'i skabs la skam po'i thug pa'am/ dza ti chang sbyar btang / yang spyi gtsug la sogs pa'i rlung gsang rnams bstims/ rtsa ded bya/ rlung gang na phebs 'dug bltas la/ bcu drug mdo la phebs 'dug na 'phar chung gis phab/ gling bzhi bcud/ yang cung zad ngal bsos nas/ yang sngar bzhin byed pa yin gsungs/ de ltar byas pas spyi bo gtsug gi rlung gsang bstims/ mjing pa'i rlung gsang bstims pas/ cung zad reg pa tsam gyis/ zug che drags nas mchi ma mang po shor byung pa la/ bzo bar bya ste/ brid nas rlung gsang tshe bstims pas/ lus ca cu mi shes pa de cung zad shes par byung / de nas ngal bso nas/ chos rje'i gsung bzhin byas pas/ mjing pa rnams gnyen lcug ste song ba la/ yang dza ti chang sbyar gcig btang nas/ gong bzhin byas pas/ lus byin cung bder song ste/ 'phar chung gis gnad la phab/ rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor che chung gsum pa spel cing byas pas/ nyi ma rgas tsam na khams sor tshud do/ /gegs sel so gcig pa ni/ yang gcig la mgo lci/ so na/ ro stod khengs se byung pa la/ drung du zhus pas/ nang gi gling bcud kyis/ rlung bzung ngam mi 'dzin lags zhus pas/ mi 'dzin gsungs/ de ltar gsung bzhin ngal bso yin byas pas/ nyi ma dro bar tsam la skyon de las grol lo/ /gegs sel so gnyis pa ni/ yang gcig la mgo bo lci/ ro stod na brang kha na yar brdzangs pa bzhin gzer/ pho stod na/ mchin gri kha skor sgyir tse na ba la/ drung du zhus pas/ 'dus pa'i nad du 'dug ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ khrag mkhris rlung gsum 'dus pa'i nad yin pas/ dkar nag mtshams dang bdun pa la dbyug pa gyis nu ma g.yas pa'i thad nas mtshon phyed dang do'i sar mchin gsang yod pas der 'jib ru gyis 'tshogs ma'i gsang phye/

des phan yong gsung phye/ des phan yong gsungs/ de ltar gsungs pa bzhin byas pas/ mdun rgyab gzer ba dang / mgo bo lci ba dang / mchin pa na ba sogs la phan te/ pho stod cung ma bde bar zhus pas/ snying rus kyi chun na pho skor gyis/ mi mchun na se 'bru brgyad pa sbyor la thongs gsungs/ gsung bzhin byas pas phan no/ /gegs sel so gsum pa ni/ yang gcig la mgo bo na/ gnyid ma phebs pa la/ spyod lam rnam bzhi tsho dris pas ma 'dzom par 'dug ste/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas lan pa yin nam snyam ste/ drung du zhus pas/ rlung shas che na de ltar du yong pa yin gsungs/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi mdun gyi thad du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin gsungs/ yang snying gi dkyil du bsgoms kyang chog gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas de'i skyon las grol lo/ /gegs sel so bzhi pa ni/ yang gcig la ro stod brgyangs sems mi bde/ sgom pa tsa na sems mchun du ma 'dod/ sgom pa drags na rlung stod du 'gyur nas skyug log log pa byas te/ glo rgyal lam skyug thabs su glo 'khogs pa byug de la drung du zhus pas/ skyug mer byung dus su bar gyi rlung zungs/ nang gi gling bzhi bcud/ yang skyug log log pa de sangs pa dang sgoms/ yang skyug log byas/ ro stod tsha khang tshe brgyangs byung na/ yang sngar bzhin gnad du snun/ de ltar byas pas cung bde ba snyam pa byung / stong skyugs glo dang bcas pa 'tshal 'gro ba lta bu de/ res tsa na sngar bas che ba 'dra ba yang byung / de drung du zhus pas/ rang bzhin ni rlung 'thos pa min pa'i rlung ro ngan pa zhig kyang rtsa nang na yod par 'dug gsungs/ de la ha'i dmigs pa slobs/ rlung ro yang yang thon gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas skyon de las grol lo/ /da ni gegs sel de rnams kyi/ zhal shes khyad par can bdud rtsi'i snying po gcig tu 'dril ba lta bu rnams brjod par bya ste/

de yang gegs sel dang po'i zhal shes ni/ thig le rtsa gnas dang gyen du 'dren pa la/ thog mar rlung gi sgo dbye dgos pas/ lus skyil krung sgal tshigs bsrang / lag pa gnyis po kha'i mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad sor/ lag pa gnyis gshibs pa'i mthil gnyis phyir la bstan te/ ser mo rnams brkyangs pa'i bar du mtho gang tsam byas la mdun gyi nam mkhar lag pa gnyis gyen thur du re mos su zeng zeng myur po bya zhing / 'jog khar gru mo rtsibs logs la brdabs pa dang / dus mnyam du bzhag de'i bar la rlung mi gzung / rang sor 'jog pa phyag len no/ /thig le gyen du 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa ni/ tsog pu pus brang bcas pa'i ngang nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i rgyu ma khung nas bzung ste/ tshigs pa bsrang / 'phongs sa la ma 'byar ba'i ngang nas lag pas yar len/ rkang pas mar 'phul/ de'i bar la rlung thub tshad bzung / lce rkan la sbyar mig nam mkhar blta/ thig le rnams rtsa gnas na yar gyen la skya chil li li 'gro ba la shes pa gtad cing / rlung mi thub na dal bus btang / ngal bso yun mi ring tsam bso la/ yang sngar bzhin du 'khrul 'khor bcud pa dang rlung bum can thengs dgu byed/ de rjes la 'khrul 'khor gsum pa ni/ 'khrul 'khor dang / rlung 'dzin gtong / dmigs pa/ ngal bso lugs rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ 'dir khyad par gan rkyal byas pa'i ngang nas bum can thengs dgu byed/ de ba gnyis kar gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi pa se gol ma byed pa ni/ tsog bu rkang pa bsnol la lag pa gnyis gcig gis gcig gi bar lhu nas 'jus la sked pa skyeg skyeg byed pa'i zhor la lag pa g.yas g.yon g.yom zhing rlung rang sor 'jog pa 'khrul 'khor snga ma dang mthun/ de ltar 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni thig le gyen du 'dren pa gtso che ba yin la/ de rting se gol ma bco brgyad byed pa ni/ lus thams cad la khyab par 'grems pa yin te/

'khrul 'khor dang po dang rting ma 'di gnyis bde chen ral gcig pa'i gnad che ba gnyis yin no gsung ngo / /gegs sel gnyis pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'di la bzhi yod pa'i tshigs bkan chung ba byed na/ sngas khri'i steng du snyes 'bol bzhag pa'am/ yang na gos bltabs la bzhag de'i steng du tshigs pa bdun pa bkal la/ lag pa rkang pa rnams brkyangs la nam mkha'i ha shugs ring bzhin du phyir yang ma bcos par rdzogs par btang / nang du'ang rdzogs par rngubs/ de'i bar la shes pa khong nas lhod glod la rkang lag gi sor mo sbrid pa dang / kha mtshul sbrid pa ma byung gi bar du de nyid la bslab/ sbrid pa dang langs la lag pa g.yas g.yon tshang ra'i gzhogs g.yas g.yon na mar 'phyangs te sor mo rnams brkyangs la bzhag mig sa la phab la mig gis blta sa de nyid shes pa lhod glod la snying tshal pa bzhir gyes pa'i nang nas ha nag po gcig thon nas bsham lam thug song / de nas ha gnyis su gyes nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon nas zhugs rting pa nas thon gser gyi sa gzhi la thim par bsgom pa dang / rkang pa'i brang ba sa la btsugs la rting pa char te sa la brdabs pa dang ha 'don pa mnyam po bya/ de ltar nyi shu rtsa re re/ snga dro phyi dro nyin gung gsum byed pa yin te/ de'i gnad 'khrul 'khor dang po ni rlung ro 'don pa/ gnyis pas ni rlung mal du 'bebs te zhes so/ /der rjes bar rlung bzung la sor sdud bsgom/ de ltar re mos byas pas/ khams sor tshud 'gro/ gegs sel gsum pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'bebs su 'gro ba'i 'grems ni/ lus gnad gong gi de rang yin la/ khyad par mig thur du blta ba dang / so dang mchu rang sor 'jog pa dang / mjing pa dang dpung pa gnyis dang bcas pa'i rtsa'i grims cha yod pa rnams yid kyis bltas la glod pa dang / bshang sgor me tshon gang pa la dmigs la bshang lam thur du phul zhing / 'khrul 'khor bcud pas sbug ngan dang chu tsag tsig byung yang a'u ci/

de lta bu thengs drug tsam song pa dang / de nas rlung bzung gin bshang lam phul bas/ 'bebs dang 'grems chig chod du song nas skyon las grol 'gro gsungs/ gegs sel bzhi pa'i zhal shes ni/ zhes pa la rang gi lag pa'i rting pa gnyis kyis nad pa'i ol stong pa'i 'og dang / de'i thad ka'i rgyab tu lag pa'i rting pa gnyis kyis rtsir zhing mdun gyi dkar nag mtshams dang rgyab kyi bdun pa'i thad tshun chod lag pa gnyis kyi rting pas mdun rgyab nas bsdams shing lhod glod cing yang bsdams/ yang lhod kyis glod/ de ltar rim gyis yas mar ded pas dbugs thung pa dang brang gi dkyil na yar shing btsugs pa lta bu'am/ ol stong pa 'khyags pa'am/ mid pa 'chus nas smra brjod mi shes pa'i skyon las grol zhing dbugs ring du 'gro/ de ltar snga ma bzhin byas pas dkar nag dang bdun pa gzer zhing na ba la de ltar byas pas sel la/ de la mdun rgyab de las dma' tsam du sngar bzhin gnad du bsnun pas na zug de sel lo/ /zhes gsung ngo / /spyi bo ltag pa phrag gnyis dang / /dkar nag tshigs bdun bcu drug mdo/ /dpyi mig g.yas g.yon tog tog dang / /brla gnyis byin pa g.yas g.yon dkyil/ /rlung gseng bcu bzhi dag tu bzhed/ /'bebs kyis thur du dbab ces pa de snga ma de rang yin la/ rlung gi gsang rnams 'them par bstims zhes pa la spyi bo'i gtsug snying gi gsang yin pas yun ring du bstim/ thal lcag brdeg de nas ltag khung mnan/ de nas mjing pa g.yas g.yon gnyis mtheb mdzub kyi tshigs pa dang po tshun chad btsir zhing bstim/ de nas phrag pa gcig nas bstim/ de nas tshigs pa gnyis nas rim gyis 'tshir zhing bcu drug mdo tshun chod man mang du ded cing bsdam dpyid mig g.yas g.yon gnyis yun ring du bstim/ yang mdun gyi ol ba'i 'og nas ze ze yan chad sngar bzhin yang yang ded la/ de nas spyi gtsug dang ltag khung dang phrag pa gnyis dang bdun pa dang dkar nag mtshams su zug 'dug mi 'dug bltas te/

de rnams rlung gsang gong ma rnams yin pas/ de rnams su zug byung na sngar bzhin gnad du bsnun pas zug chung du song pa'am med par song na/ bcu drug mdor rlung phebs yod pas der brdungs pas zug 'byung / de'i zug chung du song pa dang / de nas tog tog po la cung zad gnad du bsnun/ de nas brla sgang g.yas g.yon pus mo thug bstim/ de nas byin pa g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil mnan pas zug mi bzod pa 'byung ste/ de phebs rtags yin/ de nyid drag tu song pa dang / khams sor tshud 'gro gsung ngo / /gegs sel lnga pa'i zhal shes ni/ zhes pa snga ma dang 'dra ba la sa gzhi snyoms pa'i steng du rkang pa gnyis mnyam par brkyangs la rkang pa'i brang sa gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyi sor mos dam par 'jus la/ lag pas yar 'then/ rkang pas mar phul te/ sgyid khung gnyis sa la 'byar snyam pa'i thang sha bcad la/ 'bebs gtso bor byed na rlung mi bzung / zan gnyis za yun gyi bar du sdug sran bskyed la 'khrul 'khor bcud/ yang ngal bso/ yang snga ma bzhin bcud de/ 'di la'ang 'bebs 'dren gnyis su shes par bya ste/ 'di 'jam 'bebs yin gsung / 'dren la rlung 'dzin no/ /'bebs 'dren chig chod du gtong na'ang / rlung bzung gsungs te/ rlung med brgyad dgu'i rjes su rlung dang bcas pa dga' gsungs so/ /gegs sel drug pa'i zhal shes ni/ rlung ro 'don sa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ sa gzhi snyoms par pus mo gnyis btsugs pa'i bar du 'khyid gang bzhag rkang pa gnyis kyi brang ba sa la gzugs/ bol tog sa'i gong rkang pa'i phra mtshams gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ lag pas yar 'then brang 'bor por bya/ ro stod dgye btang / kha sna'i rlung drag por 'bud pa dang / mgo bsgril ba dus mnyam du bya'o/ /gegs sel bdun pa'i zhal shes ni/ sgra rings kyi sbyor ba ni 'di tshugs la gsungs pa la/ lus mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs bsrang / mgrin pa rgu tsam gyi ngang nas mchu btsum/

so gnyis ma 'byar tsam bya/ lce ci bder bzhag la/ phyi rol gyi rlung nang du rdzogs par rngubs la lte 'og nan byas la thur sel gyi rlung dang bsres te/ de nas sna leb byas nas sna bug gnyis nas rlung bsris la sgra che ru nga ra ra btang pas rlung shugs chung pa gcig 'ong / rlung phyir rdzogs pa dang / yang nang du rngub dus su sgra dang bcas pas rngub/ sgra 'don mi shes na sngar bzhin rngubs nas lte 'og mnan pa gcig byas la sgra dang bcas pas sngar bzhin bslab/ 'di'i phan yon ni/ rlung gang ba dang / rlung kha ma phyed pa dang / snying rlung sogs rlung ro bsags pa dang / lus bde ba chung ba dang / khyad par thig le 'dzag pa'i rigs rnams la phan gsung ngo / /gegs sel brgyad pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'dren pa za ra tshags kyi 'khrul 'khor ni gong du bstan zin to/ /gegs sel dgu pa'i zhal shes ni/ tha ga pa'i 'khrul 'khor la bslab ces pa gong dang 'dra ba la/ khyad par 'dir rlung mi 'dzin pa gnad yin/ rdo rje gtun brdungs zhes pa ni/ rkang pa skyil krung gi dpyi mag g.yas g.yon gyi thad du sa la lag pa gnyis khu tshur btsugs la lus bteg la sa la brdabs pa dang mnyam por 'phongs dngas dngas yong par bya/ rlung mi bzung gsung ngo / /gegs sel bcu pa'i zhal shes ni/ phab ces pa la rang gi mdun du nad pa skyil krung du 'dug pa'i lag pa gnyis pus mor bsnol bar 'jus pa'i rgyab tu rang 'dug la rang gi lag pa gnyis kyis nad pa'i ro stod nas 'khyud pa'i rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i 'khrig ma nas g.yon pas bzung la/ rang gi dbugs kyi thub tshad du lag pas bsdams/ yang lag pa lhod btang la ngal bso/ yang sngar bzhin bsdams/ yang ngal bso/ de lta bu thengs 'gas sel zhing / ma sel na/ zhes pa ni/ dkar nag bdun pa gnyis dang phrag gong g.yas g.yon gnyis su gru gong 'dzog tsam re bcug gsungs te/ gru gong byed pa la rnam rtog sngon song byas la skra bzang rab gtso bsags la de rnams bsed nas lag mthil du skam 'gong byas/

de nas chu bran cing rlan 'gong byas la/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi bar du bsgril zhing chu btab kyin 'khrigs par chags su ma song bar bsgril te/ de nyid skam po 'jog che shos tsam spu ril byas pas des gru gong gi dod byed pa yin/ de nyid dkar nag bdun pa phrag gong gnyis su bzhag pa'i steng nas ske rags ring na gcig thung na gnyis kyis phrag pa la rgya gram du dam par bsdams la bcing / ske rags med na ras gshags sam/ ther mas sngar bzhin du bcing / ske rags med pa'i dbang btsan yin no/ /de ltar bsdams pa'i ngang nas zan gnyis za yun tshod dam/ zan gcig za yun bzhag pas rlung ro rnying ma rnams bud de dwangs ma rang gi gnas su gnas par byed pa yin te/ 'di byas na la la la skar khongs re tsam mam/ gnyis gnyis tsam phan nas/ gzod yang na ru yong pa'i rigs de la 'bol te byas pa'i ngang de nas dkar nag mtshams su dbyug pa byas la de rjes gtun brdungs sngar bzhin byas pas phan 'gro ba 'ong / yang rlung rkyang rang la 'bol to chings byas pa la/ dbyug pa ma byas par nad pa rang gi 'khrul 'khor bya ba yong na gtun brdungs sngar bzhin byas pas phan la/ de'i bar la nad pa de 'chi ba ka 'dra dbugs mi thon pa 'byung ste/ bred mi dgos/ dbugs thung ba rnams kyang 'phral la ring du 'gro/ nad pa sdug sran chung na zan gcig za ran tsam 'khun du bcug de nas chings bkrol la ngal bso ru gzhug dza ti chang sbyor ram skam po'i thug pa btang / yang khrag rlung ngam mkhris rlung la ni skam po'i thug pa dang sgog pa dang chang / shing kun rus khu sogs drod kyi rigs mi gtong / btang na na ru 'gro bas so gsung ngo / /gegs sel bcu gcig pa gad shing lung pa'i gegs bsal lugs ni/ rlung gsang rnams rim gyis bstim zhes pa ni gong gi de ka yin la/ phab ces pa la nad pa skyil krung sngar dang 'dra/ lag pa ci bder 'jog rang gi phang par nad pa bcug la/

rang gi lag pa gnyis nad pa'i g.ya' khung na yar bcug ste/ nad pa'i brang du 'khyud la lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i khu tshur ram steng nas g.yon pa'i thal mo bkab la/ dang kha nas dkar nag mtshams su 'tshir zhing 'ded/ yang sngar bzhin ze ze thug 'tshir zhing 'ded pa'o/ /rlung gsang bsdam zhes pa gong dang 'dra/ rkang mthil brdung zhes pa ni/ rkang pa'i rgyu ma khungs na rtsa sbrul mjug 'khyil pa bya ba yod pas/ de rlung thur du 'bebs pa'i gsang chen gcig yin pas brdungs na phan pa yin gsungs/ gyen rgyu gnad dbab ces pa'ang stod 'tsher rang yin la/ phab la zhes pa 'di la lag len gnyis te/ nad pas bya ba mi yong na thang snyoms po la gdan dro ba'i steng du nad pa rkang pa brkyangs la 'dug de'i rgyab nas rang gis nad pa'i g.ya' khung na yar lag ngar gnyis bcug la nad pa bteg la 'phongs brdab/ 'khos kha chung na sor mos 'khyud la btegs la brdab/ yang ngal bso zhing sngar bzhin brdab/ de ltar byas pas cung zhig nas phan du song nas nad pas rang gis 'khrul 'khor bya ba yong zhing / de la 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa byed pa ni/ 'khrul 'khor gyi chas bcas pa gzhi la sdod na yong la/ byos sam chas med pa lta bu/ nas phad khal gsum ma yod na nas kyis bkang pa'am/ yang na sa phad khal gsum ma sas bkang pa kha sros pa'am skyigs pa'i steng du shing leb bam/ g.yam leb khru gang gru bzhi tsam mam/ de lta bu'ang ma rnyed na rdo leb de tsam gcig la bya/ de yang shing bu yod na rdo leb de sros pa sa phad de'i steng du bzhag la/ de'i steng du nad pa de khyel la bzhag la/ rlung mi 'dzin par/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du chag gang tsam bzhag la/ dal bus khag langs nas phad spu'i steng gi rdo leb la 'phongs brdab cing / dmigs pa ni gser gyi pha gu ser po'i steng na 'phongs brdabs pas gser gyi sa gzhi mer mer byung bar bsam zhing mig sa la phab/ dmigs pa 'di 'khrul 'khor gong ma la'ang 'gre zhing 'di gnyis la 'bebs chen zhes gsung ngo /

/gegs sel bcu gnyis pa'i zhal shes ni/ ha 'don zhes pa la/ langs te rkang pa gnyis gshibs la lag pa gnyis kyang dpyi mgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi thad du ser mo brkyang la bzhag dpung pa gnyis snyung tsam ngang nas lus 'phar ba dang / lce nar brkyangs nas ha zhes drag por 'don pa dang rkang pa gnyis sa la khrab tso yong pa gsum mnyam por bya/ ha 'don pa rnams dal la dod par 'don te/ tsug tsug tu ma song par bya/ nang du rlung rdzogs par rngub/ phyir la'ang rlung rdzogs par ha zhes rlung sangs sangs gtong pa mnyam par bya/ ha 'don pa'i tshad ni kha mtshul sbrid pa dang / g.yal dang / mchi ma dang / glo rgyal dang / skyug pa dang / 'khru ba dang / lus po gyong pa dang / sgyid pa skyur ba rnams 'byung gsung / rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor la bzhi yod pa'i gcig gong du song / 'dir ltag 'then yin te/ zhib par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gegs sel bcu gsum pa'i zhal shes ni/ rlung ro nyi ma re re la bzhi bzhi 'don zhes pa ni snga ma yin te/ na tshod rgan gzhon dar ma gsum la khams bzang ngan rlung shas che chung rnams rigs pas brtags la bya gsung ngo / /ha 'don zhes pa la/ skyil krung / sgal tshigs bsrang ba'i ngang nas lag pa gnyis pus mo la 'jus lce nar snar rlung nang du rdzogs par rngubs te ha zhes rlung shugs sangs tse rdzogs pa yun ring du gdon/ de lta bu nyi ma gnyis gsum gdon/ de nas lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol bar 'jus te lus gnad gzhan 'dra ba la ha snga ma bzhin sangs kyis ring po rdzogs par gdon/ de ltar byas pas ro stod na rum pa dang tsha khang pa dang shugs ring mang du 'byung pa dang ha 'don dus ha sangs mi thon pa 'byung ste/ de ltar byung yang rlung lam dga' tshad 'byongs pa nyi ma re la rlung ro 'don pa'i brtag rgyugs sngar bzhin bya/ rlung ro 'don pa rang gi dus su rlung lam sbyong pa la ha gsum gsum bton pa'i rjes la rlung ro 'don gsung ngo /

/gegs sel bcu bzhi pa'i zhal shes ni/ ha'i dmigs pas rlung lam sbyangs zhes pa'ang gong gi de ka rang yin la rlung ro 'don pa'i 'khrul 'khor yang de ka rang yin gsung / de'i dus su/ rkang lag tso sbrid de lag pa kun bza' ru bzhin du rengs na chag btsir bya zhes pa la zla'u yod na nad pa'i lag pa gnyis la mi re res dpung pa'i rtsa nas lag pa gnyis kyis chag btsir byed cing ser mo tshun chod bya/ yang nad pa la lag pa sprug tu gzhug yang sngar bzhin chag btsir bya/ de bzhin rkang pa g.yas g.yon la'ang sngar bzhin no/ /de'i rjes la 'bebs chen gnyis po sngar bzhin rigs pas dbab/ 'bebs pa'i bcud ces pa la rdo rje cung zad gsor ba yin gyi shu tra ma nyams par gal che gsung ngo / /ha'i dmigs pas pheb ces pa gong gi de nyid yin la/ gegs sel bco lnga pa'i zhal shes ni/ rlung ro thon ces pa ni/ thang mnyam po la pus mo btsugs pa'i bar du mtho gang bzhag rkang pa'i brang ba sa la bzung ste/ rting pa gnyis kyi bar du 'phongs bzhag sgal tshigs bsrang / lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo bsnol la ltag par dga'/ gru mo gnyis phyir la deng byed/ mjing pa hring byas sked pa nas 'khrul btsal la/ sked pa kyog kyog byas nas/ ro stod bsigs pas mgrin pa nas sog sog ces pa'i sgra gcig 'byung ste/ de nyid la ma ning gi ha zhes kyang ming du 'dogs te de nyid g.yas g.yon zung re la 'khrul 'khor re re brtsis pa'i dang po/ nyi shu/ de nas lnga bcu/ de nas brgya/ de nas nyis brgya la sogs pa stong phrag khas blangs la/ khams bzang na nyi ma re la nyis stong tsam re byed de/ de yang las dang po pa'i dus su rtsibs thung gzer ba dang / mkhal ma gzer ba dang / brang gzer zhing 'tshang ba la sogs pa 'byung / de la 'bebs mang du btang gin yel gyen bya ste/ yun ring po byed na rkang pa'i brang bas mi nus pas/ yob chen phugs su gral stan bsgril ba'am/

phyam rtse nyis ltas byas pas/ yob chen khugs su bcug pas/ khams bzang po rnams kyis nyin rtser ba nus pa'ang 'byung / de ltar bu sbungs bsring gin byas na snying rlung dang / 'khrugs dang / pho ba na ba dang / dmu chus mgo zin ma zin dang / ma zhu ba dang / gegs rnying pa'i rigs tsi rigs la phan cing / 'di byas pas dmu chu can la la rang sbyongs su yong gin 'dug la la gcin kyang 'dzag nas 'grag gi 'dug pho ba sbos skran de 'dra la/ sman dang 'khrul 'khor sdebs kyin byed na/ a ru ra sha chen/ mon lugs sla sgang / bong nga dkar po/ sga skya/ pi pi ling / sbos pa la kha ru tsha/ de rnams thun mnyam pa zhib par btags/ chu bskol gyis snga dgong phul zhing 'khrul 'khor bya/ dang po pho ba gyong po ltang ltang byas te de nas je nyan je nyan la 'gro bar 'dug go /rlung ro 'don pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gegs sel bcu drug pa'i zhal shes ni/ ha'i dmigs pa phog ces pa ni gong bzhin no/ /rlung ro 'don zhes pa'ang snga ma bzhin no/ /gegs sel bcu drug pa phyi ma'i zhal shes ni/ ma nang gi ha slobs gsungs pa la mdun gyi nam mkhar/ ha dngul chu'i mdog lta bu gcig bsam/ lus dkyil krung bcas la/ de la shes pa gtad/ shugs ring 'jam po ma ru ha bton la mdun gyi dngul chu'i mdog de la thim par bsgom ste dbugs dbyung 'jug ma bcos pa'i ngang nas ha ring por gtong ba yin no/ /gegs sel bcu bdun pa'i zhal shes ni/ bar gyi rlung bzung zhes pa ni gsus pa ca ca nas brgyangs pa'i ngang nas rlung 'byung 'jug byed pa yin no/ /gegs sel bco brgyad pa'i zhal shes ni/ mnyam pa'i rlung ni ro rkyang ngo / /rdo rje gtun brdungs ni snga ma bzhin no/ /rlung bsgom 'phro la glo rgyal langs nas 'chi ba ka 'dra byung zhes pa la/ mnyam pa'i rlung bsdam zhes pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /rdo rje gtun brdungs zhes pa'ang sngar bzhin la rlung mi gzung ngo /

/gegs sel bcu dgu pa'i zhal shes ni/ ye shes kyi rlung zhes pa bar rlung gong dang mtshungs la/ rdo rje gtun brdungs kyang snga ma bzhin no/ /gegs sel nyi shu pa gong ma'i zhal shes ni/ 'bol to chings zhes pa'ang gong gi de yin la/ 'phar chung zhes pa'ang gtun brdungs so/ /gegs sel nyi shu pa'i zhal shes ni/ rigs gsum mgon po'i ril bu zur du shes par bya'o/ /gegs sel nyer gcig pa'i zhal shes ni/ pho skor drag tu gyis gsungs pa la skyil krung tshigs pa bsrangs pa'i pho ba g.yas skor g.yon skor mnyam par shes pa yin/ gsor dkyil zhes pa ni skyil krung gi dpyi mig g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar lag pa g.yas g.yon btsugs la gsor bsgril ba bzhin bsgril/ gtun brdungs zhes pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /gegs sel nyer gnyis pa'i zhal shes ni/ gnya' shing 'gel yang gong dang 'dra/ yang 'bol to chings kyang de yin la/ gegs sel nyer gsum pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'phar chen yang de'o/ /gegs sel nyer bzhi pa'i zhal shes ni/ 'pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni snga ma bzhin la/ lag pa gnyis kyis sor rgya byas nas pus mo g.yas g.yon la 'jus nas byed pa'o/ /gegs sel nyer lnga pa'i zhal shes ni/ ha dmigs rting 'bebs kyang snga ma bzhin no/ /gegs sel nyer drug pa'i zhal shes ni/ stod kyi chings zhes pa'ang snga ma bzhin no/ /skyugs dar zhes pa ni dar kha gang gi sum cha la bye sbrug kha sna rtse gnyis ka byas la/ sna rtse gcig la stong skud sbom phra ran par btags nas de nyid snyug ma sor lnga pa'i sked pa la sbrags/ dar de chu'am sing pa skyur mo yod na dga'/ de bre gang tsam la sbang / bre gang ngam do tsam lto stong la 'thung / de rjes dar de sna rtse nas rim gyis mid la pho skor/ yang dar skud sna rtse nas cung zhig 'then la yang mid la pho skor byas pas skyug mer rtse 'byung / yang dar skud kyi sna mo nas 'then byas pas skyugs 'byung /

de'i 'phro la skyugs pas ljan ljin mang po 'byung / yang sngar bzhin sing po 'thungs kyin bskyugs pas bad mkhris dang / khrag rul la sogs pa skyug ste tshod bzung la/ bad mkhris thon la khrag ma skyugs tsam byas gsungs te/ de yang dar bas 'breng pa mnyen po sbangs pa ring thung rtse khru gang dang sor bzhi tsam gyi sna rtse la dar skud btags nas snga ma bzhin byas na nad 'grongs che bar 'dug de nyi ma gsum bzhi tsam snga skad bya/ phyi skad pho skor dang 'bebs bya gsungs/ gegs sel nyer bdun pa'i zhal shes ni/ gnya' shing 'gel zhes pa gong bzhin yin la/ 'khru ba ma chod na sngags mdud ces pa la bal bzang po la srung skud sked pa 'khor ba la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas la/ de la oṃ swa sbe sbad hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa mdud pa re la stong phrag re re bzlas la gdab/ sked pa la bcings pa'i mdud pa la'ang stong phrag gcig bzlas la gdab/ yang na sngags 'di des 'khru ba 'chad do gsungs so/ /gegs sel nyer brgyad pa dang / nyer dgu pa gnyis ka'i zhal shes ni/ thang sha gcod pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes pa tha ga pa yin/ ha ni snga ma bzhin/ gegs sel sum cu pa'i zhal shes ni/ rlung gsang bsdam pa bcu bzhi'o/ /rtsa ded kyang ni de nyid do/ /chag btsir zhes pa gong gi de'o/ /gegs sel so gcig pa'i zhal shes ni/ gling bzhi bcud 'bor nang gi'o/ /rlung gsang bstims pa sngar bzhin no/ /rtsa ded ces pa'ang sngar bzhin no/ /langs pa'i rkang par mtho gang bzhag /brla gnyis phra mtshams lag gnyis 'ju/ /gru mo ma gug 'phrang btang bya/ /dpung snyung sked ldeng 'phongs 'bor bya/ /sgyid lem dal bus sa la phab/ /mi phebs sdug la so bzung bya/ /des ni rlung rnams mal du phebs/ /gsang rnams bsdams pa'ang sngar bzhin no/ /'phar chung rlung ro 'don pa rnams/ /spel zhing sngar bzhin gnad du bsnun/ /gegs sel so gnyis pa'i zhal shes ni/ nang gi bcud 'bor rlung mi bzung /
