/gegs sel so gsum pa'i zhal shes ni/ pho mchin na ba'i sman la ni/ /a ru bong dkar gur gum dang / /se yab 'u su ru rta dang / /sla sga ma rnyed li ga dur/ /bse 'bru sug smel pi pi ling / /sga skya rgyam tsha cha mnyam ste/ /zhib btags chu bskol dag gis ni/ /dgong dang tho rangs gtang bar bya/ /rlung shas che na a kar dang / /dza ti bsnan pa shin tu shis/ /gegs sel so bzhi pa'i zhal shes ni/ nang gi gling gzhi sngar dang 'dra/ /'bebs chen zhes pa'ang sngar bzhin no/ /bi bhu ti da sha'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /mtheb chen mtheb chung gnyis yin te/ /rkang pa skyil krung de nyid kyis/ /lag pa g.yas kyi 'og tu ni/ /'bol stegs cung zad gcig bcug la/ /de la lag g.yas 'jus nas ni/ /kha btsums khro bo'i mig lta bus/ /de phyogs snyeng zhing sked pa ni/ /kyog kyog byed dang rlung phyir 'byin/ /bstun te ngar skad mnyam por 'don/ /de bzhin g.yon du'ang de ltar byed/ /mthe chung lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /gong bzhin 'bol la cung zad brten/ /khro bo'i mig tu thad dkar blta/ /khyad par skyil krung g.yas g.yon gyis/ /lag pa gnyis brkyangs 'bol la 'jus/ /sked pa 'khrul zhing kyog kyog byed/ /ngar skad sngar dang 'dra ba 'o/ /'di gsum gyis ni rlung 'khyil dang / /'phyur ba gang ba rnams sel gsung / /yang na thang snyoms pa la ni/ /rkang pa gnyis ni shad brkyangs la/ /lag pa g.yas pas rkang pa g.yon/ /phyi phyogs mthe bong la 'jus te/ /lag pas yar 'then rkang pas 'phul/ /de bzhin rkang pa g.yas la'ang bya/ /rlung ni kha sbyor nyid du gzung / /de nyid grub thob la ba pa'i/ /'khrul 'khor zab mo yin no gsung / /'di dang mtheb chen mtheb chung gnyis/ /gsum po 'di nyid rin chen grub/ /bu ston bla mas bi bhu ti/ /da sha dag la gsan no gsungs/ /ha ring so bzhis gegs rnams legs par sel ba yin no/ ha thung ha 'khrab rnams/

/spel zhing khrag mkhris bad rlung dang / /'dus pa'i nad rnams rim par ni/ /dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor byug sman rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par mdzod/ /de dag gis ni de las 'phros pa'i legs bshad bstan pa bshad zin te/ de ltar de dag gis ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs par bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho lta bu'i chos/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /spel mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan paṇa grub tshogs/ /bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ 1 /e ma sngon gyi skal bzang dpyod ldan rnams/ /gcig tu dam chos kho na don gnyer bas/ /mdo sngags rig gnas bka' dang bstan bcos rnams/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar gyur/ 2 /ding sang chos par rlom pa 'di phal cher/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho sbyong ba lta zhog gi /lto chos lag len phra mo'i cha 'ga' yang / /mthar phyin mi slob dkor nag za bas g.yengs/ 3 /de phyir bstan pa'i rgyun rnams ches cher nyams/ /'di 'dra ma bzod blang dor mang bstan kyang / /chu 'khyags ngos la bdud rtsi bran pa bzhin/ /skal ngan yid la 'dre ba'i skabs ma rnyed/ 4 /snyigs ma'i skye bo phyugs dang 'dra ba'i dbus/ /rang nyid lung rtogs yon tan dang bral bas/ /des na gzhan phan nus par mi 'dug snyam/ /sems khong chud mod 'on kyang lhag bsam gyis/ 5 /rjes 'brangs blo gsal 'ga' la phan rung snyam/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag rnams/ /bshad sgrub bgyid la nyer mkho'i legs bshad gtam/ /dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'di bsdebs so/ 6 /des na kho bo'i rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams/ /snyoms las ma byed bstan bcos ri mor bris/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus su legs bshad kyis/

/rang gzhan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du longs/ 7 /ding sang dus 'dir mkhas par grags rnams kyang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas chos la rmongs mthong nas/ /rang la sbyangs pa'i yon tan med bzhin du/ /legs bshad 'di la brten nas dus 'khor gyi/ 8 /bstan pa cung zad 'phel bar e 'gyur snyam/ /lhag bsam dag pas bshad la mkhas dbang dang / /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams bzod par mdzad nas kyang / /lugs 'di'i bstan pa dar ba'i dge legs stsol/ 9 /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rab rgyas shog 10 /de rgyun bskal par rigs brgyud dri med kyis/ /rgyun du skyong zhing bdag cag slob mar bcas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas srid mthar bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yang / bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang pos dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa chu mo lug gi lo'i nag pa'i nya la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i/ gdul bya gtso bo chos rgyal zla ba bzang po'i sprul gzhi gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang mthu stobs rnam dbyer med pa'i sa skya'i 'jam mgon grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / byang sham+bha la'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par sprul pa bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel pa mdzad pa po rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po dang thugs rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa/ rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa dus gsum gyi rgyal pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa kun gyi spro ba dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te/

bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gtso bor smos pa'i/ yongs 'dzin bslu med du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len zhing / shrī ka la tsakra dang gnyis su med pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang / lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can zhal rnam pa gnyis las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myangs shing / gzhan yang lugs 'di'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i shrī dhar+m+ma swa mi dpal chos kyi rje/ dag las/ bsdus rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bshad lung sogs/ 'di skor gyi chos kyi bka' drin ngoms par mnos pa'i skal ba bzang po can/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ ding sang gi dus 'dir phyogs gang na yang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa ha cang dar rgyu mi 'dug pas/ 'di nyid sems kyis ma bzod cing / rang nyid kyang lugs 'di la mkhas pa'i bag chags 'jog 'dod kyi dad pa bcos min yod pa'i nyer len gyis rkyen byas/ bdag gis bsgrigs pa'i bstan bcos 'di la brten nas/ da dung yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud man ngag gi bstan pa cung zad dar ba'i rkyen du e 'gyur snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ rang blo so dgu lon pa 'phags pa'i yul na na tshod ldan zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la shing mo phag gi lo/ gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo shar lho'i rig 'dzin pho brang du bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni nyang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas su skyes pa'i bkra shis rgang pa nam mkha' dge bsnyen gyis dad pa dang brtson 'grus bla na med pa'i sgo nas sor mo'i 'du byed mig 'phrul gyi tshul du bgyis so/

/'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob thams cad kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas/ spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa rab tu 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa dang / khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rnam grol gyi lam la 'god nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig 'di bris dge bas sangs rgyas sa thob shog yi ge pa ni bzang ldan nor bus zhus/ /maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus/ yang zhus lags// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 502 a myes zhabs/ dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
